gist: Opening greeting over music: welcomes the viewers and thanks them for joining.
Says the main dilemma of our life is that all of us are unhappy and caught up in our sorrows; the end of the sentence is garbled in the caption.

hindi: जो सूरज स्वयं चमकता है वह सूरज अपनी रोशनी के द्वारा प्रसन्न रहता है जब भी आप दूसरे व्यक्ति पर डिपेंडेंट होते हैं तो चांद की तरह होते हैं नमस्कार जो चंदा मामा थोड़ा बहुत चमकता है
says: He sets up a Sun versus Moon contrast: the Sun shines by its own light and so stays content, while a person who leans on others is like the Moon, which glows only because of the Sun. Sun stands for self-reliance, Moon for dependence on someone else.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts treat the Moon as shining by the Sun's light and as the dependent, reflective mind, and the Sun as the self (atma karaka).

gist: Says that if your happiness depends on someone else you cannot be happy, and only the self-dependent person is happy; the sentence trails off into the next lines.
Mahabharata example: Duryodhana had great warriors like Bhishma, Karna and Drona beside him, yet he depended on them and was ruined.
Repeats the same point: if you expect your wife, husband, brother or child to give you happiness, you are heading for ruin.

hindi: आप दूसरे व्यक्ति से राहु केतु मंगल बुध बृहस्पति सूर्य की औरा लेने के चक्कर में हैं और आपके यह ग्रह वीक हो जाएंगे
says: He claims that depending on another person is really an attempt to borrow that person's aura of Rahu, Ketu, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Sun, and the result is that your own versions of these six planets become weak.
ambiguity: 'Aura' is his own word and the mechanism is not explained; Venus, Moon and Saturn are not named, which may be real or just how he listed them.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no idea of borrowing another person's planetary aura; planet strength comes from the person's own chart (dignity, shadbala).

gist: Medicine analogy: once the body is made to depend on one medicine, only that medicine heals you and you cannot get well without it.
Urges the listener to depend on themselves, saying you can command yourself to stay calm, cheerful and free of anger.

hindi: लेकिन यह खुद हो नहीं पाता यह खुद इसलिए नहीं हो पाता क्योंकि हमारे ग्रह हमारे जीवन का 12 पर हमें अलाव नहीं करता
says: He says self-command usually fails because our planets control a fixed slice of life, which he calls '12 par' (most likely 12 percent), and that slice does not allow us to simply order ourselves to be calm.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is probably 12 percent (later lines contrast it with 72 and 6) but the caption is garbled; 'अलाव नहीं करता' is most likely 'allow nahin karta' (does not allow).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts speak of prarabdha and purushartha in general terms and give no percentage split.

gist: Describes the usual lament: we ask why this is happening when we never wanted it, and every mind is running some desires.
Says that since we cannot fulfil our own desires ourselves, we start expecting relatives like brother, uncle, husband, wife and children to give us happiness.
Repeats that until you can give yourself happiness your life stays like the Moon, which has no light of its own.
Says the blame we put on brother, wife or child is wrong: they trouble, fail to support or fail to love us only because we are not yet worthy of that, so the fault is ours.
Says workers not listening and goods not selling come from a shortcoming in you.

hindi: इस कमी को ठीक करने के लिए हमें समझना पड़ेगा हमारे ऐसे कौन से ग्रह हैं जो हमारे अंदर एक कमी लाकर छोड़ते हैं
says: He states the aim of the course: to fix the inner deficiency that causes our troubles we have to learn which of our planets leave a deficiency inside us.
ambiguity: He does not say here which planets or how; this is a statement of what the class will cover.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts do tie personal weaknesses to afflicted or weak planets, but not in this framing.

gist: Joke: after hearing lectures one resolves to do good karma and donate, but the moment charity is thought of, a doctor's bill turns up and mysterious troubles begin.

hindi: कोई रोक रहा है हमें कुछ करने से यह कौन रोक रहा है यह हमारे बुध मंगल बृहस्पति इत्यादि इत्यादि ग्रह हैं जो कहते हैं इधर कोई चल इधर कोई चल चल सड़क ही इधर है जाना ही नहीं
says: He answers who is stopping us from acting on our good resolutions: our own planets such as Mercury, Mars and Jupiter, each shouting 'go this way, go that way', so we never walk a road of our own.
ambiguity: The 'etc.' means other planets are included; only three are named.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: each planet has its own karakatva and the mix of dashas and placements can pull a person in different directions; the road image is his own.

hindi: जब तक आपकी वन पॉइंटेड अटेंशन नहीं होगी कि नहीं मैं इसी प्रकार चलूंगा तब तक पुरुषार्थ नहीं होगा
says: He says purushartha, real self-driven effort, does not begin until you have one-pointed attention and a firm decision to walk one chosen way, instead of being pulled by the planets.
classical_check: Silent: one-pointed attention (ekagrata) is a yoga idea; Jyotish texts only discuss purushartha as a general counterweight to fate.

hindi: पुरुष और प्रकृति दो चीज चलती है पुरुष मींस मैं क्या कर सकता हूं मैं कौन जो मैं शरीर नहीं है मैं इस समय इस पुरुष शरीर में रह रहा हूं मेरे इस पुरुष शरीर का नाम बृजेश गौतम है
says: He defines Purusha as the 'I' that asks what can I do, which is not the body but the one living in it for now (he gives his own body name as the example); Purusha is the doer half of the pair Purusha and Prakriti.
classical_check: Agrees with the Samkhya and Gita meaning of purusha as the conscious self, not the body; Jyotish texts only borrow the idea.

hindi: इसके साथ एक प्रकृति है प्रकृति क्या है जो मेरे प्रारब्ध में लिखे हुए मुन्ना के कर्मों द्वारा संचित 12 पर भाग्य है
says: He defines Prakriti as the fixed fate that goes with the person: the '12 par' (probably 12 percent) of destiny written in prarabdha and stored up by earlier karmas.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना के कर्मों' is garbled and probably means past or earlier karmas; '12 पर' is probably 12 percent.
classical_check: Agrees in idea: prarabdha is the part of past karma already ripe, and the birth chart is read as its map; the 12 percent figure is not classical.

gist: Voices a typical complaint list: why am I unhappy, why do sister, uncles not make me happy, why is there no money, no name, why do my legs hurt.

hindi: क्योंकि हमने ज्ञान नहीं लिया ज्ञान एक अकेली ऐसी चीज है जो हमारे 12 पर के अलावा 6 पर अल्फा ब्रेन को ऑन करती है
says: He puts all those troubles down to not having taken knowledge, and says knowledge is the only thing that switches on a separate '6 par' (probably 6 percent) part, the alpha brain, outside the fixed 12 percent of fate.
ambiguity: The numbers 12 and 6 are percentages only if the caption is right; this is the first place the 6 part appears.
classical_check: Silent: the alpha brain is a modern notion; classical texts link learning to Jupiter and the 5th and 9th houses without a brain model.

gist: Explains why this matters in the astrology class: unless your alpha brain is on, the subject will not sink in.
Says you sit two hours in a satsang and bring home just one sutra, which is enough; the rest is chatter, and many things you will not understand.
Warns against going mad for money: among body, mind and wealth, more of one reduces another, so take only knowledge and nothing else.

hindi: एक पूरी क्लास हम करेंगे बृहस्पति ग्रह पर जो ज्ञान है सिर्फ ज्ञान
says: He announces a full class on the planet Jupiter and identifies Jupiter with knowledge, pure knowledge.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of jnana (knowledge), wisdom and the guru.

gist: Ladder of effort: once knowledge comes there is nothing to do; first work hard, then work less, then hire a manager, then stop even hiring; follow whichever step you are on.
Says the greatest meditation is to know at every moment what is going on inside you.

hindi: हम कमर सीधी करके बैठे जाप करें यह करें वो करें यह हिप्नोसिस है यह चंदा मामा कराता है चंद्रमा आपके चंद्रमा के दोष के कारण से आप हिप्नोसिस में फंसते हैं
says: He calls sitting upright, chanting and doing rituals a form of hypnosis that the Moon causes, and says a flaw (dosha) in your Moon is why you get trapped in it and keep saying you must turn the mala and do japa.
cells_derived_method: He does not say what the Moon dosha is. Derived from classical dignity and house logic: the dosha is heaviest when the Moon is debilitated (Scorpio), afflicted by Saturn or Rahu, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th; it is light when the Moon is exalted or in its own sign in a kendra or trikona.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 12th house (lagna Sagittarius). A weak Moon in a house of loss and withdrawal is the clearest 'Moon dosha' picture, so by his logic the pull into chanting and ritual as an escape would be strong.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius). A strong Moon in its natural house shows little dosha, so ritual would be a calm choice and not a hypnotic trap.

Derived, not said by him: Moon in Saturn's sign Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo). Mind is tied to routine, duty and repetition, so mechanical repeated practice is likely, but the dosha is moderate, not severe.

ambiguity: He does not define 'Moon dosha' or say which placements cause it.
classical_check: Differs: classical remedial texts prescribe japa and mantra for planets including the Moon (Chandra japa); the Moon is manas karaka, but calling ritual hypnosis from a Moon dosha is his own view.

hindi: चंद्रमा वाटर कंटेंट होता है जल तत्व
says: He identifies the Moon with water content, the water element (jala tattva).
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is a watery planet and tied to fluids and the mind; Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces are the water signs.

hindi: हमारा देश जल तत्व को रिप्रेजेंट करता है हमारे देश में बड़े उत्साह से धूमधाम से बहुत कुछ मनाया जाता है बड़े प्रेम वाले काम होते हैं
says: He says India as a country represents the water element, and gives as proof that in India many things are celebrated with great zeal and pomp and many loving, emotional works get done.
ambiguity: This is a mundane (country-level) claim, not a chart rule; the Moon link is implied by the neighbouring lines but not said in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical mundane astrology ties nations to signs and charts, not to one element.

hindi: बड़े प्रेम वाले काम होते हैं चंद्रमा इमोशन
says: He names the Moon as emotion, the planet behind feelings and love-driven action.
cells_derived_method: How emotion plays out is read from the Moon's sign and house: water signs and the 4th house make feeling deep and steady, Saturn-ruled or earthy placements make it guarded, and 6th, 8th and 12th placements turn emotion toward worry, intensity or withdrawal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). Emotion is rooted in home and mother and is steady and nurturing.
Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 6th house (lagna Gemini). Emotion turns into worry, grudge and friction with rivals or at work.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo). Emotion becomes public and caring, suited to work that serves people.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Gemini in the 12th house (lagna Cancer). Emotion is restless and thought-driven, withdrawn into private imagination and spending.

ambiguity: The sentence is the tail of the water-element line; the first half is about loving works in India (see the previous row).
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is karaka of mind, mood and emotion.

hindi: हमारे जीवन के अंदर जितना भी नॉर्दर्न एरिया है नॉर्थ नॉर्थ ईस्ट यह सारा का सारा जल तत्व होता है वास्तु के अंदर
says: He gives a Vastu rule that the whole northern area, meaning north and north-east, is the water element.
ambiguity: 'In our life' most likely means the home or plot; whether he means north-east alone or north too is stated as both.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Vastu gives water to the north-east (Ishanya); the north is tied to water in many modern schemes though classical sources give it to Kubera and Mercury.

hindi: और हमारे शरीर में 72 पर जल है 72 पर 72 पर जल मीन सबसे ज्यादा बड़ा फर्क डालने वाला ये 72 पर तत्व है जो हमारे शरीर के अंतर्गत हमारे 12 पर के अलावा चलेगा
says: He says about 72 percent of the body is water, that this water element makes the biggest difference to a person, and that it works on its own, apart from the 12 percent that the chart fixes.
ambiguity: 'जल मीन' is garbled and may be 'jal means'; the Moon link (water equals Moon) is implied from the earlier lines but not said here.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; the 72 percent figure is also higher than the usual textbook 60 percent or so for adult body water.

hindi: 12 पर भाग्य जो जन्मपत्री होती है कुंडली होती है 72 पर आपका शरीर जो भी जल से ही बना है यह प्रारब्ध है
says: He says the 12 percent of fate is what the janmapatri or kundali shows, while the 72 percent, your water-made body, is also prarabdha; so the birth chart covers only a small part of what a person is living.
ambiguity: 'यह प्रारब्ध है' may point to the 12 percent only or to both parts; read here as covering both.
classical_check: Agrees that the kundali maps prarabdha; the percentage split is not classical.

hindi: 72 पर कहते हैं कुछ करके दिखा यार कुछ इन्वेस्टमेंट कर आप शरीर की ताकत झोक देते हैं साथ में 6 प्र आप ज्ञान डालते हैं अल्फा ब्रेन
says: He says the 72 percent water-body part pushes you to go and show something by investing effort, so you throw in your body's strength, and alongside it you add knowledge through the 6 percent alpha brain.
ambiguity: 'इन्वेस्टमेंट' here means putting in effort; it is not financial advice and he gives no money rule.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text splits life into body-effort and knowledge percentages.

hindi: यह ज्ञान देने की कृपा भी इस 12 पर में छुपी है 72 पर शरीर को चलाने की कृपा भी 12 में ही छुपी है यह सारा का सारा
says: He says the grace that gives knowledge and the grace that keeps the 72 percent body running are both hidden inside the fixed 12 percent of fate.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the end of this slice ('this whole thing...') and continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Silent: grace (kripa) as the hidden source of knowledge and bodily energy is devotional philosophy, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: चंदा मामा से होगा जल तत्व भारत देश जल से पूर्ण रूप से दाए बाए पकड़ा हुआ है
says: He ties the water element to the Moon ('chanda mama') and backs his claim that India is a water country with geography: the country is held by water on both its left and right sides.
ambiguity: A mundane (country-level) claim; the first three words may also be read as 'the water element will come from the Moon'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not assign India an element this way; the Moon as water planet is classical.

hindi: बहुत इमोशनल लोग हैं हम अत्यधिक इमोशनल है धर्म को ऐसा पकड़ के चलते हैं बस भगवान हे प्रभु फलाना ढम काना कहीं अलग धर्म कहीं अलग धर्म
says: He says Indians, as people of a water country, are extremely emotional and cling to religion in an emotional way, crying 'O God, O Lord', with one dharma in one place and another dharma elsewhere.
ambiguity: The Moon link (emotion equals Moon) is implied from the earlier lines; he does not name the Moon in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: national character is not treated by classical texts as a Moon or water-element effect.

hindi: सनातन धर्म मीन सर्वव्यापी हर जगह चलने वाला हर जगह चलने रहने वाला क्या है आकाश लेकिन उसमें चलने वाला क्या है जल
says: He glosses Sanatan dharma as the all-pervading thing present everywhere, which he identifies with akash (space), and says that what moves inside space is water.
ambiguity: 'मीन' here is almost certainly the caption's spelling of 'means', not the sign Pisces.
classical_check: Agrees that akash is the all-pervading element and that water is a distinct, flowing one; classical Jyotish gives akash to Jupiter, which he does not say here.

hindi: जल है जो हरकत देता है हर प्लेनेट पर ढूंढा जाता है कि पानी है पानी नहीं है जीव नहीं है जल ही जीवन है
says: He says water is what gives movement and life: on every planet we look first for water, and where there is no water there are no living beings, so water is life.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; it is a general statement about the water element, not a chart rule.

hindi: अगर आपका चंदा मामा मन मुन्ना मुन्ना को हिलाने डराने वाला जो एक महीने में पूरे के पूरे गोलगोल बारा जोडिक्स में घूम जाता है इस चंदा मामा को आपने संभालना सीख लिया तो जीवन ठीक हो जाता है
says: He says the Moon is the mind, the planet that shakes and frightens us and goes round the whole zodiac of twelve signs in one month, and that if you learn to handle your Moon your life comes right.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is the caption's garbling of 'mann' (mind); 'बारा जोडिक्स' is twelve zodiac signs.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is manas karaka and completes the zodiac in about 27 to 29 days, the fastest planet.

hindi: अब मन जो है य नाचता है भागता है अपने आप दौड़ा दौड़ाई करता है और यह मन हमारा विचलित होता है
says: He describes the nature of the mind: it dances, runs off and rushes about by itself, and so our mind keeps getting disturbed.
ambiguity: He speaks of 'mind' here; the Moon is implied by the previous line (mind equals Moon).
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon, as the fast-moving mind-planet, is classically restless and changeable.

hindi: आपका चंद्रमा अगर दूषित है तो आपके जीवन में पानी पीने के हिसाब से ही सुबह से रात तक सब बदल देगा
says: He says a tainted or afflicted Moon will change everything in your day from morning to night, down to the way you drink water; the afflicted Moon is blamed for disturbed daily habits.
cells_derived_method: He does not say which placements make the Moon dosha. Derived with classical dignity and house logic: debilitation in Scorpio, a weak Moon in dusthanas 6, 8 or 12, or Saturn or Rahu influence worsen the daily rhythm; an exalted or own-sign Moon in a good house keeps it steady.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). A weak Moon in the house of upheaval; the daily rhythm, including eating and drinking habits, would swing hard from morning to night.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Saturn's sign Aquarius in the 6th house (lagna Virgo). Mind tied to worry and duty, so the routine is disturbed by stress and irregular habits.

Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries). A strong unafflicted Moon gives a steady daily rhythm and regular eating and drinking habits, so the day does not swing.

ambiguity: 'पानी पीने के हिसाब से' is vague: it could mean water intake, or just 'down to the smallest daily habit'. No health claim is made or diagnosed here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts connect an afflicted Moon with an unsettled mind and irregular habits; the water-drinking detail is his own.

hindi: और शाम का समय जब चंद्रमा का आता है तो सूर्य गायब हो जाता है यानी सारे माइक्रोब्स बैक्टीरिया सारे के सारे नेगेटिव वाइब्रेशन जो कहते हैं भूत पिशाच इत्यादि नेगेटिव शक्तियां ऑन हो जाती हैं
says: He says that when evening comes, the Moon's time, the Sun disappears and the negative side switches on: microbes, bacteria, negative vibrations and what are called ghosts and spirits become active.
ambiguity: The microbe and ghost claims are his folk-science framing, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Partly agrees: night is the Moon's (and Mars's and Saturn's) time in classical kala bala, and tradition links night with spirits; the microbe claim is not classical.

hindi: इसलिए रात का समय जो है यह विशेष तौर पर हमें रख दिया गया कि सो जाओ लुड़क जाओ भैया
says: Because night is the time of the negative forces, he says night has been set apart for us specially so that we simply go to sleep and stay out of it.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; Ayurveda also advises night sleep, but classical Jyotish gives no such rule.

hindi: कुछ लोगों के चंदा मामाही बड़े डिफरेंटली काम करते हैं तो उनको रात का समय पॉजिटिव है
says: He makes an exception to the night rule: for some people the Moon works very differently, and for them the night hours are positive and productive.
cells_derived_method: He does not say which Moons are the exception. Derived from classical logic: the Moon has directional strength in the 4th house and night-time strength generally, so a strong, well-placed Moon suits night; a debilitated or afflicted Moon makes night restless.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries), where it has directional strength. Night hours feel safe and productive, so night suits this person.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the lagna (lagna Taurus). A calm, strong mind that works comfortably at night.

Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 12th house (lagna Sagittarius). Night is more likely a time of unrest and overthinking than of benefit, the opposite of his positive-night case.

ambiguity: 'चंदा मामाही' is the caption's 'chanda mama hi' (it is the Moon itself that works differently); he gives no test for who is in this group.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Moon, Mars and Saturn gain night strength (kala bala) in classical texts, so a night-strong Moon person doing well at night is consistent.

hindi: इसलिए याद रखें रूल बुक कोई नहीं है
says: He warns that there is no single rule book of routines that fits everyone; what is right for one person's temperament need not suit another's.
ambiguity: A short caption line; the explanation comes in the sentences that follow about the elements.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts also fit advice to the individual chart, not to everyone.

hindi: यह जल तत्व के लोग जो होते हैं बड़े होते हैं और यह ना सुबह जितना लेट आराम से उठे उतना इनकी जिंदगी सुखी है
says: He says for water-element people the later and more leisurely they get up in the morning, the happier their life is; early rising is not for them.
cells_derived_method: He does not say how to tell a water-element person. Taking the Moon's sign as a proxy (Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces are the water signs) and the Moon's house as the modifier, the rule fits a water-sign Moon best and a fire-sign Moon least.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own water sign Cancer in the lagna (lagna Cancer). The clearest water type; relaxed late rising suits this person by his rule.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in water sign Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius). Dreamy, home-loving mornings; a slow late start is natural.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in fire sign Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer). Not a water type by sign, so the late-rising rule may not fit and an active early start is more natural.

ambiguity: 'बड़े होते हैं' is unclear (perhaps 'bade mast hote hain'); the Moon link comes from the previous lines, not this sentence. Lifestyle advice, not a medical claim.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish gives no wake-up rule by element; Ayurveda (kapha types) is the nearest parallel.

hindi: अब लोग कहते हैं सुबह सुबह उठना चाहिए यह करना चाहिए याद रखो हम सब मनुष्य अलग है
says: He pushes back on the common advice that everyone should wake up at dawn and follow one routine, saying we human beings are all different from one another.
classical_check: Silent: it argues against a general wellness norm, not against a Jyotish rule.

gist: Analogy: companies make identical washing machines and robots, but human beings are not identical.

hindi: हम मनुष्य कैसे अलग है बिल्कुल डिफरेंट है क्योंकि हमारे तत्व अलग है किसी चीज में इस तरह के पंचतत्व नहीं है
says: He explains why people differ: each person has a different mix of the five elements (panchatattva), and no two people carry them in the same combination.
ambiguity: He does not say here how the personal element mix is measured from the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in idea: classical astrology gives each sign and planet an element, so the chart carries a personal mix; he gives no formula.

hindi: जो जल तत्व का व्यक्ति है आराम से उठता है सुबह उसकी लाइफ उतनी ही बढ़िया धीरे-धीरे काम करता है आलसी टाइप थोड़ा सा होता है मस्ती में रहता है फट रो लिया फट खुश
says: He sketches the water-element person: slow in the morning, works gradually, a little lazy by type, easygoing and enjoying himself, quick to cry and just as quick to turn cheerful again, and with a good life.
ambiguity: 'फट रो लिया फट खुश' reads as 'cries quickly, quickly happy'; the Moon link is from the earlier water-element lines.
classical_check: Agrees in part: a Moon or water-sign nature is classically emotional, changeable and easygoing; 'lazy' is more a Jupiter or kapha note.

gist: Voices what onlookers say about such a person: is he mad, does nothing, wakes late, yet is enjoying life.

hindi: उसने उस तत्व को सेटल किया है उसके लिए काम कौन कर रहा है दूर अंतरिक्ष में बैठा चंद्रमा चंद्रमा कह रहा है तम मेरे हिसाब से चल रहा है ना मजे में र है
says: He says the easygoing late-riser has settled his water element, so the Moon sitting far away in space does the work for him and tells him to live by its rhythm and stay happy.
ambiguity: 'तम' is 'tum' (you) and 'र है' is 'rah' (stay); 'settled the element' means has the Moon in order, which he does not define.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no idea that a settled planet works for the person; it speaks of strength and dasha results.

hindi: नहीं सुबह उठो प्राणायाम करो अभ्यास करो फलाना करो वो वायु तत्व के लोग करेंगे
says: He says that waking early, pranayama and regular practice are what air-element people will do; it is their way, not everyone's.
cells_derived_method: He gives no rule for who is an air person. The planet comes from his next sentence (air equals Mercury) and the cells cannot be derived from what he says here, so none are listed.
ambiguity: The planet is taken from the next sentence (air equals Mercury); this sentence says only 'air-element people'.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish gives no routine by element; classically Saturn, not Mercury, is the air planet.

hindi: मेहनत कर दिन रात पागल हो जा छोड़यो मत कुछ भी यह अग्नि तत्व के लोग काम करेंगे
says: He says that working day and night like mad, leaving nothing aside, is what fire-element people will do.
cells_derived_method: He gives no rule for who is a fire person. The planet comes from his next sentence (fire equals Mars); no cells can be derived from what he says here, so none are listed.
ambiguity: The planet is taken from the next sentence (fire equals Mars).
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Mars and the fire signs are classically the driven, hard-working type.

hindi: अग्नि तत्व मंगल ग्रह हो गया वायु तत्व बुध ग्रह हो गया
says: He fixes his element-to-planet mapping: the fire element is Mars and the air element is Mercury.
classical_check: Differs in part: fire to Mars is classical (as is the Sun), but Parashari tattvas give Mercury the earth element and Saturn the air; Mercury as air is a Western-style mapping.

hindi: बेटा कुछ बोलो कमाओ धमा हो वो बुध के कारण होगा
says: He says speaking up and earning, the trading and talking side of life, happens through Mercury.
ambiguity: 'धमा' is garbled (possibly 'dhamaal' or 'dhandha'); the sense of speaking and earning is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is karaka of speech, commerce and trade.

hindi: ज्ञान चर्चा करो बृहस्पति के कारण होगा
says: He says discussing knowledge and holding wisdom talks happens because of Jupiter.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of learning, teaching and religious discourse.

hindi: राग रंग में रहो यार पार्टी करो परफ्यूम लगाओ एंड सोने की चेने पहन पहन के शुक्र के द्वारा काम होगा
says: He says pleasure and merrymaking, parties, perfume and wearing gold chains all come through Venus.
classical_check: Agrees on pleasure, perfume and ornaments for Venus; classically gold is more Jupiter's, while Venus gets silver, diamonds and fine jewellery.

hindi: ए मले कुचले कपड़ों में घूमते हो साले कंग भिखारी लगते हो शनि महाराज की जय हो
says: He ties wearing crumpled, soiled clothes and looking like a pauper to Saturn, jokingly adding a 'Shani Maharaj ki jai'; it is the Saturn type's shabby look.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's dignity and house change how strongly the shabby look shows: a debilitated Saturn in a house of home or comfort shows it most; an exalted or own-sign Saturn gives plain but dignified dress.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn). Austere and plain but dignified and well kept, not shabby.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn). Neglect of home comfort and personal upkeep, closest to his shabby picture.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign Aquarius in the 7th house (lagna Leo), where it has directional strength. Sober, simple dress and a plain public manner.

ambiguity: 'कंग' is 'kangal' (pauper). The remark is partly a joke; the claim is Saturn equals the plain, untidy look.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is classically the karaka of old, dirty and coarse clothing and of the poor.

hindi: बंदा किसी से सीधे मुंह बात करके राजी नहीं टेढ़े हिसाब से बात करेगा हिलता ही नहीं
says: He describes a person who will not talk straight to anyone, speaks in a crooked, roundabout way and will not budge, which by his order of planets is the Saturn type.
ambiguity: No planet is named in the sentence; read as Saturn because it follows the Saturn line and the next sentence starts with Rahu.
classical_check: Partly agrees: rigidity and slowness are Saturn's, but crooked, indirect speech is classically more Rahu or Mercury.

hindi: राहु की सिर्फ काम करता है बंदा मुंह से बोलता ही नहीं मुंह में पान दाब रखा है बकवास करा के दिखाओ उसे सिर्फ पकने के लिए मुंह खोलता है
says: He sketches the Rahu type as a man who only works and hardly speaks, keeps paan pressed in his mouth, and opens his mouth only for a purpose he hints at in a garbled phrase.
ambiguity: 'सिर्फ पकने के लिए' is garbled (possibly 'pakane', to bore or irritate, or something else); 'राहु की' is the start of 'Rahu's [grace or type]'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is classically obsessive and silent in work and the karaka of tobacco and intoxicants, which fits the paan.

hindi: केतु ऑन है दौड़ा भगाई पर लगे रहता है अयाशी करता है बाप के टुकड़ों पर पलता साला करना धरना कुछ नहीं
says: He describes a person with Ketu 'on' as always busy running about, given to indulgence, living off his father's crumbs and doing nothing useful himself.
ambiguity: 'ऑन है' means the planet is active or switched on in the person.
classical_check: Differs: classical Ketu is detachment, wandering and moksha; indulgence and living off the father is not a standard Ketu karakatva.

hindi: इंद्र यूरेनस न है नेपच्यून घूम रहे हैं भटक रहे हैं सिर्फ देखा दिखाई का काम कर रहे हैं सिक्योरिटी सर्विसेस के काम कर रहे हैं
says: He says Indra (Uranus) and Neptune types roam and wander about, do the work of watching and observing, and work in security services.
ambiguity: 'यूरेनस न है' is likely 'Uranus and' with a stray syllable; the grouping of both under one description is his.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus and Neptune are outside classical Parashari Jyotish, and the Indra and Varuna naming is his own scheme.

hindi: हजार आंख वाला देवता है नेप्चून वरुण देव
says: He identifies Neptune with the god Varuna, calling him the thousand-eyed deity.
classical_check: Silent: Varuna is the Vedic god of waters and sees all, but classical Jyotish does not equate him with a planet; the thousand-eyed epithet is also given to Indra.

hindi: करना धरना कुछ नहीं औरों से करा रहे हैं साली टीम लगा रखिए 500 आदमी काम करता है कंपनी के नीचे वरुण की कृपा है यह कृपा जिसने ले ली मौज हो गई
says: He says Neptune's (Varuna's) grace is the person who does nothing himself and gets others to do the work, with a team of say 500 men working under his company; whoever has taken this grace has an easy life.
ambiguity: 'साली टीम' is a casual expletive-style phrase for 'a big team'; 500 is an illustration.
classical_check: Silent: delegation and large teams are not a classical karakatva of any planet in the nine-planet scheme.

hindi: प्लूटो बड़े बड़े ठेकेदार होते हैं य स्क्रैप का काम कर रहे हैं लाला जी क्या करते हो अंग्रेजी आती है नहीं नोट आते हैं भट्टी में ट्रक जाते हैं हमारे प्लूटो की कृपा है कमाल की बात है
says: He links Pluto to big contractors and scrap dealers: a trader who cannot speak English still sees money coming in as trucks of scrap go to the furnace, which he calls Pluto's grace.
ambiguity: This is an occupation example, not financial advice.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not classical; scrap, iron and heavy contracts would classically fall to Saturn and Mars.

hindi: वह क्या कर रहे हैं उन्होंने ग्रह से कृपा ली है ग्रह को ऑन करना सीखो फिर कर्म क्या करो
says: He says the successful people in his examples simply took grace from a planet, so the lesson is to learn how to switch a planet on; once that is done the question of what effort to make changes.
ambiguity: How one 'switches a planet on' is not said here; it is promised in the later classes.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies (puja, mantra, dana) aim to win a planet's favour, but 'switching a planet on' is his phrasing.

gist: Says those who have no understanding should keep up the flag of hard work, because working hard is what they should do.

hindi: ज्ञानी व्यक्ति क्या करता है ज्ञानी व्यक्ति खोपड़ी से कमाता है अमीर कौन है हाथ से तो काम ही नहीं करता वह खोपड़ी से कमाता है
says: He says a person of knowledge earns with his head and not his hands, and that the truly rich do not work with their hands at all but earn through thinking.
ambiguity: Jupiter (knowledge) is implied from the earlier lines but not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give intellect-based income to Mercury, Jupiter and the 2nd and 5th houses, not as a ladder of work types.

hindi: और बहुत उससे ऊपर कौन है जो बाबा जी के चरण छूते फिरते हैं ना कई बाबा जी के मजे हैं वो वो है जिन्होंने कृपा लेनी सीख ली
says: He places one level above the head-earner those who have learned to take grace, pointing to the many babas who live in comfort and the people who go round touching their feet.
ambiguity: The sentence is loose; I read it as a ladder with hand-work lowest, head-work above it and grace-taking highest.
classical_check: Silent: this is his own ranking of ways to live, not a chart rule.

hindi: अगर आपने कृपा लेनी सीख ली इसका महत्व जान लिया कुछ करने की जरूरत नहीं है
says: He says that once you have learned to take grace and understand its importance there is nothing left that you need to do.
ambiguity: Taken at face value this contradicts his own call for hard work; he explains the contradiction as different levels in the lines after.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish treats remedies and grace as an aid alongside karma, not a replacement for effort.

gist: Krishna told Arjuna to act and do karma while Krishna himself did nothing, because he knew what lies beyond, and asked Arjuna to simply follow him.
Guru Nanak's example: he said only Waheguru and surrendered mind, speech and action to God; many levels of surrender exist.
Explains the apparent contradiction that he sometimes says work hard and sometimes says do not: they are different levels, so go beyond effort when you are ready.
Asks what to do then and answers: party, meaning live in observation with the attitude of a witness.

hindi: हमारा साक्षी भाव छिन जाता है यह साक्षी भाव कौन है यह वो छ परसेंट ज्ञान है
says: He says our witness attitude (sakshi bhava) gets snatched from us, and identifies that witness with the 6 percent of knowledge, the alpha-brain part, mentioned earlier.
ambiguity: This line confirms that the earlier '6 पर' means 6 percent. What snatches the witness is not said here.
classical_check: Silent: sakshi bhava is a Vedanta idea; Jyotish has no percentage for it.

hindi: भारत हमारा वाटर कंट्री है पार्टी करते हैं लोग बढ़िया से अग्नि लेकर मारने आए कई अक्रांता मार देंगे काट देंगे पानी को कभी आग बुझा सकती है नेवर
says: He says India is a water country where people enjoy life well, and that invaders who came with fire to kill and cut could never put out the water, since fire can never extinguish water.
ambiguity: A mundane and political-historical claim, not a chart rule; physically fire can boil water away, so the line is symbolic.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not treat water as unbeatable by fire.

hindi: तभी लोग कहते हैं सनातन इतने सालों से चल रहा है बड़े-बड़े आक्रांत आ है कभी नहीं मरे हम मरेंगे भी नहीं हमारा जल तत्व है कहीं जा ही नहीं सकते
says: He offers Sanatan dharma's survival through so many years and so many invaders as proof of the water element: we have not died, will not die, and have nowhere to go because we are water.
ambiguity: A cultural and political claim; 'आक्रांत आ है' is garbled and means invaders came.
classical_check: Silent: nothing in Jyotish ties a civilisation's survival to its element.

hindi: जिसका जल तत्त्वन ठहराव वाला व्यक्ति है हले हले मध्यम चलता रहता है उसे बर्बाद किया ही नहीं जा सकता कभी भी नहीं बर्बाद हो सकता वो
says: He claims a person with a steady water nature, who keeps moving slowly and moderately, cannot be ruined at all, ever.
ambiguity: 'जल तत्त्वन' is probably 'jal tattva wala'; 'हले हले' is 'dheere dheere'. The claim is absolute (never ruined) and has no measured basis.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts promise no such immunity for any element or sign.

hindi: इसलिए आपके अंदर की तरंग क्या है उसको जानने समझने के लिए आपको यह जानना जरूरी है कि आपका जो चंदा मामा जल तत्व है इसे ठीक करना
says: He says that to know your own inner wave (tarang), you must first know your Moon, the water element, and fix it; the Moon is the starting point of self-understanding in his scheme.
ambiguity: 'तरंग' means vibration or inner wave; he does not say how to fix the Moon here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts prescribe remedies for a weak Moon and treat the Moon as the mind, but the 'fix it first' priority is his.

hindi: चंदा मामा हमारी मां होती है माता मां मासी नानी चाची फलाना ढम काना सारे उसी तरह से च लगा के चलिए
says: He says the Moon is our mother, and by extension the whole circle of mother-type women (mother, maternal aunt, maternal grandmother, paternal uncle's wife and the like) should be counted under the Moon.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's sign, house and affliction show how the bond with the mother and mother-side women runs: a strong Moon in the 4th is warm; a Moon in a dusthana or in an airy, changeable sign gives strain and ups and downs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). A warm, supportive mother and a close bond with the maternal side.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Gemini in the 8th house (lagna Scorpio). Changeable bond with mother and her side of the family, with hidden worries and ups and downs.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Virgo in the 2nd house (lagna Leo). Mother-side women are practical and careful, and the bond shows through care, service and a critical tongue.

ambiguity: The last words ('च लगा के चलिए') are garbled; read as 'count them all as Moon'.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon is karaka of the mother and of maternal relatives; paternal uncle's wife is not usually Moon, so that part is his extension.

hindi: जो हमारा एंब्रियो निक फ्लूइड होता है जिसके अंतर्गत शिशु पलता है वही एंब्रियो एक फ्लूइड हमारा सेरेब्रो स्पाइनल फ्लूइड बनता है जो हमारी रीड की हड्डी में नरिच मेंट करता है हमारे स्पाइन को
says: Continuing the mother and water line, he says the fluid in which the baby grows in the womb later becomes the cerebrospinal fluid that nourishes the spine, so the mother's water is carried inside us for life.
ambiguity: This is a body-science claim, not a diagnosis; the Moon link is implied from the previous sentence, not stated.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no such physiology; Ayurveda and modern biology are the relevant sources and this claim is not verified here.

hindi: यानी मुन्ना की जिंदगी एंड मुन्ना इज एवरीथिंग मन के जीते जीत है मन के हारे हार
says: He sums up that the mind (the Moon) is everything in a person's life: victory and defeat both lie in the mind, so if you win in the mind you win, and if you lose in the mind you lose.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is the caption's garbling of 'mann' (mind), which he equates with the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the mind (manas karaka) and the old proverb 'man ke jeete jeet' is not from Jyotish but fits the idea.

hindi: यह मन जो दूसरे से भीख मांगता है वो क्यों मांगता है क्योंकि हमारा मंगल बुध बृहस्पति वीक है इसलिए हम दूसरे से भीख मांग माते रहते हैं
says: He says the mind begs from others because our Mars, Mercury and Jupiter are weak, and so we keep asking other people for what we lack.
cells_derived_method: He does not define weak. Derived from classical dignity: debilitation (Mars in Cancer, Mercury in Pisces, Jupiter in Capricorn) or placement in 6, 8 or 12 weakens the planet; the house shows the area where we beg.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). Drive and courage are weak where security is sought, so the person leans on family for support.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 7th house (lagna Virgo). Judgment is weak and decisions are handed to a partner or others.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 11th house (lagna Pisces). Guidance and wisdom are weak, so wishes are met by asking friends and the network.

ambiguity: 'वीक' means weak but no test is given; 'भीख मांग माते' is garbled but clear in meaning.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link weak Mars, Mercury and Jupiter specifically to dependence on others.

gist: Example: we ask a neighbour for chutney we do not have, but whoever gives it will take something in return.

hindi: यदि कोई पैसे खा गया और आपने यह ले लिया क्या खाए शायद मेरे लेनदेन होंगे छोड़ यार अगले जन्म में देगा आप फ्री हो गए आपका चंदा मामा फ्री हो गया आपके 6 पर ज्ञान ऊर्जा ऑन हो गई
says: He recommends an attitude remedy: if someone has swallowed your money, accept it as an old give-and-take account, say he can repay in the next birth and let go, and then the cosmos adjusts the account, your Moon becomes free and your 6 percent knowledge energy switches on.
ambiguity: A mindset remedy from his own teaching, not financial or legal advice; he does not say when one should pursue a debt instead.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; the give-and-take karmic ledger (rinanubandhan) idea is from popular dharma teaching, not the classical texts.

gist: Repeats that expecting things from others day and night makes our life hell.
Starts an anecdote about someone whose manner of talking people wonder at; the slice ends mid-sentence.
Mid-thought remark about money owed to others and paying it on time, ending with 'that is just your own head talking, the other person is different'; the caption is too broken to follow fully.

hindi: अगर तुम्हारी कुंडली में मंगल ही दूषित है तो मजे की बात लो आपको कर्जा लेकर के ही लॉटरी लगेगी
says: He says that if Mars is afflicted in your kundli, then oddly your windfall (the 'lottery') will come only after you take a loan. He is describing a pattern for the afflicted-Mars person, not telling anyone to borrow.
cells_derived_method: He does not say what makes Mars afflicted. Derived from classical logic: debilitation in Cancer, Mars in 6, 8 or 12, or Rahu and Saturn influence count as affliction; the house shows the channel (6 loans, 8 others' money, 12 outlay) through which the loan-linked gain arrives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 8th house (lagna Sagittarius). Clearly afflicted Mars; the windfall would come through others' money, credit or borrowed funds and not through own earnings.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Gemini in the 6th house (lagna Capricorn). Mars in the house of debt is at home (an upachaya house), so the loan route works as a deliberate, managed business tool.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 12th house (lagna Taurus). Outlay-heavy pattern: loans fund large spending, and the gain shows later or away from home.

ambiguity: 'दूषित' is not defined; 'लॉटरी' means any sudden gain, not literally a lottery.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts tie Mars to debts and disputes and the 6th house to loans, but a windfall that comes only through borrowing is his own claim.

hindi: अंबानी अडानी कर्जा लेते हैं अपना पैसा है फिर भी कर्जा लेते हैं उन्हें पता है सूट करता है कर्जे पर कमाएंगे
says: He cites two famous Indian business magnates as proof that debt can suit a person: even with plenty of their own money they take loans, because they know borrowing works for them and they will earn on the borrowed money.
ambiguity: The Mars link is not said in this sentence; it comes from the line before and after. This records his claim about how some people profit from debt and is not investment advice.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss leverage as a planetary trait.

hindi: बावा भाव होता है मंगल वहां से लिंक रख ले तो भाई कर्जा ले लो किसी को ब्याज दो आपके कार्य में रुकावट आ रही है कर्जा लो
says: He gives a remedy-type rule: if there is a Mars link to a certain house (the caption garbles which), take a loan and pay interest to someone when your work is being blocked. This is his own debt-based remedy, recorded, not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: If the garbled 'बावा भाव' means the 6th house (house of debt and loans), then the remedy works through Mars's link to the 6th (Mars placed there or ruling it). Derived: Mars strong in the 6th makes the loan remedy workable; Mars weak or in a dusthana turns the loan into a burden.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 6th house (lagna Gemini). Strong Mars in the loan house; borrowing can be repaid with energy and clears blocked work.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 8th house (lagna Virgo). Loans arrive suddenly or through others' funds and carry hidden terms; the remedy needs care.
Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 12th house (lagna Leo). Weak Mars in the expense house: a loan drains more than it clears, so this remedy would work against the person.

ambiguity: 'बावा भाव' is garbled; it may be 'chhatha bhav' (6th house) but this is a guess. 'ब्याज दो' could mean pay interest or give a loan at interest.
classical_check: Partly agrees that the 6th house governs loans and Mars is linked to debts; taking a loan as a remedy for blocked work is not a classical remedy.

gist: Voices the objection: we will not die in debt, we will die of it, our Mars has sat in some house and started trouble at home; the exact house is garbled in the caption.

hindi: आप जब तक कर्जे में रहोगे मरोगे ही नहीं ले लो मजे
says: He jokes that as long as you stay in debt you will not die, so enjoy it. This is a jest tying debt to staying alive, flagged as a longevity remark and not a rule about death.
ambiguity: A joking line; the Mars link comes from the neighbouring lines. Not to be used as a death or longevity rule.
classical_check: Silent: nothing in classical Jyotish links debt to lifespan.

hindi: यह अग्नि तत्व है जितना ज्यादा मनुष्य इस आग में लगा रहता है मेरे जीवन में ये करना है जब तक उसको लगी अब ये करना है अब ये करना है वो मरता ही नहीं
says: He says this is the fire element: as long as a person stays burning with ever-new goals ('now I must do this, now that') he does not die. Fire, meaning Mars in his scheme, is the drive that keeps one going. Flagged as a general life-energy remark, not a death rule.
ambiguity: The Mars link comes from his earlier fire equals Mars mapping; the claim about not dying is a general statement, not a prediction.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie goal-driven fire to longevity.

hindi: एक य सपना पूरा हो जाए मेरा मैं आग लगा दूंगा दो फैक्ट्री बन जाए दो फैक्ट्री बनी और बंदे की डेथ हो जाती है क्योंकि उसने अपने अंदर की ऊर्जा को कह दिया बस नमस्ते इतना ही काफी
says: He tells a warning story: a man says let just this one dream be fulfilled and I will blaze, gets his two factories built, and then dies because he has told his inner energy 'enough, goodbye'. Flagged: a death claim made by him as a moral, not a rule or a date.
ambiguity: A cautionary illustration of the fire (drive) idea from the previous line; no chart basis is given and it must not be used for any death prediction.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish gives no such link between achieving a goal and death.

hindi: इसलिए आपके अंदर के तत्व समझने हैं आपके अंदर के ग्रहों का चाल समझना है यह आवश्यकता है आपके जीवन को किस प्रकार ठीक किया जाए
says: He concludes that to set life right you need to understand the elements inside you and how the planets within you move, and this is the necessary first step.
ambiguity: 'ग्रहों का चाल' may mean the planets' nature or their movement through time (gochar); he does not specify.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: reading planetary placements and movement (dasha and transit) is how classical Jyotish proposes to improve life; the inner-elements framing is his.

gist: Urges reading your own life: it has run this way for many years, so absorb and accept it.

hindi: यह एक्सेप्टेंस कहां से आएगी जब आपके बुध में दोष नहीं होगा बृहस्पति में नहीं होगा सूर्य की कृपा होगी
says: He says the ability to accept your life comes only when your Mercury and Jupiter are free of dosha and you have the Sun's grace.
cells_derived_method: He does not define dosha. Derived from classical dignity: an exalted or own-sign planet is free of dosha; debilitation or a dusthana placement is a dosha. The house shows where acceptance is easy or hard.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 3rd house (lagna Cancer). No Mercury dosha; calm, clear thinking and easy acceptance, expressed through speech and effort.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra). A Jupiter dosha; peace at home and inner contentment are hard to find, so acceptance is a struggle.
Derived, not said by him: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio). No Sun grace; weak sense of self and standing, so acceptance is hard to reach.

classical_check: Silent: classical texts tie contentment mainly to Jupiter and the Moon; his link to Mercury, Jupiter and Sun is his own.

gist: Repeats that the Moon is our water and our mother, which was already covered.
Announces that today's topic is only the elements (tattvas) of the planets.

hindi: हमारे जो ग्रह है ना वो अंतरिक्ष में इस प्रकार अलग-अलग राशियों में घूमते हैं ये अलग-अलग राशियां है ये सूरज अगर मान लो बीच में होता और धरती ऐसे घूमती तो ऐसे घूमते हैं ये
says: He sketches the sky: our planets move through the different signs, and if you imagine the Sun at the centre with the Earth circling it, the planets go round in this way.
ambiguity: He uses a Sun-centred picture only to explain the idea of movement; he does not say the chart is Sun-centred.
classical_check: Differs in frame: classical Jyotish computes positions geocentrically, though it agrees that planets pass through the signs in order.

hindi: ये आ गया धनु धनु आ गया फिर मकर आ गया कुंभ मीन मेष वृष मिथुन कर्क सिंह कन्या तुला वृश्चिक ये गोलगोल गोल गोल घूम रहा है
says: He recites the signs as a continuous circle starting from Sagittarius (Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio) and says the ring just goes round and round.
ambiguity: The sound effects before it ('ding dang') are caption noise; he starts from Sagittarius only because that is where the pointer was.
classical_check: Agrees: this is the standard zodiac order and it is cyclic, so Scorpio is followed by Sagittarius again.

hindi: अलग-अलग जगहों पर जब ग्रह पहुंचते हैं तो अलग-अलग किस्म की रश्मिया निकलती हैं अंतरिक्ष में उन ग्रहों से और अलग-अलग एरिया से हमारा शरीर उन रश्मि हों को पकड़ता है
says: He says that when a planet reaches different places in the sky it gives off a different kind of rays into space, and our body, from its different areas, picks up those rays; so a planet's effect depends on where it stands.
cells_derived_method: A planet's emission changes with the sign it occupies (its dignity) and the body-area or house it touches. Derived from classical dignity and house topics: an exalted planet sends clear, strong rays on its own topic; a debilitated one sends distorted or harsh rays.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th house (lagna Scorpio). Clear, benevolent rays; wisdom, faith and guidance are absorbed easily.
Derived, not said by him: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 5th house (lagna Taurus). Distorted rays; affection, creativity and romance reach the person in a critical, over-analysed form.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius). Harsh, impatient rays; effort and courage come with friction and delay.

ambiguity: 'रश्मिया' means rays or beams; he does not say whether these are physical or subtle, nor how the body areas map to houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts say a planet gives results by the sign it holds and its dignity; the idea of rays absorbed by body areas is his own.

gist: Quotes what people say about themselves: an injury every March, a windfall or a party every October, and that they quite enjoy it.
Says that whatever you understand of this channel's teaching will bring good times later in life, and if you grasp less it will come in the next birth.
Self-deprecating talk: a man like him did nothing, people beat him into shape, his own troubles continue and he does not understand things enough himself.

hindi: लेकिन यह पक्की बात है कृपा के कारण से निकल आता है इंसान
says: He insists it is certain that what actually brings a person out of trouble is grace, not his own understanding or effort.
ambiguity: The object of the grace (a planet, a deity or the guru) is not named here.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish gives remedies and puja but does not say grace alone decides.

hindi: लोग अक्सर कहते हैं यार यह पंडित जी की लाइफ में तो इतने पंगे हो रहे हैं इस जोशी के तो ये हो रहे हैं होते हैं उसका अपना प्रारब्ध नहीं भोगे अभी
says: He answers the taunt that astrologers and pandits have many troubles in their own lives: those troubles are the astrologer's own prarabdha being lived out, so they do not disprove the science.
ambiguity: 'नहीं भोगे अभी' is garbled; read as 'he is going through his own prarabdha'.
classical_check: Agrees with the general karma doctrine that knowledge of the chart does not cancel one's own prarabdha.

gist: Mentions a respected Vastu teacher who is currently in jail and people stirring up talk about it; no details of any case are recorded here.

hindi: तुम्हें क्या पता वो 100 बार जेल में जाने के बजाय एक बार गया कोटा तो काटेगा
says: He says a hardship such as a jail term is the working-off of a prarabdha quota, and it is better to clear the quota in one go than to go through it a hundred times; the person is just serving what was due.
ambiguity: The remark is about a specific teacher; no judgement on his case is recorded here. 'कोटा तो काटेगा' is read as 'he will serve the quota'.
classical_check: Agrees with the doctrine that prarabdha must be exhausted by experience; the one-go versus hundred-times idea is his own.

gist: Says he would have learned from that teacher and the teacher from him; all knowledge is worth taking from everyone, and nobody is good or bad.

hindi: अपने अपने प्रारब्ध के हाथों सब पिट रहे हैं कृष्ण भी ऐसे ही मरे राम की भी मुन्ना ने ऐसी तैसी कराई किसी को नहीं बक्शा मोहम्मद को भी दौड़ाया किसको छोड़ा बुद्ध की भी मृत्यु ऐसे कष्ट से कराई
says: He says everyone is beaten by their own prarabdha and that nobody is spared: he lists Krishna, Ram, Muhammad and Buddha as great figures who also went through hardship and painful deaths.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is probably the caption's 'mann' (mind) and is used as the agent of Ram's troubles; the deaths of these figures are his examples, not predictions.
classical_check: Agrees with the general karma doctrine that even great souls undergo prarabdha; the examples are his own.

gist: Says each person has their own life, so asking why something happened to this man is pointless; part of the sentence is garbled.
Example of a doctor who cures cancer and dies of it himself, and that one need not get stuck in these cycles.

hindi: यह ग्रहों की ऊर्जा एं हैं आपके ग्रह जो अंतरिक्ष में गोलगोल घूमते हैं सौरमंडल में इस प्रकार ग्रह हैं
says: He says what befalls people comes from planetary energies, the energies of your planets that circle through space in the solar system.
classical_check: Agrees in broad terms: planets are seen as carriers of karmic influence; calling them energies is his wording.

hindi: राशियां बनी हुई है राशियां मीन छोटे-छोटे बहुत सारे सितारे हैं अलग-अलग गैलेक्सी में यह ग्रहों के तारामंडल है तारा मंडल बहुत सारे तारे हैं सितारे ये बहुत सारे तारे इकट्ठा हो रखे हैं
says: He explains that the rashis are formed of many small stars gathered into star groups (constellations), which stand behind the planets' path.
ambiguity: 'मीन' here is the caption's 'means', not Pisces. 'अलग-अलग गैलेक्सी' is loose: the stars of the zodiac constellations belong to our own galaxy.
classical_check: Agrees in broad idea: the sidereal zodiac is anchored to star groups, unlike the tropical one; the galaxy remark is astronomically loose.

hindi: क्योंकि 12 महीने में धरती यूं घूम जाती है तो इसलिए हमने 12 राशियां मानी है
says: He gives his reason for twelve signs: the Earth completes its round in twelve months, so the circle is cut into twelve parts.
classical_check: Agrees in logic: the twelve signs of 30 degrees each follow the Sun's yearly round through about twelve months.

hindi: 12 ग्रह माने 12 ही खाने हैं कुंडली के
says: He equates the number twelve with the twelve boxes of the kundali: twelve (grahas, as the caption has it) mean exactly twelve boxes in the chart.
ambiguity: The word is 'grah' (planet), which may be a slip for 'rashi' or 'bhav', or may point to his twelve-planet scheme; the meaning is the twelve boxes of the chart.
classical_check: Agrees that a kundali has twelve boxes (bhavas or rashis); the 'twelve planets' reading is his own scheme, not classical.

hindi: अगर हम ऐसे किसी ग्रह पर होते जहां पर 14 महीने का सूर्य होता तो हम 13 12 के बजाय 14 होते किसी यूनिवर्स में 16 होते अलग अलग किस्म है इसलिए हमारे य 12 माने जाते
says: He argues the number twelve is local to our year: on a planet where the Sun's year had 14 months we would have 14 signs, and in some other universe 16; ours are twelve because of how our year runs.
ambiguity: A thought experiment; '13' in the caption is a stray number.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish fixes twelve signs and does not discuss other-world versions.

hindi: वास्तु में 16 डायरेक्शन है 32 द्वार है यहां पर 12 दे रखे हैं बड़ा कन्फ्यूजिंग है यार कोई कन्फ्यूजिंग नहीं है 360 डिग्री फिक्स है
says: He addresses the worry that Vastu uses 16 directions and 32 doors while the chart uses 12: he says it is not confusing, because both simply divide the same fixed 360-degree circle.
cells_derived_method: none (the sentence is about counts of divisions, not cells). Arithmetic for reference: a sign is 30 degrees, one of 16 Vastu zones is 22.5 degrees and one of 32 entrance slots is 11.25 degrees.
ambiguity: He does not map the 12 houses onto the 16 zones here.
classical_check: Agrees on the numbers: Vastu uses 16 zones (shodasha) and 32 entrance positions; the single 360-degree basis is his reconciliation.

hindi: 360 गुना में 72 25920 इसके अंतर्गत चारों युग महा युग गोल घूम जाते हैं
says: He gives the arithmetic 360 times 72 equals 25,920 and says the four yugas of a mahayuga turn round once inside this one cycle.
ambiguity: '72' is probably the same 72 he uses elsewhere; the multiplication 360 x 72 = 25,920 checks out.
classical_check: Differs: 25,920 years matches the modern precession of the equinoxes (about one degree per 72 years), not the classical Mahayuga of 4.32 million years.

hindi: इनफिनिटी का साइन होता है ना ऐसे घूमते हैं ये से यहां गए सतयुग त्रेता द्वापर कलयुग इत्यादि फलान ढम कान फिर यहीं लौट के आते हैं ये 25920 साल में आता है आमतौर पर 26000 साल में एवरीथिंग चेंजेज
says: He says the yugas, Satya, Treta, Dwapara, Kali and so on, travel along an infinity-sign (figure-eight) path and come back to where they began after about 25,920 years, roughly 26,000, when everything changes.
ambiguity: The words 'from here it went to ...' are loose; I read the order Satya, Treta, Dwapara, Kali as the sequence along the loop.
classical_check: Differs: the classical yuga cycle is millions of years long; a 26,000-year return with a figure-eight path comes from modern precession-based yuga theories.

hindi: ये 360 डिग्री गोला है और 72 पर बॉडी है इसके अनुसार सारा कुछ चल रहा है इसी मल्टीप्लिकेशन के अंदर ये काम कर कर रहा है यह पूरे यूनिवर्स का लॉ है
says: He says the 360-degree circle and the figure 72 (the 72 percent body) together run everything: it all works inside this multiplication, and this is the law of the whole universe.
ambiguity: He uses 72 both as a multiplier of 360 and as the 72 percent water body; the link between the two uses is asserted, not explained.
classical_check: Silent: there is no classical rule linking 360 times 72 to body composition.

gist: Concedes that a universe with a different time dimension may follow different laws from ours.
Describes his drawing again: planets circling, this is the Sun, this is the Earth's orbit, and the signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer and the rest form the ring.

hindi: ये राशियों का वो बना हुआ है जैसे तुला राशि है ये तराजू की जैसे बना रखी है यहां ये तराजू है जैसे इस तरह से बना रखा है
says: He says the signs are drawn from the shapes of their star groups, and gives Libra as the example: it is made as a balance, a pair of scales.
cells_derived_method: The scales image gives Libra the nature of weighing, fairness, balance and trade. Derived: planets in Libra express these, and the house decides the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries). Marriage and business partnerships are weighed with care, with a pull toward fairness and compromise.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn). Career in arbitration, law, trade or design, where balancing both sides is the job.

classical_check: Agrees: Libra (Tula) is the scales sign and its traditional qualities are balance, trade and fairness.

hindi: ये बिच्छू की टाइप है बिच्छू की शेप है एक बिच्छू डंक मार रहा है इस कारण से ये बनाई हुई है जो आकृतियां वो समझ आती है
says: He says Scorpio is shaped like a scorpion about to sting, and that this is why the figure was drawn so; the shapes explain the sign's nature.
cells_derived_method: The stinging scorpion gives Scorpio secrecy, intensity and a biting edge. Derived: planets in Scorpio act with force and hidden depth, and the house decides where the sting lands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). Secrecy and sudden events; the sting is felt through hidden matters, inheritance and research.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Scorpio in the 3rd house (lagna Virgo). Sharp, biting speech and fierce courage; dealings with siblings carry an edge.

classical_check: Agrees: Scorpio (Vrischika) is the scorpion sign with intensity and secrecy as traditional qualities.

hindi: य एक्वेरियस है ये पायस राशि है दो मछलियों वाली
says: He names Aquarius and then Pisces, and says Pisces is the sign of two fishes.
cells_derived_method: The two fishes give Pisces a double, fluid nature. Derived: planets in Pisces flow, dream and divide in two directions, and the house decides the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries). Dreamy, spiritual and foreign-linked; energy flows away like water into expenses, sleep and retreat.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Pisces in the 2nd house (lagna Aquarius). Soft speech; wealth fluctuates like water and may run in two channels.

ambiguity: He says 'Aquarius' just before but gives no shape for it, so only Pisces is recorded as a cell.
classical_check: Agrees: Pisces (Meena) is the sign of two fishes with fluid, dreamy qualities.

hindi: ये सिटरी से ये ऐसी कल्पना की गई है कि एक बंदा है घोड़ा है आधा शरीर उसका और ये तीर मार रहा परर हवा में यह कल्पनाएं की गई है
says: He says Sagittarius is imagined as a man with the lower half of a horse's body shooting an arrow into the air, and he calls these figures imaginations, not literal pictures.
cells_derived_method: The archer gives Sagittarius aim, travel and higher purpose. Derived: planets in Sagittarius aim at far goals, and the house decides the target.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries). Aims high at dharma, teachers and long journeys; the arrow is aimed at higher goals.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Sagittarius in the 6th house (lagna Cancer). Takes aim at rivals and disputes with a blunt, combative honesty.

ambiguity: 'सिटरी' is the caption's garbling of the sign name; the sign is identified from the half-horse archer description.
classical_check: Agrees: Sagittarius (Dhanu) is the archer, half man and half horse, with aim and higher purpose as qualities.

hindi: और इसके गुण धर्म देखते हुए ही हमें असर मिलते हैं
says: He says the effects we get are read from each sign's guna and dharma, its qualities and nature, which is why the figures and images given to the signs matter.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut across a slice boundary; the first half is in the previous line.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give each sign its element, quality (cardinal, fixed, mutable) and nature, and read results from them.

gist: Aside about the camera blurring and the light dropping, and how information arrives that way.

hindi: ये राइट साइड है बॉडी की ये लेफ्ट साइड है बाई तरफ का जो है ये ठंडा इलाका हो गया राइट साइड का जो गरम इलाका हो गया सूर्य नाड़ी चंद्र नाड़ी
says: He maps the body: the right side is the hot region, tied to the Sun channel (surya nadi), and the left side the cool region, tied to the Moon channel (chandra nadi).
ambiguity: The caption lists the sides first and then 'Sun nadi, Moon nadi'; I pair them in that order (right and hot with Sun, left and cool with Moon), which matches the usual yoga reading.
classical_check: Agrees with the yoga tradition: the left channel (ida) is the cool Moon channel and the right channel (pingala) is the hot Sun channel.

hindi: यह हमारा हो गया राहु यमराज और शनि यदि शनि कुपित हो जाए तो यमराज को बुला लेता है
says: He groups Rahu, Yamraj and Saturn together as one set, and says that when Saturn is angered he calls in Yamraj.
ambiguity: Yamraj is taken as Pluto (Yama) in his twelve-planet scheme, but he does not say so in this sentence; the grouping with the body-side line before it is loose.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is Yama's brother in the Puranas and Rahu is said to act like Saturn; calling Yamraj when Saturn is angry is his own image.

hindi: शनि का सारा काम इसका एजेंट करता है इसका एजेंट है राहु राहु छाया ग्रह यानी शनि की छाया
says: He says Rahu is Saturn's agent who does all of Saturn's work, a shadow planet, that is, Saturn's shadow.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is said to give results like Saturn (Shanivat Rahu) and is a shadow planet.

hindi: केतु मंगल का एजेंट है
says: He says Ketu is Mars's agent, so Ketu carries out Mars's kind of work.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is said to act like Mars (Kujavat Ketu) in classical rules of thumb.

hindi: मंगल क्या है हनुमान जी आग मंगल मंगल आग
says: He identifies Mars with Hanuman ji and with fire, repeating that Mars is fire.
ambiguity: The slice ends here; the sentence is complete but he may continue about Mars in the next batch.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the fire planet (agni tattva) and Hanuman worship is a customary Mars remedy, though the classical presiding deity of Mars is Kartikeya.

hindi: शुक्र सूर्य क्या है ताप गरमाई सूर्य गरमाई है हमें गरमाई देता है
says: He defines the Sun as heat and warmth itself: the Sun is what gives us warmth.
cells_derived_method: The warmth shows up in the life-area of the house the Sun occupies, then the sign scales it: Aries (exalted) and Leo (own) run hot and strong, Libra (debilitated) is weak, fire signs add flame while water and earth signs damp or steady it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted on the ascendant gives maximum bodily heat, vitality and visible radiance.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 10th means the warmth of status and authority is low; the person needs outside backing to be seen as a leader.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's earthy sign in the 4th gives a dry, dutiful warmth at home rather than a glowing one.

ambiguity: The first word 'शुक्र' (Venus) does not fit the sentence, which is only about the Sun; most likely a caption error for another word.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts make the Sun the hot, bilious planet and the karaka of vitality.

hindi: सूर्य मंगल अग्नि है उस अग्नि की जो गरमाई है वह सूर्य है
says: Mars is the fire element itself (agni), and the warmth that comes off that fire is the Sun, so Mars is the flame and the Sun is its heat.
cells_derived_method: How the flame behaves depends on the sign element where Mars sits: fire signs feed it, water signs smother it, earth signs make it a slow furnace; the house decides which life-area is being burned or heated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own fire sign in the 3rd gives raw, quick initiative and bold effort, heat without much steady warmth.
Derived: Mars debilitated in watery Cancer in the 4th is fire in water; the heat is smothered and turns into frustration at home.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th is disciplined fire that becomes sustained career drive.

ambiguity: 'सूर्य मंगल अग्नि है' could mean 'Sun and Mars are both fire'; the second half of the sentence favours 'Mars is fire, Sun is its heat'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical lists call both Sun and Mars hot, fiery planets; the flame-versus-heat split is his own picture.

hindi: और सूर्य ही हम खाते हैं बाहर से जितनी किरणें पड़ती है धरती पर आती है फल फ्रूट चीजों के ऊपर उन फल फ्रूट को चीजों को खाते हैं
says: He says that what we eat is really the Sun: the rays falling on the earth settle in fruits and food, and eating them takes the Sun into the body.
ambiguity: It is an analogy about food and sunlight, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe food as stored sunlight; they only tie the Sun to vitality and digestive fire.

hindi: तो हमारे अंदर मल मूत्र बनता है और बची हुई ऊर्जा क्या करती है सूर्य शक्ति बन जाती है
says: After eating, the body makes stool and urine, and the energy left over becomes the Sun's strength (solar vitality) in the body.
ambiguity: A physiological bridge to the Sun, not tied to any house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe this mechanism, though Sun as prana or vitality is classical.

hindi: जब आपका सूर्य बहुत और बढ़िया रहता है बॉडी में यानी कि आप परमपिता से जुड़े हुए हैं आपकी राइट नाड़ी बिल्कुल ठीक-ठाक है आपके अंदर भयंकर कॉन्फिडेंस है
says: When the Sun is strong in your body you feel linked to the supreme father, your right-side energy channel (right nadi) works well, and you carry huge confidence.
cells_derived_method: Sun's strength comes from house and sign: 10th house (directional strength), kendra and trikona houses, Aries exalted, Leo own all raise it; 6th, 8th, 12th and Libra lower it. Confidence is felt in the life-area of the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted and strong in the 10th (lagna Cancer) gives commanding presence and confidence in public life.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 12th (lagna Scorpio) drains drive; confidence turns inward and the person is more withdrawn than assertive.
Derived: Sun in its own sign in the 5th gives strong self-belief in creative, decision-making and children matters.

ambiguity: 'राइट नाड़ी' is a yoga term (surya or pingala channel), not a house or sign term.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: strong Sun gives confidence and authority; the paramapita and right-nadi language comes from yoga tradition, not Parashara.

gist: Mock self-talk of a strong-Sun person: I am the king, no tension at all, brother.

hindi: आपकी बॉडी में विटामिन डी सेट रहता है आपका विटामिन डी सेट रहता है
says: He ties the Sun's strength to vitamin D being in balance in the body. This is a health claim as he stated it, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent: vitamin D is a modern idea; the classical link is Sun with vitality, bones and eyes.

hindi: तो आपकी बॉडी सारे सेल्यूलर लेवल प सारे सेल बनाती है वाइट ब्लड सेल रेड ब्लड सेल स्नोफिल मोनोफिल वगैरह वगैरह न्यूट्रोफिल सारे के सारे सेल बनते हैं
says: With vitamin D in place the body keeps making every kind of blood cell (red cells, white cells and their subtypes); he presents this as what a strong Sun gives.
ambiguity: Cell names are garbled in the caption (likely eosinophil, monocyte, neutrophil). Health claim as stated by him.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give blood to Mars, not to the Sun; Sun is tied to vitality and bones.

gist: Biology premise: about 12 lakh red blood cells die in an instant and the same number are made at once (figure not verified, caption number may be wrong).
Biology premise continued: in young age cell turnover is fast and production matches or beats loss (12 die, 12 to 14 are made), and youth arrives.
Biology premise: in later age about 12 cells die per second and only 10 are made, and that is when old age starts.

hindi: अगर आरबीसी बनते रहेंगे डब्ल्यूबीसी बनते रहेंगे इम्युनिटी सेट है बीमारी आई गई यह कब होगा जब सूर्य आपका ठीक है
says: If red and white cells keep forming, immunity stays set and illnesses come and go without sticking; he says this happens when the Sun is fine in the chart. Health claim as stated, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Sun in resistance houses (3, 6, 10, 11) or its own or exalted sign points to quick recovery; a Sun in a hard house (8, 12) or an enemy sign points to slower recovery in the tradition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in its own sign in the 6th (lagna Pisces) is the classic combination for beating illness and enemies.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's sign in the 8th (lagna Gemini) is the tradition's picture of slower recovery and lingering complaints.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: strong Sun means strong vitality and resistance; the blood-cell and immunity detail is his own.

hindi: सूर्य कौन है पिता सूर्य कौन है परमपिता
says: The Sun stands for the father (physical father) and for the supreme father (paramapita), the divine source.
cells_derived_method: The father's condition is read from the Sun's house and sign, together with the 9th and 10th houses: a dignified Sun in a supportive house reads as a helpful father, a Sun in a separating house reads as distance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Jupiter's sign in the 9th (the father and dharma house) reads as a supportive, principled father.
Derived: Sun in Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo) reads as a father who is distant, living away, or more spiritual than present.

classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the natural karaka of the father and of the soul (atma).

hindi: सूर्य कौन है नेत्र आंखें सूर्य है आपकी नाभि सूर्य है
says: The Sun stands for the eyes and for the navel centre of the body.
cells_derived_method: Eyes are read from the 2nd and 12th houses and the Sun's condition there; the navel and digestive fire from the 5th area (Leo region of the body map). The sign shows how the Sun is stressed or helped.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in friendly Mercury sign in the 2nd (face and eyes house, lagna Taurus) reads as clear, bright eyes.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's sign in the 12th (lagna Pisces) is the tradition's pointer to eye strain or weak sight (tradition claim, not a diagnosis).
Derived: Sun exalted in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) reads as strong digestive fire and navel-centre vitality.

classical_check: Agrees on eyes (Sun rules the right eye); the navel link is a yoga-body association, not a standard Parashari one.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर गर्मी ओज कितना तेज है आपके अंदर
says: How much warmth, ojas (vital glow) and tej (inner brilliance) a person has is the Sun's department.
cells_derived_method: Tej shows most when the Sun sits in the 1st or 10th and in dignified signs; it is spent or hidden when the Sun sits in the 12th or in an enemy sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in its own sign on the ascendant gives visible, steady tej that others notice at once.
Derived: Sun in Venus's sign (an enemy sign) in the 12th (lagna Gemini) spreads the tej thin; energy goes into private or foreign pursuits.

classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the karaka of tejas and ojas.

hindi: अगर आपके अंदर तेज है तो धांसू धध केगा चेहरा आपका आपके अंदर से बबल कलेगी एनर्जी और आप बिल्कुल राजा की तरह रहेंगे
says: If tej is present, your face will glow, energy will bubble out of you, and you will carry yourself like a king.
cells_derived_method: The kingly look is strongest with Sun in the 1st or 10th; from the 3rd it shows as personal courage and charm instead of rank.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in a friendly fire sign in the 10th (lagna Pisces) gives a public, authoritative presence.
Derived: Sun in its own sign in the 3rd (lagna Gemini) gives energetic, charming self-expression and courage rather than formal rank.

ambiguity: Caption garbled at 'धध केगा' and 'बबल कलेगी'; read as 'face will glow' and 'energy will bubble out'.
classical_check: Agrees: a strong Sun gives lustre and a regal bearing.

hindi: यानी आपकी बात लॉयन शेर सिंह राशि होती है यह सिंह राशि है शेर सिंह राशि अकेली राशि है जो सब पे डोमिनेट करती है
says: Leo (Simha), the lion, is the one sign that dominates all the others.
cells_derived_method: Leo's dominance is expressed through the house it falls in: it commands the career in the 10th, dominates partners in the 7th, and rules the home in the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio) gives an authoritative, leader-type career.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius) gives a dominating or proud style in partnerships and public dealings.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus) gives a household where the person's word is final.

ambiguity: 'Dominates all' could mean all signs or all animals; the sign sense is assumed. The opening words 'आपकी बात लॉयन' are garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Leo is the Sun's own regal sign (lion, king of the forest), but classical texts do not say it dominates all signs.

hindi: इस राशि के साथ तोड़ ही नहीं है कहीं कोई यानी सूर्य के साथ किसी प्रकार का पंगा लिया ही नहीं जा सकता
says: Nothing matches or breaks this sign; no one can pick a fight with the Sun, so a strong Sun in Leo cannot be challenged.
