cells_derived_method: The Sun's invulnerability is greatest in its own sign on strong houses; in hidden houses its power is real but quiet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo on the ascendant is the most open form of the claim, a person nobody dares to cross.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 12th (lagna Virgo) keeps the strength but it works behind the scenes; opponents are hidden rather than defeated openly.

ambiguity: 'इस राशि' (this sign) and 'सूर्य' (the planet) are used together; both are recorded.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun in its own sign is strong, but classical texts still say Saturn, Venus and the nodes trouble it; 'nobody can challenge' is rhetoric.

hindi: सूर्य से पंगा कोई ले सकता है सूर्य से पंगा सिर्फ राहु और केतु लेते हैं जो छाया ग्रह है
says: Only the shadow planets Rahu and Ketu can take on the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The damage depends on the house where the Sun meets a node: in the 10th it hits status and reputation, in the 9th father and dharma matters. The sign sets how much dignity the Sun has to resist with.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted but joined by Rahu in the 10th (lagna Cancer) is the eclipsed-exaltation case; status is high but recognition is blocked or clouded.
Derived: Sun in Leo with Ketu in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) clouds the father's role and the sense of dharma while the Sun's own-sign strength stays underneath.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary: 'सिर्फ राहु' ends one chunk and 'और केतु लेते हैं' starts the next.
classical_check: Partly agrees: nodes eclipsing the Sun (grahan yoga) is classical, but classical lists name Saturn and Venus as Sun's enemies too, so 'only Rahu and Ketu' is narrower.

hindi: चंदा मामा की वजह से एक्चुअली ये है नहीं कहीं तो सूर्य को ग्रहण कौन लगाता है राहु
says: He notes that the eclipse is physically caused by the Moon and Rahu and Ketu do not actually exist as bodies anywhere, yet in Jyotish the one who eclipses the Sun is Rahu.
ambiguity: The subject of 'ये है नहीं कहीं' is dropped; read as Rahu and Ketu having no physical body.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic account that Rahu swallows the Sun; the Moon as physical cause is modern astronomy.

hindi: राहु का डेंजर है राहु कौन है राहु सिर्फ एक मुंडी है आपने राहु केत की फोटो देखी होंगी राहु इतना सा है केतु बॉडी है
says: Rahu is the dangerous one and is only a head (a small thing), while Ketu is the body, as in the familiar pictures of the two.
cells_derived_method: The head-without-body picture shows in the house where Rahu sits: appetite, ideas and appearance without the means to carry them out. Ketu opposite is the body without a head: action or detachment without direction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini on the ascendant is all head, a restless, idea-heavy mind and image; Ketu in the 7th is the headless partner side.
Derived: Rahu in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo) is big ambition and appearance in career with weak follow-through.

classical_check: Agrees: the Svarbhanu myth makes Rahu the head and Ketu the headless body.

hindi: हर चीज के अंदर राहु और केतु है जैसे आपका हाथ जो है ये आपका इस बॉडी के साथ अलग है तो ये भी राहु का हिस्सा है अब इसके अंदर उंगलियां है ये उंगलियां भी राहु का हिस्सा है
says: Rahu and Ketu exist inside everything as a part-and-whole pair: the hand, taken against the body, is a Rahu part, and the fingers, taken against the hand, are again a Rahu part.
ambiguity: He is gesturing at his own body; which part is Rahu depends on the reference level.
classical_check: Silent: Rahu-Ketu as head and tail is classical, but the part/whole nesting at every level is his teaching.

hindi: तो इसके लिए ये राहु हो गया ये केतु हो गया इसके लिए यह राहु हो गया यह केतु हो गया इसके लिए यह केतु हो गया यह राहु हो गया
says: Which part is Rahu and which is Ketu flips with the reference point: the same thing is Rahu from one side and Ketu from another.
ambiguity: Entirely gesture-based ('this' and 'that') so the actual pairs cannot be recovered from the caption.
classical_check: Silent: the relativity of the head/tail labelling is his own idea.

hindi: तो केतु क्या है बादल केतु को बादल की संज्ञा लेकर के चढ
says: He takes Ketu to be a cloud: if you name Ketu as cloud, it is what covers the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The cloud covers whatever the Ketu's house stands for, and it covers the Sun's matters most when Ketu sits with the Sun: identity, father, authority.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted with Ketu on the ascendant is a bright Sun under cloud; the strength is there but the person's identity feels unclear.
Derived: Sun in Leo with Ketu in the 10th (lagna Scorpio) means the work is done without credit or a clear public role.

ambiguity: The word 'चढ' at the end is garbled and cut off.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is classically smoky, hazy (dhumra) and hides what it touches.

hindi: आप सूरज के आगे बादल आ जाएगा तो क्या होगा सूरज पता ही नहीं चलेगा है तो सही कहां है दिख नहीं रहा
says: When a cloud stands in front of the Sun you cannot tell the Sun is there; it exists but is not visible, and that is how Ketu hides your own light.
ambiguity: An analogy; no house or sign is involved.
classical_check: Silent: the sun-behind-cloud image is his own; classical Ketu is hazy and hidden.

hindi: तो जब जीवन में आपका केतु का लफड़ा शुरू होता है आपको ना सुझा नहीं देता आपको सुझा नहीं दे रहा है
says: When Ketu's trouble starts in life, nothing occurs to you and you cannot see the way forward.
cells_derived_method: The area where clarity is lost follows the house Ketu occupies, and the sign shows the style of the confusion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Virgo in the 2nd (lagna Leo) clouds judgement about money, speech and family during its period.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo) leaves the person without a clear sense about partnerships.
Derived: Ketu in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus) brings loss of direction about career.

ambiguity: Whether 'शुरू होता है' means Ketu's dasha, a transit, or just a bad phase is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Ketu periods bring confusion, detachment and loss of direction in the tradition.

gist: Asks listeners to follow each point carefully, because the remedies come out of these explanations, even if they never become astrologers.
Restates that a cloud has come into your life and there is no clarity, the same idea as the previous Ketu-as-cloud point.

hindi: केतु क्या संकेत है केतु हमारे गणपति होते हैं
says: Ketu signifies Ganapati (Ganesha), so Ketu is linked to that deity.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary ('होते हैं' is at the start of the next chunk).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ganesha is the popular deity for Ketu, but classical graha-devata lists name other deities (Chitragupta and Brahma).

hindi: केतु कुत्ता होता है
says: Ketu stands for the dog.
classical_check: Agrees: dogs are widely given as a Ketu animal.

hindi: मोटे मोटे तौर पर पकड़ेंगे केतू पूंछ है
says: In broad terms, take Ketu as the tail.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the headless body or tail picture of Ketu is Puranic, but 'Ketu = tail' as a list entry is his phrasing.

hindi: आप अपने सिर के बालों को बांध के रखें
says: Remedy: keep the hair on your head tied up, on the logic that a tied tail is Ketu being kept in order.
ambiguity: The reason is inferred from his tail talk; he does not spell it out here.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical Ketu remedy; it is folk practice.

hindi: आपके अपने जीवन के अंदर शरीर के इस निचले हिस्से को साफ सुथरा क्लीन रखें
says: Remedy: keep the lower part of the body clean and tidy, as hygiene of the Ketu area.
ambiguity: 'निचला हिस्सा' (lower part) is not defined further.
classical_check: Silent: a hygiene remedy of his own, not found in classical texts.

hindi: स्किन सारी चमड़ी हमारी केतु होती है
says: All the skin on our body belongs to Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Skin matters are read from Ketu's house and sign: the 1st (body) and 6th or 8th (eruptions and ailments) are the sensitive spots.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in watery Cancer on the ascendant points to sensitive, reactive skin in the tradition.
Derived: Ketu in Virgo in the 8th (lagna Aquarius) points to hidden or chronic skin complaints in the tradition (not a diagnosis).

classical_check: Differs: the main classical skin significators are Mercury and Saturn; Ketu is tied to skin eruptions only in later practice.

hindi: कुत्ते को कुछ ना कुछ खिलाएं
says: Remedy: feed the dog something regularly.
classical_check: Agrees with popular Jyotish practice, where feeding dogs is a standard Ketu remedy; it is not in Parashara.

hindi: केतु पूंछ होती है पूंछ वाली गाय गाय तो पूंछ वाली मिलेगी कुत्ता शायद ना भी मिले
says: Remedy: because Ketu is the tail, serve tailed animals; the cow is easy to find, the dog may not be around.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: serving the cow and animals is a general remedy; the 'tailed animals' rule is his own.

hindi: पूंछ वाले जितने जानवर हैं केत मछली है उनकी सेवा कर दो
says: All tailed creatures count as Ketu, fish included (caption 'केत' read as Ketu), and he says to serve them.
ambiguity: 'केत' is a clipped caption of Ketu; it could also be the fish listed as another example of a tailed animal.
classical_check: Agrees: fish (Matsya, the first avatar) is a classical Ketu significator.

hindi: अब आपकी पूंछ कौन है आपके बच्चे भी आपकी पूंछ ही होते हैं पापा पापा मम्मी मम्मी के पल्लू लेकर घूमते रहते हैं पीछे पीछे वो सब केतु है
says: Your own tail is your children, who follow behind holding at their parents' clothes, and all of that is Ketu.
cells_derived_method: The children link is read through the 5th house and the 4th (the mother's hold); Ketu there shows clinging or detachment toward children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer) gives an intense, possessive bond with children or a pull to step back from it.
Derived: Ketu in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius) gives a clinging, home-bound bond between child and mother.

classical_check: Differs: the classical karaka for children is Jupiter; Ketu as the children is his own link.

hindi: उनकी सेवा करो उनको प्रसन्न रखना आपका काम है
says: Serve your children and keep them happy; that is your duty and the way to keep Ketu pleased.
classical_check: Silent: a duty-based remedy of his own, not a classical Ketu remedy.

hindi: आपने अपने बच्चे को कूट दिया आपका केतु नाराज होगा
says: If you thrash your child, your Ketu gets angry; this is a don't, with the angry Ketu acting through skin trouble.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says hitting children angers Ketu.

hindi: अगर तो आपकी कुंडली के अंदर पावरफुल है तो कोई बात नहीं नहीं तो आपको उसी दिन स्किन के अंदर खुजली खारिश परेशानी आप बच्चों से यूं ही परेशान हो आपकी स्किन खराब रहेगी
says: If Ketu is powerful in your chart nothing happens; if not, the same day you get itching and skin trouble and upset from the children, and skin stays bad. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A strong Ketu (in 3, 6, 11 and friendly signs) absorbs the anger; a weak or afflicted Ketu (in 4, 8 or an enemy placement) shows the skin and family stress fast.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 6th (lagna Gemini) is a strong placement that defeats ailments, so little shows even after a harsh act.
Derived: Ketu in the 4th (lagna Libra) is a weak, unsettled placement; home strain and skin irritation show quickly in his logic.

ambiguity: The subject of 'पावरफुल है' is dropped; read as Ketu being powerful. The phrase 'व्यथित' fragment that follows is unclear.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie the child-beating event to Ketu; strong Ketu in 3, 6, 11 is a classical idea.

hindi: अब किसी से यूं ही व्यथित हो केतु आपका मस्ती का द्वार है
says: Ketu is the gateway of your pleasure and enjoyment (masti).
cells_derived_method: Pleasure is shown through the houses of enjoyment: the 5th (play), the 12th (bed pleasures) and the 7th (partners).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Venus's sign in the 12th (lagna Gemini) pulls enjoyment inward into private, sensory experience.
Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius in the 5th (lagna Leo) is playful, philosophical enjoyment that is not tied to results.

ambiguity: The opening words 'अब किसी से यूं ही व्यथित हो' (distressed over nothing) do not link to the rest of the sentence in the caption.
classical_check: Differs: classical pleasure karaka is Venus; Ketu gives detachment, so this link is his own.

hindi: केतु स्त्री के शरीर के अंदर और पुरुष के शरीर में बिना हड्डी के ऑर्गन्स हैं
says: In both women's and men's bodies Ketu stands for the organs that have no bone in them (the soft organs).
cells_derived_method: The body area flagged follows the house Ketu sits in: the 8th for the genital and urinary region and the 7th for the lower abdomen in the body-map tradition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in watery Cancer in the 8th (lagna Sagittarius) points at the soft reproductive or urinary organs in the tradition.
Derived: Ketu in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) points at the lower-abdomen soft organs in the tradition (not a diagnosis).

ambiguity: The sentence runs across a caption boundary; 'ऑर्गन्स हैं' is at the start of the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent: the 'boneless organs' idea is not classical; the body map puts the 8th house over the genitals.

hindi: आपके शरीर के इन ऑर्गन्स के अंदर प्रॉब्लम शुरू हो जाएगी यूरिनरी डिसऑर्डर स्टार्ट हो जाएंगे
says: When Ketu is upset, problems begin in those soft organs and urinary disorders start. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Urinary trouble is flagged when Ketu is afflicted in the 6th, 7th or 8th, especially in water signs, which stand for fluids.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Scorpio in the 8th is the strongest water-sign flag for urinary or reproductive weakness in the tradition.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra) flags recurring but manageable fluid-related complaints in the tradition (not a diagnosis).

classical_check: Partly agrees: later practice ties the 6th, 7th and 8th with urinary trouble; the Ketu-anger trigger is his own.

hindi: केतु कहां प्लेस है केतु आपका वाटर चक्र के पास प्लेस्क को कंट्रोल केतु करता है
says: Ketu sits near the water chakra and controls something near it; the caption word 'प्लेस्क' is probably 'plexus', so he means the nerve plexus around the water chakra.
ambiguity: 'प्लेस्क' is garbled; 'plexus' is a guess. The 'water chakra' is read as the sacral (svadhisthana) centre.
classical_check: Silent: chakra mapping of Ketu comes from yoga and tantra, not Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: और मोक्ष का दाता भी केतु है
says: Ketu is also the giver of moksha (liberation).
cells_derived_method: Moksha pull is strongest with Ketu in the moksha houses (4, 8, 12) and weakens where the house is worldly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th is the classic moksha placement, a strong spiritual pull and detachment.
Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo) gives inner contentment and withdrawal from domestic ties.
Derived: Ketu in Leo in the 2nd (lagna Cancer) pulls the person away from wealth and family while the Sun-ruled sign keeps pride.

classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the moksha karaka in Parashara and later texts.

hindi: जब हम सेक्स की क्रिया में होते हैं तो मोक्ष महसूस होता है ना क्षण के लिए एक्सटेसी में जब स्खलन होता है तो उस समय लगता है यार मोक्ष ही मिल गया
says: He points to the instant of climax as a brief taste of moksha, the ecstasy that feels like release, as his illustration of Ketu's moksha role.
ambiguity: An analogy, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: Ketu as moksha karaka is classical but the climax analogy is his own.

hindi: इसलिए मनुष्य सारे टाइम सेक्स के सपे में पड़ा रहता है कुंडलिनी शक्ति यहां तृप्त हुए बिना ऊपर नहीं जा सकती
says: This is why people stay caught in sex all the time: the kundalini energy cannot rise upward until it is satisfied at this lower centre.
ambiguity: 'सपे' is unclear in the caption; it could be 'सपने' (dream) or 'चक्कर' (cycle).
classical_check: Silent: this is yoga and tantra psychology, not classical Jyotish.

gist: Repeats the cloud-over-Sun picture and says that when life gives no understanding, take it that Ketu is on top of you, the same point as earlier.

hindi: आपको यह सेवा कार्यक्रम करने हैं केत हाथ से सेवा है
says: Ketu is service done with the hands, so Ketu's work is manual seva (selfless service).
ambiguity: Caption has the clipped 'केत'; read as Ketu.
classical_check: Silent: service by hand as a Ketu quality is not classical; humility and renunciation are the usual Ketu themes.

hindi: जाओ गुरुद्वारे सेवा करो मंदिर में जाओ सेवा करो जूते पॉलिश करो फलाना डिमका ना करो आपका केतु चमकेगा
says: Remedy: do hands-on service at a gurudwara or temple, polish shoes and similar work, and your Ketu will shine (become strong).
ambiguity: 'फलाना डिमका ना करो' is filler (and so on); read as 'do such things'.
classical_check: Silent: temple seva is a folk remedy, not in Parashara.

hindi: आप क्या समझते हैं मंदिर जाने मात्र से कार्य होगा नहीं आपने कर्म के द्वारा भी ईश्वर का कर्म कर दिया मंदिर जाने की जरूरत नहीं है लेकिन करो तो सही
says: Merely visiting a temple does nothing; doing karma (selfless action) is itself the Lord's work, so a temple visit is not required, but do the action anyway.
classical_check: Silent: a general ethical stance; classical remedies stress both action (dana) and devotion.

hindi: आप मंदिर जा रहे हैं गुरुद्वारे जा रहे हैं लेकिन बाहर लोगों को गालियां बक रहे हैं तो आपके राहु के खराब हो रहे हैं
says: If you go to temples and gurudwaras but abuse people outside, your Rahu is getting spoiled; abusive speech aggravates Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Abusive-speech tendency follows Rahu in the speech and communication houses (2nd and 3rd) and is sharpened in clever or aggressive signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Mercury's sign in the 2nd (lagna Taurus) gives sharp, deceptive or abusive speech.
Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) gives blunt, aggressive expression and quarrelsome communication.

ambiguity: 'राहु के खराब हो रहे हैं' is slightly garbled; read as 'your Rahu is getting spoiled'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is tied to harsh speech and deceit; the temple-versus-abuse contrast is his own.

hindi: दूसरा राहु है जो सूर्य को दोष लगा देता है
says: The second afflictor, after Ketu, is Rahu, who puts a blemish (dosha) on the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The blemish falls on the life-area of the house where Sun and Rahu meet, with the sign setting the Sun's resilience.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Rahu in Leo on the ascendant clouds the sense of self and ego, with a swollen or shadowed identity.
Derived: Sun with Rahu in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius) clouds peace at home and the relationship with the father's house.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary ('है' starts the next chunk).
classical_check: Agrees: Sun with Rahu (grahan dosha) is a classical affliction.

hindi: राहु चंदा मामा की छाया बीच में पड़ जाती है धरती के साथ बीच में आ जाता है तो सूर्य ग्रहण लग गया जब चांद की वो पोजीशन होती है तो सूर्य को खा ही गया
says: The Moon's shadow falls between the Sun and the earth, the Moon comes in between, and that is a solar eclipse; in his language Rahu has eaten the Sun.
ambiguity: 'राहु' is stated as the eclipser, but the mechanism he describes is the Moon's shadow.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story; the Moon-shadow mechanism is modern astronomy.

hindi: यानी कि राहु तो इतना डेंजरस है आपको समझ ही नहीं आ रहा जब आपकी लाइफ के अंदर आपको चंदा मामा की तरह जैसे सूर्य को ग्रहण लग गया
says: Rahu is so dangerous that you do not even realise what is happening: when the eclipse falls on your life, like the Moon's shadow on the Sun, you cannot work out what has hit you.
ambiguity: The sentence is long and loosely joined; 'चंदा मामा की तरह' is read as 'as with the Moon's shadow on the Sun'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu works through illusion so the person does not see the cause; the eclipse comparison is his image.

hindi: यानी आपकी खोपड़ी में आंखों को दिख नहीं रहा कुछ आपको हर समय यह वहम चल रहा है करना क्या है
says: In your head you see nothing clearly and are always in doubt and delusion about what to do; this is how Rahu's eclipse shows up in the mind.
cells_derived_method: The doubt sits in the house where Rahu is: the 5th shakes the intellect and decisions, while the 3rd tends to make the person bold instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aquarius in the 5th (lagna Libra) gives constant doubt in decision-making and mental overload.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 3rd (lagna Cancer) is more drive than delusion; it shows up as restless analysis and effort.

ambiguity: 'वहम' (delusion or doubt) could be the person's superstition or paranoia; the doubt reading is used.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Rahu is classically illusion, confusion and doubt.

hindi: रोशनी रोशनी गायब हो जाती है धरती के ऊपर से जब सूरज को ग्रहण लगता है आपके जीवन में रोशनी नहीं है
says: As light vanishes from the earth in an eclipse, a Rahu phase leaves your life without light, meaning no guiding direction or hope.
ambiguity: Imagery only; no house or sign is named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu stands for darkness and obscuration; the 'no light in life' imagery is his own.

hindi: जब एक व्यक्ति यह महसूस करे मैं बिल्कुल बेबस हो चुका हूं मैं करूं क्या वह रोता है आंसू निकल आते हैं बेबस यानी राहु का कार्य क्या है
says: Helplessness is Rahu's signature: a person who feels utterly powerless and cries over what to do is under Rahu.
cells_derived_method: The helplessness shows in the life-area of Rahu's house: sudden crises in the 8th, blocked action in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra) is the helplessness of sudden shocks or hidden matters beyond one's control.
Derived: Rahu in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus) is feeling powerless in career despite a clear view of the field.

classical_check: Silent: classical Rahu gives fear, obsession and confusion; helplessness as the signature is his wording.

hindi: इतना काम करने दूंगा देख सकते हो बोल सकते हो सुन सकते हो कर कुछ नहीं सकते तो आपका निचला हिस्सा डेड हो जाता है तो आप ऐसे घूमते रहते मैं क्या करूं मैं क्या करूं
says: Rahu's rule in his voice: you may see, speak and hear, but you cannot do anything, and the lower half goes dead. This follows from Rahu being only a head with no body to act.
cells_derived_method: The inability to act is sharpest when Rahu sits in action houses (3, 6, 10) in signs without follow-through; in the 2nd it is talk and views without action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 10th (lagna Aquarius) sees every career opening but cannot execute.
Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) gives plenty of talk and feeling about money and family but no action.

ambiguity: 'निचला हिस्सा डेड' could be a metaphor for paralysis of action or a physical claim; the metaphor is assumed.
classical_check: Silent: 'sees but cannot act' is his own inference from the head-only image.

hindi: अगर आप यह कर रहे हैं तो सूर्य को ग्रहण लग गया है यानी आपका आपका विटामिन डी जबरदस्त तरीके से डाउन जा रहा है
says: If you are in this helpless wandering state, your Sun is eclipsed and your vitamin D is dropping hard. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Only meaningful where Rahu actually afflicts the Sun in the chart; the house shows which area of life takes the loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Rahu in Saturn's sign on the ascendant shows as a body-level vitality drain.
Derived: Sun debilitated with Rahu in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) hits the father and dharma area while vitality is low.

classical_check: Silent: vitamin D is modern; Sun with Rahu lowering vitality is classical.

hindi: अगर आपका विटामिन डी डाउन है तो आपके पेट की समस्या हड्डियों की तकलीफ दांतों की प्रॉब्लम कुछ
says: If vitamin D is low, you get stomach problems, bone complaints and tooth problems, and the list continues past the end of the slice. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The body area follows the Sun's house: the 2nd for teeth, the 5th for stomach, and bones through the Sun's own tradition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in the 2nd (lagna Virgo) points to dental and mouth matters in the tradition.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's sign in the 5th (lagna Libra) points to a weak stomach and digestion in the tradition.

ambiguity: The list is cut off at the end of the batch ('कुछ' is the last word).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun classically rules bones; stomach and teeth links come from the body-map houses, not the Sun alone.

hindi: ना कुछ दर्दें हो रही है यहां हो रही है होंगी
says: In that eclipsed-Sun state pains will appear in the body, now here and now there, on top of the stomach, bone and tooth troubles just listed. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The caption starts mid-sentence ('ना कुछ'), so the first words of the list are missing.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not list roaming body pains for an afflicted Sun; they tie the Sun to bones, head and heart region.

hindi: और वो क्यों होंगी क्योंकि आप सारे टाइम आप बेबस हो
says: The reason for those pains is that you are helpless all the time; permanent helplessness is the Rahu state that damages the Sun.
ambiguity: He treats helplessness as a cause, not just a symptom; the direction of cause is as he states it.
classical_check: Silent: a psychological cause-and-effect reading of his own; classical Rahu gives confusion and obsession.

gist: Mimics the helpless person's complaints: what do I do about this one, what do I do about that one, he does not listen to me, she does not listen to me.

hindi: उसका कर्म वो जाने अपना सूर्य मत खराब करो
says: Do's and don'ts: let others carry their own karma and do not spoil your own Sun by fretting over how they behave.
classical_check: Silent: a self-help instruction of his own, not a classical remedy.

hindi: आपका विटामिन डी डाउन होगा सेल्यूलर लेवल पर डिक्लाइन होगा
says: The penalty for spoiling the Sun this way is that vitamin D falls and the body declines at the level of its cells. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent: vitamin D and cell-level decline are modern terms; the classical idea is a weakened Sun lowering vitality.

hindi: आपके आंखों में फर्क महसूस होगा उन दिनों में आपको आपको लगेगा कि लगता है मेरा आंखें कुछ साफ देख नहीं पा रहे हम कुछ चश्मे का नंबर तो नहीं पढ़ गया
says: In those days you will feel a change in the eyes, as if you cannot see clearly and your spectacle number might have gone up. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The eye link follows the Sun's house: the 2nd and 12th are the eye houses, so a Sun troubled there is where the eye complaint is read from.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Virgo in the 2nd (lagna Leo) troubled by Rahu points to strain or blur in eyesight in the tradition (tradition claim, not a diagnosis).
Derived: Sun exalted in the 12th (lagna Taurus) resists, but with Rahu the tradition still expects tired, strained eyes and poor sleep under stress.

classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun rules the eyes classically, and Sun with Rahu is read as eye trouble; the spectacle example is his own.

hindi: कुछ भारीपन सा लग रहा है सिर में क्या चक्कर है यह और आपके शरीर में दर्दें आएंगी कहीं ना कहीं जब ऐसी स्थिति बनेगी
says: You will also feel a heaviness in the head and wonder what is going on, and aches will come somewhere in the body whenever this situation arises. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is tied to the head classically; the heaviness symptom is his example.

hindi: आप सूर्य डिप्लीट कर रहे हो सूर्य डिप्लीशन कब हो रही है जब विटामिन डी डिक्लाइन बॉडी बता रही है
says: You are depleting your Sun; Sun depletion is present when vitamin D declines, which the body signals by itself. Health claim as stated by him.
classical_check: Silent: 'depletion' is his modern wording for a weakened Sun.

hindi: और वो क्यों हो रहा है क्योंकि आपने अपने जीवन के अंदर सूर्य को राहु की बाधा लगा दी है
says: The cause of the depletion is that you have, in your own life, put Rahu's obstruction on the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The obstruction hits the life-area of the house where Sun and Rahu meet; the sign tells how well the Sun can resist.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Rahu in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo) puts an ego shadow over partnerships and public dealings.
Derived: Sun with Rahu in Scorpio in the 2nd (lagna Libra) shadows family, speech and savings with pride and secrecy.

ambiguity: 'Put the obstruction' reads as a result of the person's own conduct (karmic), not only a chart placement.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun afflicted by Rahu is a classical affliction; the 'you did it yourself' framing is his.

hindi: आप बेबस हो उस परमात्मा को मत भूलो आप बेबस क्यों
says: Remedy: when you feel helpless, do not forget the Supreme Being, and ask yourself why you are helpless at all.
classical_check: Silent: surrender to God is a general remedy, not a rule for Rahu.

hindi: हर कर्म ऐसे करो कि यह कृष्ण के प्रति हमारा भावा अमृत है यही अमृत चक रहे हैं हमके कृष्ण के प्रति कार्य और अपना अपना देवता चुन लो
says: Remedy: do every action as an offering to Krishna, tasting that as nectar of devotion, and let each person choose their own deity for this.
ambiguity: Several words are garbled ('भावा', 'चक रहे हैं हमके'); read as 'our devotion is the nectar we are tasting'.
classical_check: Silent: offering all action to a deity is karma-yoga from the Gita, not a classical Jyotish remedy rule.

hindi: आपके जीवन में कोई लेनदेन ही नहीं दूसरे से एक्सपेक्टेशन ही खत्म आपका सूर्य डिस्टर्ब नहीं होगा
says: Remedy: keep no give-and-take and no expectations from others, and your Sun will not be disturbed.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary ('होगा' starts the next chunk).
classical_check: Silent: a detachment ethic of his own, not a classical Sun remedy.

hindi: अगर आपका विटामिन डी डाउन है तो आपका मुन्ना आपका सूर्य की कृपा से अपने आप याद दिलाएगा विटामिन डी की गोली ले
says: If your vitamin D is low, he says your inner voice (called 'munna' here) will, by the Sun's grace, remind you to take a vitamin D tablet. Recorded as his statement, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' (little boy) is unclear; read as the inner self or intuition.
classical_check: Silent: a supplement suggestion is modern, not from Jyotish.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक आपके जीवन में ऊर्जा रहेगी नहीं तो आप थके टूटे रहोगे आप में जान ही नहीं होगी पता नहीं क्यों जान नहीं होगी
says: With the Sun in order, energy stays in your life by itself; otherwise you will be tired and broken with no strength and not know why.
cells_derived_method: Energy is high with the Sun in own or friendly signs in kendra, trikona or the 11th, and low with the Sun debilitated or in the 8th and 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in its own sign in the 11th (lagna Libra) gives steady energy and gains.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 8th (lagna Pisces) gives a tired, low-drive pattern.

classical_check: Agrees in direction: a strong Sun gives vitality, a weak Sun gives fatigue.

hindi: नेत्रों में प्रॉब्लम आएगी आंखों में खुश्की चढ़ेगी
says: A depleted Sun brings eye problems, with dryness settling in the eyes. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun rules the eyes; dryness is a specific symptom he names.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक सूरज डिप्लीट होने के टाइम आपका चंद्रमा भी डिप्लीट हो जाता है आपको नजले की शिकायत होगी सिर का भारीपन आएगा परेशानी होगी
says: When the Sun is depleted the Moon gets depleted too, so you get catarrh or cold complaints and a heavy head. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's drop follows the Sun's weakness most when the two sit together; water signs and the 6th house add the cold and phlegm side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Moon's sign on the ascendant with a weak Moon points to a cold-prone, phlegmatic body in the tradition.
Derived: Sun in watery Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra) points to recurring chest and cold complaints in the tradition (not a diagnosis).

classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun and Moon are the two luminaries and the Moon's light comes from the Sun; the Moon rules phlegm and colds; the 'depleted together' link is his own.

hindi: इसके लिए अपने पिता की सेवा करो
says: Remedy for the Sun's trouble: serve your father.
classical_check: Agrees: serving and honouring the father is a standard classical remedy for the Sun.

gist: Hypothetical objection: what if the father is awful, abusive, drinks every day, talks nonsense and fights with the mother at home.

hindi: यह वाला बाप आउट करो दूसरा बाप गोद लो आउट कर दो इस बाप को दफा कर दो कॉर्ड कटिंग कर दो नया बाप लो
says: Remedy if your own father is bad: cut that father out of your mind (cord cutting) and adopt another father figure instead.
ambiguity: It is an inner or psychological substitution, not a call to cut ties physically; he does not say which.
classical_check: Silent: a substitute-father remedy is his own, not found in the classics.

hindi: नहीं सजारा बाप परमपिता परमेश्वर उसको पिता मानो फोटोग्राफ में दादा को पिता मान लो जो आपको आइडलाइज करता है उस पिता को उठा लो
says: Choices for the substitute father: the supreme father (God), a grandfather seen in a photograph, or any father figure who idealises you or whom you idealise.
ambiguity: 'सजारा' is garbled (maybe 'सच्चा', true); 'आइडलाइज करता है' could mean either the figure idealises you or you idealise the figure.
classical_check: Silent: his own list; the classics only say to honour father, elders and ancestors.

hindi: राहु का स्थान होता है हमारे हमारे घर के अंदर डब् व में जहां पर पितृ होते हैं
says: Vastu link: Rahu's place in our house is where the ancestors (pitr) sit; the direction word is garbled.
ambiguity: 'डब् व' is garbled; it is a direction or zone of the home, probably south or south-west where Vastu places the ancestors. The sentence crosses a caption boundary.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu and ancestors (pitr dosha) are linked in popular Jyotish, and Vastu puts the ancestors on the south side; this home placement is a vastu-link claim.

hindi: देवता का नाम ही पितृ है
says: The deity of that spot is itself called Pitr, the ancestor deity.
classical_check: Agrees: the Vastu mandala has a deity named Pitr among its outer deities.

hindi: मृगा होता है एसेट में उसके बाद देवता का होता है हमारा पित्र पि स्थान
says: Vastu sequence: the deity Mriga is at one spot and next to it comes the deity belonging to the Pitr place, our ancestors' spot.
ambiguity: 'एसेट में' is garbled (maybe a direction word); the caption of the rest is also broken, so this is a best reading.
classical_check: Partly agrees: in the Vastu deity ring, Mriga and Pitr sit next to each other on the south side (from my own knowledge of the grid).

hindi: राहु वहां ग्रसित राहु बैठा है वहां यानी राहु की प्रसन्नता चाहिए राहु की प्रसन्नता चाहिए सूर्य ठीक होगा
says: An afflicted Rahu sits in that ancestors' place, so Rahu has to be pleased, and only then will the Sun be right.
ambiguity: 'ग्रसित' means afflicted or gripped; whether the chart's Rahu or the home zone is meant is unclear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: pacifying Rahu for ancestor-linked Sun trouble is popular practice; the home-zone link is a vastu claim.

hindi: अगर आपका सूर्य दोष लो लग गया आपको सुझा ई नहीं देगा जीवन का प्रकाश समाप्त हो गया अंधकार में चले जाओगे
says: Once the Sun has taken the blemish you will see no way ahead, the light of life is gone and you slide into darkness; this sets up his next point about what works in that phase.
classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted Sun gives loss of direction and authority; 'light ends' is imagery.

hindi: आपको सिर्फ डार्क एनर्जी हेल्प कर सकती है उस समय यानी कि पाप कर्म के द्वारा ही जीवन में उठ सकते हो
says: In that dark phase only dark energy helps you, meaning you can rise in life only through sinful action. He is describing the Rahu phase, recorded as his statement and not endorsed.
ambiguity: Reads as a description of how Rahu's phase tends to push people, not a recommendation.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not advise sinful action; Rahu is linked to unconventional means.

gist: Sarcastic follow-up to the dark-energy point: then do not cry, you are doing sin, so enjoy the sin.

hindi: राहु ही शराब की बोतल है
says: Rahu is the liquor bottle, that is, alcohol and intoxication belong to Rahu.
cells_derived_method: The habit shows in the house of consumption or pleasure where Rahu sits: the 2nd (food and drink) and the 5th (pleasure and escape).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Taurus in the 2nd points to a pull toward rich food and drink in the tradition.
Derived: Rahu in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio) points to escapism and intoxicants as a way of seeking pleasure.

classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is classically tied to liquor and intoxicants.

hindi: समझो शनि का एजेंट है शनि भी वही है और शनि का एजेंट क्यों है
says: Take Rahu as Saturn's agent, and Saturn is of the same kind; then he asks why Rahu is Saturn's agent.
ambiguity: 'शनि भी वही है' is vague: it could mean Saturn is also the liquor or simply of the same dark nature as Rahu.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is said to act like Saturn (shani-vat Rahu).

hindi: शनि और सूर्य पिता पुत्र है कैसी कहानियां बनाई है एक अंधेरा है एक उजाला है
says: Saturn and the Sun are father and son, which is a story about darkness against light: one is the dark, the other the bright.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the Sun's son and an enemy of the Sun in the classics.

hindi: जहां शनि सूर्य का लफड़ा बैठ गया बाप बेटे का क्लेश होगा
says: Wherever the Saturn-Sun clash sits in a chart, father and son will be in quarrel.
cells_derived_method: The quarrel shows in the life-area of the house where Sun and Saturn meet, and sign dignity decides who is stronger.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Saturn in Capricorn in the 10th, where Saturn is in its own sign, makes the son (or the native) work under the father's shadow in career.
Derived: Sun with Saturn in Aquarius in the 9th (lagna Gemini) gives estranged views and distance from the father and dharma.
Derived: Sun is debilitated here. Saturn is exalted in the same sign in the 4th (lagna Cancer), so the son's weight overwhelms the father at home.

ambiguity: 'लफड़ा बैठ गया' is read as conjunction or mutual affliction; aspect is not excluded.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun with Saturn is classically read as friction with the father.

hindi: और राहु से पिटवा जाएगा वो क्योंकि शनि तो मार नहीं सकता सूर्य को अंधकार कभी प्रकाश को मार नहीं सकता प्रकाश चला गया तभी अंधकार अपने आप आया है
says: Saturn cannot strike the Sun himself, because darkness cannot kill light; he has Rahu do the beating. Darkness only comes when the light has already gone.
classical_check: Silent: the agent mechanism is his own story; the Saturn-Rahu likeness is classical.

hindi: शनि आई तब सकता है कमरे में जब बाप नहीं है क्योंकि वो नौकर माना जाता है
says: Saturn can enter the room only when the father is absent, because Saturn counts as the servant and cannot walk in on the king.
ambiguity: 'आई तब सकता है' is garbled; read as 'can come in only when'.
classical_check: Silent: his story; the Saturn-as-servant image is classical.

hindi: ये सूर्यकांत राजा है ये शनि चाकर है एक प्रकार से
says: The Sun is the king and Saturn is, in a way, the servant.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary ('है एक प्रकार से' starts the next chunk).
classical_check: Agrees: the classical planetary court makes the Sun the king and Saturn the servant.

hindi: लेकिन बेटा ही है इसका समझो नाजायज संतान समझ लो
says: Yet Saturn is the Sun's own son; he says to regard him as an illegitimate child.
ambiguity: 'नाजायज' (illegitimate) is his own label for Saturn's standing as the Sun's son.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the Sun's son by Chhaya, the shadow wife; 'illegitimate' is his word, not classical.

hindi: अब वो आता ही कमरे में तब है लेकिन इसने एजेंट रखा हुआ है राहु ये कहता है बाप की ना साले ऐसी तैसी करी हो बदला लेना मुझे
says: Saturn enters only when the father is away, but he keeps Rahu as his agent and tells him to wreck the father because he wants revenge.
ambiguity: The speaker of 'बाप की ऐसी तैसी' is Saturn talking to Rahu; the line is partly slang.
classical_check: Silent: Saturn sending Rahu for revenge is his story; Rahu acting like Saturn is classical.

hindi: शनि क्या है अज्ञानता ऐश अयाशी सारा मुन्ना सारा खजाना सारा धन सारी प्रॉपर्टी जायदाद दो नंबर के काम
says: Saturn stands for ignorance, indulgence and debauchery, all the stored treasure, wealth, property and estates, and shady dealings.
cells_derived_method: Which of these shows depends on Saturn's house: property in the 4th, hoarded wealth in the 2nd, hidden dealings in the 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 4th (lagna Libra) points to inherited land, property and estates.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 2nd (lagna Capricorn) points to slow, stored-up wealth and a treasure-keeping habit.
Derived: Saturn in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio) points in the tradition to hidden or undeclared dealings (not a charge against any person).

ambiguity: 'सारा मुन्ना' is garbled (maybe 'सारा मुनाफा', all the profit).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is tamas, ignorance, property and long-held wealth; luxury is usually Venus and shady money Rahu, so the mix is his own.

hindi: और सूर्य क्या है चेतना
says: The Sun is consciousness (chetana), the awareness side of a person.
ambiguity: The words after it ('नहीं गंदे बात अच्छी बात...') are garbled, so the sentence may continue.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the soul or consciousness (atma) karaka.

gist: Garbled fragment about dirty talk and good talk that these cannot do; the meaning cannot be recovered from the caption.

hindi: शुभ कर्म करो ऊपर की ओर ऊपर के चक्र पर प्लेसमेंट रखो
says: Remedy: do auspicious deeds and keep your focus upward on the upper chakras, the Sun's side.
ambiguity: 'Placement on the upper chakras' is a yoga phrase; no technique is given.
classical_check: Silent: a general ethic framed with yoga language; the chakra part is not classical Jyotish.

hindi: शनि कहता अे नीचे आना पार्टी करेंगे यार किन चक्रों में लगा है काम नहीं हो रहा
says: Saturn calls you down to the party, pulling attention to the lower centres, which is where the work gets stuck.
ambiguity: The tail 'किन चक्रों में लगा है काम नहीं हो रहा' is garbled; read as 'which chakras is it engaged in, nothing gets done'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is tamas and low pleasures; the chakra wording is yoga, not classical.

hindi: सबसे नजदीक इसके राहु है याय राहु है यह इससे काम कराता है राहु को बोलता है
says: The planet closest to Saturn is Rahu, who gets his work done through Rahu by giving him the orders.
ambiguity: 'इसके' (his) refers to Saturn as the speaker's subject; read in context of the preceding lines.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu acts like Saturn in the classics; the executor image is his.

hindi: जो शनि कुंडली में आपका बुरा है और राहु अच्छा है तो भी राहु बुरा फल देगा मिक्स कर देगा
says: If Saturn is bad in your chart and Rahu is good, Rahu will still give bad results by mixing the two; Rahu's result follows Saturn's condition.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's good placement is only as good as Saturn's condition; the house shows where the mixed result lands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer) promises gains, but if Saturn is weak in the chart the gains come with loss or delay.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) promises partnerships, but with an afflicted Saturn they turn sour or cold.

ambiguity: 'अच्छा' for Rahu is not defined (strong sign or good house); both are possible.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu gives the results of its dispositor and associates, so Saturn's state matters; 'always bad' is stronger than the classics.

hindi: शनि आपका लाजवाब है राहु नीच का है राहु की नीचता घट जाएगी
says: If Saturn is excellent in your chart and Rahu is debilitated, Rahu's lowness will shrink; a strong Saturn lifts a weak Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's debilitation sign depends on the school; with a strong Saturn the harm is softened in the house where Rahu sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 8th, the debilitation sign in one school, has its harm softened if Saturn is strong.
Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo), the debilitation sign in the other school, is made gentler by a strong Saturn.

ambiguity: He does not say which sign is Rahu's debilitation; Scorpio and Sagittarius are the two traditions.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a strong dispositor softens a weak node; Rahu's debilitation sign is disputed between schools.

hindi: यानी एजेंट तो वो उसी का है क्योंकि छाया ग्रह है नहीं असल में य यह छाया है
says: Rahu is Saturn's agent because it is a shadow planet; it is not a real body, only a shadow that borrows from Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: shadow nodes take the colour of their dispositors and associates, with Rahu linked to Saturn.

hindi: ऐसे मंगल का है
says: In the same way, Mars has his own agent, who is Ketu (the object of 'है' is Ketu, named in the next line).
ambiguity: The sentence is clipped; 'मंगल का है' is read as 'Ketu is Mars's agent' from the following lines.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is said to act like Mars (kuja-vat Ketu) in the classics.

hindi: केतु कौन है पूंछ हनुमान जी की पूंछ है
says: Ketu is the tail, and in his story it is Hanuman's tail.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary ('जी की पूंछ है' starts the next chunk).
classical_check: Silent: the Hanuman link is his image; Ketu as the tail is Puranic.

hindi: ये इस पूंछ के दम पर हनुमान जी ने पूरी लंका ला लंका की लाल कर दी
says: With the power of this tail Hanuman turned all of Lanka red with fire, showing Ketu's strength at setting things ablaze.
ambiguity: The caption stutters ('ला लंका की'); read as 'set all of Lanka aflame'.
classical_check: Silent: a story-based image of Ketu, not a classical rule.

hindi: लंका कहां है लंका है यहां शनि में सोना कहां है सोना धरती में होता है गर्भ में
says: Lanka is in the Saturn area of the story: it is the realm of gold, and gold lies in the womb of the earth, so Lanka stands for Saturn's buried treasure.
ambiguity: 'यहां शनि में' is read as 'here in Saturn's department'.
classical_check: Differs: classical gold is for Jupiter and the Sun, while Saturn gets iron and oil; the buried-treasure link is his allegory.

gist: Hanuman flew from here over the ocean (jaladhi, the water) to Lanka, which is no wonder.

hindi: और यहां पर लंका में पूंछ से आग लगा दी तो हनुमान को करना कुछ नहीं है केतु को बोलना है
says: The fire in Lanka was lit by the tail, so Hanuman himself need do nothing; he only has to tell Ketu, which does the work as Mars's executor.
classical_check: Silent: the executor image is his own.

hindi: आग जलती देखी है आपने मंगल अग्नि है उसमें धुआ होता है
says: Mars is fire, and fire always carries smoke; the smoke is Ketu.
ambiguity: He does not say 'smoke is Ketu' outright; it is read from the next lines where Ketu is the fire's agent.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is classically smoky (dhumra) and Mars is fire.

hindi: धुआ ही आपकी ऐसी कर देगा दूर खड़े खड़े आग के पास आप गई नहीं धुए में घुट के मर जाओगे तो केतु उसका एजेंट है
says: The smoke alone can ruin you even if you stand far from the fire and never go near it, you can suffocate in it; that is why Ketu is Mars's agent. The death talk is a figure of speech.
ambiguity: 'मर जाओगे' (you will die) is a vivid figure of speech, not a death prediction.
classical_check: Silent: his image of Ketu harming at a distance.

hindi: अगर मंगल बढ़िया है केतु अच्छा काम करेगा
says: If Mars is good in the chart, Ketu will do good work; Ketu's results follow Mars's condition.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in a sign ruled by Mars or in Mars's exaltation sign gets Mars's strength and acts well; the house shows the area that benefits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu sits in Mars's own sign Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius), giving courage and sharp effort if Mars is strong.
Derived: Ketu sits in Mars's own sign Scorpio in the 10th (lagna Aquarius), giving disciplined, detached career action if Mars is strong.
Derived: Ketu sits in Mars's exalted sign Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer), giving a steady, protective partner side if Mars is strong.

ambiguity: 'बढ़िया' (good) is not defined as strong sign or good house.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu acts like Mars in the classics, so Mars's condition shapes Ketu's results.

gist: Lead-in question: to keep the Sun strong, vitamin D from dropping and trouble away, what has to be done?

hindi: एक तो राहु और केतु को सेट करके रखना है यही दो तंग करते हैं
says: Remedy: first keep Rahu and Ketu settled (pacified), because these two are the ones that cause the trouble.
classical_check: Silent: classical Rahu-Ketu remedies are specific (mantra, charity); 'set them' is his general instruction.

hindi: तो इन दोनों के मालिक कौन है एक शनि
says: The masters of Rahu and Ketu are named: one of them is Saturn (the other, Mars, was named earlier).
ambiguity: He names only Saturn here; Mars as the second master is taken from the preceding lines.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Rahu follows Saturn and Ketu follows Mars in classical practice.

hindi: यह कौन है चाकर सारे चाकर है य जो पांव दबाते हैं
says: Saturn stands for servants, all the attendants, those who press your feet.
cells_derived_method: Servants and subordinates are read from the 6th house and the 10th; Saturn there shows the type of dependants.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 6th (lagna Leo) gives reliable, hard-working servants and subordinates.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 10th (lagna Taurus) points to work involving service, labour or the masses.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the servant and labour karaka.

hindi: इनको कभी भी नाराज नहीं करना बच्चे की तरह ट्रीट करना प्यार करना
says: Do's and don'ts: never anger these servants and helpers (Saturn, Rahu and Ketu people), treat them like children and show love.
ambiguity: 'इनको' could mean the servants only or Saturn, Rahu and Ketu as planets; he links the two.
classical_check: Silent: treating servants well is a popular Saturn remedy, not in Parashara.

gist: Starts an everyday story: your own child, to whom you bring an iPhone (continues in the next chunk).
The child gets angry at the father and abuses him, tells the mother she is worthless, and compares her with the neighbour aunty who loves her kids more.
The mother answers that she bought a 1.5 lakh iPhone for him, and he gives nothing back and only sucks her blood.

hindi: वहीं पर आपने दो बालक रखे हैं प्रेम करने वाले जो आपका सेवा भी करते हैं कुछ देते हैं व सेवा भी कर रहे प्रेम भी कर रहे हैं वह आपके शनि राहु केतु है इनके लिए साथ प्रसन्नता रखो
says: By contrast, the dependants who love you, serve you and give you something are your Saturn, Rahu and Ketu, so keep them pleased.
ambiguity: 'दो बालक' (two boys) could mean two real helpers or children; read as people who serve and love you.
classical_check: Silent: dependants as Saturn is classical, but adding Rahu and Ketu is his own.

hindi: जितना पशु धन है जिनके द्वारा सेवा मिल रही है उनमें शनि का गुण है
says: All the livestock and animals that give you service carry Saturn's quality.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn rules servants and labour; cattle are usually Moon or Venus, so animals as Saturn is his reading.

hindi: घोड़ा जो होता है चंद्रमा होता है लेकिन वाइट घोड़ा काला घोड़ा जो है व शनि रूपी चंद्रमा है
says: The horse is the Moon, but only the white horse; the black horse is the Moon in Saturn's form.
ambiguity: The caption 'वाइट घोड़ा' sits between two clauses; read as 'the white one is Moon, the black one is Saturn-type Moon'.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts link horses to the Sun or Moon in different lists; the white and black split into Moon and Saturn is his own.

hindi: यानी आपको सेवा करने वाला तो आपके व्हीकल भी वही है आपकी गाड़ियां आपके मोटरसाइकिल आपके साइकिल साफ सुथरी ठीक रखो शनि प्रसन्न रहेगा
says: Remedy: your vehicles also serve you and so belong to Saturn's group; keep cars, motorcycles and cycles clean and in order and Saturn stays pleased.
classical_check: Differs: vehicles are classically a Venus matter; vehicles as Saturn is his reading, and the upkeep remedy is general.

hindi: शनि प्रसन्न रहेगा तो क्या होगा नीचे का मामला ठीक य ये पक्की बात है रोटी पक्की है भाई
says: When Saturn is pleased, the lower-body or lower-centre matters stay in order and your livelihood (roti) is assured; he calls this certain.
ambiguity: 'नीचे का मामला' could mean the lower body, the lower chakras or lower-class dependants; the first two are likelier.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a pleased Saturn is said to give steady livelihood; no classical text promises it as certain.

hindi: अगर आपने शनि ठीक रखा आपकी रोटी पक्की है
says: If you have kept Saturn in good order, your livelihood (roti) is secure.
cells_derived_method: Saturn keeps livelihood steady when strong by sign (Libra exalted, Capricorn and Aquarius own) and well housed (10th, 6th, 11th); debilitated in Aries it makes bread-and-butter hard-won.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in the 10th (lagna Capricorn) gives secure, lasting livelihood and authority in work.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 6th (lagna Leo) gives steady income through service and routine work.
Derived: Saturn debilitated on the ascendant gives a struggle to build a steady livelihood early in life.

ambiguity: 'ठीक रखा' (kept right) points to remedies and conduct from the last chunk, not only to a chart placement.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a strong Saturn gives stable livelihood in practice; 'assured' is stronger than the classics.

hindi: भाड़ में गया ज्ञान नहीं आ रहा ज्ञान नहीं है इतनी अकल नहीं पैदा हुआ ज्ञान नहीं लेना
says: With Saturn right, lack of knowledge does not matter: if learning does not come, you were not born with that much brains, and you do not want knowledge, you are still fine.
ambiguity: A slangy, rhetorical line; he does not mean knowledge is useless, only that Saturn's security does not depend on it.
classical_check: Silent: classical wisdom is Jupiter's department; Saturn gives practical, plodding skill.

hindi: रोटी पक्की है प्रॉपर्टी पक्की है व्हीकल पक्का है
says: A well-kept Saturn secures three things: livelihood, property and vehicle.
cells_derived_method: Property and vehicle show through the 4th house, stored food and wealth through the 2nd; Saturn in its own sign there backs them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 4th (lagna Scorpio) points to land, property and a steady vehicle.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 2nd (lagna Sagittarius) points to a well-stocked household and slow-growing savings.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn gives property and long-held assets; vehicles are classically Venus.

hindi: अब अगर चेतना अच्छी है सूर्य की कृपा है तो ज्यादा बड़ी प्रॉपर्टी ज्यादा बड़ा ज्ञान ज्यादा बड़ी मौज करोगे
says: If consciousness is also good, meaning the Sun is gracious, you get bigger property, bigger knowledge and bigger enjoyment on top of Saturn's basics.
cells_derived_method: The upgrade from the Sun shows where it is well placed: the 9th for knowledge, the 10th for status and property.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in the 9th (lagna Leo) adds depth of learning and fortune on top of whatever Saturn secures.
Derived: Sun in its own sign in the 10th (lagna Scorpio) adds rank and larger holdings.

classical_check: Agrees in direction: a strong Sun lifts status and learning; 'bigger of everything' is rhetoric.

hindi: अगर नहीं है तो गुरु का सहारा लेना है यानी किसी गुरु के पल्ले बन जाओ उसी के साथ पार्टी कर लो
says: Remedy: if your consciousness (Sun) is weak, take a guru's support, attach yourself to some guru and enjoy life along with him.
ambiguity: 'पार्टी कर लो' is slang for sharing in the guru's good company, not literally a party.
classical_check: Partly agrees: taking a guru's shelter is a standard remedy; the exact use for a weak Sun is his.

hindi: इसके लिए आपको शनि को सेट करना है राहु ग्रहण नहीं लगाएगा
says: Remedy: set Saturn right and Rahu will not eclipse the Sun, since Rahu works for Saturn.
classical_check: Silent: setting Saturn to stop a Rahu eclipse is his own chain; Rahu behaving like Saturn is classical.

hindi: इसके लिए आपको केतु के लिए मंगल सेट करना है यह नाभी है
says: Remedy: for Ketu, set Mars right; Mars sits at the navel centre.
ambiguity: Earlier (22:04) he gave the navel to the Sun; here and below the navel is Mars's. Both name the same fire centre.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu acts like Mars in the classics; the navel placement of Mars is a yoga-body association.

hindi: भाड़ में जाए हनुमान जी के लिए हर चीज भाड़ में जाए
says: For Hanuman, the Mars deity, everything can go to blazes; his nature is a carefree 'let it all go' attitude.
ambiguity: 'भाड़ में जाए' is a slang phrase meaning 'who cares, let it go to hell'.
classical_check: Silent: Hanuman as the Mars deity is popular worship, not Parashari.

hindi: अग्नि के लिए अं अग्नि में कुछ भी डाल दो अग्नि कहती है भाड़ में जाए
says: Fire takes whatever is thrown into it and does not mind, which is how Mars as fire behaves.
classical_check: Silent: Mars as fire is classical; the 'accepts anything' image is his.

hindi: पेट में जठ रागनी है खूब दारू पी खूब मुर्गे खाए खूब कतल मचाया खूब बकवास खाई मैगी चबा रहे हैं सोच रहे हैं यहां भाड़ में जाए बॉडी में कुछ नहीं होगा
says: The digestive fire (jatharagni) in the belly is Mars's fire, so he says a person can drink heavily, eat meat and junk food and the body will not suffer. This is his claim about Mars, recorded and not endorsed as diet or health advice.
ambiguity: A speaker's exaggeration to show how strong a Mars fire is; no limit or condition is given.
classical_check: Silent: a strong digestive fire is read from Sun and Mars, but the 'nothing will happen' claim is not classical. Not dietary advice.

hindi: हनुमान जी कहीं भी चले गए कहानियां कितनी सुंदर कि जल को लांघ गए समुद्र पार कर गए वरुण की भी ऐसी तैसी
says: Hanuman went anywhere; in the story he jumped across water and crossed the sea, overpowering Varuna too. So Mars (fire) is shown beating Varuna, the water-lord (Neptune in his scheme).
ambiguity: Varuna as Neptune is from his 12-planet scheme; the sentence itself only names Varuna.
classical_check: Silent: an allegory; Neptune is not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: सोचो कौन सा ग्रह अपने आप में कं बलशाली है
says: A rhetorical question: which planet is mighty all by itself? The Hanuman story points to Mars.
ambiguity: The answer is not spoken; 'Mars' is inferred from the Hanuman context. The word 'कं बलशाली' is split across the caption boundary.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the planet of strength and valour.

hindi: वरुण देवता को सुरसा के मुंह से निकले अंदर गए बुद्धिमानी देखो और बाहर यात्रा करी
says: In the Surasa episode Hanuman slipped into her mouth and came out again, and he asks you to see the intelligence in it; so Mars's might comes with wit.
ambiguity: The opening 'वरुण देवता को' is garbled and does not fit the Surasa story; read as a stray from the previous line.
classical_check: Silent: an allegory for Mars with intelligence.

hindi: सीता को उठा के ले आओ कोई बात नहीं मर्यादा के लिए राम के लिए छोड़ा है नहीं तो ला सकते थे रावण को निपटा दूं सब कर दूं अहंकार का नाश कर दूं
says: Hanuman could have lifted Sita and brought her back, finished Ravana and destroyed his ego, but held back for the sake of Rama's maryada (honour and dignity). Mars has the power to do it all and restrains it out of devotion.
ambiguity: The caption blends narrator and Hanuman's voice in a single run.
classical_check: Silent: an allegory for restraint; no classical rule.

hindi: अल्टीमेटली हनुमान काबू नहीं क्यों भाड़ में जाए कोई परवाह ही नहीं है
says: Ultimately Hanuman cannot be controlled, because he does not care about anything; this carefree quality makes the Mars type uncontrollable.
classical_check: Silent: his own characterisation of Mars.

gist: People make jokes about Hanuman (a garbled line about a wife), and he says we Sanatanis can take jokes since Hanuman is a deity like our Supreme Being.

hindi: लेकिन यह हनुमान ही तो कर सकते हैं क्या किसी में ऐसा गुण है जो बिना मतलब के किसी की मदद करके आए
says: Only Hanuman can do it: does anyone else have the quality of helping someone with no motive and walking away? Selfless help is made out to be a Mars quality.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the courageous helper; selfless help is more often given to Jupiter and the Sun in the classics.

hindi: मंगल सेनापति बनाता है जो नाभी पर रहता है वो सेनापति है यानी वह अपने आप में बॉस ही है एक बॉस है उसके ऊपर लेकिन वो खुद भी बॉस है
says: Mars makes a commander (senapati); the one who lives at the navel is the commander, a boss in his own right, though one boss may stand above him.
cells_derived_method: The commander role shows where Mars is strong: the 10th (rank), the 3rd (leading by courage) and the 6th (managing staff).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th gives a commander-type executive career with real authority.
Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 3rd (lagna Virgo) gives a team leader who leads by courage and initiative.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the army commander (senapati) in the classical planetary court.

hindi: यदि कार्यक्षेत्र में मंगल के और राहु की स्थिति ऐसी बन जाए कि वह बैठे हो या दृष्टि हो दसवां घर होता है कार्य का तो आप सेनापति होंगे आपके ऊपर एक बॉस होगा लेकिन आप ही बॉस होंगे
says: If Mars and Rahu sit in the work-sphere, the 10th house, or aspect it, you will be a commander: a boss above you, yet you yourself a boss.
cells_derived_method: The commander result needs Mars and Rahu in or aspecting the 10th; the sign sets the style: fire signs give command, earth signs give executive follow-through.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) with Rahu gives a strong executive who runs a division under a higher boss.
Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 10th (lagna Cancer) with Rahu gives an ambitious line commander who pushes hard.
Derived: Mars in the 10th in Virgo (lagna Sagittarius) with Rahu's aspect gives a technical or analytical supervisor.

ambiguity: 'वह बैठे हो या दृष्टि हो' (sitting or aspecting) leaves open whether it is Mars, Rahu or both that do it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars in the 10th is strong (directional strength) and Mars with Rahu gives bold ambition; the 'boss above, but you are a boss' reading is his gloss.

hindi: यह तब है जब आप नाभी से शुद्ध हैं
says: The commander result holds only when you are pure at the navel centre.
ambiguity: 'नाभी से शुद्ध' is a yoga term; purity is defined in the next lines as lacking greed and ill will.
classical_check: Silent: a moral condition of his own, outside the classics.

hindi: आपके मन में यह नहीं है लूट लू खा जाऊं इसको नाराज कर दूं उसे पागल कर दूं आप शुद्ध चित्त मन से रहते हो और कहते हो भाड़ में जाए
says: Navel purity means there is no thought in your mind of looting, devouring, angering or driving someone mad; you live with a clean mind and say 'let it go'.
classical_check: Silent: a moral definition of his own.

hindi: मुझे कम अकल है भैया अपने तो कम अकल में ही मौज करेंगे आप कम अकल में मौज कर रहे हो इफ बट ना लोभ है ना लालच है
says: The pure-hearted say they have little brains and enjoy life on that; this works because there is no greed and no hunger for gain.
ambiguity: 'इफ बट' is a filler; read as 'with no ifs and buts, there is no greed'.
classical_check: Silent: an ethic of contentment of his own.

hindi: क्या मिलेगा मुझे सीता को बचा के अरे छोड़ यार मिलना राम को है हमें क्या हम तो राम की भक्ति मिल
says: Hanuman's attitude is: what do I get by rescuing Sita, forget it, Rama is the one who gets her, we are only devoted to Rama. He serves without expecting any reward.
ambiguity: The last word 'मिल' is a stray from the caption and reads like 'in devotion to Rama'.
classical_check: Silent: nishkama karma ethic, from the Gita.

hindi: राम कहां है मर्यादा हृदय आप हृदय चक्र हृदय पर कौन रहता है
says: Where is Rama? He is maryada (honour and dignity), which sits in the heart, the heart chakra; he then asks who stays on the heart.
classical_check: Silent: Rama as maryada in the heart is devotional, and the heart chakra is yoga language.

hindi: यहां चक्र के ऊपर वरुण रहता है और कौन रहता है शुक्र
says: The heart chakra is the seat of Varuna (Neptune) and also of Venus.
ambiguity: The meaning of 'चक्र के ऊपर' is unclear: on or above the chakra.
classical_check: Differs: the classical heart planets are the Sun (and Moon); Neptune is not classical, and Venus on the heart is his own link.

hindi: सारी तो मौज करोगे दिल क्या मौजे कराता है दिल खुश हो गया यार
says: When Venus and Varuna in the heart are pleased you enjoy everything, since the heart is what produces joy: 'the heart is happy, friend'.
cells_derived_method: Joy shows in the house of happiness and pleasure where Venus sits: the 4th for inner contentment, the 12th for the pleasures of the bed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius) gives deep contentment of the heart and a happy home.
Derived: Venus in its own sign in the 12th (lagna Scorpio) gives enjoyment in private life and abroad.

ambiguity: The subject is implied from the last line: a content heart of Venus and Varuna.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of enjoyment; the heart-joy link is his image.

hindi: वर्ण समुद्र जितना बड़ा दिल होना चाहिए आपका बुरा तो मानते ही नहीं ना समुद्र में कुछ भी डाल देते हैं कोई बुरा मानता है समुद्र कभी
says: Varuna's nature is the ocean: your heart should be as big as the sea and never take offence, since people throw anything into the ocean and it never complains.
ambiguity: 'वर्ण' is the caption's mis-spelling of 'वरुण'.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not classical; the ocean-hearted Varuna is his image.

hindi: यदि आप इस स्वभाव के हैं आपका वरुण प्रसन्न हो जाएगा
says: Remedy: if you have this ocean-like, non-offended nature, your Varuna becomes pleased.
classical_check: Silent: a character-based remedy of his own.

hindi: और वरुण किस स्थान पर रिप्रेजेंटेशन करता है यह है आपका इंद्र का स्थान जो पैरों में है मुड़ने से जांघे
says: Body map of the outer planets begins: Indra's place (Uranus in his scheme) is in the legs, from the bend upward, the thighs.
ambiguity: He asks where Varuna sits but answers with Indra's place; the thigh reading follows from the next line giving the calves to Varuna. The sentence crosses a caption boundary.
classical_check: Differs: the classical body map gives thighs to Sagittarius and the 9th house; the Uranus assignment is his own.

hindi: यह आपका वरुण है पिंडलियों
says: Varuna (Neptune) sits in the calves.
classical_check: Differs: the classical body map gives the calves to Aquarius and the 11th house; Neptune on the calves is his own.

hindi: और यह यम है आपके अगर पांव के अंदर तकलीफ है
says: Yama (Pluto in his scheme) sits in the feet, the lowest part of the body.
ambiguity: The clause 'अगर पांव के अंदर तकलीफ है' starts the next point and is treated there.
classical_check: Differs: the classical body map gives the feet to Pisces and the 12th house; Yama is classically the deity of Saturn, not a separate planet.

hindi: पांव अंदर मुड़ते हैं घुट हो घबराते हो टेंशन तो पैरों की प्रॉब्लम स्टार्ट होगी तलों के अंदर आपके मास पिलपीले आपको पैरों में पोलापन लगेगा जलन होगी रात को सोते हुए
says: If your feet turn inward, you feel suffocated, anxious and tense, foot trouble starts: soft and flabby soles, a hollow feeling in the feet and burning at night while asleep. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The foot area is the 12th house and Pisces in the body map, so the complaint shows when Yama (Pluto) is stressed there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 12th in Scorpio (lagna Sagittarius) points in the tradition to restless nights and burning or draining feet.
Derived: Pluto in Pisces, the foot sign, in the 12th gives foot and sleep complaints in the tradition (not a diagnosis).

ambiguity: The caption 'घुट हो' is read as 'feeling suffocated' (ghutan).
classical_check: Silent: foot complaints are his example; the classical body map ties the feet to Pisces and the 12th.

hindi: य सब क्या है जब यम नाराज है यम नाराज का मतलब क्या है मौत का स्यापा पड़ा है सारे टाइम मरते हो सड़ते हो कुड़ते हो यह नेचर है
says: All this happens when Yama is angry, which means a constant wail about death in your mind: you spend all the time dying, rotting and fretting. This describes a mindset, not a death prediction.
ambiguity: 'मौत का स्यापा' is a mourning wail; it reads as a habit of gloomy thinking, not as a literal event.
classical_check: Differs: classically Yama is Saturn's deity, not a planet of his own; Pluto is outside the classical seven.

hindi: आपने यम को एक्टिवेट कर दिया पावर दे दिए सबसे नीचे हो आप
says: By living that way you have activated Yama and handed him power, and you are at the very bottom.
ambiguity: 'सबसे नीचे हो आप' can mean the feet region of the body or the lowest state of life; both fit.
classical_check: Silent: a karmic cause-and-effect reading of his own.

hindi: यह वरुण है यह पिंडली है जो संभाल के बैठी है पूरे शरीर को
says: Varuna is the calf, which carries and holds the whole body upright.
classical_check: Differs: calves belong to Aquarius (Saturn) in the classical body map.

hindi: यह ईर्षा का चक्र है य ईर्षा करने वालों का वरुण नाराज होता है
says: This calf centre is the chakra of envy, and for people who envy others Varuna becomes angry.
classical_check: Silent: envy as a Varuna matter is his own; classically envy is read from Saturn, Rahu or Mars.

hindi: आप ईर्ष्यालु है ना मेरे से नहीं भूली जाती बातें ये उसने मेरे साथ यह किया था आपका वरुण नाराज है आपके दिल पर चोट मारेगा
says: If you are envious and cannot forget what someone did to you, your Varuna is angry and will strike at your heart. Health-related claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'दिल पर चोट' is both emotional and, in the next lines, physical.
classical_check: Silent: heart and grudges as Neptune are his own; the classical heart planet is the Sun.

hindi: दिल पर चोट का मतलब क्या है मेनिफेस्टेशन नहीं कर सकते प्रेम तो गया तेल लेने और आपको हर हालत के अंदर हार्ट रिलेटेड कोई ना कोई इशू बन सकता है
says: A blow to the heart means you cannot express love (love goes out the window), and in any case some heart-related issue can arise. Health claim as stated by him, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'मेनिफेस्टेशन' is read as expressing or showing love.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give love to Venus and the heart to the Sun; this mapping is his.

hindi: नहीं तो 100% बी बीपी हाई या लो होगा यह होना ही है
says: If it is not a heart issue, then blood pressure will certainly go high or low; he calls it unavoidable. Medical claim as stated by him, not endorsed.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary ('तो 100%' starts the next chunk). The 100% is a speaker's emphasis, not a measured rate.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives a certain outcome like this.

hindi: अगर मंगल की कृपा है तो बी बीपी बचेगा
says: If Mars is gracious, blood pressure will be saved from trouble.
cells_derived_method: A strong Mars (own, exalted or in the 3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) steadies blood; a weak Mars (debilitated, or in the 8th and 12th) leaves blood pressure exposed in the tradition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 3rd (lagna Virgo) is a strong placement that keeps blood pressure steady in the tradition.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 12th (lagna Leo) leaves blood pressure vulnerable in the tradition (not a diagnosis).

classical_check: Agrees: Mars rules blood and, in popular practice, blood pressure.

hindi: मंगल लाल होता है आरबीसी बॉडी के जो है मंगल है
says: Mars is the red colour; the body's red blood cells are Mars.
ambiguity: At 21:03 he tied red-cell formation to the Sun's vitamin D; here red cells are given to Mars, so the two lines overlap.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of blood and red.

hindi: तभी जाकर केय सेट हो सकता है अदर वाइज आपका रोना पक्का है
says: Only then (with Mars's grace) can things be set right; otherwise you are sure to be crying. The word before 'set' is garbled.
ambiguity: 'केय' is garbled (maybe 'सब', everything); the subject of 'set' is a guess.
classical_check: Silent: rhetorical emphasis.

hindi: यह सूर्य जो है इसकी परमपिता की कृपा सबसे पहले चाहिए प्रकाश है जीवन में तभी तो सब सही होगा नहीं तो बर्बाद है जिंदगी
says: The Sun comes first: the grace of the supreme father is needed before anything else; there must be light in life, only then will all be right, otherwise life is ruined.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: the Sun is the soul and king of the chart; the ranking over every other planet is his emphasis.

hindi: अगर आपके लाइफ में प्रकाश सही है सूर्य सही है तो याद रखें आप हॉस्पिटल भी गए हो डॉक्टर टाइम से मिलेगा आपका इलाज टाइम से होगा
says: If the Sun is right, then even if you land in a hospital you will get the doctor on time and your treatment will happen on time. This is his claim, not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent: Sun as authority and the physician is classical; timely care is his claim.

hindi: मेजर सर्जरीज में मंगल और सूर्य का खेल है मंगल सेनापति है सूर्य मालिक है
says: Major surgeries are a play of Mars and the Sun: Mars is the commander who does the work and the Sun is the master who sanctions it.
cells_derived_method: Surgery events are read from Mars in the 6th and 8th houses (illness and cutting); the Sun's condition decides whether it goes through.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 8th (lagna Virgo) is the tradition's pointer to a knife or surgery event.
Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 6th (lagna Gemini) points to surgical cure of an illness in the tradition.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of surgery and knives; the Sun as 'owner' is his gloss.

hindi: सारी सर्जरी मंगल के पास है लेकिन सूर्य ठीक है तो ही यह काम हो पाएगा अदर वाइज हो नहीं पाएगा
says: All surgery belongs to Mars, but it can happen only if the Sun is fine; otherwise it will not take place.
classical_check: Silent: a gating role for the Sun is his own.

hindi: इसलिए सूर्य की प्रसन्नता के लिए एक पिता गोद लो उस पिता की सेवा करो
says: Remedy: to please the Sun, adopt a father figure and serve him.
ambiguity: It repeats the earlier substitute-father idea but now as the closing remedy for the Sun's role in health.
classical_check: Silent: the adopted-father remedy is his own; serving the father is classical.

hindi: पिता से लड़ो मरो जो जी मन में श्रद्धा रखो बाप बेटा है बच्ची है बेटी है लड़ाई झगड़े होते हैं इट्स ओके
says: Quarrelling with your father is allowed as long as you keep respect (shraddha) in your heart; fights between father and son or daughter happen and are okay.
ambiguity: 'लड़ो मरो' is a casual phrase for 'go ahead and fight'. The sentence crosses a caption boundary.
classical_check: Silent: this softer rule is his own; the classics ask for respect toward the father.

hindi: लेकिन पिता पर छोड़ो
says: But leave the matter with the father: do not carry the quarrel forward.
ambiguity: A very short clause; 'leave it with father' could also mean 'leave the father alone'.
classical_check: Silent: a letting-go instruction of his own.

hindi: आपके भाई बहन भतीजे ने कष्ट दिया आपको वोह अलग-अलग ग्रह हैं चाचा मामा
says: If your brother, sister or nephew hurt you, that is the work of other planets; uncles and maternal uncles also belong to different planets, not to the Sun.
ambiguity: He does not name which planet rules which relative here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: relatives are spread across planets (Mars for brothers, Mercury for the maternal uncle); the Sun is the father only.

hindi: लेकिन सूर्य के आगे छोड़ो पिताजी आपके हवाले है कॉस्मस जो फैसला करे ऑटोमेटिक
says: But where the Sun (father) is concerned, let go: the father is placed in your care and whatever the cosmos decides will happen by itself.
ambiguity: 'पिताजी आपके हवाले है' is read as 'father is entrusted to you'; it could also mean 'you are in the father's hands'.
classical_check: Silent: a surrender attitude of his own.

hindi: जिनकी कुंडली में सूर्य पांच नंबर का है उनकी लाइफ में सूर्य का भयंकर पावर है
says: People whose Sun is at 'number five' in the horoscope have tremendous Sun power in their lives.
cells_derived_method: If it is the 5th house, the strength shows in intelligence, authority and children; if it is Leo (sign 5), it is the Sun's own sign and strong in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius) gives powerful intelligence and confident leadership.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's sign in the 5th house (lagna Virgo) is in the 5th as he says but the sign mutes its power.
Derived: Sun in Leo (sign 5) in the 8th house (lagna Capricorn) has own-sign power but is strained and hidden.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर का' is either the 5th house or Leo, sign number 5; both are recorded as cells because he does not say which.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the Sun in the 5th and in its own sign Leo is classically strong; he does not separate the two cases.

hindi: याद रखें सूर्य की एक से 30 डिग्री के अंतर्गत 10 डिग्री तक का सूर्य मोस्ट पावरफुल होता है
says: Within a sign's 1 to 30 degrees, a Sun up to about 10 degrees is the most powerful.
cells_derived_method: The degree rule applies to the Sun's exact longitude in whatever house and sign it sits; the same cell reads stronger in early degrees and weaker later.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun at about 5 degrees of Leo on the ascendant is at the peak of his rule, own sign and early degree both strong.
Derived: Sun at about 27 degrees of Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo) is past the peak and fading in his rule, so gains come with less force.

ambiguity: '1 से 30' means the degrees within a sign; the 10-degree figure is his, with no source given.
classical_check: Differs: the classical Baladi avasthas rate each 6-degree band (infant to dead) and the middle bands are strongest; the Sun's deep exaltation point is 10 degrees of Aries, so 'first 10 degrees' is his own.

hindi: इसके बाद के सूर्य की डिग्री बढ़ जाने से उसके पावर खराबी और नष्ट की ओर जा रही है अब व सूर्य नष्ट की ओर जा रहा है
says: After the first 10 degrees, as the Sun's degree rises its power goes toward damage and destruction; the Sun is then heading toward ruin.
ambiguity: 'नष्ट' (destroyed) is strong wording for a Sun in late degrees; he gives no further bands.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts weaken a planet at the very start and very end of a sign but do not put the whole span beyond 10 degrees in decline.

hindi: इसलिए बहुत ज्यादा डिग्री का सूर्य हो सकता है अपने भाव से आगे ही चला गया हो
says: So a Sun at a very high degree may already have moved on out of its own house (bhava) into the next one.
cells_derived_method: A Sun at late degrees of a sign may read in the next house in the bhava-chalit view, so the house meaning shifts by one.
