derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun at about 28 degrees of Leo in the 5th reads in the 6th house of service and health in the bhava-chalit chart.
Derived: Sun at about 29 degrees of Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries) reads in the 10th house of career in the bhava-chalit chart.

ambiguity: He does not say bhava-chalit by name; 'अपने भाव से आगे' is read that way.
classical_check: Agrees: bhava-chalit and the Sripati method shift planets near sign boundaries into the next house.

gist: Defers the house (bhava) topics to the time of the kundli lesson; for now only the Sun is being discussed.

hindi: इस सूर्य के साथ इसकी पत्नी है मान के चलो पत्नी मानते हैं सहभागी दोस्त मित्र जो भी मानो जो इसका दूसरा फ्लिप साइड है कि रात का सूरज कौन है चंद्रमा
says: With the Sun comes his partner, call her wife, companion or friend: the Moon is his flip side, the Sun of the night.
ambiguity: 'पत्नी' is loose here; he lets the listener choose wife, partner or friend.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the Sun's counterpart, the night luminary; wife is his picture.

hindi: चंद्रमा क्या है पानी जल सारा जल इसके पास है
says: The Moon is water; all water belongs to it.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon rules water and fluids.

hindi: इसके पास हमारा हड्डी भी है हड्डी इसके पास भी है शनी के पास भी है
says: Our bones also lie with the Moon, and the same bones lie with Saturn too, so bones are shared between the Moon and Saturn.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption boundary. It is not clear if 'इसके' is the Moon (read so from context) or the Sun.
classical_check: Differs: classically bones go to the Sun and Saturn, while the Moon rules blood and fluids.

hindi: यह जल है वाइट जितना भी धरती पर वाइट चीजें हैं जो सुंदर लाइट है
says: Water is white, and all the white things on earth and the soft beautiful light belong to the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: white things, milk and silver are the Moon's.

hindi: सूरज को हम देख नहीं सकते लेकिन चंदा मामा की लाइट में हम कहते हैं क्या शीतलता मिलती है
says: We cannot even look at the Sun, but in moonlight we say what coolness this gives; the Moon is the soothing, cooling side.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is cool and soothing, the Sun hot.

hindi: यह तो पिता हो गया यह हो गई मां ये हो गया पिता ये है माता
says: The Sun then stands for the father and the Moon for the mother.
ambiguity: Gesture-based 'this' and 'this'; read as Sun first, Moon second.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the father and Moon is the mother.

gist: Says again that all white things belong to the Moon and are full of coolness, already stated in the last two points.

hindi: लेकिन यह माता इसी पर डिपेंडेंट है
says: But the mother (Moon) depends on him (the Sun), as the Moon shines only by the Sun's light.
ambiguity: 'इसी पर' (on this one) points to the Sun; the 'light' reason is supplied from context and is not spoken in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon's light is borrowed from the Sun.

hindi: आप अपने जीवन में अपने पिता से नाराज हो सकते हैं तो यह सोच लो चल यार मेरी मां का कसम है कोई बात नहीं क्योंकि मां इस कसम को नहीं छोड़ेगी
says: If you fall out with your father in life, think that your mother is there, and no matter, because the mother will not let go of her bond with you; the Moon holds on where the Sun may not.
ambiguity: 'कसम' (oath) is unclear here; read as 'bond' because the next lines say a woman holds on like a magnet.
classical_check: Silent: a comfort-based reading of Moon over Sun, not classical.

hindi: स्त्री के अंदर विशेष गुण होता है वो जहां चिपक जाती है पकड़ लेती है चुंबक होता है छोड़ती नहीं है ये स्त्री में विशेष गुण है
says: Women have a special quality: wherever she clings she holds on like a magnet and does not let go; this clinging nature is the Moon's.
ambiguity: He generalises about women; read here as the Moon's feminine attachment quality, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is mother, feminine and attachment; the magnet image is his.

gist: Husbands' complaint that the wife keeps checking all the time by phone, and she enjoys it because she gave birth to us and feels it is hers (the sentence is cut at the end of the slice).

hindi: ही तो अंश है इसीलिए तो पुत्र या पुत्री होने के बाद मां उसे छोड़ती नहीं सीने से लगा के रखती है क्योंकि उसके शरीर से ही तो बना है
says: He explains why a mother clings to her newborn: the child is literally a part of her own body, so after a son or daughter is born she keeps the baby held to her chest and does not let go. He uses this bodily fact to ground the Moon's mother-child attachment.
ambiguity: The Moon is not named in this sentence; the link to Moon as the mother karaka comes from the surrounding passage and the Moon dosha lines that follow.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts make the Moon karaka of the mother and of nurturing; the 'made from her body' argument is his own explanation, not a text rule.

hindi: यह पुरुष शरीर जान ही नहीं सकता कि ये मां ने जो हमें जन्म दिया मां का हिस्सा है हम वो कहती है मेरा ही तो टुकड़ा है ये तभी तो कहते मेरे जिगर का टुकड़ा बाप थोड़ी कहता
says: He claims a male body cannot truly feel that the child is a piece of the mother, which is why only mothers say 'a piece of my liver' while fathers do not; the mother's sense that the child is hers is a bodily fact, not a social habit.
ambiguity: The caption 'hum vo kehti hai' is garbled; the reading is that the mother says the child is her own piece. The Moon is implied, not named.
classical_check: Silent on this specific argument; Moon as mother is classical.

gist: Joke: which piece is it, the father is just an ATM card, and the two parents keep separate accounts.
If your mother seems wrong to you or there were many fights, assume she acted under circumstances that stopped her from loving you freely.
Kunti bore Karna during an experiment and abandoned him out of social shame and other pressures, used as an example of a mother acting under compulsion.

hindi: यदि स्त्री की कुटिलता बन रही है तो चंद्रमा के दोष से है
says: If a woman (here the mother figure) turns out cunning or crooked in her behaviour, he puts it down to a Moon dosha, an affliction of the Moon in the chart, and not to her character alone.
cells_derived_method: A Moon dosha is read from the Moon's own cell and from the 4th house (mother). The sign the Moon sits in changes the style of crookedness: fixed or secretive signs give hidden manipulation, dual or air signs give double-talk, earth-cardinal signs give calculated coldness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo). The mother-house Moon is in its fall, so secrecy and emotional manipulation in the mother's conduct is the likely form of 'crookedness'.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo). Mercury's sign in the public house shows the crookedness as double-talk and clever speech in the woman's dealings outside the home.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 1st house (lagna Capricorn). Saturn's sign makes the cunning slow, calculated and cold, part of the woman's own temperament.

ambiguity: He says 'stri' (woman) in general; whether it means the native's mother, the native if female, or any woman in the native's life is not stated.
classical_check: Differs in wording: classical texts link an afflicted Moon (with Saturn, Rahu or Ketu, or in 6/8/12) to a troubled mother and a disturbed mind, but do not state 'a woman's cunning equals Moon dosha'.

hindi: दफा करो दूसरी मां गोद लो माएं गोद लेना भी कोई बड़ी बात नहीं है भाई गोद लेना बड़ी बात नहीं यह मां गोद ले ली जाती है
says: Remedy-style advice for a painful relationship with the birth mother: drop the grievance and 'adopt' another mother figure, since taking a foster or adopted mother is no big matter. He offers this as a way past the Moon's mother-karaka trouble.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he means a literal adoption or taking an elder woman as a substitute mother; the audience talk suggests the second.
classical_check: Silent; classical Moon remedies are mantra, pearl, milk or water offerings and serving the mother, not adopting a substitute mother.

hindi: यानी कि कॉर्ड कटिंग करी और छोड़ दिया कर्तव्य पूरा करो नहीं तो चंद चमा का दोष आएगा
says: Even if you cut the emotional cord and walk away from a mother you cannot get along with, you must still do your duty towards her, or Moon dosha will come upon you. So the dosha attaches to neglecting the mother's needs, not to the quarrel itself.
ambiguity: 'Kartavya' (duty) is not spelled out: it may mean money, care, or attending to her at the end of life.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts treat neglect of the mother as a cause of Moon-related suffering, though they do not use the phrase 'cord cutting'.

hindi: चंद्रमा के पास आपका सारा का सारा डब्ल्यूबीसी है लिंफ है वाइट ब्लड सेल बॉडी में इम्युनिटी
says: He gives the Moon charge of the body's white blood cells, lymph and immune defence: all your WBC and lymph sit under the Moon. This is his karaka claim about the body, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's cell sets how sturdy the immune side is read to be: strong in dignity signs and kendra or trikona houses, weak in dusthana houses or in its fall.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer). Dignity plus kendra, so the immune side is read as resilient.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 6th house (lagna Gemini). Fall in the house of illness and the body's fight against it, so the immune side is read as fragile or over-reactive.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th house (lagna Libra). Dignity in a dusthana gives a mixed reading: hidden resilience with long-running sensitivity.

ambiguity: The sentence begins at the end of the previous caption chunk and runs into the next; 'immunity' as a Moon matter is his modern gloss.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical Moon karakatwa includes body fluids, lymph, phlegm and blood-side substances; 'immunity' and 'white blood cells' are modern wording not found in the texts.

hindi: हमारे शरीर में प्रॉब्लम हो गई अब हमें शरीर उससे लड़ रहा है कैसे लड़ रहा है क्योंकि वाइट ब्लड सेल बहुत अच्छे हैं चंद्रमा में निर्मलता है मन में निर्मलता है
says: When something goes wrong in the body, the body can fight it only because the white cells are healthy, and he ties that to a clear, pure Moon: purity in the Moon means purity and clarity in the mind. So a clean Moon gives good bodily defence and a clear mind together.
cells_derived_method: none; 'Moon is pure' is a planet-level condition here. How it varies across cells is handled in the strong-Moon and disturbed-Moon rows of this slice.
ambiguity: 'Nirmalta' (purity) is not defined in chart terms: it may mean no malefic conjunction or aspect, or simply a strong Moon.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: an unafflicted, bright Moon is classically a clear mind and sound constitution; the white-cell wording is modern.

hindi: यह मुन्ना के अटैक का कार्यक्रम होता है शनि में शनि स्थान पर मुन्ना रहता है मूलाधार पर
says: He places Saturn, whom he calls 'Munna', at the root chakra (Muladhara): the root is Saturn's place, and Munna lives there and runs its 'attack programme' from it, at the opposite end of the body from the Moon at the crown. A later slice confirms the name, 'मुन्ना जो है शनि है' (Munna is Saturn).
ambiguity: 'Munna' is read as his pet name for Saturn, made explicit in a later slice ('मुन्ना जो है शनि है'); 'attack ka karyakram' (programme of attack) is still vague. 'Shani sthan' is read as Saturn's seat, the root.
classical_check: Not in Parashari texts; chakra-to-planet schemes vary by school, and Saturn at the root is one common mapping.

hindi: और ऊपर चंदा मामा जो है यहां पर टॉप से ऊपर से सहसरारा से आउटर स्पेस से किरणें आती है यहां
says: He places the Moon at the top of the body, at the crown (Sahasrara), and says rays from outer space enter at that crown point, making the Moon the receiving station for cosmic input.
ambiguity: 'Yahan' is a pointing gesture at the body; 'Chanda mama' is the Moon in affectionate speech.
classical_check: Not in Parashari texts; schools differ on which planet owns the crown chakra.

hindi: और मेनिफेस्टेशन के लिए नीचे हिट करती है यहां चंदा हिल जाता है मन बार-बार हिलता है ना हर दो घंटे में
says: The incoming rays strike downward through the body so that things can manifest, and where they strike the Moon it shakes; this, he says, is why the mind wavers again and again, roughly every two hours.
ambiguity: 'Every two hours' is a casual figure, not a measured period.
classical_check: Moon as the restless, fast-changing mind is classical (its quick motion); the two-hour period and the ray-strike mechanism are his own.

gist: Acted-out monologue of a mind flip-flopping about a friend through the day: loyal brother, then a rascal, then I was a fool, then confused again at night.

hindi: ये चंद्रमा की डिस्टरबेंस से होता है जब भी लाइफ में अंदर आत्म मंथन चल रहा है ये करूं वो करूं क्या करूं साला समझ नहीं आ रहा आपका चंदा मामा डिस्टर्ब है
says: Whenever you feel inner churning and cannot decide what to do, with the 'do this or that' question looping and no clarity, he reads it as a disturbed Moon; the Moon's disturbance is the cause of the indecision.
cells_derived_method: How the indecision shows depends on the Moon's sign and house: dual or air signs give constant weighing of options, water signs give fear-driven swings, and the house shows the life area where the confusion sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 12th house (lagna Cancer). Restless dual-minded overthinking that peaks in isolation or at night, with sleep-time rumination.
Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 8th house (lagna Leo). Indecision from fear and over-sensitivity, swinging between escape and blind faith.
Derived: Moon in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer). Indecision as a weighing habit, with confusion about home and family choices.

ambiguity: 'Disturbed' is not defined: affliction by conjunction or aspect, weak sign, or a dusthana placement are all possible.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the mind (manas) and an afflicted Moon is classically restlessness and indecision.

hindi: आपका डब्ल्यूबीसी वाइट ब्लड सेल इम्युनिटी डाउन
says: With the Moon disturbed, he says your white-cell count and immunity go down: Moon trouble in the mind shows up as a fall in bodily defence. This is his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A disturbed Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or in its fall, would be read as the strongest immunity drop; the sign sets whether it is chronic or sudden.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo). Saturn's sign makes the drop slow and chronic rather than sudden.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 12th house (lagna Taurus). Mars's sign gives short sharp dips, with energy drained during rest.

ambiguity: The sentence is a fragment; 'down' is read as the result of the Moon being disturbed in the line before.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts tie an afflicted Moon to weak constitution and fluid-related ailments; 'immunity' is modern wording.

hindi: कौन लोग हैं जिनको कोविड में करोना हो गया और उसके बाद भी कोविड अर जेब में लेकर घूम रहे हैं बॉडी में कैरियर है उन्हें कुछ नहीं हो रहा जिनका चंद्रमा बहुत मजबूत है
says: He says the people who caught Covid, kept carrying the virus as symptom-free carriers and were not troubled by it, are those with a very strong Moon; a strong Moon is his marker for strong resistance. This is his general health claim, not a diagnosis or a prediction for any named person.
cells_derived_method: 'Very strong Moon' is read from sign dignity, house strength and freedom from affliction; the same claim gets weaker or fails in the Moon's fall and in dusthana houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 1st house (lagna Taurus). Highest dignity in a kendra, so resistance is read as very strong.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). Own sign in a kendra, so also read as strong.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). This is the opposite of a very strong Moon, so the claim would not apply to this cell.

ambiguity: 'Strong' is not defined (dignity, shadbala, or no affliction). He treats a carrier with no symptoms as the proof.
classical_check: Silent on viral infection, which is a modern topic; the classical rule says only that a strong Moon gives a strong mind and good health.

hindi: यानी मन से कौन है वो ढीठ जिसे कहते हैं ना यार महा घटिया और ढीठ आदमी है साला हिलता नहीं है इसे जो सोच लिया समझ लिया इसे हिला के दिखाओ
says: In terms of mind, the strong-Moon person is the stubborn, immovable type: once he has made up his mind nobody can shift him, and people curse him as obstinate. So 'strong Moon' here means mental firmness, not softness.
cells_derived_method: Obstinacy is strongest where the Moon sits in a fixed sign (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) or in dignity; the house shows the area of life where the person will not budge.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries). Fixed sign plus dignity, so stubborn about money, speech and family values.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th house (lagna Taurus). Fixed-sign obstinacy but with emotional turbulence, shown as grudge-holding rather than calm firmness in partnerships.
Derived: Moon in Aquarius in the 10th house (lagna Taurus). Fixed air sign gives detached, rigid opinions about career and public matters.

ambiguity: A very strong Moon is classically a steady, popular mind; he is reading 'strong' as 'does not shift', which is closer to a fixed-sign reading.
classical_check: Partly agrees: fixed-sign and exalted Moon give a firm mind classically, though a bright Moon is also described as gentle and sociable, which he does not mention.

hindi: यह आम शब्द कहा जाता है स्त्री हमारे मन को बहुत जल्दी विचलित करती है क्योंकि स्त्री में मोह है स्त्री में चुंबक है
says: He quotes the common saying that a woman unsettles a man's mind very quickly and explains it: a woman carries attachment (moha) and a magnet-like pull, so she moves a man's mind easily. It sits in the Moon talk as a reason the mind shakes.
ambiguity: No planet is named; Moon (mind) or Venus (attraction) could both fit. Whether 'stri' means any woman or a wife is also not stated.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; classical karakas for the spouse are Venus (male chart) and Jupiter (female chart), and this folk saying is not a house or sign rule.

gist: A wife tells her husband someone wronged her, he gets provoked and says wars were fought over Sita and Draupadi so he will fight too, then regrets it later.
Advice that a man should think carefully before getting into trouble, asking whether the quarrel is really needed.

hindi: यह पुरुष है यह प्रकृति है प्रकृति लगातार बदल रही है पुरुष स्टेबल है इसलिए आपको सोचना समझना है ये आपसे नाराज होगी कोई टेंशन नहीं थोड़ी देर में मान जाएगी
says: He sets Purusha (the male principle) as stable and Prakriti (the female principle) as always changing, and concludes that when she is angry with you there is no need to worry because her mood will turn and she will come round soon, since change is her nature.
ambiguity: He does not tie Purusha or Prakriti to a planet here; the surrounding Moon discussion suggests the Moon as the changing principle, but that is not said in this sentence.
classical_check: Purusha and Prakriti are Sankhya philosophy, not a Parashari rule; the Moon as the changing, feminine mind is classical.

gist: She calls her child a good-for-nothing and then hugs and kisses him, calls her husband a stray who roams outside and then brings him food: examples of a woman's changing moods.
If she actually decides to leave, that is an extreme case and a different matter; otherwise her mood keeps changing.

hindi: यह स्थिति स्त्री शरीर में स्त्री की है पुरुष शरीर में भी पुरुष की है क्योंकि चंद्रमा दोनों में ही ऑन है फेमिनिटी दोनों के अंदर है
says: The changeable-mind state belongs to women in a female body and equally to men in a male body, because the Moon is switched on in both and femininity exists inside both sexes. Mood swings are a Moon matter, not a women-only matter.
cells_derived_method: none; applies to every chart whatever the gender. The Moon's own cell still sets how strong the swings are.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the mind karaka in every chart, male or female.

gist: A man also dithers: give goods to him or not, take this work or not, pay or not, and will my name be made or ruined over money.

hindi: पुरुष अहंकार का प्रतीक है उसे अपने घमंड का और इज्जत का इस फसा रहता है क्या करेंगे क्या नहीं करेंगे स्त्री को अपने स्थान का सम्मान रहता है
says: He calls the male a symbol of ego: a man stays caught in his pride and reputation (what shall we do, what shall we not do), while a woman keeps her respect for her own position or place. The male wobbles over honour, the female over her standing.
ambiguity: The caption 'इस फसा रहता है' is garbled (probably 'इसमें फंसा रहता है'). No planet is named; classically ego is the Sun but he does not say so here.
classical_check: Ego as the Sun is classical; the male-ego versus female-place contrast is a general gender claim, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: चंद्रमा गड़बड़ हो जाता है गंदे पानी से आपके घर के आसपास गटर है आपके घर के आसपास खराब चीज है आपके घर के अंदर ही सीवर बना हुआ है
says: The Moon gets spoiled by dirty water: an open drain near your home, some foul thing around the house, or a sewer line built inside your own premises all damage the Moon. This is a vastu-style link between the Moon's water nature and sanitation around the house.
cells_derived_method: The home is the 4th house, so dirty water around the dwelling points to the 4th and its Moon; a Moon in or aspecting the 4th shows the effect most readily, and water signs make it more pronounced.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). The house itself is highly Moon-sensitive, so drain or sewer faults near the home would be read as hitting household peace directly.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 12th house (lagna Sagittarius). Loss house with the Moon in its fall, so dirty-water faults are read as a source of loss and sleeplessness.
Derived: Moon in Pisces (a water sign) in the 6th house (lagna Libra). Disease house plus water sign, so hygiene faults around the house are read as feeding illness and daily worry.

ambiguity: It is not said whether the dosha is a chart condition or a house-site condition; he treats the site fault as damaging the Moon in the person.
classical_check: Classical vastu has direction rules for drains and toilets, but linking dirty water to Moon affliction in the chart is this lecturer's reading, not a stated text rule.

hindi: अगर चार दीवारी के अंतर्गत आपके स्किन के अंदर प्रॉब्लम्स आ रही है और आपका मन विचलित होता है
says: If, within the walls of your premises, you are getting skin problems and your mind is unsettled, that is the Moon spoiled through dirty water. He names skin trouble and mental unrest as the two body-mind signs of this Moon fault; these are his claims, not diagnoses.
cells_derived_method: none; same cell logic as the dirty-water row before it, this row only adds the two symptoms.
ambiguity: The sentence is an unfinished 'if'; the 'then it is the Moon's dosha' part is implied from the previous line.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link an afflicted Moon to mental unrest but do not tie skin trouble to dirty water around a house.

hindi: आप जितनी वाइट चीजें ले रहे हैं वो बासिया खराब ले रहे हैं उसके बाद दूध हो गया जो खराब है
says: Another way the Moon is hurt is diet: the white foods you consume, milk being the example he reaches for, damage the Moon if you take them stale or spoiled. Spoiled milk is his case in point.
ambiguity: The wording 'उसके बाद दूध हो गया जो खराब है' is rough; the reading is 'then there is milk that has gone bad'. It is not clear whether he treats this as an affliction of the chart Moon or only of the body.
classical_check: Partly agrees: white items such as milk and curd belong to the Moon in classical lists; treating stale white food as a Moon affliction is a lecture-style link, not a text rule.

hindi: अगर उबाल देंगे गर्म कर देंगे उसके अंदर के कीटाणु खराबी मर जाएंगी मंगल तत्व जाने आ जाने से पानी उबल के ठीक होता है
says: If the spoiled milk or water is boiled and heated, the germs in it die and it becomes fine; he credits this to the Mars element arriving as heat. So boiling is Mars (fire) rescuing a spoiled Moon substance (water or milk), and boiling is his fix for stale or dirty water.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of one caption chunk and finishes in the next.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; boiling water is ordinary hygiene, expressed here in Mars and Moon terms, and fire as Mars and water as Moon are classical element links.

hindi: मंगल क्या है आग पानी क्या है वाटर वाटर एलिमेंट क्या होता है आग से कभी नष्ट नहीं होता लेकिन आग उसे शुद्ध कर देती है पूर्ण रूप से शुद्ध कर देती है
says: Mars is fire and water is the water element; fire never destroys water but purifies it completely. He uses this as the working relation between Mars and the Moon side: Mars cleans what the Moon holds.
ambiguity: The Moon is not named in this sentence; 'water' is taken as the Moon's element from the surrounding passage.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as fire and Moon as water are classical element links; 'Mars purifies Moon' is his reading, while the classical Chandra-Mangala yoga is read for wealth through trade, not purity.

hindi: यानी उसके अंदर के जो कीड़े मुकड़े हैं वो मर जाते हैं यानी मंगल के सपोर्ट से चंदा मामा एकदम शुद्ध होता है
says: With Mars's support the Moon becomes fully pure, he says, because the germs and impurities inside it die. So a Moon backed by a working Mars is clean, and Mars's support is the thing that cleanses the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Mars's support to the Moon is strongest when the two share a sign or when Mars is strong by sign; the house shows where the cleansing is felt and the sign changes how harsh it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon and Mars together in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries). Mars in own sign gives the strongest cleansing support to the Moon.
Derived: Moon with Mars in Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra). Mars exalted gives the cleansing at full power, but with a scorched, hard edge to the home-side feelings.

Derived: Moon with Mars in Scorpio in the 7th house (lagna Taurus). Mars sits in its own sign and cleans, but the Moon is in its fall in the same sign, so the support is mixed with emotional heat in partnerships.

ambiguity: 'Support' is not defined: it may mean conjunction, aspect, or simply a strong Mars in the chart. He does not say which.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: classical texts give Moon-Mars together as Chandra-Mangala yoga for wealth, and also warn of an emotionally heated mind; 'purification' is his reading.

gist: Garbled line: as soon as 'you told the thing to go to hell', then something about the lymph nodes inside you; the object is unclear, though the next lines show it is about losing Mars's fire.

hindi: लिंफ असल में क्या होता है हमारा वाइट ब्लड होता है सफेद रंग का खून
says: He defines lymph as our 'white blood', blood of white colour, and so places lymph under the Moon's white, watery domain. This is a loose lay description, because lymph is a clear-to-whitish tissue fluid and not a kind of blood.
ambiguity: The Moon is implied from the colour white, not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts list body fluids, lymph and white or watery substances under the Moon; calling lymph 'white blood' is his lay shorthand, not a text statement.

hindi: यह सफेद खून के अंदर वाइट ब्लड सेल रहते हैं इसमें रेड ब्लड सेल और आते हैं लाल रंग के जिसकी वजह से आरबीसी होने से लाल रंग का दिखता है खून खून होता वाइट है
says: Inside this 'white blood' sit the white cells; red cells are added and give the red colour, so blood is basically white and only looks red because of the RBCs. He is setting white as the Moon's colour and red (RBC) as Mars's, which he uses in the next lines. The physiology as stated is loose, since plasma is pale yellow and not white.
ambiguity: No planet is named here; Moon (white) and Mars (red) are implied by his later line about the Moon being left without RBC.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon-white and Mars-red colour and karaka pairing is classical; the claim that blood is white is not.

hindi: अगर इसमें वाइट ब्लड कंटेंट कम होगा तो आपको लिंफेटिक नोड्स में प्रॉब्लम होएगी लिंफ में यानी सफेद खून खराब
says: If the white-blood content is low you will get trouble in the lymphatic nodes, meaning the white blood goes bad. He links a weak Moon, the white and lymph side, to lymph-node problems. This is the health link as he states it, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A weak Moon gives the lymph theme; the body area follows the sign and house through the body-part mapping (2nd house and Taurus for the neck and throat, 12th house and Pisces for the feet).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra). Fall in the house of face and neck, so the lymph theme is read around the neck and throat area.
Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries). Water sign in the house of the feet, so the lymph and fluid theme is read in the lower limbs.

ambiguity: 'White blood content' is not defined (white-cell count, lymph volume, or Moon's strength); the Moon link is implied.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give the Moon lymph and body fluids; 'lymphatic nodes' is modern anatomy not found in the texts.

hindi: कहते नहीं है तेरा खून पानी बन गया है डन टन यह शब्द ऐसे क्यों है एक्सप्रेशन फिल्मों में बहुत आता है क्योंकि आपका मंगल नष्ट हो रहा है
says: He explains the film phrase 'your blood has turned to water' as a literal Jyotish sign: the phrase exists because your Mars (the red, fiery quality of blood) is being destroyed, leaving the blood watery and Moon-dominated.
ambiguity: 'डन टन' is a garbled filler. The Moon is implied by 'water', not named here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as blood and courage is classical; the idiom explanation is his rhetorical reading, not a text rule.

hindi: आपकी अग्नि जो है भाड़ में जाएगी उसी को आप नष्ट कर रहे हो अब आप बहुत स्यापा करने लगे हो चंद्रमा को बहुत ज्यादा बल दे रहे हो इसलिए आपका मंगल नष्ट होता है
says: He blames the person for the loss: you have started wailing and fussing a great deal, which pours too much strength into the Moon, and by that you destroy your own Mars fire. Over-feeding the Moon (emotional fuss) is his stated cause of Mars being wrecked.
ambiguity: 'Syapa karna' is colloquial for wailing or making a fuss; it is behaviour, not a chart position. The sentence starts at the end of one caption chunk and finishes in the next.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that behaviour can feed one planet and starve another is a lecture-style principle, not a classical rule.

hindi: कहते हैं ना तेरा खून सफेद हो गया है यानी मंगल नष्ट हो रहा है अग्नि डाउन हो रही है
says: The second idiom, 'your blood has turned white', is read as Mars being destroyed and the fire going down. He treats both idioms, 'water' and 'white', as the same sign: Mars failing so that the Moon's whiteness takes over.
ambiguity: Whether 'blood turned white' also means cowardice (a common Hindi sense) is not mentioned; he reads it only as Mars falling.
classical_check: Partly agrees: weak Mars is classically low courage and low blood vigour; this idiom reading is his own.

hindi: तो चंद्रमा जब इतना ज्यादा आरबीसी के बिना रहेगा पानी को उबाल के पियो दूध को उबाल के लो गर्म करते हैं ना तो शुद्ध हो गया ना
says: Remedy-style rule: when the Moon is left without the RBC, that is the Mars side, drink only boiled water and take milk after boiling it, since heating makes it pure. Heat (Mars) is added back to the Moon's substances.
ambiguity: 'RBC' stands for Mars only by implication from his earlier red-versus-white line.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; boiling water and milk is ordinary hygiene put in Mars and Moon terms.

hindi: तो अगर यह नष्ट हो रहा है तो वाइट ब्लड सेल क्या होंगे अशुद्ध हो जाएंगे और यही आपको मारेंगे
says: If the purifying Mars side is being destroyed, the white cells become impure and those same cells will harm you, he says in strong language ('kill you'). This is his claimed mechanism, not a diagnosis and not a prediction of death for anyone.
ambiguity: 'Maarenge' (will kill) is hyperbole for serious harm here; he gives no timing or case.
classical_check: Silent; a modern-physiology style claim and not a Parashari rule.

hindi: चंद्रमा का मेजर दोष होता है जब कैंसर होता है
says: He names cancer as the major form of Moon dosha: the heaviest Moon affliction is when cancer occurs. Recorded as his health claim only; it is not a diagnosis and not a rule for reading cancer from a chart.
cells_derived_method: The severity of a Moon dosha would be graded by the Moon's cell: fall or a dusthana placement with malefic company grades heaviest, while a dignified Moon in a kendra grades lightest. This grades severity only and names no disease.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries), with Saturn or Rahu joining. Fall, dusthana and malefic together would be the top grade of Moon dosha on his scale.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 6th house (lagna Capricorn) with Rahu. An afflicted Moon in the disease house would be graded a major-dosha candidate.

ambiguity: It is not said whether 'major dosha' is a chart condition or a home-site condition; the next lines tie it to a toilet position in the house.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not name cancer; they link an afflicted Moon, especially in the 6th, 8th or 12th with malefics, to mental and fluid-related ailments.

hindi: मेजर दोष घर के नॉर्थ से ईस्ट की बेल्ट के अंतर्गत यूजुअली यदि टॉयलेट होता है तो चंद्रमा पर दोषी कर देता है
says: Vastu link: the major Moon dosha usually arises when the house has a toilet in the belt running from north to east; such a toilet makes the Moon guilty, meaning afflicted.
cells_derived_method: none: this is a physical-direction rule, not a chart cell. A chart link would need a direction-to-house mapping, which he does not give in this sentence.
ambiguity: 'North to East belt' could mean only the north-east corner or the whole arc from north through north-east to east; the 'usually' also leaves exceptions open.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical vastu also forbids a toilet in the north-east (Ishan, Jupiter's zone), but common vastu texts give the north-west to the Moon, so the north-to-east belt as the Moon's seat is his own mapping.

hindi: मैक्सिमम से मैक्सिमम बड़े से बड़े केस में कैंसर दे देता है नहीं होता तो फोड़े फुंसी स्किन के निशान
says: He says the toilet-in-that-belt fault can in the very worst case produce cancer, and where it does not, it still gives boils, pimples and skin blemishes. It is a graded outcome: cancer at the extreme, skin eruptions in the milder case. Health claim as he states it, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Nahi hota to' means 'if not, then', so the skin outcome is the fallback and not an additional effect.
classical_check: Silent; neither classical Jyotish nor classical vastu names these outcomes for a toilet position.

hindi: यह दिमाग खराब तो करेगा ही करेगा हर हालत में
says: Whatever else happens, this fault will at least spoil the mind in every case: mental disturbance is the one guaranteed effect, with the skin trouble and worse effects being the variable ones.
ambiguity: 'दिमाग खराब' is colloquial and can mean mental unrest or irritation; it is not a clinical condition.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: an afflicted Moon is classically a disturbed mind; the toilet-position cause is his vastu link.

hindi: टॉयलेट वाटर कंटेंट सब फ्लश आउट हो रहा है सत्यानाश हो रहा है इसलिए
says: He gives the reason a toilet there ruins the Moon: a toilet is where water content is flushed out, so the Moon's water element is being drained away in that belt, and he calls the result total ruin. The sentence trails off at 'therefore' and continues in the next slice.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off by the end of the slice, so the conclusion after 'इसलिए' is missing.
classical_check: Silent; the 'flushing drains the Moon's water' argument is his own explanation.

hindi: आपके मां मांसी नानी चाची फलानी ढम कानी यह सारी जो स्त्री तत्व है जीवन का वह सारे के सारे चंद्रमा है
says: He lumps every female relative in life, mother, maternal aunt, maternal grandmother, paternal aunt and the rest, under the Moon: the whole feminine element of your life is the Moon.
cells_derived_method: How the women of the family fare is read from the Moon's dignity and house: a well-placed Moon in the 4th (mother's house) or in a kendra supports them, a Moon in its fall or in a dusthana strains the bond.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). Mother and elder women are read as warm and supportive.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). Hidden strain, secrecy or sudden changes in dealings with the women of the family.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio). Women, and the spouse's side of the family, strongly present and benefic in the native's life.

ambiguity: 'Falani dham kani' is filler for 'and so on'. He does not exclude the wife or sisters, who classically belong to Venus and Mars.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is classically the mother and women in general, but the wife is Venus (male chart) and a sister is usually Mars or Mercury, so 'all female relatives are Moon' is wider than the texts.

hindi: इसमें चंद्र में मां लगा ही हुआ है यही शिव के मस्तक पर है
says: He plays on the name: 'Chandra-ma' already has 'maa' (mother) built into it, so the Moon itself carries the mother in its very name; and this is the same Moon that sits on Shiva's forehead.
ambiguity: 'Lagaa hi hua hai' means 'is already attached'; the wordplay is on 'Chandrama' (Moon) being Chandra plus Maa, and he does not say the grammar proves anything.
classical_check: The Moon on Shiva's forehead (Chandrashekhara) is standard iconography; the name wordplay is not a classical rule.

hindi: यानी आपके तीसरे नेत्र के खोलने के लिए शीतल दिमाग भी चाहिए और तेज गर्म सूर्य का भी चाहिए सूर्य की रोशनी में ठंडक के साथ सोचेंगे आपका तीसरा नेत्र चलेगा
says: To open the third eye you need both a cool, calm mind (Moon) and the fierce heat of the Sun; thinking coolly while standing in the Sun's bright light is what makes the third eye work.
cells_derived_method: none; it is a balance between the Sun and the Moon as planets, not tied to a cell. A chart where both are well placed would fit it best.
ambiguity: The Sun and the Moon are named by 'tez garm surya' and 'sheetal dimaag' (hot Sun, cool mind); he does not say what 'third eye working' means in chart terms.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; third-eye talk is yogic. The Sun-Moon pairing of heat and coolness resembles the pingala and ida idea.

hindi: तीसरे नेत्र के स्थान को दाएं और बाएं से जकड़ा हुआ है हमारे माता-पिता ने कॉमन सेंस ने यह है तीसरा नेत्र
says: He says the spot of the third eye is held in a grip from the right and the left by our mother and father, and he equates the third eye with common sense: common sense sits between the two parental pulls.
ambiguity: 'Right and left' may refer to the two eyes or two sides of the brain, with father as Sun (right) and mother as Moon (left), but he does not name the planets in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent as stated; Sun as father and Moon as mother are classical karakas, and Sun right eye, Moon left eye is also classical.

hindi: याद रखें अगर आप जल्दी ही मम्मी या पापा की भड़का में आ जाते हैं उन्होंने जो कह दिया
says: A warning sign: if you quickly flare up at whatever your mother or father tell you, taking their remarks as provocation against your spouse or someone else, that quick reactivity is the behaviour he warns about.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete here; its result comes after the example, in the line about the third eye being ruined.
classical_check: Silent; this is a behavioural warning, not a chart rule.

gist: Acted example: the mother-in-law phones her daughter and asks 'what did he do', the daughter complains, and the husband is provoked against his own wife or in-laws.

hindi: मए को उसी टाइम समझ लो आपका तीसरा नेत्र का नाश पिट रहा है यह मां या बाप आपको बर्बाद करने पर लगे हुए हैं
says: At the moment you catch yourself being provoked this way, he says, understand that your third eye (common sense) is being wrecked, as if that mother or father were set on ruining you.
ambiguity: He may mean this as a rhetorical device for that moment only; he does not say the parents are truly out to harm you.
classical_check: Silent; he appears to contradict himself in the next slice, where he says the parents provoke you without intent.

hindi: इसलिए इनको कहां करो मंगल आग में ताप दो दूध को भाड़ में भेज दो
says: A garbled metaphorical prescription: apply Mars's fire and heat and send the Moon's 'milk' to hell, meaning stop being soft and pliant (Moon) towards such provocations and use Mars's firmness instead.
ambiguity: 'इनको कहां करो' is garbled and the object being heated is unclear; the Mars-over-Moon reading rests on 'mangal aag' and 'doodh' (milk, the Moon's substance).
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies do not tell the native to suppress the Moon, so this is his own symbolic advice.

gist: Do not listen to them too much: a son should not heed his parents too much in this kind of matter.
Nor should a daughter listen too much to her mother and father; how much is too much he does not measure, saying time itself will settle it.

hindi: अन्यथा आपकी लाइफ के अंदर तीसरा नेत्र आपकी कॉमन सेंस बंद हो जाएगी आप भड़का में आ जाओगे
says: If you over-listen to the parents' provocation, the third eye, meaning your common sense, will shut down in your life and you will keep falling for being provoked. The stake in the earlier advice is the loss of your own judgement.
ambiguity: 'Otherwise' refers to the previous line about over-listening; how much listening counts as too much is left open.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural claim, not a chart rule.

gist: When parents tell the son 'your wife is like this', tie a firm knot that they are provoking him, though perhaps not on purpose, and decide for himself instead of being provoked.
A girl of today's generation, twenty-five years on, will not follow the parents' way of thinking.
If you had brought a village girl who stands and sits on command it would suit them, but you brought one who wants clubs and parties, which they will dislike: the generation gap.
Voicing the parents' complaint about the bride: she came from a place like that, why such a girl, why a plain wedding, why did you bring her.
You want a wife-material girl, not a girlfriend-material one who roams around, yet you imagine her partying with you as a girlfriend would.
A girlfriend would do that; she will not, so you will not like her, so what is it you are qualified for.
Everyone settled abroad who wants to marry wants an Indian girl from the village, because the other kind is thought to be hard.
And for a girlfriend he would pick one met at a club, to party with.
It is men's double standard: they want one kind of girl as a wife and a different kind as a girlfriend.

hindi: कुंडली में पांचवा भाव होता है गर्लफ्रेंड का और सातवा भाव होता है पत्नी का
says: In the chart the 5th house stands for the girlfriend and the 7th house for the wife; he treats them as two separate partner types, one for romance and one for marriage.
cells_derived_method: The sign on each house colours the partner: the sign on the 5th shapes the girlfriend or romance, the sign on the 7th shapes the wife.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo on the 5th house (lagna Aries). The girlfriend is read as proud, warm and wanting admiration, the Sun's sign.
Derived: Libra on the 7th house (lagna Aries). The wife is read as refined, fair-minded and partnership-minded, Venus's sign.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th house (lagna Cancer). Romance is read as intense, secretive and possessive.
Derived: Capricorn on the 7th house (lagna Cancer). The wife is read as serious and practical, perhaps older or slower to open up, Saturn's sign.

ambiguity: The sentence reads as a man's chart (girlfriend and wife); the next line gives the mirror for a woman's chart. He does not say the houses are multi-sign.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th is classically love, romance and courtship and the 7th is marriage and the spouse; 'girlfriend' is a modern label for the 5th-house romance.

hindi: पांचवा भाव होता है बॉयफ्रेंड का सातवा भाव होता है पति का
says: The mirror claim for a woman: the 5th house is the boyfriend and the 7th house is the husband, again two separate partner types in the chart.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th shapes the boyfriend and the sign on the 7th shapes the husband, read in the same way as for the man's chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius). The boyfriend is read as bold, impulsive and quick in courtship, Mars's sign.
Derived: Pisces on the 7th house (lagna Virgo). The husband is read as gentle and imaginative, perhaps vague about practical matters, Jupiter's sign.
Derived: Capricorn on the 5th house (lagna Virgo). The boyfriend is read as older or serious and slow to commit, Saturn's sign.

ambiguity: He does not say 'woman's chart' aloud; the reading follows from the boyfriend and husband wording. Houses being multi-sign is not mentioned.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give the 7th to the husband in a woman's chart and the 5th to love affairs; 'boyfriend' is a modern label.

hindi: यह दोनों अलग है इनमें से जिस भाव में ग्रह अच्छा होगा वह अच्छा मिलता है
says: Since the two are separate matters, whichever of the two houses holds a good planet gives the good partner of that type: a good planet in the 5th gives a good girlfriend or boyfriend, in the 7th a good wife or husband.
cells_derived_method: A strong benefic in a house gives a good partner of that kind; a weak or afflicted planet spoils that kind while leaving the other house free to be judged on its own.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 7th house (lagna Capricorn). A strong benefic in the 7th, so by his rule the spouse is the good partner of the two.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn). A strong benefic in the 5th, so the romance is the good one while the 7th is judged separately.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra). A weak malefic in the 7th spoils the marriage side, so a good 5th could still give a good girlfriend but not a good wife.

ambiguity: 'Good planet' is not defined (benefic by nature, dignified by sign, or well aspected).
classical_check: Agrees: benefics in the 5th and 7th are classically good for love and marriage, and afflictions in the 7th harm the spouse.

hindi: पत्नी अच्छी मिलेगी या गर्लफ्रेंड यह पांचवा और सातवा घर निर्धारित करता है आपका
says: He concludes that the 5th and 7th houses together settle which of the two relationships turns out good for you, the wife or the girlfriend; the choice between them is read off the strength of these two houses.
cells_derived_method: none; it restates the previous rule, so the cell logic is the same as there.
ambiguity: 'Decides' is read as comparing the strength of the two houses; he gives no method for deciding when both are strong or both weak.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 5th and 7th are the classical houses for romance and marriage, though no text frames it as 'wife or girlfriend'.

gist: All of this will be discussed later; for now, the main point follows.

hindi: तो चंद्रमा के बढ़िया बेहतर कर देने मात्र से आपका जीवन ऑटोमेटिक चंदा मामा आपकी बॉडी के सारे के सारे डब्ल्यूबीसी इत्यादि ठीक करते हैं
says: He says that merely putting the Moon in better shape lets your life improve automatically, with the Moon repairing all your white cells and similar body functions as a by-product. It is a broad claim for Moon remedies, not a diagnosis or a promise of cure.
ambiguity: 'Better' is not defined; the sentence runs into the next caption chunk, where 'sare' completes 'all the WBC'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: strengthening the Moon is a classical route for mind and fluid-related weakness, but 'automatically fixes everything' is stronger than any text.

hindi: और चंद्रमा के पास ही बॉडी के अंदर सारा फ्लूइड का गोल गोल घूमने का है
says: He gives the Moon the circulation of all fluid in the body, the round-and-round movement of body fluids; fluid flow is a Moon job.
ambiguity: 'Fluid' is not narrowed to blood, lymph or water; the sentence follows his earlier lymph and white-cell lines.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon classically rules body fluids, blood and lymph circulation.

hindi: चंद्रमा के पास ही आपके लाइफ के अंदर आपका किडनी का रोल है पानी फिल्टर करती किडनी
says: The kidney's job of filtering the body's water is also put under the Moon, so he places kidney function in the Moon's charge.
ambiguity: He gives the kidney to the Moon on the basis of 'water filtering'; it is not said whether other planets share the kidney.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical lists usually give the kidneys to Venus (with Saturn), with Libra and the 7th house as sign and house, while the Moon gets fluids and the bladder.

hindi: तो सोचो आपका जितना डर है मन कितनी जल्दी डर जाता है डर लग गया डरते ही किडनी सिकुड़ जाती है
says: He ties fear to the Moon-mind: the mind gets frightened very quickly, and the moment fear arises the kidney contracts, linking the Moon's emotional state straight to the kidney. A physiological claim in his words, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The Moon is implied through 'mind'; he does not name it in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; the fear-kidney link exists in other medical traditions but not in classical astrology.

hindi: तो आपको यूरिनरी डिसऑर्डर और किडनी संबंधित समस्या तभी है जब चंद्रमा गड़बड़ है
says: Urinary disorders and kidney-related problems occur only when the Moon is spoiled, he says, making the Moon the sole cause. His claim as stated, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's cell and the body-part map decide where the kidney and urinary theme would show: Libra and the 7th house for the kidney region, Scorpio and the 8th for the excretory tract, and the 2nd house for food and drink intake.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries). Libra and the 7th both map to the kidney and lower-abdomen region, so this is the clearest cell for his claim; read as a kidney and urinary theme, not a diagnosis.

Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). Scorpio maps to the urinary and excretory tract and the 8th house is hidden trouble, so a fall here is read as a recurring urinary theme.
Derived: Moon in Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo). The 2nd house governs intake of food and drink and Libra maps to the kidney region, so fluid intake habits are read as the trigger.

ambiguity: 'Only when' (tabhi) is a strong word; it is not clear whether he means the Moon is the sole cause or the main one.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts tie urinary and kidney disease mainly to Venus, Saturn and the 7th and 8th houses, and none says it occurs only when the Moon is spoiled.

gist: Emphasis: think how important it is to keep your Moon in good order through life.

hindi: इसके लिए क्या करो अगर चंद्रमा अच्छा है जल का दान नहीं करना
says: For keeping the Moon in order he gives a do-not: if the Moon is already good, do not donate water, because giving away the Moon's own substance weakens a Moon that is doing well.
cells_derived_method: The rule applies where the Moon is 'good', which he defines in his next lines as exalted in Taurus, own sign in Cancer, or in a friendly sign; where the Moon is weak, his later line says to give such items away.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer). A strong Moon in a kendra, so water donation is to be withheld.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius). Highest dignity, so the same do-not applies.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). A weak Moon, so by his later line water donation would be the fitting remedy, not a prohibition.

ambiguity: 'Jal ka daan' could include casual acts such as giving a drink to a thirsty person, which he does not clarify.
classical_check: Differs: giving water is widely praised as charity, and classical remedy texts tell a weak Moon to donate white items; a ban on donating water when the Moon is strong is not stated in the texts.

hindi: आपने प्याऊ खोल के दे दिया आपको खून के आंसू रो गए नहीं हम तो बड़ा भला काम कर रहे हैं प्याऊ बनते ही आपकी हड्डियां टूट गई आपकी जिंदगी नर्क हो गई और आप सड़क पर आ गए
says: His example: someone with a good Moon opens a public water stall (pyau) thinking it a noble deed, and once it is built, he says, the person weeps tears of blood, suffers broken bones, finds life turned to hell and ends up on the street. He means that charity of the wrong planet's item backfires; the outcomes are his claims, not predictions for anyone.
cells_derived_method: none; same 'Moon is good' condition as the line before it.
ambiguity: The quoted 'we are doing a great good deed' is the donor's voice. 'Bones broken' is read as hardship or injury, not literal in every case.
classical_check: Differs: classical and popular practice treats a water stall as meritorious; this warning is his own reading, not a text rule.

hindi: चंद्रमा अच्छा का मतलब क्या है जब चंद्रमा दो नंबर राशि का है तो उच्च का है इसकी अपनी राशि चार है और मित्र राशियों के अंदर यदि बैठा है
says: He defines a 'good Moon': in sign number 2 (Taurus) it is exalted, its own sign is number 4 (Cancer), and it also counts as good when sitting in friendly signs.
cells_derived_method: Any house can carry the Moon in these signs; the house sets the life area where the Moon's strength is felt. The friendly signs he does not name; by Parashari friendship the Moon's friends are the Sun and Mercury, so Leo, Gemini and Virgo would count.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo). Counts as good by his sign test; the strength shows in public standing and career.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer). Counts as good by his sign test; the strength shows in personality and body.
Derived: Moon in Leo, the sign of its friend the Sun, in the 11th house (lagna Libra). Qualifies only through the friendly-sign clause, so a weaker kind of good than exaltation or own sign.

ambiguity: Sign numbers follow Aries=1, so 'do number' is Taurus and 'char' is Cancer, matching the Moon's exaltation and own sign. 'Mitra rashi' is not listed, and the Moon's friends are not named.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is exalted in Taurus and owns Cancer; the Moon's friends are the Sun and Mercury in the usual Parashari scheme.

hindi: और आपने पानी का दान कर दिया दूध का दान कर दिया सफेद चीज सफेद कपड़ा आप खून के आंसू रोगे
says: Likewise, if a person with a good Moon gives away water, milk, white things or white cloth, he will weep tears of blood: the whole white family of the Moon should be kept, not donated, while the Moon is good.
cells_derived_method: none; same 'Moon is good' condition as the sign test just given.
ambiguity: 'Tears of blood' is idiom for heavy regret or loss. The sentence runs over into the next caption chunk, where 'kapda' completes 'white cloth'.
classical_check: Differs: classical remedy texts prescribe donating milk, rice, white cloth and silver to a weak or afflicted Moon, and are silent on a prohibition for a strong Moon.

hindi: अच्छे ग्रह का दान नहीं होता
says: The general principle behind the last rules: a planet that is doing well must not be donated from; donation is not for a strong planet.
cells_derived_method: For any planet, the test is whether it is dignified in its sign and house; where it is, its characteristic items (and so its charity items) are kept.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer). By his rule the Sun's items such as wheat, jaggery and copper should not be given away.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra). Red lentils, red cloth and other Mars items should not be donated.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries). Black sesame, iron and mustard oil should not be given away.

ambiguity: 'Good planet' is not defined here beyond the Moon example just before it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies target weak or afflicted planets; wearing or donating for a strong planet is generally discouraged, though donation is rarely forbidden outright.

hindi: जब ग्रह खराब है तो उसकी चीज हाथ से निकालो
says: The opposite rule: when a planet is bad, get that planet's things out of your hands, meaning give its items away; donation is the remedy for a weak or afflicted planet.
cells_derived_method: For any planet, the test is whether it is weak or afflicted in its cell; then its items are given away.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). The Moon is bad here, so giving away water, milk and white items is the matching act.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra). Saturn is bad here, so sesame, iron and oil are the items to give away.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn). The Sun is bad here, so wheat, jaggery and copper are the items to give away.

ambiguity: 'Haath se nikaalo' (take out of your hands) is read as donating; the following 'le lo bhai' is a garbled aside.
classical_check: Agrees: donating a weak or afflicted planet's items is a standard classical remedy (daan).

gist: Analogy: would anyone put on dirty clothes, or go out in three-day-old clothes, so why keep three-day-old rotten thoughts in the head.
Analogy continued: someone insulted me a year ago, so should I wear a year-old filthy cloth, with the neighbourhood beating me with shoes; the same goes for old dirty thoughts.

hindi: ऐसे गंदे थॉट हम रखते क्यों है चंद्रमा डिस्टर्ब कर रहे हो
says: Closing the clothes comparison: keeping such stale dirty thoughts, old insults and grudges, means you are disturbing your own Moon.
ambiguity: 'Dirty thoughts' means grudges and old hurts here; it is not about sexual thoughts.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: the Moon is the mind and brooding is read as Moon affliction, though no text states it so.

hindi: आपकी हड्डियां गला देगा ये कैंसर देता है यह कोई पता नहीं गुप्त रूप से
says: A disturbed Moon, he warns, will dissolve your bones and gives cancer silently, with no warning and no one knowing when. This is his health claim in strong words, not a diagnosis or a prediction for anyone.
cells_derived_method: The 'silent, unseen' type fits a Moon in hidden houses (8th, 12th), and bones link to Saturn's signs; the severity grade rises with fall and malefic company. Severity only, no disease is named.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 12th house (lagna Aquarius). Saturn's sign, ruling bones and slow decay, in the hidden house matches the 'silent, unseen' type he describes.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). A fall in the house of hidden matters is the top grade on his 'secret trouble' scale; severity only.

ambiguity: The subject of 'dissolve the bones' is the disturbed Moon of the line before; 'gupt roop se' (in secret) could also mean it develops unseen.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not name bone loss or cancer for the Moon; bones belong to Saturn and the Moon is tied to fluids and the mind.

hindi: कब शनि और चंद्रमा का कॉमिनेशन आपको कैंसर दे दे
says: He singles out the Saturn and Moon combination as the pairing that can hand out cancer at an unknown time, unseen beforehand. Health claim as he states it, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Severity would follow where the two sit together and how strong Saturn is: a strong Saturn pressing on the Moon in a dusthana is the heaviest grade, while a Moon in its own sign with a weak Saturn is the lightest. Severity only, no disease is named.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon and Saturn together in Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo). Saturn in own sign presses hardest on the Moon and the 6th is the disease house, so the top grade on his scale.
Derived: Moon and Saturn together in Libra in the 8th house (lagna Pisces). Saturn exalted in Libra sits in the house of hidden trouble, also a high grade.
Derived: Moon and Saturn together in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer). The Moon is in its own sign and Saturn in an unfriendly sign, so the Moon holds up better, a milder grade.

ambiguity: 'Combination' is not defined: it could be conjunction, mutual aspect, or any link between the two. 'When' is rhetorical, not a timing.
classical_check: Differs: the Moon-Saturn conjunction is classically Vish (poison) yoga, giving a dull, grieving mind, delays and trouble with the mother; cancer is not named in the texts.

hindi: शनि क्या है तेल चंद्रमा क्या है पानी
says: He sets two element symbols: Saturn is oil and the Moon is water, the pair that will not mix and in which oil floats over water.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is classically oil and black items, and the Moon is water.

hindi: पानी का यह बड़ा ड्रम है और उस पर सिर्फ यह बड़ा ड्रम जिसमें 10000 मगे का पानी आएगा उस पर एक मग्गा तेल डाल दो पानी गायब तेल की तह बह जाएगी शनि खत्म कर देता है नष्ट
says: His analogy: a big drum holding ten thousand mugs of water, with just one mug of oil poured on it, hides the water under a spreading film, which is how Saturn finishes the Moon. So a small dose of Saturn can cover and wipe out a very large store of Moon.
ambiguity: The caption 'sirf yeh bada drum' is garbled filler. The 10,000-mug figure is illustrative, not a measured ratio. The sentence runs into the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon-Saturn pairing is classically harmful to the mind (Vish yoga); the oil-on-water picture is his own.

hindi: जैसे ही अंधकार आया आपके मुन्ना पर आप तबाह हो गए बर्बाद हो गए
says: As soon as Saturn's darkness falls over your Moon, you are wrecked and ruined: this is the payoff line of the oil-on-water picture, where the dark film (Saturn) covers the Moon.
cells_derived_method: How hard the ruin lands depends on Saturn's strength and how it touches the Moon: sitting on the Moon is the heaviest, aspecting it from the opposite side is lighter, and the house shows the life area that collapses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer), with Saturn aspecting it from the 7th. Saturn's full opposite aspect lays the dark film on the Moon from the other side, so the ruin is read as coming through partnerships.
Derived: Moon and Saturn together in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer). Saturn exalted in Libra sits right on the Moon in the home house, the heaviest case; peace at home is lost.
Derived: Moon and Saturn together in Aquarius in the 8th house (lagna Cancer). Saturn in own sign makes the darkness steady and slow, a hidden, long-running ruin.

ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is his pet name for Saturn (a later slice says 'मुन्ना जो है शनि है'), which makes 'आपके मुन्ना पर' odd here; it is read as a caption slip for 'Moon' because the line follows the oil-on-water picture of Saturn covering the Moon. 'Andhkaar' (darkness) as Saturn is implied by the oil analogy.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon-Saturn pairing is classically harmful to the mind and fortune (Vish yoga); 'ruin as soon as darkness arrives' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: यदि आप दुष्कर्म नीच कर्म दो नंबर का काम कर रहे हैं और पछता रहे आपका चंद्रमा नष्ट है पछताना नहीं है
says: He says that if you are doing wrong, low or shady deeds and are tormented by remorse over them, that remorse is what destroys your Moon, so you should not repent. Recorded as his claim only; it is not an endorsement of wrongdoing.
ambiguity: The sentence is loose: it could mean 'do not regret what you did' or 'do not keep doing wrong and then regret it'. He does not say which.
classical_check: Differs: classical and popular remedy practice asks for atonement (prayashchitta) and repentance for wrong deeds; telling a person not to repent is not a classical position.

hindi: फिर आप दो नंबर के सारे काम शनी महाराज के पास दो नंबर तीन नंबर छ छह नंबर यानी टेढ़े से टेढ़ा काम गंदे से गंदा आतंकवादी घटना जो मर्जी हो रही है
says: All the shady 'number two' work, and every grade of crooked and dirty work right down to terror incidents, whatever is going on, he hands over to Saturn: Saturn is the karaka of underhand and dirty dealings.
cells_derived_method: The house and sign of Saturn show the channel of the shady work: career and authority for a Saturn in the 10th, communication for the 3rd, hidden and foreign dealings for the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries). The shady-work theme runs through career and positions of authority.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 3rd house (lagna Sagittarius). The theme runs through communication, media and small ventures.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio). The theme runs through hidden, covert dealings and foreign links.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर तीन नंबर छ छह नंबर' is a slang ladder of grades of dirtiness (number two, three, six), not house numbers.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn classically rules dirty, low and menial work, and Rahu also rules deceit; linking terror incidents to Saturn is a mundane-astrology extension, not a stated text rule.

hindi: इसमें राहु वगैरह इंद्र इत्यादि जुड़े हुए प्लूटो जुड़ा हुआ है
says: He adds that Rahu and the like, Indra (his name for Uranus) and so on, and Pluto are also joined into this shady-work territory beside Saturn.
ambiguity: 'Rahu wagairah' leaves open whether Ketu is also meant; 'Indra' is read as Uranus from the series' naming, which this sentence does not repeat.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu as deceit and the underworld is classical; Uranus and Pluto are outside the Parashari nine, so they belong to his 12-planet scheme.

hindi: लेकिन चंद्रमा नष्ट नहीं होने देना किसी हालत में भी
says: He closes with a hard priority: whatever else happens, never let your Moon be destroyed; the Moon is the one planet to protect at any cost.
ambiguity: 'Destroyed' is not tied to a chart condition; it means harmed by Saturn, grudges, bad water or remorse, the causes he has just listed.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts treat the Moon as the mind and a protected, well-kept Moon as the base of health; 'at any cost' is his emphasis.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर आपके आत्मा तक के एरिया को चंद्रमा इंपैक्ट डालता है हालांकि वो लिवर होता है वहां बृहस्पति का आधिपत्य है
says: Garbled: the Moon's influence reaches the areas of life and body all the way up to the soul (atma), though he adds that the liver region is Jupiter's, so Jupiter has sway at that point.
ambiguity: The sentence is hard to read: 'atma tak ke area' (up to the soul), 'wo liver hota hai' (that is the liver) and 'haalanki' (however) do not obviously connect. It may mean the Moon's reach stops at the liver or covers all but the liver.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the liver is classically Jupiter's; the Sun, not the Moon, is the atma karaka, so a Moon reach 'up to the soul' differs.

hindi: यह चंदा मामा इसके लिए मोती पहनते हैं इस हाथ की सबसे छोटी किसी भी हाथ की सबसे छोटी उंगली में
says: For the Moon the remedy is to wear a pearl, on the smallest finger of either hand.
ambiguity: He does not say when a pearl suits (weak Moon, malefic Moon or any Moon) or the metal; 'iss haath ki' is a pointing gesture then corrected to 'any hand'.
classical_check: Agrees: the pearl (moti) is the Moon's gem and the little finger is a common classical choice, though texts often name the right hand and silver.

hindi: इसके लिए माणिक्य पहना जाता है
says: He says a ruby (manikya) is worn 'for this', but which planet 'this' points to is unclear; the line sits right after the pearl for the Moon, yet ruby is the Sun's gem.
ambiguity: If 'for this' means the Moon, it conflicts with the classical gem; it is more likely a caption slip, or he is starting the Sun's remedy. The planet is left blank because it is not clear.
classical_check: Differs if it refers to the Moon: ruby is classically the Sun's gem; for the Sun it would agree.

gist: There are many more remedies in this area; they will be covered gradually in later talks.

hindi: इस चंद्रमा की इंपॉर्टेंस को जानने के बाद किसी हालत में भी आपने स्त्रियों का अनादर नहीं करना है
says: Having understood how important the Moon is, you must never disrespect women under any circumstance, since women are the Moon's domain and disrespect to them damages your own Moon.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of one caption chunk and finishes in the next, where 'nahi karna hai' completes it.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts make serving and honouring the mother and women a Moon remedy and an offence against them a Moon fault.

gist: Aside answering an imagined objection: 'But the woman is bad, very bad, bad for us'; he concedes this may be so.

hindi: ना हो तो उसको बहन को हाथ जोड़ो और बोलो माता तुम ही हो माता तो पिता तुम ही हो तुम ही हो सर्वे सर्वा और निकल लो साइड से
says: If a woman really is bad for you, fold your hands to her as to a sister, say 'you are my mother, you are my father, you are everything', and slip away from the side instead of confronting her.
ambiguity: 'Na ho to' is read as 'if it cannot be sorted out'; 'behen ko' may mean 'to her, as a sister' or 'to the sister'.
classical_check: Silent; this is behavioural advice and not a classical Moon remedy.

hindi: क्योंकि छेड़ो मत क्योंकि उसकी अग्नि ताप आपके मिरर न्यूरॉन्स के फेमिनिटी को खराब कर देगी
says: He gives the reason for leaving her alone: do not provoke a woman, because her heat of anger will damage the feminine side of your own mirror neurons, that is, spoil the Moon-like femininity inside you.
ambiguity: 'Mirror neurons' is used loosely as neuroscience colour, and 'agni taap' (fire heat) means her anger, not the planet Mars. The Moon is implied through 'femininity'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not use mirror neurons and give no rule about a woman's anger harming a man's Moon.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा दो नंबर पानी का दान सफेद चीज का दान
says: A recap that seems to say: for this Moon, 'number two' (the exalted sign Taurus), donation of water and donation of white things is what must not be done. The sentence is clipped and could instead be a fresh list of Moon items.
cells_derived_method: If the recap holds, the do-not applies to a Moon in Taurus in any house; the house shows the life area that would be drained if the rule were broken.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 3rd house (lagna Pisces). Water and white items are kept; breaking the rule drains effort and sibling matters, the 3rd house.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 9th house (lagna Virgo). Water and white items are kept; breaking the rule drains fortune and father-linked matters, the 9th house.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 11th house (lagna Cancer). Water and white items are kept; breaking the rule drains gains and friendships, the 11th house.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' here follows his earlier 'sign number 2' and is read as Taurus; it could also be slang for 'dishonest' as in the shady-work lines, or the 2nd house. The verb is missing.
classical_check: Differs: as with the earlier Moon rule, classical remedy texts prescribe giving white items to a weak Moon, not withholding them from a strong one.

hindi: वाइट वाइन वुड का वाइट मीट वाइट मीट आपका जो है यह सारा चंदा मामा है
says: White wine, white food and white meat all belong to the Moon, he says: a list of white things you consume sits under the Moon.
ambiguity: 'वुड' is garbled, probably 'food'. Whether white wine is meant as a prohibition or only as a classification is not said.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical lists put white substances such as milk, curd, rice and sugar under the Moon; white wine and white meat are his extension.

hindi: यदि चिकन से भी आपको प्रॉब्लम हो रही है तो यह वाइट मीट है तो वह चंदा मामा की वजह से है
says: If chicken gives you trouble, he reads it as a Moon problem, since chicken is white meat and white things belong to the Moon. The trouble is as he describes it, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Problem from chicken' is not specified (digestive upset, allergy or dislike).
classical_check: Silent; classical texts have no rule on chicken or food intolerance.

hindi: रेड मीट मंगल है
says: By contrast, red meat belongs to Mars, giving a red-versus-white split of meats between Mars and the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is classically the karaka of meat, red things and blood.

hindi: आपका वाइट मीट और वाइट में क्या आ जाएगा जी दुदू आ गया
says: Asking what else counts as white, he says milk, the white drink, comes in too; milk joins white meat on the Moon's list.
ambiguity: 'दुदू' is baby-talk for milk; the Moon is implied by the white list, not named here.
classical_check: Agrees: milk is classically a Moon substance.

hindi: जितने लोग लैक्टोज इनटोलरेंट है वोह सारे के सारे चंद्रमा के दोष से पीड़ित है
says: He claims that everyone who is lactose intolerant is suffering from a Moon dosha, so milk intolerance is read as a Moon affliction. His claim only, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'All of them' is a sweeping claim that he does not back with any chart condition.
classical_check: Silent; lactose intolerance is a modern condition with no classical reading.

hindi: जब आप अग्नि तत्व के व्यक्ति होते हैं तो आपके जीवन में आप तीखा बहुत ज्यादा खाना पसंद करेंगे यह मसालेदार च चटकारे मार मार के यह चांस है
says: When you are a fire-element person, he says, you will like very spicy, sharp food and relish masala with a smack of the lips; this is a likelihood.
cells_derived_method: A fire-element nature would come from a fire-sign lagna, Moon or Sun, or a strong Mars; the house shows where the spicy appetite is felt, such as the 4th for home food habits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries). A fire-sign lagna with a strong Mars gives a strong appetite for very spicy, hot food.
Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus). A fire sign on the house of home and food habits gives a taste for hot, rich dishes at home.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 10th house (lagna Pisces). A fire sign on the career house shows the taste for spice in public or eating-out habits.

ambiguity: The sentence trails off at 'yeh chance hai' and continues in the next slice. 'Fire-element person' is not defined: fire lagna, Moon or Sun sign, or a strong Mars.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical taste lists give the Sun a pungent taste; linking a fire-element nature to a liking for spice is a lecture-style extension.

hindi: कि आप अपने इसी पेट में नाभी पर जैसे ही आप वाटर ले जाओगे अग्नि है
says: He locates fire in the belly at the navel: the moment you carry water down to the navel it meets the fire there, so the navel region is the body's fire seat and water arriving at it clashes with fire.
ambiguity: The sentence opens with 'कि' ('that') and continues the 'chance' line from the previous slice about fire-element people and spicy food. The planets are implied by water and fire, not named.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; the navel as the fire centre (Manipura) is a yogic idea, and Mars or the Sun are the fiery planets.

hindi: ये अग्नि तत्व के लोग कौन है फायर जिन में काम करेंगे आग लगा देंगे भाई दुनिया में यह लंबा लंबा काम करना है छोटी काम तो करने ही नहीं लंबी लंबी छोड़नी है
says: Fire-element people, he says, are those who will set the world ablaze with their work: they want long-range, big projects, refuse small work altogether, and like to talk big.
cells_derived_method: A fire-element nature would come from fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) on the lagna, Moon or Sun; the house shows where the big-scale drive is aimed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 10th house (lagna Cancer). The big-scale drive goes into career and status, with a pioneering start-things-up style.
Derived: Leo on the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius). The grand ambition aims at fame through teaching, beliefs and long journeys.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 3rd house (lagna Libra). Big talk and big plans in writing, media and ventures, with a taste for distant horizons.

ambiguity: 'Fire-element person' is not tied to a sign or planet; 'lambi lambi chhodni' is a colloquial idiom for talking big or boasting.
classical_check: Partly agrees: fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) are classically bold and ambitious; the 'only big work, never small' version is his emphasis.

hindi: वो अक्सर लैक्टोज इनटोलरेंट होते हैं यानी चंद्रमा दूषित होता है तो उनको समस्या होती है दूध की चीज से
says: Those fire-element people are often lactose intolerant, he says, which he reads as a spoiled Moon: with the water-Moon vitiated by fire, milk products give them trouble. His claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The clash shows most where the Moon sits in a fire sign (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius), because water is placed in fire; the house shows the life area where the intolerance flares.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 2nd house (lagna Pisces). The Moon sits in Mars's fire sign on the house of food and intake, so milk products are the likely trouble.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus). The Moon sits in the Sun's fire sign on the house of home comfort, so milk in home meals is the trouble.
Derived: Moon in Sagittarius in the 10th house (lagna Pisces). A fire sign on the career house, so the intolerance is read as flaring with work stress and outside eating.

ambiguity: 'वो' refers to the fire-element people of the line before; 'often' (aksar) is a tendency, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent: lactose intolerance is a modern condition; the fire-on-water clash between Mars or the Sun and the Moon is element logic, not a text rule.

hindi: तो वो दूध की चीज छोड़ दूध बहुत अच्छी चीज है नो डाउट लेकिन नहीं है भैया उनके लिए जिनको सूट नहीं करता
says: His advice: those who are troubled should drop milk products; milk is a very good thing without doubt, but it is not good for those it does not suit. Dietary advice as he gives it, not medical advice.
ambiguity: It is not said whether the advice is permanent or only while the Moon is afflicted.
classical_check: Differs: classical Moon remedies centre on giving and using milk and white items, not on avoiding them.

hindi: तो यह अलग-अलग ग्रह विशेष का कार्यक्रम है जिनके कारण से अलग-अलग एनर्जी आपको डिस्टर्ब कर सकती है
says: He generalises: each planet runs its own programme, and the different energies behind them can disturb you in their own different ways, so a problem has to be traced to the particular planet behind it.
classical_check: Agrees: each graha has its own karakatwa and afflicts in its own way.
