gist: Agenda: the next topic is Mercury as number 3 and then Rahu as number 6 (a little later he calls Rahu the fourth).

hindi: चंद्रमा मतलब मन होता है मन और मुन्ना श मुन्ना और मन दोन अलग अलग
says: The Moon means the mind, but the mind and 'Munna' (his pet name for Saturn, made explicit a few lines on) are two separate things; he is separating the mind from what rules it.
ambiguity: 'श' is a stray garbled syllable. 'Munna' is read as Saturn from the later line 'मुन्ना जो है शनि है'.
classical_check: Moon as mind (manas) is classical; treating Saturn as a separate controlling factor of the mind is his own framing.

hindi: मुन्ना ही तो मन का मालिक है
says: Saturn ('Munna') is in fact the master of the mind: the Moon is the mind, but Saturn is its owner and controller.
ambiguity: 'Malik' (owner) could mean ruler, controller or the one that loads the mind with karma; he explains in the next lines that Saturn's seat is the root.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon is the lord of the mind and Saturn only afflicts or restrains it; calling Saturn the master of the mind is his own claim.

hindi: मुन्ना पर तो अटैक मारता है वो यह प्रारब्ध के कर्म है
says: Garbled: something strikes with an attack, apparently Saturn's seat acting on the mind, and he says this attack is the working of prarabdha (already-ripening) karma.
ambiguity: The subject and object of 'attack' are unclear: it may be Saturn attacking the mind, or karma attacking Saturn's seat. The next slice explains it as the attack coming up from the root.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn as the delivery of prarabdha karma is classical in spirit; the attack imagery is his own.

hindi: बहुत सुंदर प्रश्न है कि चंद्रमा मन होता है और मुन्ना जो है शनि है यह स्थान है उसका
says: Answering a listener's question, he states plainly that Munna is Saturn and that this spot, the base of the body, is Saturn's place, while the Moon is the mind; Saturn sits at the root as the controller.
ambiguity: 'यह स्थान' is a pointing gesture, read as the root (Muladhara) from the earlier slice where Saturn was placed there.
classical_check: Not in Parashari texts; Saturn at the root is one common chakra-planet mapping.

hindi: मन तो यहां भी है यहां भी यहां भी यहां भी सब जगह है सब जगह है
says: He answers that the mind is not confined to one spot: it is here, here and here, everywhere in the body, shown by pointing gestures, so the Moon-mind pervades the whole body even though Saturn's seat is the root.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of one caption chunk and finishes in the next; 'यहां भी' are pointing gestures at body parts.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the mind pervading the whole body is a standard yogic idea, though not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: आपका जो यहां पर है वह प्रारब्ध संचित कर्म है सारे के सारे
says: What sits at the root, Saturn's seat, is your prarabdha and sanchit karma, all of it: the root centre is the store of accumulated and ripening karma.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is a pointing gesture, read as the root from the context of Saturn's seat.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the classical giver of the results of past karma, and sanchit and prarabdha are classical karma categories; making the root centre the store is a yogic overlay.

hindi: यहां से अटैक मारता है ढुंग और यहां से उठा के ले जाता है वो क्या कर्म को करना है और सोचता यहां खोपड़ी खराब यहां करता है आपको
says: From the root it strikes upward ('dhung'), lifts out what karma has to be done and carries it up to the head, where it is thought over and where it spoils the skull: Saturn's karmic load travels from the base to the head and disturbs the mind there.
ambiguity: 'ढुंग' is a sound effect, and 'यहां' is a pointing gesture, read as the root the first time and the head the second. The head is the Moon's region by his scheme but he does not say so in this line.
classical_check: Silent; a yogic and lecture model of karma moving up the body, not a Parashari rule.

hindi: आपको बीच रस्ते में बृहस्पति आ गया ना ज्ञान ये फिल्टर कर देता है उसे और खराब नहीं होने देता
says: On the way up, Jupiter comes in the middle: knowledge acts as a filter that cleans what Saturn sends up and stops it from getting worse.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the filter is read from Jupiter's dignity and house: a strong Jupiter in a kendra or trikona filters well, and a weak or afflicted Jupiter lets the karmic pressure through.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 1st house (lagna Sagittarius). A strong filter on the lagna: the native's own knowledge and judgement clean up karmic pressure.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). Highest dignity in the home house gives a strong inner filter and a settled mind.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 9th house (lagna Cancer). Strength in the dharma house: faith and teachers act as the filter.

ambiguity: 'बीच रस्ते' (midway) is read as between the root and the head; he does not name the body spot for Jupiter in this line.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is classically the wise, protective benefic whose strength blunts malefics; the 'filter between Saturn and the head' is his own model.

hindi: बृहस्पति के आगे शनि की चलती नहीं है किसी की नहीं चलती उसके आगे
says: Before Jupiter, Saturn's strength does not work, and in fact nobody's does; Jupiter overrides every other planet and Saturn in particular.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's override reaches the houses it aspects (5th, 7th and 9th from itself), so a Saturn placed there is the case where the rule is clearest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 7th house (lagna Virgo). Its full aspects on the 1st, 3rd and 11th houses blunt a Saturn placed there.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 10th house (lagna Libra). Its full aspects on the 2nd, 4th and 6th houses blunt a Saturn placed there.

ambiguity: 'Aage' (in front of) could mean Jupiter's aspect, its conjunction, or simply Jupiter being stronger; he does not say which.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter's aspect is classically the strongest protective influence and can blunt a malefic; 'nobody's works before Jupiter' is overstated.

hindi: उसके आगे वो अलग कहानी है फिल्टर लगा हुआ है बॉडी के अंदर
says: He notes that beyond this point it is a different story and that a filter is fitted inside the body; he does not name the organ here, though it fits his Jupiter-as-filter line and his earlier remark giving the liver to Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'उसके आगे' can mean 'beyond that' or 'in front of that'; the filter organ is not named, and the Jupiter link is inferred.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the liver is classically Jupiter's; the filter wording is his.

gist: A separate talk is needed on this; we must also do a class on Saturn.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा हमारा मन है जो चंचल मन है सारे टाइम इंपैक्ट डालता है
says: The Moon is our fickle mind and it keeps impacting us all the time; the restless mind is the constant background influence on a life.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is classically the changeable mind (manas).

hindi: खोपड़ी सबसे ज्यादा पानी हमारे यहां पर है वाटर 100% है हमारी जो थर्ड आई है 90 पर वाटर ही वाटर है
says: The skull holds the most water in the body, he says, roughly all water in the head and about 90 percent water at the third eye; so the head is the watery Moon region.
ambiguity: The percentages ('100%' and '90 par') are rough and garbled; brain tissue is about 75 to 80 percent water, so the figures are loose and not a medical statement.
classical_check: Differs: classical body maps give the head to Aries (Mars) and the face to Taurus; the Moon's claim on the skull is his own.

hindi: य 72 पर बॉडी में वाटर है आप 60 साल के हो गए समझो 60 पर वाटर रह गया तो कमर झुक गई 72 पर वाटर है नहीं झुके गी वो कब है निर्मल मन है
says: The body is about 72 percent water; by age 60 it has fallen to about 60 percent, which is why the back bends, and if it stayed at 72 percent the back would not bend, which holds when the mind is clear (nirmal). So body water and a straight back are tied to a pure Moon-mind. A physiological claim in his words, not medical.
ambiguity: 'वो कब है' ('when is that') is read as 'this holds when the mind is pure'; the percentages are rough figures.
classical_check: Silent; the Moon rules body water classically, but nothing about age, water percentage or posture.

hindi: यार आग नहीं लगाते अपन परेशान नहीं हो खून नहीं जलाते
says: Part of the same picture of a pure mind: you do not set fires (stir up trouble), do not get upset and do not burn your own blood; such a calm person keeps the body's water and stays upright.
ambiguity: 'आग नहीं लगाते' is an idiom for not stirring up trouble; it is a do-not list for keeping the Moon calm.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural advice, not a chart rule.

hindi: कहते खून जला रहा है मेरा खून जल रहा है इसका मतलब क्या है चंद्रमा फुक रहा है इम्युनिटी डाउन हो रही है
says: When people say 'my blood is burning', he reads it literally: the Moon is being burnt up and immunity is going down. Anger and irritation, 'blood burning', is a Moon-burning and immunity-falling sign.
ambiguity: 'फुक रहा है' means burning out; 'blood burning' is an idiom for anger or irritation.
classical_check: Silent; the fire-on-water clash of Mars and the Moon is the element logic behind it.

gist: Illustration: say it plainly, 'this one is burning my blood, and he is my brother', an example of a relative who irritates you.

hindi: नमस्ते टाटा साइड से निकल लो उसको कुछ करना कहना ही नहीं कॉस्मस पर छोड़ दो अपने आप मरेगा जिएगा अपने कर्मों को यही समझदारी चाहिए
says: For a person who keeps burning your blood, even a brother, say goodbye, step aside, do and say nothing, and leave him to the cosmos: he will live or die by his own karma, and this is the wisdom needed. 'Will die' is an idiom for leaving someone to their fate, not a prediction.
ambiguity: The Moon is implied from the 'blood burning' lines before it; 'kosmos par chhod do' means detaching and leaving the outcome to karma.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural advice, though detachment matches classical karma teaching.

gist: Agenda: this one (the filter) will be Jupiter's; the third topic has become Mercury and the fourth Rahu (earlier he called Mercury number 3 and Rahu number 6).

hindi: अब बुध जो है यह क्या है वाणी का देवता वायु
says: Mercury is the god of speech and of air (vayu): speech is his domain, and he is linked to the air element.
ambiguity: 'वायु' could mean the air element or the wind-god; the sentence is clipped.
classical_check: Partly agrees: speech is classically Mercury's, but Parashari element lists give Mercury the earth element and put air with Saturn.

hindi: जिन लोगों की कुंडली के अंदर बुध का दोष होता है वो कंजूस होते हैं यह बहुत बड़ा लफड़ा होता है
says: People with a Mercury dosha in the kundli turn out miserly or stingy, which he calls a big problem; an afflicted Mercury shows as tight-fistedness.
cells_derived_method: A Mercury dosha is read from Mercury's cell: a fall or an unfriendly sign makes the stinginess sharper, and the house shows where it appears, such as money in the 2nd or home and savings in the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd house (lagna Aquarius). Weak Mercury on the house of wealth and speech: tight-fisted with money and with words.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio in the 6th house (lagna Gemini). Mars's sign on the house of debts and service gives grudging, suspicious handling of money.
Derived: Mercury in Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra). Saturn's sign turns caution into hoarding at home.

ambiguity: A 'Mercury dosha' is not defined: it could be a fall, combustion, retrogression or affliction by malefics.
classical_check: Differs: classically an afflicted Mercury gives nervousness, speech and skin trouble and indecision; miserliness is more Saturn's or the 2nd house's.

gist: Garbled line: 'if Mercury becomes good ... and ... cry from the heart ... no one knows anything'; the sentence cannot be recovered.

hindi: वाणी इतनी बकबक अब अपन इतनी बकबक करते हैं यह बुद्ध का खेल है
says: All the chatter in speech, how much we all talk, is Mercury's game; talkativeness itself is Mercury at work.
ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' is the caption spelling of 'budh' (Mercury) and not the Buddha.
classical_check: Agrees: speech and talkativeness are classically Mercury's.

hindi: अब बकबक कौन सी कर रहे हैं फालतू के जोक्स कर रहे हैं यूं ही बकवास कर रहे हैं कोई ज्ञान की चर्चा हो रही है अलग-अलग ग्रह चल रहा है
says: He frames a test: look at what kind of chatter you are doing, idle jokes, plain nonsense or serious talk of knowledge, because a different planet is running behind each kind; the style of your speech tells which planet is active in you.
cells_derived_method: none; the planet-by-planet list that follows gives the mapping, and the cell logic is in those rows.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet is behind idle jokes; the lines that follow cover Mars, Sun, Moon, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts read speech from the planets joined to Mercury and the 2nd and 3rd houses; the 'style of chatter shows the active planet' test is his teaching device.

hindi: तेज बोलते हैं मंगल का इंपैक्ट आ गया
says: Fast, sharp speaking means Mars's impact has come onto the speech.
cells_derived_method: Mars's colouring of speech is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house or joins Mercury, and its sign sets how sharp it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius). Mars at full strength on the house of speech and effort: rapid, forceful talk.
Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra). Mars on the house of speech: cutting, blunt talk, fast when angry.

ambiguity: 'तेज बोलना' could mean fast speech or sharp, harsh speech; both are read here.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars gives forceful, blunt and hasty speech.

hindi: ठहरी हुई बात करते हैं सूर्य का इंपैक्ट आ गया
says: Calm, settled, measured talk means the Sun's impact is on the speech: a steady, authoritative delivery.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd house or in dignity, and the house shows where the steady, authoritative voice is used.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 2nd house (lagna Cancer). Authoritative, measured and dignified speech.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer). Steady, commanding delivery in public and at work.

ambiguity: 'ठहरी हुई' means settled or unhurried, set against Mars's fast talk just before it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun classically gives dignified, authoritative speech.

hindi: चंचलता की बात करते हैं कोई ना सिर है ना पैर है चंद्रमा का इंपैक्ट आ गया
says: Fickle talk with neither head nor tail, jumping from point to point, is the Moon's impact on the speech.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house or joins Mercury; air and water signs make the talk more scattered.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries). Mercury's sign on the house of speech: restless, topic-hopping chatter.
Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 2nd house (lagna Aquarius). Dreamy, shifting talk that follows moods.

ambiguity: 'ना सिर है ना पैर' is the idiom for rambling talk without sense or order.
classical_check: Agrees: an afflicted or restless Moon gives changeable, scattered speech and thoughts.

hindi: आप की वाणी में बृहस्पति का इंपैक्ट आ गया सिर्फ ज्ञान की बात हो रही है
says: When your speech turns only to matters of knowledge, Jupiter's impact has come into it: talk of wisdom and learning is Jupiter's signature.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house or joins Mercury, and the sign sets whether the talk is preaching, teaching or philosophy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 2nd house (lagna Scorpio). Speech turns to teaching and advice.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 3rd house (lagna Capricorn). Gentle, philosophical talk in everyday communication.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter classically gives wise, scriptural and advisory speech.

hindi: सिर्फ रसिक बातें करते हैं रोमांस जिंग इसके अलावा कुछ नहीं पता शुक्र का इंपैक्ट आ गया
says: Talking only juicy, romantic things, romancing and nothing else, means Venus's impact is on the speech.
cells_derived_method: Venus's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house, the 5th for romance, or joins Mercury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries). Sweet, sensual, charming talk with a love of compliments.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 3rd house (lagna Capricorn). Romantic, artistic talk in everyday exchanges.

ambiguity: 'रोमांस जिंग' is a garbled filler; 'rasik' means fond of pleasures, flirtatious or romantic.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus classically gives sweet, romantic and artistic speech.

hindi: शनि का इंपैक्ट आ गया जैसे ही आप रोने पिटने वर्ल्ड पॉलिटिक्स फलान ढम कान कर रहे हो
says: As soon as you start weeping and lamenting, complaining about world politics and the like, Saturn's impact has come onto your speech.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house or joins Mercury; its sign sets whether the talk is complaint, duty or public affairs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 2nd house (lagna Sagittarius). Speech turns to complaint, hardship and serious public affairs.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 3rd house (lagna Sagittarius). Long talk of society and politics.

ambiguity: 'फलान ढम कान' is filler for 'and so on'; the sentence runs into the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn classically gives sombre, complaining and sorrowful speech; the world-politics detail is his addition.

hindi: राहु का आ गया जहां आप कह रहे हो यार इससे मिल उससे मिल भाई ये करेंगे अपन वो करेंगे बड़े-बड़े प्लांस हो रहे हैं सारी कंफ्यूजन चल रही है
says: Rahu's impact shows in talk full of 'meet this one, meet that one, we will do this, we will do that', with huge plans being made and general confusion all around.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house or joins Mercury; its sign sets what the grand plans are about.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries). A rush of ambitious plans and over-promising talk.
Derived: Rahu in Aquarius in the 11th house (lagna Aries). Big networking talk of meeting this one and that one.

ambiguity: The opening 'ढम कान कर रहे हो' belongs to the Saturn line before it, and 'राहु का आ गया' is read as 'Rahu's impact has come'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Rahu classically gives exaggeration, over-ambition and confusion in speech and plans.

hindi: बोलने को कुछ नहीं मुंह बंद है केतु का इंपैक्ट आ गया
says: Having nothing to say, with the mouth shut, is Ketu's impact on the speech: silence and withdrawal.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's colouring is strongest where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house or joins Mercury; the sign sets whether the silence is shy, spiritual or cut off.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra). Few words and sudden silences.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 3rd house (lagna Capricorn). Reserved and hard to draw out in conversation.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Ketu classically gives reticence, detachment and a lack of speech.

hindi: इस प्रकार आपके चंद्र इसके बुध के ऊपर अलग-अलग प्लेनेट का इंपैक्ट आ जाता है
says: Summing up: in this way the impact of one planet after another falls on your Moon and on Mercury, so the mind and speech take on a different colour each time.
ambiguity: 'आपके चंद्र इसके बुध के ऊपर' is clipped; 'on your Moon, on its Mercury' is the likely reading.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the mind and speech are read from the Moon and Mercury as modified by the planets that join or aspect them.

hindi: तो बुध क्या है सूर्य पर टोटली डिपेंडेंट है
says: Mercury is totally dependent on the Sun.
cells_derived_method: none; a planet-level dependence, spelled out in the sign-neighbour rule later in this slice.
ambiguity: 'Dependent' is not defined here; the next lines explain it as Mercury needing the Sun's protection and always staying close to the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury never strays far from the Sun in the sky and is classically a friend and attendant of the Sun.

hindi: बुध क्या है एक बिटिया हैय बुद्धि का नाम रखा था हमने इसका यह सूर्य पर डिपेंडेंट है पिताजी पिताजी पिताजी
says: He personifies Mercury as a little daughter, whom he has named Buddhi (intellect), who depends on the Sun as her father and keeps calling 'father, father, father'.
ambiguity: 'बुद्धि का नाम रखा था हमने' is read as 'we named her Buddhi'; it is his teaching image, not a naming rule.
classical_check: Differs: in the classical story Budha is the son of the Moon (Chandra) and Tara, and Mercury is of neutral gender; the daughter-of-the-Sun image is his own.

hindi: इसे प्रोटेक्शन चाहिए आपने मुंह से जो बोला उसको प्रोटेक्शन चाहिए 24 घंटे इसलिए कहते हैं माप तोल कर बोलो माप तोल के कैसे बोलो
says: Mercury needs protection, and what you say from your mouth needs protection round the clock, which is why people say to weigh your words before speaking; the question 'how do you weigh them' is left hanging for the next lines.
ambiguity: '24 hours' means constantly. The protection is the Sun's, as the family picture before and after it shows, though this line does not say so.
classical_check: Silent; a proverb-style link between Mercury and careful speech.

hindi: अब यह दोनों तो कभी टेढ़े मेढ़े जाते नहीं यहां से ग्रह वक्री होने शुरू हो जाते हैं वक्री मींस उल्टे भी चलते हैं अंतरिक्ष में
says: These two (the Sun and Moon, read from context) never go crooked; retrograde motion starts from the planets after them, and 'vakri' means they also move backward in space.
ambiguity: 'यह दोनों' is read as the Sun and the Moon; it could instead mean the Sun and Mercury. 'यहां से' is a gesture along the planetary order.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun and Moon are never retrograde; differs in that vakri is an apparent backward movement seen from Earth, which he describes as real backward travel. He does not mention Rahu and Ketu, which are always retrograde.

hindi: अब अगर बुध वक्री है तो व्यक्ति उल्टी बात करेगा बीच में हकला सकता है तुतला सकता है तेज बोल सकता है बोलते हुए उसकी जबान क्लियर नहीं होगी
says: If Mercury is retrograde the person speaks in reverse, saying the opposite of what is meant, may stammer or lisp in the middle, or speed up, and his tongue will not be clear while speaking. Speech traits as he states them, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Retrograde Mercury colours speech most where it sits on the 2nd or 3rd house, and the sign sets how hesitant or circular it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury retrograde in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries). Mercury's own sign on the house of speech: fast, circular talk that doubles back on itself.
Derived: Mercury retrograde in Pisces in the 2nd house (lagna Aquarius). Mercury in its fall and retrograde on the house of speech: the clearest case of unclear, hesitant talk.
Derived: Mercury retrograde in Sagittarius in the 6th house (lagna Cancer). Contrary talk shows in arguments, service and disputes.

ambiguity: 'उल्टी बात' means saying the opposite or the contrary of what is wanted; stammering and lisping are listed as possibilities, not certainties.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a retrograde Mercury is classically read as contrary, hesitant or unusual in speech and thinking; stammer and lisp are his extension.

hindi: कॉन्फिडेंस टूटेगा लगेगा हलक में कुछ अटक गया है बुध के दोष के कारण
says: The person's confidence will break and it will feel as if something is stuck in the throat; he attributes this to the Mercury dosha.
cells_derived_method: none; same cell logic as the retrograde-Mercury row before it.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of one caption chunk and finishes in the next, where 'atak gaya hai' completes it. 'Dosha' is read as the retrograde Mercury of the line before.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury governs the voice and nerves classically, and its affliction is linked to speech trouble.

hindi: जिन स्त्रियों को बोलने नहीं देते उन बेचार को राहु और बुध के दोष में थायराइड हो जाता है अटका रखी बातें लक से बाहर नहीं आ रही
says: Women who are not allowed to speak, the poor things, get thyroid trouble under a Rahu and Mercury dosha, because the held-back words stay stuck in the throat and cannot come out. His claim in his own words, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The throat theme would be read where Rahu and Mercury meet on the throat and speech signs and houses (Taurus and the 2nd house); the house sets whether it is chronic, sudden or hidden. Theme only, no diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Mercury in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries). Taurus and the 2nd house both map to the throat and speech, so suppressed speech is read as landing on the throat here; a theme only.
Derived: Rahu with Mercury in Taurus in the 6th house (lagna Sagittarius). The throat sign sits in the disease house, so the throat-area theme is read as long-running.
Derived: Rahu with Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries). Voice and communication clogged with confusion; the strain shows more in the voice and breathing than in the throat itself.

ambiguity: 'लक से' is read as 'हलक से' (from the throat). 'Women who are not allowed to speak' is a social premise, not a chart condition.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical body maps give the throat to Taurus and the 2nd house, and Mercury governs the voice and nerves; thyroid is a modern organ name, and Rahu with Mercury is classically read for speech and nerve trouble.

hindi: इसलिए उनको कहा गया स्पेस में जाकर बोल के आओ खुल्ले में यह क्या एलिमेंट है ब्लू कलर है यहां स्पेस बोल के आओ
says: The remedy he gives them: go out into open space and speak your stuck words out there, since space is the element with the blue colour, so speak them into the sky.
ambiguity: He names no planet for the space element or the blue colour; blue is the throat-centre colour in yogic schemes, so Mercury and the throat are the implied link. 'यहां स्पेस' is a pointing gesture at the sky.
classical_check: Silent; classical Mercury remedies use green items, Vishnu chanting and giving green gram, and going outdoors to speak is his own.

gist: A woman who says 'you don't let me speak' truly will not be allowed to, since she might blurt out things that provoke strife at home.
If she is intelligent she becomes a learned, witty woman and speaks in a way that makes the whole house listen.
A woman has to decide for herself what kind of woman she wants to become.

hindi: सारे टाइम यह बोलते रहो कि स्त्री की इज्जत करो स्त्री को प्रेम करो स्त्री का आदर करो इस लायक बनो नहीं तो फिर नमस्ते कट जाएंगे आपको बोलने नहीं दिया जाएगा परेशानी होगी
says: Keep saying all the time: respect women, love women, honour women, and make yourself worthy of it; otherwise you will be cut off, you will not be allowed to speak and trouble will follow. It is his warning of the consequence for a man who fails to respect women.
ambiguity: No planet is named here; the women and Moon link was made earlier in the series, so the Moon is not entered in this row. 'नमस्ते कट जाएंगे' is an idiom for being cut off or dismissed.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical Moon and Venus remedies include honouring women.

gist: The same goes for a man: keep barking all the time and you will be treated like a dog, with bread thrown to you and no love, respect or honour.
A man who keeps barking has a dog's worth; as people say 'the dog is barking', so a man keeps barking.

hindi: तो दोनों का अपना अपना एटिबल है अगर आप ज्ञानी है तो ही आप स्त्री से इज्जत पा सकते हैं अन्यथा आपकी स्त्री आपको इज्जत नहीं करेगी किसी हालत में
says: Both sexes have their own attribute; a man can win a woman's respect only if he is knowledgeable (gyani), otherwise his woman will not respect him under any circumstance.
ambiguity: 'एटिबल' is read as 'attribute'. 'Gyani' is not tied to Mercury or Jupiter here. The sentence starts at the end of one caption chunk and finishes in the next.
classical_check: Silent; a general claim about respect between the sexes, not a chart rule.

hindi: इज्जत नहीं करेगी तो प्रेम तो करेगी नहीं स्त्री प्रेम ही उससे करेगी जिसकी इज्जत करती है असंभव अन्यथा इज्जत नहीं तो प्रेम नहीं
says: Without respect she will not love: a woman loves only the man she respects, anything else is impossible, so no respect means no love.
ambiguity: 'असंभव' (impossible) makes it an absolute claim, with no exceptions allowed.
classical_check: Silent; a general claim about relationships, not a chart rule.

hindi: यह बुद्ध जो है बुद्धि का है बिटिया है सूर्य की सूर्य के साथ ही अंतरिक्ष में गोल गोल घूमता हैय गोल-गोल घूमता है
says: Mercury, the 'Buddhi' daughter of the Sun, goes round and round in space together with the Sun, never apart from it.
ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' is the caption spelling of 'budh' (Mercury), and 'बुद्धि का है बिटिया है' is read as 'the daughter of intellect' or 'Buddhi the daughter'.
classical_check: Agrees astronomically: Mercury is always near the Sun (at most about 28 degrees away); the daughter image is his own.

hindi: अब मन की चंचलता के कारण समस्या है बुद्ध जो है बुद्धि का जब जब मम्मी इसको आके कुछ बोलती है तोय नाराज होती मम्मी सारा टाइम रोकते रहते हो पापा मुझे साथ लेकर चलते हैं
says: He turns it into a family picture: the trouble comes from the mind's fickleness, so whenever 'Mummy' (the Moon) tells the daughter Mercury something she gets cross, 'Mummy, you are always stopping me', and prefers to go with Papa (the Sun), who takes her along.
ambiguity: The mother is the Moon and the father the Sun by context, not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: in the Parashari friendship table Mercury is a friend of the Sun and an enemy of the Moon, which matches this picture.

hindi: चंद्रमा क्या करता है अंतरिक्ष में घूम रहा है गोल गोल
says: In the same picture the Moon just whirls round and round in space, restless and fast-moving, which is the Moon's fickle nature in motion.
ambiguity: The sounds after 'गोल गोल' in the caption are garbled playful noises, not words.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the fastest-moving graha, about 13 degrees a day, and classically changeable.

hindi: सूरज एक महीने में एक राशि घूमेगा बाय कसम से
says: The Sun spends about one month in each sign, he swears on it, which is the Sun's steady pace through the zodiac.
ambiguity: 'बाय कसम से' is an oath, not astrology.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun takes about 30 days for each sign, about a year for the whole zodiac.

hindi: और बुध उससे थोड़ा आगे पीछे फुदक का लेकिन फुदक फुदक के व ऐसे फुदक रही है पापा के साथ चल रही है उंगली पकड़ के कभी आगे कभी पीछे
says: Mercury hops a little ahead of or behind the Sun but stays right with him, like a child walking holding her father's finger, sometimes in front and sometimes behind; so Mercury is always close to the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Wherever the Sun sits, Mercury can only be in the same sign or the sign just before or after it, so Mercury's possible cells are fixed by the Sun's cell.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with the Sun in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer), Mercury can only be in Pisces (9th), Aries (10th) or Taurus (11th).
Derived: with the Sun in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer), Mercury can only be in Virgo (3rd), Libra (4th) or Scorpio (5th).
Derived: with the Sun in Gemini in the 2nd house (lagna Taurus), Mercury can only be in Taurus (1st), Gemini (2nd) or Cancer (3rd).

ambiguity: He gives no angle; the same-or-adjacent-sign limit comes from the classical maximum of about 28 degrees, not from his words.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury never goes more than about 28 degrees from the Sun, so it stays in the Sun's sign or the next one on either side.

hindi: तो बुद्ध साथ र वो कहते प्रोटेक्शन मेरे को प्रोटेक्शन चाहिए सूर्य के कारण ही मैं जीवित हूं लेकिन चंद्रमा का रोल नहीं है
says: Speaking in the daughter's voice, Mercury says: I need protection, I am alive only because of the Sun, but the Moon has no role in my life.
ambiguity: 'बुद्ध साथ र' is garbled filler. 'The Moon's role is not there' is read as the Moon playing no part in protecting Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the Parashari table makes the Sun Mercury's friend and the Moon its enemy, so Mercury leans on the Sun and not the Moon.

hindi: तो बुध जब चंद्रमा के घर में गया तो चंद्रमा का नाश पीट देता
says: When Mercury goes into the Moon's house it wrecks the Moon: Mercury in the Moon's sign ruins the Moon's results, as the daughter who resents her mother does harm to her.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Cancer in any house is the case; the house shows where the Moon's results are wrecked, such as the personality in the 1st, home and mother in the 4th, and career in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer). Mercury in the Moon's sign on the lagna: clever thinking is flooded by moods, so the personality's mind is unsettled.
Derived: Mercury in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries). In the home house the mind's comfort is disturbed by overthinking, with the mother's mood affected.
Derived: Mercury in Cancer in the 10th house (lagna Libra). Career decisions and talk swing with mood.

ambiguity: 'Moon's house' is read as Cancer, the Moon's own sign; it could also mean the house where the Moon sits (a Moon-Mercury conjunction), which he does not separate.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury in Cancer, the sign of its enemy the Moon, is classically weak, and a Moon-Mercury conjunction is read as clever but unsettled; 'wrecks the Moon' is stronger than the texts.

gist: Opening fragment that is only the tail of a sentence from the previous batch ('...it ruins'); the Mercury placement it refers to is not named here, so nothing can be extracted.

hindi: यानी बुद्ध यह तीन नंबर का बुद्ध है अपना घर है इसका
says: Mercury placed in sign number 3 (Gemini) is sitting in its own home, which he treats as a comfortable and safe placement for it.
cells_derived_method: Sign is fixed as Gemini (Mercury's own sign), so the placement is strong everywhere; the house then decides which life topic Mercury's strength is spent on, and the lordships of Mercury for that lagna decide how mixed the result is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. Mercury is lagna lord and 10th lord, in its own sign in the 10th kendra, so work in trade, writing, analysis or communication is well supported.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio. Mercury (8th and 11th lord) is in own sign but in the 8th, so the sign is comfortable while the house is about research, hidden matters and other people's money; ease of speech is there, ease of life is not guaranteed.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius. Mercury (5th and 8th lord) in own sign in the 5th gives a sharp intellect and good learning, with sudden turns coming from the 8th lordship.

ambiguity: He says 'number 3' for a sign. It could be heard as the 3rd house, but 'apna ghar' (own home) fits Gemini, so sign number is the reading. Mercury's second own sign Virgo (6) is not mentioned here.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini is Mercury's own sign in BPHS.

hindi: ये य पांच नंबर में जाता है सूर्य का है पापा का घर है कोई टेंशन नहीं बहुत बढ़िया है
says: Mercury going into sign number 5 (Leo) lands in the Sun's house, which he calls the father's home, so Mercury has no stress there and he rates it very good.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed as Leo (a friend's sign for Mercury). Comfort comes from the sign; the house chooses the topic: kendra and trikona houses use it constructively, dusthana houses blunt it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus. Mercury (2nd and 5th lord) in the 4th in the Sun's sign: studies, home and speech-income combine comfortably.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio. Mercury (8th and 11th lord) in the 10th in the Sun's sign: career tied to authority, father or government, with gains from work; the 8th lordship adds pressure and hidden factors.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. Mercury (lagna and 10th lord) in the 12th in the Sun's sign: the 'no tension' claim is weaker because the 12th brings expenses, distance and withdrawal even in a friendly sign.

ambiguity: 'Number 5' is read as the sign Leo because he calls it the Sun's house; he also uses house numbers in the same way elsewhere.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is a natural friend of Mercury in Parashara, so Leo is a friendly sign for it. Calling it 'father's home' is his own framing.

hindi: लेकिन बुध चार नंबर में जब जाता है बर्बाद कर देता है कुंडली में किसी भी खाने में बुध चार नंबर का बैठा हुआ है नष्ट कर देगा
says: Mercury in sign number 4 (Cancer, the Moon's sign) ruins things, and he stresses this holds in any box (house) of the chart: whichever house holds Mercury in Cancer, he says it destroys that house's matters.
cells_derived_method: The sign is fixed as Cancer and the damage lands on whichever house Cancer occupies, so the topic changes with the house (self, spouse, children, work, gains) while the sign is the cause. Mercury's lordships for each lagna colour how it is felt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer. Mercury (3rd and 12th lord) in the lagna: by his rule, speech, self-image and body-level matters suffer; skill-based effort and siblings are the topics tied in.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius. Mercury (7th and 10th lord) in the 8th: by his rule both partnership and career lordships are pulled into a damaged house, so marriage and work would both be affected.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. Mercury (lagna and 10th lord) in the 11th: by his rule the income and friends house is spoiled, so earning through work and networks is the affected area.

ambiguity: 'Four number' is read as the sign Cancer because he says 'any box in the chart' (any house); it could be misheard as the 4th house, but the any-box wording points to the sign.
classical_check: Partly differs: Cancer is an enemy sign for Mercury (Moon is its natural enemy in Parashara), but Mercury is not debilitated there (that is Pisces). No classical text says it ruins every house.

hindi: पढ़ाई में बैठा है फेल
says: If Mercury in Cancer is sitting in the education house, the person fails in studies.
cells_derived_method: House is the education house (school 4th, higher learning 5th) with sign fixed as Cancer; the same Mercury in a friendly sign such as Leo would, by his own earlier rule, be comfortable in the same house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries. Mercury (3rd and 6th lord) in the 4th in Cancer: schooling suffers; home, mother and emotional disturbance are the channels.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces. Mercury (4th and 7th lord) in the 5th in Cancer: higher study and exams are hit; this combination touches both his rule and the 4th-lord-in-5th classical link to learning.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries. Contrast case: Mercury (3rd and 6th lord) in the 5th in the Sun's sign; by his own Leo rule this is the comfortable placement, so studies are protected.

ambiguity: He names the place by topic ('padhai') not by number. Which house counts as the study house (4th or 5th) is not stated, so both are listed.
classical_check: Silent on 'fail'. Classically the 4th and 5th are the education houses and Mercury is the karaka of learning, so the topic link is classical but the outcome is his.

hindi: शादी पर बैठा है तलाक नट
says: If Mercury in Cancer sits in the marriage house, the result is divorce.
cells_derived_method: House is the 7th (marriage) and sign fixed as Cancer; other signs on the 7th give different results by his own scheme, for example Gemini (own) or Leo (Sun's) would be comfortable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn. Mercury (6th and 9th lord) in the 7th in Cancer: by his rule the marriage house is damaged; the 6th lordship adds disputes and separation themes.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius. Contrast case: Mercury (5th and 8th lord) in the 7th in the Sun's sign: no stress by his Leo rule; partner is assertive and the marriage stays in place.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius. Contrast case: Mercury (7th and 10th lord) in own sign in the 7th: strong partnerships, spouse communicative.

ambiguity: 'Shaadi par baitha' (sitting on marriage) is taken as the 7th house, an assumption from the classical topic and not a number he said. 'Talaak' is stated as outcome, not as probability. The stray token 'nat' after it may be a caption slip for 'nasht' (destroyed) and is not read as content.
classical_check: Silent on divorce from Mercury in Cancer; the 7th is the classical marriage house.

hindi: बच्चे स्थान पर बैठा है एक बच्चे को मार देगा
says: If Mercury in Cancer sits in the children's house, he says it will kill one child. This is a death-type claim recorded only as his statement, not something to apply.
cells_derived_method: House is the 5th (children) and sign fixed as Cancer; the claim is about harm to progeny, tested against the 5th house plus Cancer only, and the same Mercury in Leo would by his rule be fine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces. Mercury (4th and 7th lord) in the 5th in Cancer: by his rule trouble around children; as a measurable item this means progeny difficulty/delay, not a death forecast.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries. Contrast case: Mercury (3rd and 6th lord) in the 5th in Leo, the 'papa's house': by his rule no damage to children.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius. Contrast case: Mercury (5th and 8th lord) in own sign in the 5th: supports children and learning.

ambiguity: 'Bachche sthaan' is taken as the 5th house, an assumption from classical topics. 'Maar dega' (will kill) is his wording; whether it means loss, miscarriage or only trouble is not clear.
classical_check: Silent. The 5th is the progeny house classically, but no text gives this exact result.

hindi: नपुंसक ही कर देगा कोई भरोसा नहीं
says: Alternatively the same Mercury in the children's house may make the native impotent or infertile; he says there is no certainty which one happens. This is a medical-type claim recorded as his statement, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Same cell as the child-harm claim (5th, Cancer); the 'no guarantee' means he treats the two outcomes as alternatives for the same placement, and the severity would depend on aspects and Mercury's strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces. Mercury (4th and 7th lord) in the 5th in Cancer: fertility and potency-related delay is the readable theme.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn. Mercury (6th and 9th lord) in the 7th in Cancer: potency would link to the marriage house here rather than the progeny house.

ambiguity: 'Napunsak' could mean impotent or sterile; he does not say which. The first part of the sentence is cut off from the previous clause.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury is a neuter planet (napunsaka graha) classically, so Mercury-based potency problems have a classical hook; the specific rule is his.

hindi: स्त्री नपुंसक होता है य एक पुरुष नपुंसक स्त्री नपुंसक य नपुंसकता ले आता है शरीर के अंदर
says: He says this Mercury problem applies to both men and women: it brings 'napunsakta' (loss of potency or fertility) into the body. Medical-type claim, recorded as his statement only.
cells_derived_method: Applies to both sexes; the house of Mercury in Cancer points to which area of the body or life is touched, with the lagna house showing the body itself.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer. Mercury in the lagna in Cancer: body-level weakness or low vitality is the theme.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo. Mercury (2nd and 11th lord) in the 12th in Cancer: bed-pleasure and loss houses; reduced vitality shows as withdrawal rather than visible weakness.

ambiguity: 'Napunsakta' is used loosely; it can be physical or functional. He gives no test.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury and Saturn are the neuter planets (napunsaka) in BPHS; the claim that Mercury in Cancer causes it is his.

hindi: नपुंसकता मतलब कार्य क्या मतलब कार्य के स्थान पर बैठ गया तो कार्य नपुंसक कर देगा काम बढ़ता ही नहीं उठेगा ही नहीं
says: He widens 'impotence' to work: if this Mercury sits in the work house, the career turns 'impotent' and does not grow or rise at all.
cells_derived_method: House is the 10th (karma/work) and sign fixed as Cancer; career stagnation is the outcome. The stagnation reading is reversed in own or friendly signs, so Gemini or Leo on the 10th would be good by his own earlier rules.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra. Mercury (9th and 12th lord) in the 10th in Cancer: work does not scale; foreign or advisory work might exist but stays small.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. Contrast case: Mercury (lagna and 10th lord) in own sign in the 10th: work grows; trade and writing flourish.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio. Contrast case: Mercury (8th and 11th lord) in the Sun's sign in the 10th: comfortable by his Leo rule; career tied to authority and father.

ambiguity: 'Karya ke sthaan' is taken as the 10th house, assumed from the topic. 'Napunsak' here is a metaphor for non-growth, not the body.
classical_check: Silent on this result. The 10th is the classical house of work; Mercury in Cancer for the 10th is not singled out in BPHS.

hindi: तो बुद्ध के लिए क्या करो इसके पापा को काम करके दो वाणी के साथ क्या ठीक होगा
says: Remedy for a bad Mercury: do something for Mercury's 'father', the Sun (the caption is garbled about the exact act), and speech is what will be fixed with it.
ambiguity: 'Kaam karke do' is unclear: it could be 'do service/work for the father' or 'offer a salutation'. 'Vaani ke saath' (with speech) points to speech being the thing repaired, but the sentence is partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text names the Sun as a remedy for Mercury; BPHS gives Mercury's own remedies. Sun is Mercury's friend, so strengthening it is not out of line.

hindi: सूर्य क्या है हमारी आत्मा है हमारा जीवन का सब चरमोत्कर्ष
says: The Sun is our soul and the peak of everything in life; he states Sun as the atma karaka and the source of life's highest attainment.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is atma karaka and the king of planets in BPHS.

hindi: पिता की कृपा पिता कौन है परमपिता उसकी कृपा
says: The grace of the father is really the grace of the Supreme Father (Paramapita); he identifies the Sun with the father whose blessing matters.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk boundary (it continues 'if you have fire inside you'), so the full conditional is not clear.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Sun is pitri karaka (father) classically; equating it with the Supreme Father is his devotional framing.

hindi: यदि आपके अंदर अग्नि है वायु का जो स्थान होता है वह हमारा सूरज कहां से निकलता है ईस्ट से
says: He says that the grace works if there is fire inside you, and that the place of the air element (which he links to where the Sun rises) is the East.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled: 'agni' (inner fire) and 'vayu ka sthaan' may be two separate points, or the air-place may be a Vastu zone he names later. Reading chosen: the East is the Sun's rising place and also his air-zone.
classical_check: Differs: classical Vastu puts the air element in the north-west; the East belongs to the Sun/Indra. His air-in-East statement is not classical.

hindi: ईस्ट में आपने देखा होगा यदि वास्तु याद है तो हरे रंग होता है हरा रंग किसका है बुध का
says: In Vastu the East zone is linked to the colour green, and green belongs to Mercury; so East colour and Mercury connect.
ambiguity: He says 'if you remember Vastu', so this is a recall of an earlier session; the East-green link is only partly stated.
classical_check: Partly agrees: green is Mercury's colour and Mercury lords the North in classical direction lordship; East is the Sun's. The East-green link is his Vastu mapping.

hindi: बुध हरे रंग का होता है सारी वेजिटेशन सारी प्लांटेशन बुध है हरे रंग का है यह हरा रंग सारा इसके पास है
says: Mercury is the green planet: all vegetation, plantation and greenery belong to Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees: green and plants are standard Mercury significations.

hindi: और ई फ एक एरिया होता है हमारे घर के अंदर जहां सूर्य का स्थान है वो सूर्य के स्थान में जबरदस्त कम्युनिकेशन होती है
says: Inside the house there is a zone that is the Sun's place (the East side), and that zone has very strong communication energy; he links Sun's Vastu area with communication.
ambiguity: 'Ee fa ek area' is garbled; 'East ka ek area' is the likely reading. Which wall or room is meant is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: Vastu texts give the East to the Sun, but the 'communication' tag is his.

hindi: यानी वहां सेही सूरज निकला वहीं है मीठी मठी हवा कितनी सुगंधित हवा लगती है सुबह-सुबह की जब सूरज अंकल आते हैं
says: He gives the picture of dawn: the Sun rises from that zone and the air is sweet and fragrant when 'Uncle Sun' arrives; used to show the East as gentle and communicative.
ambiguity: Descriptive sentence; no rule is stated, only a mood.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फिर वो सूरज आग का गोला बन जाता है मंगल मंगल तो नहीं बनता रहता सूर्य लेकिन आग का गोला बन जाता है दोपहर में तो हवा गर्म हो जाती है
says: By midday the Sun turns into a ball of fire and the air gets hot; he notes it stays the Sun, not Mars, yet shows fiery nature, so the Sun can behave like Mars at noon.
ambiguity: The 'not Mars' remark is unclear: he may mean the Sun does not become Mars but takes on a fire character.
classical_check: Silent. Sun and Mars are both fire/heat planets classically.

hindi: सूरज गया हवा ठंडी हो गई हवा वैसे ही है जैसा सूरज चाहता है
says: When the Sun sets the air cools; the air always behaves as the Sun wants, so he makes the Sun the controller of air, which he ties to Mercury's field.
ambiguity: He does not name Mercury in this sentence; the air link to Mercury is inferred from context.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो बिटिया वैसा ही बिहेव करेगी पापा के लेकिन रहेगी पापा की नजर में
says: So Mercury, treated as the Sun's daughter, will behave as the father (Sun) wishes while staying under his eye: a bad Mercury is steered by strengthening the Sun.
ambiguity: 'Bitiya' (daughter) is a metaphor for Mercury; he earlier called Leo the 'papa's house'.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury is the son of Moon, not the Sun's daughter. Sun-Mercury are close in the sky (Mercury never strays far), which is the astronomical basis of the metaphor.

hindi: इसलिए सूर्य को ठीक करना बहुत जरूरी है
says: Therefore fixing the Sun is very necessary; the first remedy for Mercury problems is to strengthen the Sun.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for a weak Mercury are Mercury-based; Sun-first is his method.

hindi: यानी परमपिता को जानो आत्मा को जानो साक्षी भाव रख आपकी वाणी आपको पता हो आप क्या बोल रहे हैं सब ठीक रहेगा
says: Behavioural remedy: know the Supreme Father and the self, keep a witness attitude, and stay aware of what you are saying; then everything stays fine.
classical_check: Silent: spiritual self-awareness advice rather than a classical rule.

hindi: बुद्ध ही वैश्य है सारे बनिए
says: Mercury is the Vaishya (trader/merchant) planet; the business community is Mercury's people.
classical_check: Mixed: Mercury as trade and commerce karaka is classical, but the varna (caste) assignment of Mercury differs between texts (some list it as Shudra rather than Vaishya).

hindi: इसीलिए सब बनियों को एगजैक्टली ये कृपा है कि तुम्हारे पर बुध रहेगा
says: That is why the trading community has exactly this grace: Mercury stays upon them.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break; 'baniye' is used as the trading class, not a claim about every individual.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुद्ध इज कागज नोट उनको नोटों की कृपा है
says: Mercury is paper and currency notes; so those under Mercury's grace get the grace of notes (money in paper form).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury as accounts, paper, documents and trade is classical; notes as a specific form is his reading.

hindi: भाई क्या करना है उन्होंने बुध हरा रंग इस डायरेक्शन कम्युनिटी बनानी है एक ग्रुप बना के रखो
says: Remedy for Mercury: use green and the relevant direction, and build a community, keeping a group around you.
ambiguity: 'Is direction' is unclear: the caption does not say which direction. He just linked East/green earlier, but the classical Mercury direction is North.
classical_check: Partly agrees: green is Mercury's colour; North is its classical direction. 'Community' as a remedy is his.

hindi: जब भी आपके कुछ ग्रुप होंगे पांच सात लोग है जिनका ग्रुप है फैमिली लेवल पे है आपका बुद्ध एक्टिवेट हो जाएगा और बहुत स्ट्रांग रहेगा
says: Whenever you belong to a group of five to seven people, even at family level, your Mercury is activated and stays very strong.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम अकेले थ अकेले पड़े रहते हैं तो भैया या तो बृहस्पति हो जिसको फॉलो करते हो सारे तो तो बात समझ आई अदर वाइज ग्रुप करो
says: If you live alone and isolated, it works only if you are a Jupiter-type figure whom everyone follows; otherwise form a group. A loner needs followers (Jupiter) or a circle (Mercury).
ambiguity: The first half of the sentence is garbled ('hum akele th'); the contrast Jupiter-followed leader versus Mercury-style group is the clear part.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अपने खाने से पहले दूसरे का खाना खिलाओ अपने पानी पीने से पहले दूसरे को पूछो भाई साहब और क्या खाएंगे क्या लेंगे
says: Remedy for Mercury: feed others before you eat and ask others if they want water or more food before you drink or take your share.
classical_check: Silent: hospitality as a planetary remedy is his method.

hindi: दीदी आप बहन जी आप ध्यान रखें आप केयर करेंगे
says: Address the women in the group respectfully ('Didi', 'Behen ji') and care for them; the caring attitude is part of the same Mercury remedy.
ambiguity: The sentence is a spoken example; who 'you' refers to (host or guest) is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा नहीं होगा कि आपके पास 10 लोग हैं दवा आप कहते हैं ये तो बेकार है उसको भी कुर्सी देंगे बैठने को
says: Do not write anyone off: even if among ten people you think one is useless, still give that person a chair to sit on.
ambiguity: 'Dava' is likely a caption error for 'wahan' or similar and is ignored; the point about giving a seat is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका बुद्ध जबरदस्त तरीके से फ्लश करेगा आपके हृदय में प्रेम है आपको कोई लेनदेन नहीं
says: Your Mercury will flourish greatly if the heart holds love and there is no transactional motive behind your giving.
ambiguity: 'Flush' could mean 'flourish' or 'flush out'; flourish fits the context.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप किसी को नाजायज कर दे रहे हो आप अपना ग्रह ठीक कर रहे हो आपका ग्रह ठीक हो रहा मजे करा देगा मेहनत
says: When you give to someone without any claim or return expected, you are repairing your own planet; once repaired the planet will make you enjoy life.
ambiguity: 'Naajayaz kar de rahe ho' is garbled; he likely means giving even to someone who has no right to it. The sentence is cut at the chunk end.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: करने की किसे पड़ी है नहीं करना आता तो मेहनत करो फिर फिर मेहनत कर कर के डंडे खाके होगा नहीं
says: Without fixing the planet, people prefer not to work; if you only know labour, then labour, but after toiling and taking knocks it still may not work. Hard work alone, without planetary repair, is unreliable.
ambiguity: Partly garbled and read from the tail of the previous chunk ('...mehnat'); the thread is that labour without remedy brings blows.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Imagined objection from the audience: 'how can I say it to my brother or uncle?'

hindi: बोल दो सूर्य की शक्ति मिलती है बुद्ध को बोल दो
says: Say it out: Mercury (speech) receives the Sun's strength, so a person who speaks up gets the Sun's authority behind the words.
classical_check: Silent. Sun-Mercury conjunction (Budha-Aditya yoga) is the classical link between the two.

gist: Imagined objection: 'we do not speak, who will speak, then there will be a fight.'

hindi: तो तुम्हे बोलना नहीं आता फिर बोलना सीखो किसी गुरु की कृपा लो उससे सीखो बोलना कैसे
says: If you do not know how to speak, learn it: take a guru's grace and learn how to speak; the remedy for weak Mercury speech is a teacher.
classical_check: Silent. Guru here ties to Jupiter as teacher.

hindi: भाई को बहन को पति को पिता को बोलते लड़ाई हम झल्ला के बोलते हैं क्लेश में बोलते हैं तूने मेरे पैसे नहीं दिए
says: In quarrels with brother, sister, husband or father we speak in irritation, as in 'you did not give my money'; this is poor Mercury speech that causes family fights.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नहीं बुद्ध को तो सूर्य की शक्ति चाहिए आपके आगे जबान नहीं खोल पाएगा कोई
says: No: Mercury needs the Sun's power; when it has it nobody can open their mouth in front of you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य कौन है तीसरा नेत्र
says: The Sun is the third eye; he defines the Sun as the third eye (seat of authority and inner sight).
classical_check: Differs: classically the Sun is the right eye, and the third eye (ajna) is not assigned to it in BPHS.

hindi: जब यहां से शिव ने तीसरा नेत्र खोल दिया बड़े बड़ों के तांडव समाप्त हो गए आपके आगे बोल नहीं सकता
says: Using the story of Shiva opening his third eye, he says even the mightiest stopped their dance; likewise a person with strong Sun cannot be argued with.
ambiguity: A mythological illustration, not a rule; the 'you' is the person whose Sun is strong.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन आप बोलते कैसे हो आपके बुद्ध के वक्री हो जाने से यह दोष चलता है
says: If your speech goes wrong, the cause is Mercury being retrograde; the speech flaw continues because of the retrograde Mercury.
ambiguity: Any sign and any house is meant; he does not restrict it.
classical_check: Differs: retrograde planets gain cheshta bala (motional strength) classically; BPHS links speech defects to an afflicted Mercury, not to retrogression as such.

hindi: हर हालत में पन्ना पहनो
says: In every case (retrograde Mercury) wear an emerald, whatever the situation.
ambiguity: 'Har haalat mein' (in every state) could also mean regardless of finances, not only regardless of chart.
classical_check: Agrees: emerald (panna) is the classical gem for Mercury; the 'always for retrograde' rule is his.

gist: Mock complaint from the audience about the cost of emerald and the 'stone mess' that he (Brajesh Gautam) added; played for laughs.

hindi: पैसे इकट्ठा करते हो ना बेटी की शादी के लिए बच्चे के स्कूल फीस के लिए मकान बनाएंगे स्टोन के लिए पैसे इकट्ठे करो यार
says: You save money for a daughter's wedding, school fees and building a house, so save money for the gemstone as well. Recorded as his advice on spending, not as financial advice.
ambiguity: The sentence is split by the chunk break; the second half is the same advice stated again.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्टोन प इतना महत्व क्यों है 100 साल चलेगा आई दो साल चार साल चलता है फिर वो आईफो वाले खराब कर देते हैं उसे
says: Why this importance on stones? A stone lasts about a hundred years, while a phone lasts two to four years and then the company spoils it; he argues the stone is the better spend.
ambiguity: 'I' and 'aifo' are a phone brand garbled; the comparison with a phone is clear.
classical_check: Silent: lifespan of a gem is his argument, not classical.

gist: Garbled caption ('absent time ... cataract ... operation will be done'); only a medical analogy can be guessed, no astrology can be extracted.

hindi: पहले लोगों के पास चश्मा नहीं था अंधे होकर मर जाते थे क्यों आंखें एक मसल है कमजोर हो गई उम्र के साथ हड्डियां भी कमजोर होती है
says: Before spectacles existed people went blind; eyes are muscles that weaken with age, bones also weaken, so weakness with age needs an aid; he uses this to justify wearing a stone for a weak planet.
ambiguity: An analogy; medical remarks are not astrological claims.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह आयु है यह जीवन है सूर्य भी कमजोर पड़ता है शाम होते होते अता अस्त हो जाता है
says: This is the course of age and life: even the Sun weakens toward evening and sets; planets also weaken in their cycle.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अल्टीमेट बात क्या आती है बढ़िया स्टोन पहनो पैसे इकट्ठे करो
says: Final point: wear a good-quality stone and collect money for it; the ultimate remedy is the gemstone.
classical_check: Agrees: gem therapy (ratna) is a classical remedy.

hindi: पैसे नहीं है वो कभी नहीं होंगे क्योंकि ग्रह कभी खुद को ठीक होने नहीं देगा
says: If you say you have no money for the stone, you will never have it, because the afflicted planet never lets itself be repaired; the planet blocks the means of its own remedy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब घर आपसे नाराज होता है वास्तु अनुसार तो आपको छोड़ने नहीं देता उससे प्रार्थना करनी पड़ती है हमें जाने दे अदर वाइज होता नहीं है छोड़ता नहीं है
says: Vastu link: when the house is displeased with you it will not let you leave (sell or move), and you must pray to it to let you go, or it does not release you.
classical_check: Silent: classical Vastu has no 'angry house' doctrine; this is his personification.

gist: Analogy: a virus or Covid does not want to leave on its own; you must push it out or take a strong diet.
Illustration: nobody lets go willingly; people complain the husband or wife will not grant a divorce.

hindi: तो कॉस्मस को बोलो वो दिलवाए अगर इसी ने देना होता दे ही देता
says: Remedy: tell the Cosmos to arrange the release, since if the person would have given it, they would have given it by now.
ambiguity: Whether the release is a divorce, a job exit or any other let-go is left open by the previous illustration.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो परमात्मा कौन है हम कहते हैं हमेशा कॉस्मस को बोलो कॉस्मस कौन है सूर्य देवता हमारा कॉस्मस सोलर सिस्टम कौन है सूर्य उसकी कृपा लो
says: He defines the Cosmos for us as the solar system and its centre, the Sun god; always speak to the Cosmos, so the Sun's grace is what you seek.
classical_check: Silent: equating Paramatma with the Sun is his devotional framing.

hindi: आपकी वाणी के द्वारा आप जो भी कम्युनिकेशन कर रहे हो सारी बुद्ध है उसी से कागज है
says: All the communication you do through your speech is Mercury, and from it comes paper (documents and money).
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury governs speech, communication and documents.

hindi: मीठी मीठी बातें करो लंबी लंबी छोड़ो बढ़िया कितना प्यार से नोट कमाता है आदमी
says: Speak sweetly and even talk big; see how lovingly a person earns money through nice speech. Sweet speech is the Mercury way to income.
ambiguity: 'Lambi lambi chhodo' is slang for boasting; he may mean generous talk instead.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और अगर आपका बुध वक्री है उसका पन्ना पहनना पड़ेगा
says: If your Mercury is retrograde, you will have to wear an emerald.
classical_check: Agrees that emerald is Mercury's gem; the retrograde-specific compulsion is his.

hindi: कितना अच्छा पहनना कैसे पहनना है यह आपके ऊपर है जो स्टोन पहनो साफ सुथरा पहनो
says: How good a stone to buy and how to wear it is up to you, but whatever stone you wear must be clean and clear.
classical_check: Agrees: classical gem texts require a flawless stone (no cracks, spots or cloudiness).

hindi: गोगल आपके सूर्य को रोक देता है यानी कि अगर आपने ऐसा स्टोन पहना जो साफ सुथरा नहीं है तो किरणें रोक देगा
says: A cloudy 'goggle-like' stone blocks your Sun; a stone that is not clean will stop the rays, so it will not pass planetary light to the wearer.
ambiguity: 'Goggle' is read as dark glasses; the mechanism is a stone acting as a lens for planetary rays.
classical_check: Silent: the lens mechanism is his model; classical texts only say flawed gems give harm.

hindi: वक्री बुद्ध आपको नुकसान देगा ही देगा
says: A retrograde Mercury will certainly cause you harm, without fail.
classical_check: Differs: retrograde planets are strong in cheshta bala; harm is not assured by BPHS.

hindi: बुद्ध बालक है बुद्ध के दाढ़ी नहीं है
says: Mercury is a child and has no beard; he describes Mercury as youthful and beardless.
ambiguity: The sentence continues at the chunk break; the beardlessness sets up the Jupiter-beard remedy that follows.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is described as youthful (kumara) classically.

hindi: अगर आपका बृहस्पति वक्री है और आपने सफेद दाढ़ी रखी हुई है तो आपको पुखराज पहनने की जरूरत नहीं है
says: If your Jupiter is retrograde and you keep a white beard, you do not need to wear a yellow sapphire; the beard stands in for the stone.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text offers a beard as a replacement for gem therapy.

hindi: मोदी जी का चौथे घर के अंदर बृहस्पति वक्री है वो सफेद दाढ़ी से रहते हैं
says: His example: Modi ji's Jupiter is retrograde in the 4th house and he keeps a white beard. A claim about a public figure's chart, not checked here.
cells_derived_method: House fixed as the 4th with any sign; Jupiter's dignity changes with the sign on the 4th, so the same retrograde Jupiter reads differently in exaltation, own sign or debilitation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries. Jupiter exalted in the 4th; retrograde exalted Jupiter gives home and comfort strength but an inward, indirect style.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. Jupiter in own sign in the 4th (lord of 4th and 7th); retrograde own-sign Jupiter is strong but second-guessing.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra. Jupiter debilitated in the 4th (lord of 3rd and 6th); retrograde here is the case where the beard remedy would matter most.

ambiguity: Which sign the 4th house is for Modi ji is not stated; the chart data is not verified in this note.
classical_check: Silent: no classical comment; the chart detail cannot be checked from the caption.

hindi: एंड टिंच बात करेंगे यह हटे बृहस्पति डबल माइंडेड कर देगा
says: Retrograde Jupiter makes a person double-minded; the beard fixes that. The first half ('and tinch we will talk') is garbled.
ambiguity: 'Hate' (turned away) is read as retrograde. The words 'and tinch' are unreadable and are ignored.
classical_check: Silent: indecision from retrograde Jupiter is his reading.

hindi: बड़ा गजब का काम है इतने से ही काम हो जाता है
says: This is a wonderful trick: just this one small act does the whole job; he claims the cheap beard remedy is enough on its own.
ambiguity: 'Itne se hi' (just this much) refers to the beard remedy, inferred from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका बुध चिकना है बिल्कुल लड़की है ना स्त्री तत्व मानते हैं
says: Your Mercury is smooth and clean-faced, just like a girl; we treat Mercury as carrying the feminine element.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury is neuter (napunsaka), not feminine; he makes it feminine-leaning.

hindi: पुरुष भी है ऐसा नहीं है कि वह स्त्री है उसकी फेमिनिटी ज्यादा है मेस्कल निटी कम है
says: Mercury is also male; it is not that it is female, but its femininity is higher and masculinity lower.
classical_check: Partly agrees: BPHS gives Mercury as neuter; his 'more feminine than masculine' is a refinement.

hindi: मुझ में भी स्त्री तत्व है एक स्त्री में भी पुरुष तत्व है
says: Every man has a feminine element in him and every woman has a masculine element, so the Mercury principle applies to both sexes.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो बुद्ध जो है बेसिकली स्त्री तत्व के अनुसार चलता है मीठी बोली बोलो कर्कश बोलोगे तो बुद्ध कहां रह गया वो तो राक्षस बन गया
says: Mercury basically runs on the feminine principle, so speak sweetly; with harsh speech Mercury is gone and the person becomes a demon (rakshasa).
classical_check: Silent: sweet speech as a Mercury remedy is his; classical Mercury remedies are different.

hindi: तो आपका वो स्त्री तत्व ऑन रहता है तो चिकना है वो अगर आप साफ सुथरे रहते हैं क्लीन रहते हैं
says: Your feminine element stays 'on' and Mercury stays smooth only if you remain neat and clean; cleanliness keeps Mercury healthy.
ambiguity: The sentence ends at the chunk end, so a continuation may follow in the next batch.
classical_check: Silent: cleanliness is a classical Mercury theme (hygiene, neatness) but not stated as a remedy.

hindi: आपका बुद्ध एक्टिवेटेड रहता है सुधरा रहता है बहुत बढ़िया से
says: Result of the neatness and cleanliness habit he just described: your Mercury stays activated and keeps improving very well.
ambiguity: The sentence is the tail of the previous batch's cleanliness remedy, so 'it' is inferred from the earlier context.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुद्ध क्या है बुद्धिजीवी
says: Mercury is the intellectual, the one who lives by the mind (buddhijivi); the planet stands for people who earn and live through intellect.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of intellect, learning and reasoning.

hindi: बड़ी प्यारी बात मीठी बात सम्मान देना यह करते रहोगे आपका बुद्ध ठीक ठाक रहेगा
says: Keep speaking lovingly and sweetly and keep giving respect to people; if you carry on with these, Mercury stays in decent order.
classical_check: Silent: speech-and-manners remedies are his, not classical.

hindi: बुद्ध बहन है बुआ है बेटी है
says: Mercury stands for the sister, the father's sister (bua) and the daughter; he lists these young female relatives as Mercury's people.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS names the maternal uncle for Mercury; sister, bua and daughter come from popular North-Indian and Lal Kitab style lists.

hindi: बकरी है जानवरों में
says: Among animals, Mercury is the goat.
ambiguity: Caption reads 'bakri hai janwaron mein'; the goat link is clear, he does not name other animals here.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; goat is a folk or Lal Kitab style Mercury animal.

hindi: आप इनकी सेवा करेंगे ध्यान देंगे बहुत बढ़िया
says: Remedy: serve and pay attention to these Mercury people (sister, bua, daughter, goats) and your Mercury improves very well.
ambiguity: 'Inki' (these) points back to the sister, bua, daughter and goat list.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for Mercury are mantra, gem and charity; serving relatives is his.

hindi: बकरी कोई भी बकरी यानी बकरी की तरह व्यवहार करने वाला जो बेचारा बिल्कुल मिमिया हुआ है
says: 'Goat' means any goat or any person who behaves like a goat: the poor, meek, bleating type who has no strength of his own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी कि जिस व्यक्ति नीडी व्यक्ति के साथ आप प्रेम से जुड़े और उसका ध्यान रखा सेवा नहीं उसका ध्यान रखा
says: So the goat remedy means connecting lovingly with a needy, meek person and looking after them; he says he does not mean formal service but caring attention.
ambiguity: He distinguishes 'seva' (service) from 'dhyan rakhna' (taking care), but does not say how the two differ in practice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपका बच्चा बकरी की तरह चरता रहता है तो बुद्ध स्वभाव का है कहते ना सारा दिन चरता रहता है
says: A child who grazes and eats all day like a goat has a Mercury temperament; parents complain 'he keeps grazing all day'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मत कोसो आपका बुद्ध खराब हो रहा है
says: Do not curse or scold the child for it; each curse spoils your own Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सारा दिन बोलता रहता है मत कोसो उसका तो बुद्ध ऑन है और ऑन ही रहने दो वो पट्ठा जबान से कमा लेगा
says: A child who talks all day has his Mercury switched on; do not curse him, let it stay on, because that lad will earn through his tongue.
ambiguity: 'Jabaan se kama lega' is a general forecast about livelihood from speech, not a measured outcome.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a strong Mercury gives speech-based livelihood (trade, teaching, media).

hindi: कुछ लोग शरीर से कमा रहे हैं कुछ लोग जबान से कमा रहे हैं कुछ लोग इससे कमा रहे हैं यह टॉप है

ambiguity: 'Isse' (with this) points to a body part, probably the head or higher centre; the caption does not say which.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आपके ऊपर है आप किस चक्र पर पहुंचे हुए हो आप उसी हिसाब से कमाइयां कर रहे हो
says: So it depends on you which chakra you have reached, and your earnings match that level.
classical_check: Silent: linking income to chakra level is his own scheme.

hindi: क्याक कमा रहे हो पैसा तो सबको समझ आता है प्रेम कमा रहे हो शांति कमा रहे हो
says: Ask what you are really earning: everyone understands money, but are you earning love and peace?
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप यहां से कुछ बोलते नहीं मुह से कुछ यहां से क्षमा कर देते हो आपको प्रेम सब करेंगे कैसे नहीं करेंगे

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप डांट रहे हो फिर भी यहां से मौन है आपको वो प्रेम ही करेगा व्यक्ति डांट खाके भी उसे करना पड़ेगा उसकी चलेगी नहीं क्योंकि ऊपर की फ्लोर वाले से कौन लड़ेगा
