ambiguity: The 'rakshasa' grouping may refer to the outer or non-classical planets as a class; he does not say who else is in it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu as the rakshasa-type planet and Mercury's nature as flexible are classical; Neptune's friendships are his own addition.

hindi: मंगल जब अग्नि यहां आती है तो अग्नि इसको शुद्ध करके चली जाती बिगाड़ कुछ नहीं पाती
says: When Mars, the fire planet, comes to Varuna's place, fire only purifies it and moves on; it cannot harm Neptune.
ambiguity: 'यहां आती है' may mean Mars entering Varuna's sign, a conjunction or a transit; he does not say.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune has no classical Mars relation.

hindi: इंद्र जब यहां आता है इसको शुद्ध करके चला जाता है बिगाड़ कुछ नहीं कर पाता
says: Likewise when Indra (Uranus) comes to Varuna's place it cleanses Neptune and leaves without doing any damage.
ambiguity: Same unspecified 'comes here' as the Mars line; the sentence runs into the next slice ('जाता है बिगाड़ कुछ नहीं कर पाता').
classical_check: Silent: Uranus and Neptune are not classical grahas.

hindi: वरुण देवता जब यहां आते हैं समुद्र य आ ग यह इंद्र है जब समुद्र मान लो यहां आ गया उफान मारता हुआ आग के ऊपर क्या हल होगा नष्ट तबा
says: The reverse case: when Varuna arrives in the place of the fire planets (Indra or Mars), the surging sea over fire leaves the fire destroyed. So Neptune visiting Mars or Uranus ruins them, while they visiting Neptune only purify it.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is unspecified, and 'यह इंद्र है' suggests he points to Indra's place; the caption is garbled in the middle ('समुद्र य आ ग').
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no Neptune; water quenching fire is the usual elemental image only.

hindi: पेट विशाल नहीं बनाना अगर आपका पेट बहुत बड़ा हो गया है और आपकी दाढ़ी सफेद है तो आप यह मान के चले आपने बृहस्पति को सेट कर लिया है अन्यथा वरुण आपको खा जाएगा
says: He cautions against growing a vast belly like Varuna's. If the belly is big but the beard is white, take it that Jupiter (the wise, white-bearded elder) is set right; otherwise Varuna will swallow you. Flagged: body-shape talk, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'वरुण आपको खा जाएगा' is figurative; the white beard as proof of Jupiter being set is his own image.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter as karaka of fat, abdomen and elders is classical; the Varuna belly link is his own.

hindi: वरुण आपके शरीर का वाटर कंटेंट बढ़ा देगा और आपको जितने भी पानी से संबंधित सबसे पहले तो किडनी उसका पंगे डालना शुरू कर देगा
says: A harmful Varuna raises the water content of the body and brings water-related troubles, kidneys first. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement and not as a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The sentence does not say what makes Varuna harmful, whether affliction or a certain sign or house.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classically kidneys belong to Venus and Libra and the water element to the Moon; Neptune is his addition.

hindi: आपके घर के अंदर नॉर्थ से नॉर्थ ईस्ट नॉर्थ ईस्ट की नॉर्थ ईस्ट का एरिया ही खराब कर देगा किडनी गई फिर चाहे किडनी में स्टोन होता फिरे चाहे कुछ और होता फिरे खराब 101 पर करेगा
says: Vastu link: an upset Varuna spoils the north and north-east area inside your house, and then the kidneys go wrong, stones or anything else, which he says it will spoil 101 percent. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'नॉर्थ से नॉर्थ ईस्ट' is repeated and garbled; read as the north to north-east sector of the home.
classical_check: Partly agrees: vastu gives the water element to the north and north-east (ishanya), but the Neptune and kidney links are his own.

gist: Caption reads roughly 'your sea ... should come'; the key word is garbled, so no claim is recorded.

hindi: वरुण वरुण की राशि केतु के अंदर बहुत बढ़िया है यहां इसमें बहुत बढ़िया है यहां बहुत बढ़िया है
says: Varuna and Ketu do very well together: he says Varuna's sign inside Ketu is very good, and repeats 'very good here' while pointing at different spots.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether Ketu sitting in Varuna's sign, Varuna sitting in Ketu's sign, or one shared sign is meant; he names no sign.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune has no classical relation to Ketu.

gist: Promises a friend-and-enemy chart for next week, only to be photographed for memory, showing which planets are enemies and friends in different signs; the sentence breaks off.

hindi: मित्र है इनके तो वरुण आपकी कुंडली में कहां बैठा उस हिसाब से आपका जीवन में शादी अच्छी बच्चा अच्छा प्यार अच्छा यह सब बैठेगा
says: Having just named Varuna's friends, he says the place where Varuna sits in your chart decides how good your marriage, your children and your love turn out; all three follow that one placement.
cells_derived_method: The house of Varuna picks which topic it colours (5th for love and children, 7th for marriage) and the sign tells whether the surroundings are friendly (Moon's or Mercury's signs) or hostile (fire signs, by his later lines).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Neptune in Libra in the 7th: a large-hearted, trusting spouse, marriage run on feeling.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Neptune in the Moon's sign in the 5th (the Moon is Varuna's friend): love and bond with children are warm and deep.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Neptune in Mars's sign in the 5th: by his rule that Varuna entering fire ruins it, love and children matters turn stormy.

ambiguity: 'इनके' refers to the friends he named a moment earlier (Moon, Mercury, Rahu); he does not tie each result to a specific house, so the house choices above are only how the idea would be applied.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not part of classical Jyotish.

gist: Says nobody discusses these outer planets (Varuna and the like) in ordinary astrology talk.

hindi: मंगल ग्रह हनुमान जी है
says: He identifies the planet Mars with the deity Hanuman, so Mars is approached through Hanuman worship.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give Mars the deity Kartikeya (Skanda) and Narasimha as its avatar; Hanuman as the Mars deity is a popular remedy tradition.

hindi: मंगल नाभी पर बैठा हुआ है
says: Mars is seated at the navel of the body, so the navel is the Mars seat.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: yoga places the fire element at the navel (manipura), matching Mars as fire; classical Jyotish gives Mars blood, marrow and muscle, not the navel specifically.

hindi: मंगल अग्नि है आग का गोला है मानते हैं लेकिन है ये खुश
says: He repeats that Mars is fire, a ball of flame, as everybody accepts; the closing words 'लेकिन है ये खुश' are garbled, so the 'but' that qualifies this is lost.
ambiguity: 'है ये खुश' may be 'है ये कुछ और' (it is something else) or a different word; the qualifier cannot be recovered.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the hot, fiery planet (agni tattva) in classical texts.

hindi: मंगल ग्रह ऐसा ग्रह है जिसमें आयरन रिच है यह साइंटिफिकली प्रूवन है कि मंगल पर लोहे की कसब रिचस है सोइल के अंदर मिट्टी में
says: He says Mars is an iron-rich planet and calls it scientifically proven that the soil of the planet Mars is rich in iron, using that to tie the planet to iron.
ambiguity: 'कसब रिचस' is garbled and read as 'quite rich'.
classical_check: Differs: classical metal lists give iron to Saturn and copper or brass to Mars; his iron-rich Mars is a science-sounding argument.

hindi: और लोहा क्या है चुंबक चुंबक क्या है आपका सारा का सारा शनि महाराज
says: Iron is a magnet, he says, and magnetism is entirely Saturn's, so the magnetic side of the Mars-iron link belongs to Saturn.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: iron is Saturn's metal classically; magnetism as Saturn is his own gloss.

hindi: यानी शनि की ऐसी की तैसी आपके हड्डियों की तकलीफ है आपको कोई और प्रॉब्लम है क्या दवाई देते हैं लोग आपको चालू शिलाजीत देते हैं
says: When Saturn is badly hit you get bone trouble, and the usual treatment people give is shilajit, which he places under Mars, so a Saturn complaint is handled with a Mars substance. Flagged: a medical claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'शनि की ऐसी की तैसी' is slang for Saturn being badly spoiled; it does not say how (placement, aspect or period).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn rules bones classically; shilajit is an Ayurvedic substance not named in Jyotish texts, and the Mars link is his own.

hindi: मंगल क्या है पत्थर लाल पत्थर लाल रंग का पत्थर है
says: Mars is a stone, specifically a red-coloured stone, which is why a red mineral substance like shilajit falls under Mars.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: red colour, stones and minerals (red coral, red earth) are classical Mars significations.

hindi: और शिलाजीत क्या करती है ब्लड सर्कुलेशन
says: Shilajit works on blood circulation, which is Mars's department, so he treats shilajit as a Mars remedy. Flagged: a medicinal claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as karaka of blood is classical; shilajit is Ayurvedic and is not named in Jyotish texts.

hindi: आपका शनि क्या कर रहा है हड्डियों में दर्दें दे रहा है नसें खराब कर रहा है
says: An afflicted Saturn gives pain in the bones and damages the nerves. Flagged: a medical claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: What makes Saturn afflicted is not stated here.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn rules bones, nerves and chronic pains in classical texts.

hindi: नसे सारी शनि के पास है सारा नर्वस सिस्टम शनि के पास है क्योंकि गुप्त है बॉडी के अंदर वो ये इलाका गुप्त रहता है
says: All the nerves and the whole nervous system belong to Saturn because they are hidden inside the body, and Saturn owns whatever is hidden.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the karaka of nerves and of hidden or secret matters.

gist: Repeats that Mars sits at the navel, leading into the next point about the navel.

hindi: नाभि ब्लड सप्लाई सारी सप्लाई खून की चीजों की 72000 नाड़ियों से यहां होती है
says: The navel is the hub of blood supply: all supply of blood and blood-related things runs from here through the 72,000 nadis, which is why Mars at the navel rules circulation.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 72,000 nadis and the navel as their hub are a yogic and Ayurvedic idea; Mars as karaka of blood is classical Jyotish.

hindi: नाभी पुष्ट रखो नाभी प क्या लगाओ यह नाभि है आपकी इस नाभि के ऊपर घी लगाओगे भड़का देगी आग
says: Keep the navel nourished, but ghee put on the navel will flare up the fire, since Mars is fire, so ghee is the wrong thing for that spot.
ambiguity: The next words repeat 'घी लगाओ' without a 'not', so it may really be 'do not apply ghee'; I read the ghee as the warning.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives navel-oil remedies for Mars.

hindi: घी लगाओ नारियल का तेल लगाओ
says: Instead of ghee, apply coconut oil on the navel as the recommended oil for strengthening the Mars seat.
ambiguity: 'घी लगाओ' just before 'नारियल का तेल लगाओ' may be a slip for 'घी मत लगाओ'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text prescribes coconut oil on the navel.

hindi: नारियल का तेल क्या है आपका राहु है नारियल
says: Coconut and coconut oil belong to Rahu, so the navel remedy is a Rahu substance used to support Mars.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: coconut is tied to Rahu in folk remedies (such as floating a coconut in running water) but is not in classical karaka lists.

hindi: यह तेल लगाओ हरे वाला तेल लगाओ बुध का है
says: A green-coloured oil is another option to apply, and it belongs to Mercury.
ambiguity: Which green oil he means is not said.
classical_check: Agrees on the colour: green is Mercury's colour in classical texts.

hindi: यह अलग-अलग ग्रहों के टाइम उपाय है इसके कि अगर आपको मंगल को पावर पकड़नी है
says: He frames the coconut and green oils as remedies drawn from different planets, all meant for the situation where you want Mars to gain strength.
ambiguity: 'टाइम' is probably 'type' (types of remedies from different planets) but could be read as planetary periods.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe borrowing other planets' substances to power up Mars.

hindi: मंगल क्या करेगा पूरी बॉडी में ब्लड सप्लाई बढ़िया ब्लड सप्लाई बढ़िया धके की बॉडी लाजवाब काम दिमाग सही चलेगा कोई ब्लॉकेज है सारी साफ
says: A strong Mars gives good blood supply through the whole body, an excellent body, a brain that works properly, and clears any blockage. Flagged: health claims, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: Mars is strong in its own signs Aries and Scorpio and exalted in Capricorn, and a house placement then decides which area of life gets the drive and stamina.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Mars (lagna lord) in the 10th: strong stamina and drive at work.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd (3rd and 10th lord): courage, effort and initiative are strong.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 6th (6th and 11th lord): wins over rivals and obstacles.

ambiguity: 'धके की बॉडी' is garbled, probably 'डटके की बॉडी' (a sturdy body).
classical_check: Partly agrees: strong Mars as vitality, blood and stamina is classical; blockages and brain function are his additions.

gist: Says shilajit is presented as a fraud everywhere in the market.

hindi: उसका कोई लेनदेन नहीं है बूढ़े बुजुर्ग छोटे बच्चे ले सकते हैं
says: He says shilajit has no 'give and take' (no harmful interaction or side-effect) and can be taken by old people and small children. Flagged: a medicinal-safety claim, recorded only as his statement and not as advice.
ambiguity: 'लेनदेन' (dealings) is read as side-effects or interactions.
classical_check: Silent: shilajit dosing is outside Jyotish.

hindi: आपके नजल जुकाम की प्रॉब्लम तो सारी की सारी उसी से होगी ठीक सबसे बड़ा तो शिलाजीत है
says: He claims all your cold and catarrh troubles will be cured by shilajit, calling it the biggest remedy for them. Flagged: a medical cure claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: a Mars substance as a cold cure is not a Jyotish idea; he explains the Moon side in the following lines.

gist: Garbled attempt to describe how tiny the dose should be ('मरासा मरासा मींस इतना मरासा'); the caption is unusable.

hindi: इतने से दूध के अंदर लो उसको शॉट बोलते हैं जैसे दारू का शॉर्ट बोलते हैं इतना सा लोग गर्म करो उ बालो रंग भुरा भुरा हो जाएगा दूध का भुरा भुरा रंग हो जाएगा दूध का उसको लो
says: Preparation: take a tiny, shot-glass-sized amount in milk, warm it and boil until the milk turns brown, and drink that. Flagged: a preparation instruction, recorded only as his statement and not as advice.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('उ बालो' probably 'उबालो', boil); the quantity is only 'a shot'.
classical_check: Silent: preparation of shilajit is outside Jyotish.

hindi: आपको नजले खांसी के अंदर भूरे भूरे रंग की चाय भूरे भूरे रंग की कॉफी क्यों मदद देती है क्योंकि चंद्रमा चेंज हो गया चंद्रमा है ना पानी की बहुत यात हो गई चंद्रमा डिस्टर्ब हो गया बॉडी के अंदर
says: In colds and cough, brown tea or coffee helps because the Moon has changed: the body holds too much water, which is the Moon, and the Moon is disturbed inside the body. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'पानी की बहुत यात हो गई' is garbled and read as 'too much water has accumulated'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon governs body fluids and kapha (colds) classically; the brown tea or coffee mechanism is his own.

hindi: उस समय में क्या करना है आपको पानी अवॉइड करना है कौन सा लेना है गर्म लेना है लेकिन उसमें भी तासीर बॉडी की कैसी है उसके हिसाब से डिसाइड होगा
says: While the Moon-water disturbance lasts, avoid water; if you must drink, take it warm, and even then the choice depends on the body's own temperament (taseer). Flagged: a do and don't, recorded as his tradition claim only.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: taseer is an Ayurvedic and Unani idea, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: इसके लिए आपको शिलाजीत लेनी है आपको एलोपैथिक मेडिसिन लेनी है आप होम्योपैथी से ठीक नहीं होंगे
says: For this complaint he says take shilajit and allopathic medicine, because homeopathy will not cure you. Flagged: medical advice, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'इसके लिए' points back to the cold case, but the next lines make the choice depend on which planet is strong in the chart, so this may be the Mars-strong, Moon-weak case.
classical_check: Silent: choosing a medical system by chart is not a classical Jyotish topic.

hindi: होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन के लिए आपको चंद्रमा है अगर चंद्रमा ठीक है कुंडली में होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन सूट करेगी
says: Homeopathic medicine suits you if the Moon is in good condition in your chart. Flagged: a medical-system claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: The Moon counts as good by dignity: exalted in Taurus, own sign Cancer; the house then tells where the benefit shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Moon exalted in Taurus in the 2nd (4th lord): the Moon counts as good, so by his rule homeopathy suits.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Moon in own sign Cancer in the 7th (7th lord): the Moon counts as good, so homeopathy suits.

ambiguity: 'ठीक' (good) is not defined; I take it as dignity or lack of affliction.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not match planets to systems of medicine.

hindi: आपका बुध ठीक है आयुर्वेदिक सूट करेगी
says: If Mercury is in good condition in the chart, Ayurvedic medicine will suit you. Flagged: a medical-system claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: Mercury counts as good by dignity: own in Gemini and Virgo, exalted in Virgo.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 6th (3rd and 6th lord): Mercury counts as good, so Ayurveda suits.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 5th (5th and 8th lord): Mercury counts as good, so Ayurveda suits.

ambiguity: 'ठीक' is not defined; read as dignity or no affliction.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not match planets to medical systems, though Mercury is linked with herbs and Ayurveda in later tradition.

hindi: आपका शुक्र ठीक है शुक्र ठीक है यूनानी मेडिसिन ठीक करेगी
says: If Venus is in good condition in the chart, Unani medicine will cure you. Flagged: a medical-system claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: Venus counts as good by dignity: own in Taurus and Libra, exalted in Pisces.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Venus in own sign Taurus in the 2nd (2nd and 7th lord): Venus counts as good, so Unani suits.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Venus exalted in Pisces in the 5th (7th and 12th lord): Venus counts as good, so Unani suits, though his earlier rule says exalted Venus ruins the house it sits in.

ambiguity: 'ठीक' is not defined; also his earlier claim that exalted Venus ruins matters conflicts with calling it 'good' here.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not match planets to medical systems.

hindi: मंगल ठीक है तो एलोपैथिक
says: If Mars is in good condition, allopathic medicine is the system that works for you. Flagged: a medical-system claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: Mars counts as good by dignity: own in Aries and Scorpio, exalted in Capricorn.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna and 8th lord): Mars counts as good, so allopathy suits.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd (3rd and 10th lord): Mars counts as good, so allopathy suits.

ambiguity: The sentence is a clipped fragment; 'तो एलोपैथिक' is read as 'then allopathic suits'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not match planets to medical systems, though Mars rules surgery and cuts.

hindi: अगर मंगल खराब है एलोपैथी कभी मत लेना ठीक नहीं होगे सर्जरी होती रहेगी
says: If Mars is bad in the chart, never take allopathy: you will not be cured and surgeries will keep happening. Flagged: medical advice and prediction, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: Mars counts as bad by debilitation in Cancer or by affliction; the house tells which area of life the repeated surgeries relate to.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th (lagna and 8th lord): repeated surgical trouble tied to the chest and home-stress area.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (4th and 11th lord): surgery cycle tied to the lower abdomen and partner-related stress.

ambiguity: 'खराब' (bad) is not defined; read as debilitated or afflicted.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not forbid a medical system from a chart condition.

hindi: चंद्रमा खराब है होमोपैथी से भी सत्यानाश हो सकता है लेकिन उसका एक तरीका है देने का वो सब ठीक हो जाता है
says: If the Moon is bad, even homeopathy can wreck you, but there is a particular way of giving it by which everything comes right. Flagged: a medical claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: The Moon counts as bad by debilitation in Scorpio or by affliction; the house shows which area the trouble is felt in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 6th (2nd lord): treatment mix-ups and a shaky response to medicine.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 10th (6th lord): the trouble shows in the work-and-routine area, with unsettled care choices.

ambiguity: The 'particular way of giving' is not explained in this slice.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss homeopathy.

hindi: इस मंगल की कृपा के लिए आपको हनुमान की कृपा चाहिए हनुमान कौन है हनुमान है राम के सेवक हनुमान है सेनापति
says: To win Mars's grace you need Hanuman's grace, and he describes Hanuman as Rama's servant and his commander, which points to Mars's nature as the loyal servant-commander.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as commander (senapati) of the planetary cabinet is classical; Hanuman worship for Mars is a popular remedy tradition.

hindi: तुम मम प्रिय भरत ही सम भाई भाई है राम के भाई के समान है ऐसा कोई बच्चा आपका जो कि बच्चा ही है लेकिन बच्चा भी नहीं है
says: Quoting the line 'you are as dear to me as Bharat', he says Hanuman stands like a brother to Rama, and Mars shows up in your life as that brother-like figure, a young companion who is a child yet not quite a child.
ambiguity: The 'child who is not a child' line is garbled and the next sentence starts mid-thought; the meaning is a brother-like younger companion.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mars is the classical karaka of brothers (sahaja); the Hanuman parallel is his own.

hindi: लेकिन बही है ऐसा कोई व्यक्ति जो आपका परम मित्र है आपके मित्र है जीवन में मित्र होने बहुत जरूरी है अगर आपके पास मित्र है तो मंगल है
says: Mars also appears as a person who is your closest friend; friends are essential in life, and if you have friends then Mars is present and working for you.
ambiguity: 'बही है' is garbled and probably continues the 'not quite a child' line.
classical_check: Partly agrees: friends are the 11th house and Mars is the karaka of close companions and brothers; reading a strong Mars from having friends is his own.

hindi: सूर्य ने तो आदेश देना है काम सारे मंगल करेगा और मंगल कराएगा किससे केतु से
says: The Sun's role is only to give orders; Mars carries out all the work, and Mars in turn gets things done through Ketu, which sets up a command chain of Sun, Mars and Ketu.
ambiguity: 'कराएगा' is read as 'will get it done by'; he does not say whether Ketu acts as Mars's agent or as its shadow.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun as king and Mars as commander is classical; Ketu as Mars's agent is his own.

hindi: बेटे पैदा करने का शौक होता है हमारे देश भारत के अंदर बेटा होना बहुत जरूरी है मंगल कृपा बिना नहीं होगा क्योंकि सूर्य के आदेश से करेगा वो
says: He remarks that having a son matters greatly in India, and says a son cannot be born without Mars's grace, because Mars acts on the Sun's command in this matter. Flagged: a childbirth-related claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'बेटे पैदा करने का शौक' (the craving for sons) is a cultural remark; whether he means only sons or all children is not clear.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter and the Sun are the classical karakas for sons and the 5th house is the main house; Mars's role here is his own.

hindi: और सूर्य बृहस्पति परम मित्र है और बृहस्पति बैठा है
says: The Sun and Jupiter are the closest of friends, which he uses to bring Jupiter's help into the Sun's command chain for getting a son.
ambiguity: 'बृहस्पति बैठा है' is a fragment, probably the start of the next point about Jupiter's seat.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is a friend of the Sun in the classical friendship table.

hindi: बृहस्पति स्त्री के लिए वही क्रोमोसोमल लेवल पर वाय क्रोमोसोम देगा ताकि उसका एग एक्सेप्ट करे और पुत्र हो
says: Jupiter, acting for the woman at the chromosome level, supplies the Y chromosome so that her egg accepts it and a son is born. Flagged: his claim only; in biology the Y chromosome comes from the father's sperm.
ambiguity: 'वही' (that same) is unclear; he may mean Jupiter as the woman's karaka for her husband and sons.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the classical putrakaraka; the chromosome mechanism is his own and does not match biology.

hindi: अब केतु की समस्या यह केतु बीच में डिस्टर्ब अगर हो गया तो अधूरा देता है
says: Ketu's weak point: if Ketu is disturbed in the middle of the chain (Sun orders, Mars acts, Ketu delivers), the result comes out incomplete.
ambiguity: What disturbs Ketu is not stated here; the next lines tie it to home-direction defects.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text describes a Sun-Mars-Ketu delivery chain.

hindi: जितने बच्चे मिसकैरेज हो जाते हैं वह साउथ साउथ वेस्ट के डिफेक्ट्स की वजह से होते हैं घर के अंदर और आपका केतु डिस्टर्ब हो
says: He says miscarriages come from defects in the south and south-west of the home together with a disturbed Ketu. Flagged: a pregnancy-loss claim, recorded only as his statement and not as a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'जितने ... होते हैं' reads like 'all miscarriages', which is a sweeping claim; whether he means every case is not clear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: south-west (nairutya) is the Rahu-Ketu direction in vastu and Ketu is read for pregnancy loss, but the causal claim is his own.

hindi: केतु मींस मिसकैरेज केतु मींस एक पढ़ाई वेस्ट
says: Ketu stands for miscarriage and for wasted study, a lost year of education.
ambiguity: 'एक पढ़ाई वेस्ट' is read as 'one study wasted' (a year of study lost).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu signifies loss, breaks and abortion, and wasted study fits Ketu in the 5th; the exact karaka list is his.

hindi: और यह मंगल ठीक करने से केतु ठीक होता है
says: Setting Mars right repairs Ketu, so the remedy for Ketu troubles runs through Mars.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not make Mars the remedy route for Ketu.

hindi: तो मंगल क्या है नाभी नाभी क्या है विल पावर
says: Mars is the navel and the navel is willpower, so Mars stands for your willpower.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as courage, drive and will is classical; the navel-willpower link is his own.

gist: Advises looking at one simple quality and never giving up willpower ('man ke haare haar'), saying the person who does not take offence does not accept defeat and does not fret.

hindi: लेकिन आपके मंगल में वक्र है अस्त है अस्त भी अस्त भी वक्री जैसा ही एक स्यापा है
says: He turns to the case where Mars is retrograde or combust, adding that combustion is a mess in the same way as retrogression.
cells_derived_method: The weakening applies in any sign, and the house shows which area is hit: courage and siblings in the 3rd, drive at work in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd (3rd and 10th lord) but retrograde or combust: courage, effort and sibling matters falter.
Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Mars (lagna lord) in the 10th but retrograde or combust: the drive at work is strong in principle but comes out erratic and blocked.

ambiguity: 'वक्र है' is read as vakri (retrograde).
classical_check: Partly agrees: combustion (asta) weakens a planet classically; classical texts treat retrograde as strength (cheshta bala), so his equating retrograde with combustion as a mess differs.

gist: Says the combustion status will come ready-made in the software, and asks what combustion is and how it works before going into it.

hindi: इसको जानने से पहले जरूरी है कि हां जी कुंडली में में देख लिया अस्त है बुध अस्त मंगल अस्त है शुक्र अस्त है
says: Before judging, first check in the chart whether Mercury, Mars or Venus is combust, the three planets he names for this test.
ambiguity: He does not give the degree distances for combustion in this slice.
classical_check: Partly agrees: asta is classical, but there every planet except Rahu and Ketu can be combust and the Moon, Jupiter and Saturn have their own limits; he names only three.

hindi: अगर वक्री या अस्त है तो आपकी विल पावर तोड़ देगा आपके मित्रों से प्रेम छोड़ देगा
says: If Mars is retrograde or combust it breaks your willpower and leads you to drop your affection for friends.
cells_derived_method: The damage shows in the area of the house where Mars sits: courage and siblings in the 3rd, the friend circle in the 11th, career drive in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, retrograde or combust Mars in the 3rd: personal courage and effort collapse, with a break in sibling ties.
Derived: lagna Gemini, retrograde or combust Mars in own sign Aries in the 11th (11th and 6th lord): the friend circle shrinks and old friendships are dropped.
Derived: lagna Aries, retrograde or combust exalted Mars in the 10th: willpower at work breaks even though the sign is strong.

ambiguity: The sentence does not name Mars; it follows the Mars lines, and 'अगर वक्री या अस्त है' is read as Mars.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat retrograde as strength and read combustion as loss of the planet's results, not as breaking willpower specifically.

hindi: आपको कहीं ना कहीं पेट की जरूरी नहीं कोई सी भी करा सकता है प्रॉब्लम सर्जरी भी करा सकता है
says: Such a Mars can also give some belly trouble, not necessarily a fixed one, and can even lead to surgery. Flagged: a medical prediction, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: The caption is broken ('जरूरी नहीं कोई सी भी करा सकता है'); I read it as 'any kind of problem may arise'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of surgery and cuts; the belly link follows his navel idea.

hindi: मंगल ही भट्टी है अग्नि है
says: He calls Mars the furnace of the body, the place where the fire burns, which sets up the vastu warning about fire that follows.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: heat and fire are classical Mars significations.

hindi: कोई अग्नि का तत्व आपने घर के येलो जोन में साउथ में तो नहीं रखा हुआ आपको पाइल्स की प्रॉब्लम हो सक फिशर की प्रॉब्लम हो सकती है किसी किस्म की एनल प्रॉब्लम आ सकती है
says: Vastu link: if a fire item has been placed in the south (the yellow zone) of the house, you may get piles, fissure or some other anal problem. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'येलो जोन' is his colour scheme for the south sector; the sentence does not say which fire items.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the south belongs to Mars and Yama in vastu, but classical vastu places fire in the south-east, and the anal-disease link is his own.

hindi: कहीं ना कहीं हो सकता है पेट के अंदर आपको एसिडिटी की शिकायत हो जाए हो जाए कुछ भी ऑपरेशन करा सकता है टेडा मेडा शनि का संगम होता है उसमें
says: Mars trouble can show inside the belly as acidity or anything else, can lead to operations, and a crooked mix with Saturn is involved. Flagged: a medical claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'टेडा मेडा शनि का संगम' is garbled and read as 'a twisted mixing with Saturn'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars with Saturn is a classical malefic combination linked to cuts and digestive heat; the 'crooked mix' wording is his own.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा कब ठीक है जब विल पावर स्ट्रंग है
says: All of these Mars troubles stay under control when willpower is strong.
ambiguity: 'सारा' refers to the troubles just listed (belly, anal, acidity).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie a planet's troubles to willpower.

hindi: विल पावर कब ठीक है आपके मन में संदेह नहीं होना चाहिए
says: Willpower is in good shape only when there is no doubt in the mind.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: this is his reading of Mars as will, not a classical rule.

hindi: अगर मंगल अपसेट है तो संदेह देगा
says: When Mars is upset or afflicted it creates doubt in the mind, which in turn damages willpower.
ambiguity: 'अपसेट' is not defined (placement, affliction or combustion).
classical_check: Silent: doubt is classically a Mercury, Rahu or Moon theme.

hindi: तो मूंगा डालो मूंगा उंगली में पहन लो पांच सात रत्ती का रिंग फिंगर में आएगा आपका चांदी या सोना किसी के अंदर भी मोटे तौर पर है
says: Remedy: wear red coral (moonga) on the ring finger, 5 to 7 ratti, set in silver or gold, as a rough rule only. Flagged: a gem recommendation, recorded as his tradition claim only.
ambiguity: He calls this rough and says the exact method is long; later in the same slice he restricts silver, which contradicts this opening rule.
classical_check: Agrees on coral as the Mars gem worn on the ring finger, usually 6 ratti or more; silver as a setting is later restricted by him and is rarely advised.

gist: Says the exact details will be worked out later because the subject is very long.

hindi: अगर यह मंगल की राशि आपकी एक बेसिक प्रॉब्लम यह छठा घर है यह आठवा घर है ये 12वां यह मृत्यु का है यह खर्चे का है वेस्टेज का है यह बीमारी का है
says: He points at the 6th, 8th and 12th houses and names their topics, death, expenses and wastage, and disease; these are the problem houses that matter for the coral question that follows.
cells_derived_method: The topics are fixed by house (6th disease, 8th death, 12th expenses and loss) and the sign on each gives them a nature; Mars's sign Aries on these houses gives hot, sudden versions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars's own sign on the 6th (lagna and 6th lord): disease and rival matters come as sudden, hot troubles.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars's sign on the 8th (3rd and 8th lord): abrupt, impulsive turns in the 8th-house matters.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Mars's sign on the 12th (7th and 12th lord): expenses and losses come in sudden bursts.

ambiguity: The three topic words come in a different order from the three house numbers; I used the standard mapping 6 disease, 8 death, 12 expenses.
classical_check: Agrees: 6th disease, 8th death or longevity, and 12th loss and expenses are the standard dusthana meanings.

hindi: अगर इन घरों में से किसी भी घर के अंदर आपका एक नंबर राशि जो मंगल की है यह भी कंसीडर किया जाएगा कई बार लेकिन यह चला सकते हैं इन सर्टेन केसेस
says: If sign number 1 (Aries, Mars's sign) falls in any of the 6th, 8th or 12th houses it has to be considered when choosing the coral, although in certain cases it can still be managed.
cells_derived_method: Aries sits in the 6th for lagna Scorpio, in the 8th for lagna Virgo and in the 12th for lagna Taurus; Mars then rules that dusthana. He adds sign number 8 (Scorpio, Mars's other sign) a little later.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars lords the lagna and the 6th, so the coral carries a 6th-lord side that needs care.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars lords the 3rd and the 8th, so the coral carries an 8th-lord side that needs care.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Mars lords the 7th and the 12th, so the coral carries a 12th-lord side that needs care.

ambiguity: 'यह भी कंसीडर किया जाएगा' may extend to sign 8 as well; the sentence is split across two slices.
classical_check: Agrees: classical gem practice avoids the gem of a planet that lords the 6th, 8th or 12th, which is the case when Mars's sign falls in those houses.

hindi: अगर यहां तीन जगह मंगल की एक नंबर राशि है तो मूंगा उंगली में सूट नहीं करेगा
says: If Mars's sign number 1 sits in any of those three places (6th, 8th or 12th), coral will not suit when worn on the finger.
cells_derived_method: The finger ban applies for the three lagnas that put Aries in a dusthana (Scorpio, Virgo, Taurus); other lagnas where Aries is in a kendra or trikona are not covered.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Aries on the 6th: finger coral is discouraged by his rule.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Aries on the 8th: finger coral is discouraged by his rule.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Aries on the 12th: finger coral is discouraged by his rule.

ambiguity: 'तीन जगह' is read as the 6th, 8th and 12th pointed at a moment earlier; whether the rule also applies to sign 8 is stated only in the silver line that follows.
classical_check: Agrees: wearing the gem of a dusthana lord is classically avoided.

hindi: लेकिन मंगल वक्री है या अस्त है पहनना तो पड़ेगा तो क्या करो गले में डालो यहां की राशि गला है यह गले यह भी गला है तो गले में पहनो
says: But if Mars is also retrograde or combust the coral has to be worn anyway, so hang it around the neck instead of on the finger, since the sign of that place is the neck.
cells_derived_method: The neck exception applies only when Aries sits in a dusthana and Mars is also retrograde or combust.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Aries on the 6th with a combust Mars: coral on a chain at the neck.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Aries on the 12th with a retrograde Mars: coral on a chain at the neck.

ambiguity: 'यहां की राशि गला है' is unclear: he may be pointing at Taurus (the neck sign) or at the 2nd house as the throat; I could not tell which.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule moves a gem to the neck for this reason, though pendants are common practice.

hindi: चांदी की धातु चंद्रमा की है अगर यहां एक नंबर राशि है या एक नंबर राशि है या आठ नंबर राशि है तो यह चंद्रमा है यानी आप मूंगा चांदी में नहीं पहन सकते यह मंगल की राशि है
says: Silver is the Moon's metal, and when Mars's sign (number 1 or 8) is in play here he says coral cannot be worn in silver, because the sign is Mars's and the metal is the Moon's.
cells_derived_method: The silver ban follows Mars's own signs Aries and Scorpio; wherever they fall, the Moon's metal is ruled out for the coral.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars's sign Scorpio on the 8th: no silver setting for the coral.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars's sign Aries on the 6th: no silver setting for the coral.

ambiguity: 'यहां ... तो यह चंद्रमा है' is not fully audible: he may mean the Moon is a factor in the houses pointed at. The caption also repeats 'एक नंबर राशि' twice, so the second may be another number.
classical_check: Partly agrees: coral is usually set in gold or copper and silver is rarely advised; the sign 1 or 8 condition is his own.

hindi: तांबे में पहन सकते हो तांबा इसकी अपनी धातु है
says: Coral can be set in copper, which is Mars's own metal.
ambiguity: This sits slightly against his earlier claim that Mars is the iron planet; here he gives it copper.
classical_check: Agrees: copper is the common classical metal for Mars (and the Sun).

hindi: यह सूर्य का है बृहस्पति का है दोनों इसमें मित्र होते हैं तो सोने में पहन सकते हो
says: Gold belongs to the Sun and to Jupiter, both friends of Mars, so the coral can also be set in gold.
ambiguity: 'यह' is read as gold (सोना) from the next phrase.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Jupiter are friends of Mars and gold is their metal.

hindi: कुछ भी सूट ना करे पंच धातु में डालो
says: If no single metal suits, set the coral in panchdhatu, the five-metal alloy.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: panchdhatu is a common fallback setting in practice.

gist: Says these are technicalities and that learning them will take a long time.

hindi: मूंगा गले में जब डालेगा तो दश रती डले का उंगली में डले का तो पांच भी ठीक है लेकिन इसी से ही
says: Weight rule: coral hung on the neck should be about 10 ratti, while on the finger even 5 ratti is fine; the sentence breaks off at 'but from this itself'.
ambiguity: 'दश रती डले का' is read as 10 ratti; the trailing 'लेकिन इसी से ही' is cut off.
classical_check: Partly agrees: heavier stones are used in pendants than in rings, though 5 ratti on the finger is under the usual 6 ratti minimum some texts give.

hindi: बंदे की लाइफ के अंदर यह प्रॉब्लम ठीक हो जाएगी
says: Closing the Mars remedy topic, he says that with this the person's problem will be corrected in life; the sentence is the tail of the preceding coral and metal discussion.
ambiguity: 'यह प्रॉब्लम' is not named; it is presumably the Mars doubt and willpower problem. The sentence continues the previous slice, which ended mid-thought with 'लेकिन इसी से ही'.
classical_check: Silent: a promise that a remedy fixes a life problem is a tradition claim with no classical text behind it.

hindi: आपके मित्र की प्रॉब्लम पैसे की मित्रता नहीं है आपसे आके भग लेता है जरूर मंगल का दोष है
says: If your friends are the money-only kind, with no real friendship, who come to you, take what they need and run off, he says it is certainly a Mars defect in your chart.
cells_derived_method: A defective Mars (debilitated in Cancer or afflicted) shows this most in the friend and gains houses and in the siblings and courage house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Mars (3rd and 8th lord) in the 11th: friends who take and vanish, gains that leak away.
Derived: lagna Taurus, debilitated Mars (7th and 12th lord) in the 3rd: peers and siblings who let you down when you need them.

ambiguity: 'आपके मित्र की प्रॉब्लम' is clumsy; I read it as the problem of such a friend. 'Defect' (दोष) is not defined further.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is a karaka of brothers and companions and a weak Mars hurts them, but friends are classically the 11th house and a Mars defect is not the standard cause.

hindi: यदि किसी किस्म की मित्रता की कमी है तो आपके मंगल में दोष है
says: Generalising the point, any kind of shortfall in friendship in your life means there is a flaw in your Mars.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts read friendship from the 11th house and its lord and from Mercury, not from Mars alone.

gist: Opens a question-and-answer round and says the rest of the topic will be done next week.
Audience question: if Mars is in the garbled 'bave' house, is it a thumb rule that a person succeeds when he borrows money from others.

hindi: अगर मंगल बवे घर में है तो उसको बहुत सूट करेगी यह चीज लगभग मान के चलो कि मंगल महाराज यहां बैठ गए हैं दिस इज मंगल या यहां मंगल है यहां मंगल है यहां मंगल है
says: If Mars sits in the 'bave' (read as bad) houses, borrowing money will suit that person very well, as a rough rule. He points at three spots saying 'Mars here, here, here', which I read as the 6th, 8th and 12th. Flagged: a money claim, recorded only as his statement and not as financial advice.
cells_derived_method: The idea is Mars in a dusthana, and the sign decides the strength: Mars in its own sign or exalted should carry the loan through better than a debilitated one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 6th (6th and 11th lord): debts are managed and repaid with strength.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars in own sign Aries in the 8th (3rd and 8th lord): borrowing for a venture goes through but with sudden turns.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, exalted Mars (3rd and 10th lord) in the 12th: a large outflow that turns productive.

ambiguity: 'बवे' is garbled. I read 'बुरे' (bad) because he has just named 6, 8 and 12 as the problem houses and points at three places; it could instead be one house only, such as the 12th or the 6th.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mars is good in the 6th (it beats debts and rivals) and poor or mixed in the 8th and 12th; debt (rina) belongs to the 6th, and a rule that borrowing suits all three houses is his own.

gist: Notes that planetary aspects have not been covered yet.

hindi: इनकी मंगल की दृष्टि होती है कई किस्म से इसकी दृष्टि ऐसी है कि बव घर पर जिका इंपैक्ट है तो आपको कर्जा सूट करेगा
says: Mars has aspects of several kinds, and if its aspect or impact falls on those bad houses, borrowing suits you in the same way.
cells_derived_method: Using Mars's classical aspects on the 4th, 7th and 8th from itself, Mars in the 3rd aspects the 6th, in the 1st or 2nd or 5th it reaches the 8th, and in the 9th it reaches the 12th. He did not list the aspects himself.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd aspects the 6th (4th aspect), so by his rule borrowing suits.
Derived: lagna Leo, Mars in own sign Aries in the 9th aspects the 12th (4th aspect), so by his rule borrowing suits.

ambiguity: 'बव घर' is the same garbled word as before and 'impact' is not defined; the list of Mars's aspects is not given in this slice.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars has special aspects on the 4th, 7th and 8th from its position; the borrowing result is his own.

hindi: थंब रूल टाइप समझ लो लगभग लगभग और कई फैक्टर्स आएंगे
says: He stresses that this is only a thumb rule, approximate, and that several other factors will also have to be weighed before it holds.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical judgement always weighs several factors, not one placement.

hindi: लेकिन यस थोड़ा सा कर्जा ले लो अपने दोस्त को फोन करना है
says: Even so, he advises taking a small loan by phoning a friend, as the step that wakes up Mars. Flagged: financial advice, recorded only as his claim.
ambiguity: The reason is given only in later lines (activating Mars); here it is just the advice.
classical_check: Silent: borrowing as a Mars remedy is not found in classical texts.

hindi: कर्जा लेने का तरीका समझले आप यह नहीं कह सकते भाई टोटका कर रहा हूं पहले तो वही मर लेगा के साले तू मेरे पर जादू कर रहा है क्या
says: On the method of borrowing: you cannot tell the friend 'brother, I am doing a totka (a superstitious remedy)', because he will first blow up and ask whether you are doing magic on him. Flagged: financial dealing, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'वही मर लेगा' is garbled and read as 'he himself will flare up'.
classical_check: Silent: this is practical advice, not a classical rule.

hindi: आपको यह कहना भाई बहुत जरूरत है पैसों की मदद करेगा कोई दोस्त तो मान जाएगा
says: Instead, say plainly that you badly need money and ask for help; a real friend will agree. Flagged: financial dealing, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: practical advice, not a classical rule.

gist: Acts out an imagined phone call: the friend agrees warmly, asks how much, is told a large sum is needed, calls the borrower mad, then reluctantly goes along.

hindi: र ले लो उससे एक रप महीने का ब्याज दे दो उसे आपका ग्रह सेट है
says: Take the money from the friend and pay him interest every month, a token amount in his words; doing this sets your planet, meaning Mars. Flagged: financial dealing, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'एक रप' is garbled: it may be one rupee a month as a symbolic amount, or one percent; the amount cannot be fixed.
classical_check: Silent: paying monthly interest as a planetary remedy is not classical.

gist: Imagines the friend later suspecting you of superstitious tricks and of loading your planets onto him.

hindi: इसने किसी के ऊपर किसी के ग्रह नहीं चढ़ आप उसको ब्याज देते रहेंगे दोनों की ट्रांजैक्शन होती रहेगी
says: No one's planets are actually loaded onto anyone; you keep paying him interest, and the transaction keeps running on both sides as an ordinary exchange, which is what keeps the remedy honest.
ambiguity: 'किसी के ग्रह नहीं चढ़' is read as 'nobody's planets get put on anybody'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text covers the transaction remedy.

hindi: आपकी प्रॉपर्टी नहीं बन रही ट का है कर्जा ले लो उस पर चार दोस्तों से ले लो किसी बैंक से ले लो बिजनेस ल नहीं हो रही फटाफट कर्जा ले लो मंगल एक्टिवेट कर दो
says: Applying it: if your property deal is not forming or your business is not taking off, take a loan fast, from four friends or from a bank, and thereby activate Mars. Flagged: financial advice, recorded only as his claim.
ambiguity: 'ट का है' and 'बिजनेस ल' are garbled; the loan purpose is read as property and business.
classical_check: Silent: loans as a way to activate Mars have no classical basis.

hindi: यार मेरा तो है ही नहीं मैं तो कर्जे पर कर रहा हूं काम आपकी डील हो जाएगी
says: He voices the borrower's stance, 'it is not even mine, I am doing this work on a loan', and says that working this way gets your deal done. Flagged: financial advice, recorded only as his claim.
ambiguity: Whether this is what you tell others or only the mindset is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical idea.

hindi: फिर आप जब डील पूरी हो गई उसको उसके र हजज जो वापस दे दो वापस देक ब्याज बंद कर दो काम हो जाएगा आपका
says: Once the deal is complete, return the money to the lender and stop the interest; your work will have been done. Flagged: financial dealing, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'उसके र हजज' is garbled and read as 'his money'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical equivalent.

gist: Says even well-known business magnates borrow money on interest to this day, so borrowing is no big deal.
Audience question: if an exalted planet is retrograde in the house of fortune, what should one avoid.

hindi: भाग्य स्थान पर उच्च का ग्रह वक्री है तो सत्यानाश कर दिया उसने आपका आपके भाग्य की लंका लगा के रखेगा
says: An exalted planet that is retrograde in the house of fortune has ruined you, he says, and will keep your luck in a shambles.
cells_derived_method: Any planet in its exaltation sign that is retrograde in the 9th; the Sun and Moon never turn retrograde, so Aries and Taurus are left out. Which life area is wrecked follows the planet's lordships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, retrograde exalted Jupiter (2nd and 5th lord) in the 9th: luck, savings and children's matters go off track.
Derived: lagna Taurus, retrograde exalted Mars (7th and 12th lord) in the 9th: marriage and foreign or loss matters break the luck.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, retrograde exalted Saturn (lagna and 12th lord) in the 9th: self-effort and expenses undercut fortune.

ambiguity: 'भाग्य स्थान' is read as the 9th house, and 'उच्च का ग्रह' as any planet in its exaltation sign.
classical_check: Differs: classically an exalted planet in the 9th is strong, retrograde adds cheshta bala, and some later texts read a retrograde exalted planet as acting debilitated; total ruin is his own reading.

hindi: क्योंकि वक्री ग्रह बीच में तोड़ता रहेगा उसको चल तो उल्टा ही रहा है चल तो सीधा रहा है लेकिन एक्चुअली वक्री का मतलब है कि उल्टा काम कर रहा है
says: His reason: a retrograde planet keeps breaking things midway; it appears to move forward but retrograde actually means it is working in reverse.
ambiguity: 'उसको चल तो उल्टा ही रहा है चल तो सीधा रहा है' is garbled and read as 'it seems to be moving straight but is really moving backward'.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat a vakri planet as having strength (cheshta bala), though also as intense or backward-acting in results.

hindi: या ऐसा कह लिया जाए वो नीच राशि के बराबर काम करेगा नीच राशि बराबर नहीं करेगा वो ढंग से काम नहीं करेगा वो अगड़म बगड़म रहेगा
says: He first offers that a retrograde planet acts like a planet in a debilitated sign, then corrects himself: it is not exactly equal to debilitation, it simply will not work properly and will behave haphazardly.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: some later texts equate retrograde exalted with debilitated results; classical cheshta bala reading differs.

hindi: वक्री का मतलब है इधर उधर इधर उधर क्या करो उलट चलाता है नीच नहीं करेगा उलट काम करेगा बनाते बनाते भी ब्रेक कर सकता है
says: Retrograde means erratic motion, here and there: it runs things backwards, and unlike a debilitated planet that merely underperforms, it does the opposite work and can break something even while it is building it.
ambiguity: 'क्या करो' in the middle is filler and left out.
classical_check: Silent: the 'builds then breaks' picture of vakri is his own.

gist: Sets up an example: the 8th house as a bad place with a debilitated planet lying in it, and picks a cruel planet, Mars, to illustrate.

hindi: चार नंबर का मंगल आ गया यह नीच का हो गया अब यह बुरे स्थान में बुरा कर रहा है तो यह मृत्यु के स्थान को मार रहा है तो आसानी से मरेगा नहीं
says: Take Mars debilitated in sign 4 (Cancer) in the 8th house: a bad planet in a bad place does its harm there, so it strikes the house of death and the person will not die easily. Flagged: a longevity claim, recorded only as his statement and not as a prediction.
cells_derived_method: The same bad-planet-in-bad-place logic would apply to the 6th and 12th: the harmful planet attacks the harmful house instead of the person.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, debilitated Mars (5th and 12th lord) in the 8th: it attacks the death-and-crisis house, so the person survives crises that would finish others.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, debilitated Mars (3rd and 10th lord) in the 6th: it attacks the disease-and-enemy house, so rivals and debts are beaten back.
Derived: lagna Leo, debilitated Mars (4th and 9th lord) in the 12th: it attacks the loss house, so expenses and drain are curbed.

ambiguity: The 8th house is set up in the previous lines as the example place; 'चार नंबर' is read as sign 4, Cancer, which is Mars's debilitation.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a malefic in a dusthana protecting that house is the idea behind viparita raja yoga, but 'debilitated Mars kills the 8th house so the person lives long' is his own wording.

hindi: मंगल ने आ करके बर्बाद कर देना है इसको मार दूंगा खत्म कर दूंगा तेरी ऐसी की तैसी पर ये मार रहा है
says: He voices Mars's intent in the first person ('I will kill it, finish it'): Mars arrives only to wreck the 8th house, and it is that house that keeps being hit, not the person.
ambiguity: This is a dramatised retelling of the previous row's mechanism.
classical_check: Silent: a planet 'intending' to destroy a house is his image, not a classical statement.

hindi: लेकिन मंगल जो चार नंबर का होता है वह कमाल के असर देता है य सबसे बढ़िया समझाने का तरीका है
says: He says Mars in sign number 4 (Cancer) gives remarkable effects and that this is the best way to get the principle across.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars gives striking results in whichever house Cancer falls, in good or bad direction; the house decides which life area is hit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, debilitated Mars (lagna and 8th lord) in the 4th: striking effects on home, mother and mind.
Derived: lagna Libra, debilitated Mars (2nd and 7th lord) in the 10th: striking effects on career, status and public image.

ambiguity: 'कमाल के असर' is positive in tone but he does not say good or bad; it may refer only to the bad-place case just given.
classical_check: Differs: classically debilitated Mars is weak; striking results come only if neecha bhanga applies.

hindi: शनि या एक नंबर का शनि है नीच का शनि है क्रूर ग्रह है और मृत्यु का मालिक भी एक तरह से क्योंकि मुन्ना महाराज तो क्या करेगा ये मौत को मारेगा तो मरते ही नहीं ऐसे लोग
says: Saturn in sign 1 (Aries, its debilitation) is a cruel planet and in a way the owner of death, so it kills death itself, and such people hardly die. Flagged: a longevity claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: The same would hold for debilitated Saturn in other bad houses, where it attacks the harmful house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Saturn (5th and 6th lord) in the 8th: a long-lived person who comes through repeated crises.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, debilitated Saturn (3rd and 4th lord) in the 6th: stubborn endurance against illness and enemies.

ambiguity: The 8th house is carried over from the example just set up; 'मुन्ना महाराज' is a filler address.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn is the longevity karaka and Saturn in the 8th is classically a long-life placement; 'debilitated Saturn kills death' is his gloss.

hindi: अब अब शनि यहां भले ही उच्च का बैठा है तो भी मौत को मारेगा लेकिन उच्च का शनि है बड़े आराम से मौत होगी
says: Even if Saturn sits in its exaltation (Libra) in the 8th it still beats death, but with exalted Saturn the end, when it comes, is very comfortable and easy. Flagged: a manner-of-death claim, recorded only as his statement, with no date or cause.
cells_derived_method: The exalted case would read the same way in other dusthanas, with the house naming the area through which the peaceful outcome shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, exalted Saturn (11th and 12th lord) in the 8th: long life and a peaceful end.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, exalted Saturn (3rd and 4th lord) in the 12th: a calm ending of life abroad or in seclusion by analogy.

ambiguity: 'उच्च का' is read as Libra, Saturn's exaltation; the 8th is carried over from the example.
classical_check: Partly agrees: exalted Saturn in the 8th is a classical long-life indication; the peaceful-death detail is his own.

hindi: नीच का शनि है खड़ झटके से मौत होगी बीमार पड़ के और लंबा सड़ सड़ के मर सकता है यह फर्क आएगा
says: With debilitated Saturn the end comes with a jolt: the person falls ill and may linger and suffer for a long time before dying, which is the difference from the exalted case. Flagged: a manner-of-death claim, recorded only as his statement, with no date or cause.
cells_derived_method: The debilitated case in other bad houses would read as a hard, drawn-out ending shown in that house's area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Saturn (5th and 6th lord) in the 8th: a long, hard illness before the end.
Derived: lagna Taurus, debilitated Saturn (9th and 10th lord) in the 12th: a hard, lingering end away from home or in hospital.

ambiguity: 'खड़ झटके से' is garbled and read as 'with a jolt'; the second half says it can also be slow and lingering, so the two halves pull in different directions.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give the manner of death from Saturn's dignity this way.

hindi: शनि य बैठ गया तो लंबा नीच भंग राजयो ग नीच भंग बुरा ग्रह बुरे स्थान में बैठ गया रॉकेट बन गया
says: He calls this pattern neecha bhanga rajayoga: a bad planet that sits in a bad place becomes a rocket and shoots upward. For Saturn sitting here, he adds the result is long.
cells_derived_method: The idea covers any debilitated cruel planet in the 6th, 8th or 12th, and the planet's lordships say which areas of life rise.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, debilitated Mars (3rd and 10th lord) in the 6th: effort and career rise through conflict and competition.
Derived: lagna Taurus, debilitated Saturn (9th and 10th lord) in the 12th: rise comes through foreign, hidden or high-expense matters.

ambiguity: 'लंबा' is a fragment and may mean long life or long process; the bad houses are those named earlier (6, 8, 12).
classical_check: Differs: classical neecha bhanga needs specific cancellation conditions (such as the dispositor or exaltation lord in a kendra); a malefic in a dusthana doing well is closer to viparita raja yoga.

hindi: प्लूटो बैठा है य कोई और बैठा है इंद्र बैठा है ये सब दैत्य माने जाते हैं य नीच भंग राजयोग जब बुरी राशि में बैठ जाए तोय बड़ा उलट हिसाब किताब चलता है इसके अंदर
says: The same holds for Pluto or Indra (Uranus) sitting there; all of these are counted as daityas (demons), and when such a planet sits in a bad sign the neecha-bhanga rajayoga works on a very reversed logic.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled in places ('य कोई और बैठा है'), and 'बुरी राशि' (bad sign) is not defined for the outer planets.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto and Uranus are not classical grahas, and the daitya grouping is his own.

gist: Audience question: if a planet gets neecha bhanga, does it become good.

hindi: वो लेकिन व धमाल मचाए रखेगा
says: A planet that gets neecha bhanga does turn good, but it will keep creating a commotion (dhamaal) instead of behaving quietly.
ambiguity: The opening 'वो' is read as 'yes it becomes good'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: neecha bhanga is classically a raja-yoga-giving cancellation, often after an early struggle.

hindi: टांग पर प्रॉब्लम देता है पैर में प्रॉब्लम देगा
says: Such a planet gives trouble in the leg and the foot; the example he is moving to is Saturn. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: The sentence does not name the planet; it comes just before 'य शनि का', so Saturn is the likely subject.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn rules the legs and feet (Aquarius and Pisces zone) in the body map.

hindi: य शनि का तो मजेदार तिल भी देगा य पैर में तिल देगा जहां बैठा हु तिल होता है और उसकी दृष्टि जहां होगी वहा ल दे सकता है क्योंकि वो घूम सकता है
says: Saturn also gives a mole, for instance on the foot: a mole appears in the body part matching where Saturn sits, and its aspect can place one where it looks, because it can move around (which ties to the chalit chart).
cells_derived_method: The body part follows the house number in the body map, and the aspect carries the mole to a second area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, debilitated Saturn in the 12th: a mole on the foot.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 1st: a mole on the head or face.

ambiguity: 'वहा ल दे सकता है' is garbled and read as 'can give one there'; 'घूम सकता है' hints at the chalit shift of planets between houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: moles and marks read by planet and house-to-body-part mapping are a known tradition; the Saturn and aspect detail is his own.

gist: Says the chalit chart was not covered today, along with the KP, chalit and nirayana-bhava charts the audience prepared, and promises to take them up later.
Opening words of the slice are garbled ('ले जैसे ये तो घर केबसे आप लि इस म से लेकर इस साल तक शनि चल'); only that it talks about Saturn running over a stretch of time can be made out.

hindi: ये दशाओं की बात हो रही कि दशा चलती है भाई जनवरी 25 से लेकर जनवरी 26 तक आपके शनि की दशा है तो उस समय शनि प्रधानमंत्री है कुछ टाइम एक साल के लिए
says: On dashas: while a planet's period runs, his example Saturn from January 2025 to January 2026, that planet is the prime minister for the stretch, here a year.
ambiguity: The dates are an example and not an actual dasha table; it is not said which dasha system he uses.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the running dasha lord is classically the ruler of that period.

hindi: उस टाइम में शनि जैसा है चलते है चच का कि नीच का वो तो देखने के बा जब तक सीखो ग नहीं आएगा नहीं उच्च नीच है लेकिन उसमें एक और लकूना है
says: During that period the outcome depends on whether Saturn is exalted or debilitated, which can be read only after you have learned more; he adds there is one more gap (lacuna) in this method.
ambiguity: The caption is badly garbled ('चलते है चच का'); the 'lacuna' is not named.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the dasha lord's dignity is classically a main factor in its results.

hindi: आप जैसे यह सीख रहे हैं तो आपने दशा की बात सीखी दशा से पढ़ लिया आप अगर सीख जाएं कि गोचर से ही सीख लिया तो आपको दशा देखने की जरूरत नहीं है
says: If you learn to read from transits alone, there is no need to look at the dasha at all.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he means transit makes dasha redundant for every question or only for timing.
classical_check: Differs: classical prediction combines dasha with transit (gochara); dropping the dasha is his own position.

hindi: आजकल शनि कहां बैठा है ट्रांजिट करंट ट्रांजिट करंट आजकल और आपकी कुंडली से कैसे वो लिंक कर रहा है तो समझो आपने पहले ही जान लिया और आप वैसे ही फलित कर दोगे
says: The method: find where Saturn is sitting now (the current transit) and how it links with your birth chart; with that you already know enough to make predictions.
ambiguity: How the link is judged (from the lagna, the Moon or planets) is not said.
classical_check: Agrees: gochara over the natal chart is classical, usually from the Moon.

hindi: कि भैया तेरा एक्सीडेंट होने वाला है इस से इस डेट के बीच एक्सीडेंट बता दोगे आप
says: With the transit link you could tell someone, 'you will have an accident between these two dates'. Flagged: a dated event prediction, recorded only as his claim.
ambiguity: The sentence follows the transit lines; it does not name which transit triggers the accident.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical gochara can time events within a window but not to exact dates.

hindi: आपकी गाड़ी के किस हिस्से पे यह गाड़ी है यह गाड़ी का मुंह है यह गाड़ी के दरवाजे हैं साइड के यह गाड़ी का पिछला हिस्सा है
says: You can even say which part of the car will be hit by treating the chart like a car: this is the front (the face), these are the side doors, and this is the rear of the car.
cells_derived_method: The car is mapped onto the chart by pointing, much like a body map, but the houses he points at are not captured in the caption, so no cell mapping is derived.
ambiguity: 'यह ... यह ... यह' point at parts of a diagram; the house for each car part is unknown.
classical_check: Silent: mapping car parts to houses is not classical; it follows the kalapurusha body-map idea.

hindi: अगर शनि यहां बैठा है मान लो चोट मार रहा है तो गाड़ी के राइट साइड के टायर के पिछले हिस्से प चोट आएगी एक्सीडेंट होगा
says: If Saturn sits at the spot he points to and is striking, the hit lands on the rear part of the right-side tyre of the car, and an accident follows.
cells_derived_method: The car part follows the spot where Saturn sits; a different spot would give a different part of the car.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is a pointed spot with no house number, so which house gives the rear right tyre cannot be set.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: डेंट ठीक मत कराना जब तक शनि की दशा है यहां बैठा नीच का
says: Do not get the dent repaired as long as the Saturn dasha runs, with Saturn sitting here debilitated.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is the pointed spot; 'नीच का' gives the sign as Aries, the house is not named.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: यहां राइट साइड पे आएगा ड्राइवर के पीछे वाले हिस्से पे वहां चोट आएगी गाड़ी के ऊपर डंट लगेगा
says: At this spot the hit comes on the right side, on the part behind the driver, and the car gets a dent there.
ambiguity: This looks like a second wording of the same spot, now as 'behind the driver'; the house is not named.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: और उधर आप इसको रिपेयर मत कराना जब तक शनि की दशा है दशा खत्म रिपेयर करा लो नहीं तो फिर एक्सीडेंट करेगा वो डेंट देखने आएगा बार-बार
says: Do not repair that part until the Saturn dasha ends, then get it repaired; otherwise Saturn will keep causing accidents, coming back again and again to look at the dent.
ambiguity: 'डेंट देखने आएगा' is figurative: Saturn returning to the unrepaired mark.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: यहां है ये फ्रंट हेड लाइट है ये फ्रंट हेड लाइट के ऊपर आपके चोट मारेगा वो एक्सीडेंट होगा उसे ठीक मत कराओ
says: With Saturn at another spot he points to, the hit falls on the front headlight and an accident follows; do not get that repaired either.
ambiguity: The pointed spot is not named in houses; it is the front end of the car.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: और करा दिया तो डेंट का निशान रहने दो लाइट लगा लो ई वो बली लेगा
says: If you have already had it repaired, leave a dent mark visible and fit a light there; that way Saturn takes his sacrificial offering (bali) and is satisfied.
ambiguity: 'लाइट लगा लो ई वो बली लेगा' is garbled; 'light' may be a lamp or a headlight, and 'ई' may be 'he'.
classical_check: Silent: a leave-the-dent offering to Saturn is his own remedy.

hindi: जैसे मान लो आपका शनि यहां बैठा है आपको चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम देगा या खराब है एक नंबर आठ नंबर या किसी भी खराब राशि का ये चेस्ट है छाती है छाती पे चोट मारेगा
says: If Saturn sits in the chest area in a bad sign such as number 1 (Aries) or number 8 (Scorpio), it will strike the chest. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement and not as a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The chest zone follows the 4th house in the body map, and the bad signs for Saturn here are Aries and Scorpio; Saturn in other houses would hit other body parts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, debilitated Saturn (lagna and 2nd lord) in the 4th: chest and bone trouble tied to home stress.
Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in a Mars sign in the 4th (6th and 7th lord): chest strain through partner or work worry.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a pointed spot, read as the chest area and so the 4th house, which is not said aloud; 'किसी भी खराब राशि' may include signs beyond 1 and 8.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the chest and heart area is the 4th house and Cancer in the body map, and Saturn there is classically a source of chest trouble; his 'bad signs 1 and 8' are his own.

hindi: हार्ट नहीं होता शनि हड्डी होता है ये आपकी चेस्ट है ये चेस्ट है ये हड्डी पे चोट मारता है
says: Saturn is not the heart but the bone, so what it strikes in the chest is the bony frame and not the heart itself.
ambiguity: The leading word 'मारेगा' is repeated from the previous line.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical karaka of bones; the heart belongs to the Sun.

hindi: अब आपकी गाड़ी में चोट आएगी ये एक्सीडेंट
says: He turns back from the body to the car: the same Saturn that hits the chest bone will now dent your car, which he calls the accident. The slice ends here, before the point is finished.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: का एरिया और मां बीमार पड़ेगी
says: Continuing from the chest, he says that with afflicted Saturn in this chest zone the mother will fall ill; the chest area and the mother go together. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: The mother-and-chest result belongs to Saturn in the 4th; the sign decides how hard it falls, being sharpest when Saturn is debilitated and softer when it is exalted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, debilitated Saturn (lagna and 2nd lord) in the 4th: mother's illness and chest-bone strain at home.
Derived: lagna Cancer, exalted Saturn (7th and 8th lord) in the 4th: the same house topics, but the blow is milder and slower by dignity.

ambiguity: 'का एरिया' is the tail of 'छाती का एरिया' (chest area) from the previous slice; the 4th house is inferred from chest and mother.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 4th house is the chest and the mother, and Saturn there classically harms the mother's comfort and health.

hindi: अब आपने क्या किया गाड़ी की चोटाई डेंट निशान पड़ गया परमानेंट आपने गोचर में आया हुआ दो साल का या दशा आई है न साल की इसे तीन साल पड़े रहने दो
says: The car has taken the hit and the dent mark is now permanent; he says leave it unrepaired for the whole length of the transit (two years) or of the dasha, about three years in his words.
ambiguity: 'दो साल का या दशा आई है न साल की इसे तीन साल' is garbled, so the exact durations (2 and 3 years) are only as heard.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: अगर आपने रिपेयर करा लिया आपके चेस्ट प चोट मारेगा आपकी हड्डी तोड़ सकता है ये तो सोचो यह बचाना है तो वो लगे रहने दो
says: If you repair the dent, Saturn will strike your chest instead and can break your bone, so if you want to protect the chest let the dent stay. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: a car dent as a substitute for a bone injury is not classical.

gist: Says people will remark that you are not fixing the car and the mark is still there, and tells you to take that as good and let it stay.

hindi: और कुछ नहीं तो अपनी शर्ट पहनो या जेब फाड़ के निशान डालो कुछ टूटी हुई चीज रखो उसका साइड इफेक्ट आएगा नो डाउट
says: If the dent option is not available, wear a damaged shirt or tear a pocket to leave a mark, or keep some broken item, as a stand-in offering to Saturn; he admits this will have a side-effect, no doubt.
ambiguity: 'अपनी शर्ट पहनो' is unclear; I read it as wearing a worn or damaged shirt. The side-effect is not described.
classical_check: Silent: symbolic breakage as a Saturn offering is not classical.

hindi: लेकिन गाड़ी अगर ले लेती है चोट तो बहुत बड़ी गाड़ी हाथी होता है
says: When the car takes the hit it is a big body that can bear the blow, since a large car is like an elephant.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: the elephant picture of a car is his own.

hindi: मोटरसाइकिल चंद्रमा हाथी प कितनी बड़ी चोट आएगी कुछ बिगड़ेगा राहु होता है ये
says: A motorcycle belongs with the Moon, while the elephant-like car is Rahu; he asks how much a blow can really spoil on an elephant, meaning very little.
ambiguity: The caption 'कुछ बिगड़ेगा' lacks a 'not'; I read it as 'will anything be spoiled', a rhetorical question meaning almost nothing.
classical_check: Silent: classical karaka lists give the Moon water and vehicles by sea or road in general, but no motorcycle, and give Rahu large or foreign vehicles at most.

hindi: और राहु ही शनि का एजेंट है यह इतनी डेप्थ की चीज है बड़ी मस्त और मजेदार
says: Rahu is Saturn's agent, so Saturn's work gets carried out through Rahu's things such as the car; he calls this a deep and delightful part of the system.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is classically said to act like Saturn (shani-vat Rahu); the 'agent' wording is his.

hindi: इसलिए हम चाहते हैं किसी की गाड़ी छूटे छूट जाए
says: He draws the moral that we should wish for a vehicle to slip away, be lost or be missed, because such a small loss absorbs Saturn's blow so it does not land on the body.
ambiguity: 'गाड़ी छूटे' may mean a vehicle is missed or lost; the sentence is compressed and the 'someone's' makes the intended person unclear.
classical_check: Silent: absorbing a malefic's hit through a small material loss is a tradition idea, not a classical rule.

hindi: चौथा शनि है बच्चा फेल होए भगवान करे हो जाए एक बार जल्दी से जल्दी फेल हो जाए जैसे ही फेल होगा उसकी चेस्ट बची रहेगी
says: With Saturn in the 4th, he says to pray that the child fails once, as early as possible, because once the child has failed the child's chest stays protected. Flagged: a health-linked claim, recorded only as his statement.
cells_derived_method: The 'let it fail once' offering applies where Saturn sits in the 4th, and a harder Saturn (debilitated) makes the failure more necessary than an exalted one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, debilitated Saturn in the 4th: one early school failure is the offering that spares the chest.
Derived: lagna Cancer, exalted Saturn in the 4th: by dignity a milder case, with a smaller setback enough.

ambiguity: 'चौथा शनि है' is read as Saturn in the 4th house; it could also mean Saturn's 4th aspect.
classical_check: Silent: letting a child fail as a remedy is not classical.

hindi: फेल नहीं होने देंगे ट्यूशन लगाएंगे फालतू देंगे पैसे दे देंगे खरीदोगे जिद्द करके ग्रह डीप जाता जाएगा यहां से नसों में घुस जाएगा शनि के पास नर्व्स है सारी
says: If you do not let the child fail, and instead add tuition, pay extra money and buy things on stubborn demand, the planet goes deeper, from the chest into the nerves, which all belong to Saturn. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'फालतू देंगे' is read as 'unnecessary extras'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the classical karaka of nerves; the idea that a blocked offering pushes it deeper is his own.

gist: Audience question: since the planet comes to hit a given thing for a given time, can that impact be converted onto money.

hindi: हां धन पर डाल सकते हो तो जैसे गाड़ी ठीक कराई तो गाड़ी ठीक करा के धन का बली दी तुमने
says: Yes, the impact can be converted onto money: when you pay to get the car repaired you have offered Saturn a money sacrifice (bali). Flagged: money handling, recorded only as his claim and not as financial advice.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies include daan (donation) as a money offering to a planet; repairing a car as the offering is his own.

hindi: गाड़ी चमका के खुश हो गए ना गाड़ी सेट हो गई ये तो होनी नहीं है शनि क या चोट मार रहे या छाती प दो या गाड़ी प लेगा वो मन में
says: Shining the car and feeling that everything is set does not close the matter: Saturn has to hit either the chest or the car, and he will take the blow somewhere, including in the mind.
ambiguity: 'वो मन में' (in the mind) is cut short and may begin the next thought.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: हमने जो उसका जो मुन्ना ने सेट मुन्ना की सेटिंग कर लो कितना ज्योतिष सीख लो मुन्ना सेटिंग जरूरी कर
says: However much astrology you learn, you must still set your own mind (his 'Munna setting'); the inner setting is essential and remedies alone do not do it.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled around 'मुन्ना सेट'; I read Munna as an affectionate address for the listener or the self.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss inner setting.

hindi: धन की बली तो दी है हमने तो इंपैक्ट कम होगा लेकिन वो डीप जाएगा क्योंकि वो आया तो है करने वो बारबार आके देखेगा चोट लगी हुई है
says: Since a money offering has been made the impact will be lighter, but it goes deep, because Saturn came to do this job and will keep coming back to check whether the wound is there.
ambiguity: 'डीप जाएगा' is the same 'goes deep' as before, meaning moves from the outer item into the body or mind.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: पर यहां से अगर हम खुश नहीं हो तो अगेन वो नफाई हो सकता है हा सारा खेल ब्रेन का है हमें चोट लगी कितनी सहज रहना ही सबसे बड़ी मेडिटेशन है
says: If we are not content at this point the trouble can flare up again; he says the whole game is in the brain, in how hurt we feel by the blow, and that staying composed is the greatest meditation.
ambiguity: 'वो नफाई हो सकता है' is garbled and read as 'it can recur'.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

gist: Starts a story about Osho: Indian listeners at his Hindi lectures would complain that they did not understand one point or another.

Osho's reply in the story: foreigners had sat for ten days listening to Hindi without understanding a word, but their subconscious, the Chitragupta of an earlier class, was recording everything, including what they would become in which birth.
Moral of the story: even while you sleep something awake in the skull listens, whatever you have heard is stored in memory, and nothing is wasted.
Audience question about the blue thread he mentioned earlier for a job, to be worn on the right hand.

hindi: नहीं नहीं राइट हैंड नहीं है इसके लिए लाल थ्रेड भी हो सकता है हो सकता है हरा भी होगा हो सकता है गुलाबी होगा पर्पल होगा
says: He corrects the questioner: it is not necessarily the right hand, and the job thread need not be blue; it could be red, green, pink or purple, depending on the chart.
ambiguity: 'राइट हैंड नहीं है' may mean the thread is not fixed to the right hand; the wrist is named later. 'Depending on the chart' is my reading.
classical_check: Silent: coloured threads for jobs are not classical.

hindi: पर जो ब्लू होता है वो राहु इसलिए इतना ज्यादा यूज होता है क्योंकि वो उसको डेड करना बड़ाही मुश्किल है किसी ग्रह के द्वारा
says: Blue is Rahu's colour, and blue thread is used so often because Rahu's effect is very hard for any other planet to cancel or kill.
ambiguity: 'डेड करना' is read as cancelling or neutralising Rahu's effect.
classical_check: Partly agrees: blue or dark colours are linked to Saturn and Rahu in the usual colour lists; the cancelling reason is his own.

hindi: वायलेट यूज होता है पर्पल यूज होता है उन सब में नीला रंग मिक्स है राहु को बताने के लिए
