says: Violet and purple threads are also used, because blue is mixed into both of them, and the purpose is to stand for Rahu.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: violet and purple are not in classical colour lists for Rahu.

hindi: इतना पावरफुल ग्रह है कि इसका तो धागा भी जादू करता है
says: Rahu is so powerful a planet that even its thread works like magic.
ambiguity: The opening words 'कहा था किय' are garbled; the meaning is clear from the rest.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: यह आपकी रीड की हड्डी का एल फ ए5 एव है यह तीन हड्डिया है
says: Pointing to the back, he says this stretch of the spine is the lower region of the vertebrae he names as L4, L5 and one more, three bones in all. Flagged: a body-part statement, recorded only as his claim.
ambiguity: 'एल फ ए5 एव' is garbled; I read it as L4, L5 and a third vertebra (probably S1). The exact third name is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent: vertebra names are modern anatomy, not classical.

hindi: अगर यहां डिस्टर्ब है राश और ग्रह आपकी रेड की हड्डी में गैप होगा इन तीन में होगा ही होगा
says: If the sign and planet linked to this area are disturbed, there will certainly be a gap in one of these three spinal bones. Flagged: a medical-looking claim, recorded only as his statement and not as a diagnosis.
ambiguity: He does not say which house or planet governs the lower back, so no cell can be named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical body maps give the lower back to the 6th or 7th house and Saturn; his sign-and-planet linkage is not stated.

hindi: एक और दो काम कर रही है या 12 एक और दो कर रही है या सिर्फ एक कर रही है उस हिसाब से धागा निर्धारित होगा
says: The thread colour is fixed by which sign numbers are working in that spot: signs 1 and 2 together, signs 12, 1 and 2, or sign 1 alone give different threads. This is the multi-sign idea, where each place is touched by more than one sign.
ambiguity: The preceding words 'क्या राशि नंबर य हो य तो सेम आ गया' are garbled. How a given sign combination maps to a colour is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

gist: A run of sign numbers (5, 7, 1, 2, 3, 4) and a question about which sign numbers are working, too garbled to turn into a rule.

hindi: और आपकी रीड की हड्डी का गैप भर जाएगा जादू यह प्रयोग हुए सालों साल से
says: With the right-coloured thread the gap in the spine fills up, which he calls magic and says came from experiments carried out over many years. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

gist: Says this is his own worked-out method, he will tell everyone all of it, there is nothing to worry about and no wish to keep it to himself.
Says he himself was amazed at how the gaps vanished, and that this knowledge was not earned in this lifetime.
Says he never studied L4 and L5 and knows nothing of it himself, but someone inside him knows, and the spinal gap does get cured, he cannot say how.

hindi: आपका घुटना खराब हो रहा है ये बाया घुटना खराब हो रहा है यहां कोई ना कोई ग्रह बैठा खराब आपका यह मंदिर का स्थान है
says: If the left knee is going bad, some planet is sitting badly in the place he calls the temple place (the house of worship), and that planet is the cause. Flagged: a body-part claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: 'मंदिर का स्थान' is not tied to a house number; it may be the 9th, the 4th or the 5th. The word 'बाया' (left) may only be the example he was pointing at.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical body maps give the knees to the 10th house (Capricorn) with Saturn; his 'temple place' link is not classical.

hindi: मंदिर में उस ग्रह के पॉजिटिव चीज का दान कर दो घुटना ठीक हो गया
says: The fix he gives is to donate, at a temple, a positive item belonging to that badly placed planet, after which the knee got better. Flagged: a health claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: What counts as the 'positive' item of each planet is not listed here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: donating a planet's items (daan) is a classical remedy; the knee link is his own.

hindi: वास्तु के अंदर लेफ्ट घुटना है ये लेफ्ट घुटना आपका पड़ेगा जाकर के नॉर्थ वेस्ट में
says: In the vastu map of the body, the left knee falls in the north-west and the right knee in the south-east of the house.
ambiguity: The repeated words 'नॉर्थ वेस्ट' and 'ईस्ट' in the captions are stutters, not extra directions.
classical_check: Silent: a body-to-direction vastu map is not in classical jyotish texts.

hindi: वहां पर सरसों के तेल की शीशी रखो पीली
says: At that corner of the house, keep a yellow bottle of mustard oil as the remedy for the knee. Flagged: a health-linked remedy, recorded only as his claim.
ambiguity: 'पीली' (yellow) may describe the bottle or the oil; the planet Saturn is inferred from mustard oil and is not named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: mustard oil is classically a Saturn item; the vastu placement is his own.

gist: Says all these experiments were understood only by trying them: they work and he does not know how, and once he gets into the detail it is magic and a miracle.

hindi: बच्चा पेपर देने गया है इंटरव्यू देने गया है उसके चौथे या दसवें घर के अंदर जो प्लेनेट बैठा पावर फुली उसका धागा डाल दिया
says: For a child going to an exam or interview, take the planet that sits strongly in the 4th or 10th house and tie that planet's thread; he says the job came through.
cells_derived_method: Take the strongest planet in the 4th or 10th and use its thread colour: red for Mars, yellow for Jupiter, blue or black for Saturn. Dignity in the sign marks which planet is 'powerful'.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, exalted Mars (2nd and 7th lord) in the 4th is the powerful planet, so a red thread.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, exalted Saturn (lagna and 2nd lord) in the 10th is the powerful planet, so a blue or black thread.
Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Jupiter (9th and 12th lord) in the 4th is the powerful planet, so a yellow thread.

ambiguity: 'पावर फुली' is read as strongly placed or in strength; he does not define strong. Colour per planet is my reading of the standard scheme.
classical_check: Silent: threads for exams and interviews are not classical.

hindi: सिर्फ कलाई प यह कलाई का हिस्सा है उसकी जॉब लग गई पता नहीं कैसे लग गई
says: For the job thread, the thread goes only on the wrist, and he says the child then got the job though he does not know how.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: यही शत्रु स्थान है कोर्ट जा रहे हैं यहां का पॉजिटिव धागा राइट पैर में डाल के जाओ आप हार नहीं सकते
says: For a court case, the enemy house (6th) is the one to look at: take the positive thread of the planet there and tie it on the right foot, and he says you cannot lose.
cells_derived_method: Use the planet that sits in the 6th and tie its colour thread on the right foot before the court visit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars in its own sign (lagna and 6th lord) in the 6th: a red thread on the right foot.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, exalted Jupiter (2nd and 11th lord) in the 6th: a yellow thread on the right foot.
Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Mercury (3rd and 6th lord) in the 6th: a green thread on the right foot.

ambiguity: 'शत्रु स्थान' is taken as the 6th house; the sentence 'यही शत्रु स्थान है' points at a place on the chart, not a number. 'आप हार नहीं सकते' is an absolute promise and is recorded only as his statement.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 6th house is the classical house of enemies and litigation; the foot thread is his own.

gist: Fragment 'जीतो ना हो सकता है ऐसा हो सकता है जीतो ना ग्रह नेगेटिव है लेकिन' is garbled and cut at the slice end, only hinting that the planet may be negative yet still win.
Audience question: does a planet give more result by house (bhava) or by the lagna chart, by chalit.

hindi: ग्रह चलित से देता है लगन से देता है भगवान
says: He answers that the planet gives its result by the lagna chart (rashi placement), not by the chalit or bhava chart.
ambiguity: The first words are garbled ('ग्रह चलित से देता है' is the repeated question). 'भगवान' is a filler. The answer 'लगन से' is clear.
classical_check: Disagrees in part: many classical authors give bhava-chalit priority for house results; Parashari practice uses rashi placement for most results.

gist: Shows a chart on screen and says he does not know whose lagna chart it is.

hindi: तीन नंबर का लगन है तीन डिग्री है तो कम डिग्री है य तीन नंबर नहीं दो नंबर भी काम कर रहा है तीन के साथ दो नंबर काम कर रहा है
says: In this chart the lagna is in sign 3 at only 3 degrees; since the degree is low, sign 2 is also working along with sign 3, so the first house is shared between the two signs.
cells_derived_method: A lagna at a low degree of its sign also draws on the sign before it; a lagna at a high degree draws on the next sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries at a low degree also works with Pisces, so Mars and Jupiter both colour the first house.
Derived: lagna Libra at a low degree also works with Virgo, so Venus and Mercury both colour the first house.

ambiguity: I read 'तीन नंबर' as sign 3 (Gemini) and the second sign as 2 (Taurus). The garbled start 'अबे तीन नंबर का लगन है' makes the numbers slightly uncertain.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts treat lagna degree and sandhi (sign boundary) as important; the two-sign sharing is his own.

hindi: ये डिग्री है तीन नंबर अलग चार्ट होता है ऐसा होता है डिग्री का
says: The degree of each planet gives a separate chart of its own: where a planet's degree falls decides which neighbouring sign it also touches.
ambiguity: The caption is broken; 'तीन नंबर अलग चार्ट' may refer to the sign-3 lagna or to a degree chart. Reading is partly inferred.
classical_check: Silent: a separate chart built only from degrees is not found in classical texts.

hindi: अब ये चार नंबर का केतु दिख रहा है
says: Ketu is seen in sign 4 at 9 degrees; with the neighbouring signs working there as well, the influence slides gradually from one sign to the next as the degrees move.
ambiguity: The caption 'य दो नंबर काम कर रहा तो य तीन करेगा' is broken, and 'धीरे धीरे करते करते धारा आ जाती है' is read as the influence arriving gradually. Sign 4 is read as Cancer.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts.

hindi: बृहस्पति उच्च का क रहा है करोड़ों और पति बनाऊंगा
says: Exalted Jupiter says it will make the person a multi-millionaire, a wealth promise. Flagged: a money claim, recorded only as his statement and not as financial advice.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Jupiter in Cancer carries the wealth promise; the house it sits in decides which area of life gets it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, exalted Jupiter (7th and 10th lord) in the 2nd: the wealth promise falls on money and family.
Derived: lagna Virgo, exalted Jupiter (4th and 7th lord) in the 11th: the wealth promise falls on gains.

ambiguity: The sign is inferred: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer and Ketu was just named in sign 4, so the pair is placed together in Cancer. The words 'क रहा है' are garbled and read as 'says'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: exalted Jupiter classically gives wealth and status; 'multi-millionaire' is his own wording.

hindi: केतु क कंगला करूंगा कंगला बिल्कुल कंगला होगा आदमी
says: Ketu, in the same place, says it will make the person a pauper, completely penniless, the opposite of the Jupiter promise. Flagged: a money claim, recorded only as his statement.
ambiguity: The sign is inferred from the earlier 'चार नंबर का केतु'. 'केतु क' is garbled and read as 'Ketu says'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is classically a karaka of loss and detachment from material gain; the pauper wording is his own.

gist: Says this is how the system works: two planets in one place pull in opposite directions, so a person with exalted Jupiter and Ketu together gets both outcomes.

hindi: शुक्र नीच का बैठा है यहां पर कायदे से 16 डिग्री है
says: Venus is sitting debilitated here, and by the rule its degree is 16, which he reads as how strongly the debilitation works.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Venus in Virgo; the house it sits in decides which area of life carries the weak Venus result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Venus (2nd and 9th lord) in the lagna: weakness in speech, money and fortune themes tied to the self.
Derived: lagna Pisces, debilitated Venus (3rd and 8th lord) in the 7th: weak Venus on partnership themes.

ambiguity: The sentence ends in a stray '3' where the slice stops, and what 16 degrees means (strength or the Venus mid-point) is not explained. Virgo is inferred from 'नीच का' for Venus.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus is debilitated in Virgo by classical rule (deepest at 27 degrees); the 16-degree remark is not classical.

hindi: डिग्री का लगन है पीछे की राशि पांच नंबर काम कर रही है
says: He says the lagna in this chart sits at a low degree, so the sign just behind the lagna sign also works inside the first house, and the caption names that earlier sign as number 5. The 1st house is therefore read as two signs, a main one and a minor one behind it, not as one sign.
cells_derived_method: When the lagna degree is early in its sign, the 1st bhava reaches back into the previous sign, so the 1st house carries a main share from the rising sign and a minor share from the earlier sign. A planet sitting late in that earlier sign is judged as a 1st-house planet, and its 12th-house reading fades. The closer the lagna is to 0 degrees, the bigger the earlier sign's share.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo at a low degree, so Leo (sign 5) behind it also works in the 1st. A planet in Virgo in the 1st reads as Mercury-style practical self, coloured by a minor Leo share of pride and need for authority.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. A planet in the last degrees of Leo is nominally in the 12th, but with a low-degree lagna it is pulled into the 1st, so its Leo-Sun traits show on body and personality and not only as expenses or loss.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini at a low degree, as in the chart under discussion. A planet in late Taurus is in the 12th in D1 but acts from the 1st in chalit, so Taurus matters (Venus values, money, stubbornness) show in the self.

ambiguity: The sign number 'पांच' may be a mis-caption: the earlier slice of this chart has lagna 3 (Gemini) with sign 2 (Taurus) working behind it, while number 5 is Leo, the Sun's sign. The principle (low degree pulls the earlier sign in) is clear; which sign is behind is not.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: bhava chalit (Sripati) moves planets between houses when the lagna degree is early or late. Classical texts do not phrase it as 'two signs work in one house', but the effect is the same.

hindi: सूर्य पावर पकड़ लेगा धेला नहीं नास पीटने देगा इसके
says: For the chart on screen he says the Sun will take hold of power and authority and will not let even a paisa of it be ruined for this native. In other words the Sun protects the native's resources and standing, even though a different problem (studies) is about to be named.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's protective strength depends on dignity and house: strongest in Leo (own) and Aries (exalted), in the 10th, 9th, 2nd or 11th; weak in Libra (debilitated) and in the 6th, 8th and 12th. 'Power and money kept safe' reads best from the 10th, 9th, 2nd and 11th houses; a Sun in the 12th or 8th would not give that protection.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer). Authority, official position and savings are held firmly; the strongest form of his claim.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius). Power comes through fortune, father and government links; savings are guarded.
Derived, not said by him: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio). The protective claim fails; losses, expenses and loss of status are likelier, the opposite of what he says.

ambiguity: 'पावर पकड़ लेगा' could mean the Sun gains authority or simply becomes strong; 'धेला' is a tiny coin, so he means no money is lost. The Sun's link to the previous sentence's sign 5 (Leo) is suggested but not said.
classical_check: Silent on this exact phrase; agrees with the general idea that a strong Sun gives authority and protects status.

hindi: लेकिन पढ़ाई में एक साल फेल होगा ये व्यक्ति
says: He predicts, for this chart, that despite the Sun's protection the native will fail one year in studies, which sets up the 4th and 5th house explanation that follows.
cells_derived_method: Study failure is read from the 4th (basic schooling) and 5th (intellect, exams) houses, their lords, Mercury and Jupiter. A malefic such as Mars in or aspecting the 4th or 5th, or a debilitated planet there, can cost a year; the dasha of the afflicted planet shows when. Which sign sits in the house changes the kind of difficulty.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 4th house (lagna Gemini). Weak school-level foundation; a lost year is plausible if the dasha runs during exams.
Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 5th house (lagna Virgo). Sharp, competitive mind, but anger and haste in exams; failure only when the dasha is adverse.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo). Mars in the 4th disturbs home peace and concentration, so study results suffer in Mars periods.

ambiguity: This sentence gives no cause; the next sentences link it to the 4th and 5th houses and to Mars in the lagna in chalit. It is a case prediction, not a general rule.
classical_check: Agrees that the 4th and 5th houses show education; a failed year is a chart-specific claim and classical texts give no such rule.

gist: Audience member asks how studies come into this reading at all; he answers that they will come in, and the explanation follows.

hindi: चौथा घर पढ़ाई होता है चौथा और पांचवा पढ़ाई होता है
says: He fixes the houses for studies: the 4th house is the house of studies, and the 4th and 5th together are used when judging studies. He does not separate school from higher learning in this sentence.
cells_derived_method: Each of these houses is touched by two or three signs, so the learning style depends on the signs and planets there: Mercury signs give analytical and commercial study, Jupiter signs law, teaching and philosophy, Mars signs technical subjects. The 4th's lord shows schooling and the 5th's lord shows exam performance and intellect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury's sign in the 4th house (lagna Pisces). Schooling runs through language, commerce and mathematics; a planet here shapes the school years.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter's sign in the 5th house (lagna Leo). Intellect leans to law, philosophy and teaching; exam results are good if Jupiter is placed well.
Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 5th house (lagna Cancer). Research, investigation and science or medicine leaning; intense but private learning with exam stress.
Derived, not said by him: Aquarius in the 4th house (lagna Scorpio). Technology, systems and large institutions shape the education.

classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is vidya bhava (basic education) and the 5th is buddhi and higher learning in Parashari texts.

hindi: अब पंगा क्या है यह है लगन कुंडली में मंगल यहां नहीं मंगल बैठा लगन में यहां 12वां एक्चुअली वो लगन में भी है ये हो गई चलित कुंडली
says: He explains the catch in this chart: in the rashi (lagna) chart Mars is shown in the 12th house, but because the lagna is at a low degree Mars also falls inside the 1st house in the chalit chart. So Mars has to be read as a lagna planet in chalit even though D1 puts it in the 12th.
cells_derived_method: A planet in the 12th in D1 that lies within the 1st bhava zone moves to the 1st in chalit (the lagna degree being low). Mars in the 1st gives heat, drive and temper, and aspects the 4th (home, education), 7th (partner) and 8th, so the 4th house of studies gets hit. In the 12th the same Mars would give expenses, lost sleep and foreign links instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in Taurus in the 12th (lagna Gemini). In chalit it moves into the 1st and aspects the 4th, Virgo, the house of education.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Leo in the 12th (lagna Virgo). Pulled into the 1st in chalit: bold, hot-tempered body energy, aspecting the 4th, Sagittarius, home and schooling.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Aquarius in the 12th (lagna Pisces). In chalit in the 1st: restrained but irritable energy, aspecting the 4th, Gemini, learning and communication.

ambiguity: 'यहां' may point at the rashi chart or the chalit chart; the sign Mars occupies is not named. 'मंगल यहां नहीं' is read as 'Mars is not in the lagna in D1'.
classical_check: Agrees: planets can change bhava between the rashi and bhava-chalit charts, and classical texts support using chalit for house results.

hindi: अब चलित भी काम करेगी यह भी करेगी काम ये दोनों ही करेंगी
says: He says the chalit chart does not replace the rashi chart: chalit will work, the rashi chart will also work, and both operate together on the same person.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual practice that the rashi chart gives sign effects and chalit gives house results, so both are used.

hindi: अभी आपके अपने एक्सपीरियंस से आपने देखना है कि भाई क्या करेगा
says: He says there is no fixed formula for how much weight each chart gets: the student must judge from their own experience what the rashi and chalit charts will each actually deliver in a given case.
ambiguity: 'क्या करेगा' is vague: it may mean which chart takes precedence or what the planet itself will do.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no weighting between the rashi and chalit charts, and he leaves it to experience.

hindi: अब इसमें निर भाव चलित होता है केपी कुंडली भी होती है वो थोड़ी सी अलग है
says: He lists the other chart types that sit beside the rashi chart: the bhava chalit chart, and the KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) chart, which he says is a little different from the others.
ambiguity: 'निर भाव चलित' is garbled; it is probably 'nirayana bhava chalit' or the Sripati bhava chalit.
classical_check: Bhava chalit is classical (Sripati); KP is a 20th-century system by K. S. Krishnamurti and is not in classical texts.

gist: He says KP is another story and drama; we will only look at what the KP chart does for information, and it gives no practical benefit in today's discussion.
He defends KP: it is not something casually invented, and Krishnamurti was a godlike astrologer whose method deserves respect.
Says each master's method comes out of his own experience, just as Gautam's own approach came from experience in life; the sentence runs on into the next slice.

hindi: देखा है कि मैं अब पर्सनली देखूंगा तो तीन नंबर लगन और दो नंबर लगन दोनों इकट्ठा खोपड़ी में घुमा करके कुंडली देख के बताऊंगा
says: He says that from his own experience, when he reads a chart personally he takes lagna 3 (Gemini) and lagna 2 (Taurus) together, rotating the whole kundli once for each of them in his head, and only then gives the answer.
cells_derived_method: With a low-degree lagna the 1st house is shared between a main sign (Gemini) and a minor sign behind it (Taurus). Read the chart twice, once with Gemini as lagna and once with Taurus as lagna; every planet then has two house numbers. Conclusions that hold in both readings are firm; ones that differ are partial.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in Leo is in the 3rd from Gemini lagna (effort, siblings) and in the 4th from Taurus lagna (home, studies); both readings are held together.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Sagittarius is in the 7th from Gemini (marriage, partners) and the 8th from Taurus (sudden events, joint money).
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Aquarius is in the 9th from Gemini (fortune, dharma) and the 10th from Taurus (career, status).

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर लगन' and 'दो नंबर लगन' are taken as sign numbers Gemini and Taurus, matching the previous slice, where lagna 3 has sign 2 also working.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts name one lagna. Reading two lagnas in turn is his own practice and fits the project rule that houses are multi-sign.

hindi: मैं एक से बताऊंगा ही नहीं सवाल ही नहीं उठता
says: He rules out judging from a single lagna: when the lagna house is shared by more than one sign he will never give an answer from only one of them, and the question does not even arise.
cells_derived_method: Applies to every house that is shared by two signs: each affected house has to be read once per sign that touches it, and a result from one sign alone is incomplete. Which sign is minor depends on whether the lagna degree is early (earlier sign joins) or late (next sign joins).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries at a late degree, so the 1st house shares Aries and Taurus and the 7th shares Libra and Scorpio. Judging marriage from Libra alone would miss the Scorpio share (Mars, Ketu and Uranus style intensity).

Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio at an early degree, so the 10th reaches back into Cancer as well as Leo. Career read from Leo alone would miss the Moon-ruled Cancer share (public dealing, care professions).

classical_check: Differs from standard teaching, which reads each house from one sign; agrees with the project rule that houses are multi-sign.

hindi: अगर यहां तीन राशि काम कर रही तो तीनों की कुंडली दिमाग में घूमेगी
says: He extends the method: where three signs work in the same house, he rotates the kundli for all three lagna signs one after another in his head, so three readings are combined and not just two.
cells_derived_method: A house touches three signs when it is longer than 30 degrees (unequal-house systems such as chalit and KP) or when its edges fall in the neighbouring signs. Run the chart once per sign, then weigh the three results by each sign's share of degrees in the house. The opposite house shifts the same way.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: if the 1st house covers Taurus, Gemini and Cancer, the chart is read three times, taking Taurus, Gemini and Cancer each as the rising sign in turn, and the answers are blended.

Derived, not said by him: with Gemini lagna the 10th is Pisces, and a three-sign 10th would also take in Aquarius and Aries; career reads through Saturn style structure, Jupiter style guidance and Mars style drive together.

Derived, not said by him: with Gemini lagna the 7th is Sagittarius, and a three-sign 7th would also take in Scorpio and Capricorn; the partner shows traits of all three, intense, philosophical and practical.

ambiguity: 'यहां' does not say whether this is the lagna house only or any house; the following sentences suggest chalit and KP houses in general.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts, which assign one sign per house; consistent with unequal-house systems where a house can span three signs.

hindi: सर चलित में अलग आ गया है अब वो एक नई कुंडली है के लगन चेंज करके पूरा कुंडली घुमा दी
says: He says that when the chalit chart gives a different lagna sign from the rashi chart it is effectively a new kundli: the lagna has changed, so the whole chart is turned around, every planet gets a new house number, and it is read afresh.
cells_derived_method: If chalit moves the lagna back by one sign (for example Gemini to Taurus), every planet's house number goes up by one; if it moves forward, every number goes down by one. So each planet's house topics change across the whole chart and not only for the planet that moved.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in Leo is in the 3rd from Gemini lagna but the 4th from Taurus lagna, so effort and siblings turn into home and studies.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Capricorn is in the 8th from Gemini lagna (sudden events) but the 9th from Taurus lagna (fortune and dharma), a big change of meaning.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in Taurus is in the 12th from Gemini lagna but in the 1st from Taurus lagna, so expenses become self and body.

ambiguity: The opening words 'सर चलित में अलग आ गया है' look like an audience remark mixed into his sentence, and 'के लगन चेंज करके' is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees with the chalit idea that house placement can differ from the rashi chart; calling it a new kundli is his own phrasing.

hindi: अब इसी में केपी भी घुमानी भी अब य केपी कुंडली कृष्ण मूर्ति पद्धति इसमें तीन नंबर का लगन है
says: He adds the KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) chart to the same rotation: in this chart's KP version the lagna is sign 3 (Gemini), so KP is also turned and read along with the rashi and chalit charts.
cells_derived_method: KP uses unequal cusps and star-lord and sub-lord rules, so its lagna sign can differ from D1. Here the KP lagna is Gemini, the same as D1, so KP agrees on the rising sign and differs only in which planets fall in which house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with Gemini lagna in the KP chart, a planet in Cancer sits in the 2nd (money, speech), judged also through its star-lord and sub-lord.
Derived, not said by him: with Gemini lagna in the KP chart, a planet in Aries sits in the 11th (gains, friends), and a KP cusp shift could move it to the 12th or keep it.

ambiguity: 'घुमानी भी' is garbled; 'तीन नंबर का लगन' is taken as sign 3 (Gemini), consistent with the earlier slice.
classical_check: KP is a modern system (1960s) using Placidus-style cusps and sub-lords; it is not in classical texts.

hindi: चलित में तीन तीन राशि दो जग आ गई य तीन है तीन है चार पा 6 सा
says: He says that in this person's chalit chart three signs have come into two places, meaning two houses carry three signs each, and the caption lists the signs working as 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, with sign 8 missing next.
cells_derived_method: none: the sentence only lists sign numbers for this one chart and gives no house numbers, so no house-by-sign mapping can be derived from it.
ambiguity: The caption 'चार पा 6 सा' is garbled; 'पा' and 'सा' are probably 5 and 7. It is not clear which two houses carry three signs.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give one sign per house; three signs in a house arises in unequal-house systems.

hindi: आठ नंबर है ही नहीं आठ नंबर की राशि गायब है इस व्यक्ति की आठ नंबर की राशि काम ही नहीं कर रही
says: He says sign 8 (Scorpio) is simply absent from this person's chalit houses: no house is touched by Scorpio, so that sign does not work at all for this person.
cells_derived_method: A sign wholly hidden inside a house, never forming a house boundary, is treated as inactive in his method. Planets sitting in that sign give no house result of that sign's nature, and sign-based dosha such as debilitation in it does not apply. Which houses lose a sign depends on the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Gemini lagna, where Scorpio would be the 6th. If Scorpio is missing, the 6th is built only from Libra and Sagittarius shares, so a planet in Scorpio is not read through the 6th topics of debt and disease.

Derived, not said by him: Aquarius lagna, where Scorpio would be the 10th. If Scorpio is missing, career is read from the neighbouring Libra and Sagittarius shares and not from Scorpio's Mars-style intensity.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर' is read as sign 8 (Scorpio) rather than the 8th house, because the next sentence talks about the Moon's debilitation in sign 8.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts never describe a missing or intercepted sign; it is a feature of unequal-house systems.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा नीच का होता है आठ में वरुण खराब करता है आठ में
says: He states the two reasons sign 8 (Scorpio) is a problem sign: the Moon is debilitated there, and Varuna (Neptune) also does damage there.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Moon in Scorpio gives emotional turbulence, secrecy and mind or mother troubles, and the house decides the area it hits. Neptune in the same sign adds confusion and anxiety in that area. How hard it lands also depends on cancellation of the debilitation, which he does not discuss here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo). Disturbed peace of mind and home; trouble with the mother's side.
Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 10th house (lagna Aquarius). Unsteady career and a swinging public image.
Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). Hidden fears and sudden emotional upheavals; the placement is heavy but inward.

ambiguity: 'आठ में' means sign 8 here because he has just said 'आठ नंबर की राशि'; for Varuna it could also mean the 8th house.
classical_check: Moon debilitated in Scorpio agrees with classical texts; Neptune is not in classical astrology, so that part is his own.

hindi: अब यहां वरुण और चंद्रमा होते तो कुंडली में दोष ही नहीं है वो जिंदगी में दोष ही नहीं है उस बंदे के
says: He argues that even with Varuna and the Moon placed in sign 8, there is no dosha in this kundli and none in the man's life, because sign 8 does not work in his houses. A sign-level debilitation is cancelled when the sign has no house.
cells_derived_method: Under this principle a sign-based fault, such as Moon debilitated in Scorpio, is checked against the chalit house-sign map first; it stands only if the sign has a share in some house. The houses decide which signs are live.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Scorpio with Gemini lagna. If Scorpio has no house share in chalit, the debilitation does not act, and the 6th shows no emotional-health or debt trouble from it.
Derived, not said by him: Neptune in Scorpio with Sagittarius lagna. If Scorpio is not a working sign, the confusion and sleep or expense problems expected from it in the 12th do not appear.

ambiguity: 'होते तो' may be conditional ('if they were there') or a statement that they are there; either way the claim is that a planet in a non-working sign creates no dosha.
classical_check: Differs from classical Jyotish, where Moon in Scorpio is debilitated by sign regardless of house shares, apart from neecha-bhanga cancellation.

hindi: और वो दिखा रहे है कि नीच का चंद्रमा है ये ऐसे अजीब अजीब कहानियां है
says: He criticizes other astrologers who, reading only the rashi chart, announce a debilitated Moon in this person's chart; he calls such readings strange stories because, in his view, the sign never even works in the houses.
cells_derived_method: none: a criticism of D1-only reading; the working rule is in the previous sentence.
ambiguity: 'वो' is not identified; it is read as other astrologers or software showing the rashi chart.
classical_check: Differs from usual practice of calling Moon in Scorpio debilitated straight from the rashi chart; neecha-bhanga rules could also answer his example.

hindi: 10 गुण वाली लड़की से शादी हुई है लड़के से घर बस गया 25 वाले से तलाक हो
says: He gives a contrast to show that guna scores do not predict marriage: a boy married a girl matched on only 10 gunas and the home is settled, while another couple matched on 25 gunas ended in divorce.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the slice boundary ('तलाक हो' continues as 'गया' next); the numbers 10 and 25 are taken as Ashtakoota points out of 36.
classical_check: Differs from the classical Ashtakoota rule, where 18 of 36 is the pass mark and higher scores count as better; he argues from observed cases.

gist: Calls the 10-versus-25 gunas outcome a mess, asks whether one should believe in gunas or not, and says he will not take up the guna story now.

Describes a common scene: kundlis get matched, a problem is written or told, yet people later go to a pandit and blame the first man as a cheat ('only 15 gunas matched, how did you get the marriage done').
Says that is why he says no to such matching requests, tells people to go by their own reckoning, and calls it very difficult.

hindi: क्योंकि शादी ब्याह में सुख ढूंढने के लिए आपके ग्रह में सुख होना चाहिए तब मिलता है अन्यथा नहीं
says: He gives his reason: happiness in marriage can be found only if the happiness is already present in your own planets; if your own chart lacks it, no spouse and no guna score will supply it.
cells_derived_method: Marital happiness is read from the native's own chart: the 7th house and its lord, Venus (men) or Jupiter (women) as karaka, and the 2nd and 4th houses for family and home peace, each across all the signs that touch them. A chart with these afflicted does not promise happiness whatever the match score.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Venus's own sign Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries). Placement supports marital harmony and a pleasant partner.
Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra). Passionate but argumentative partner; Mars's sign puts a hot-tempered note on the marriage.
Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo). Domestic peace is tested by intensity and secrecy at home.

ambiguity: 'आपके ग्रह में सुख' is loosely worded; it may mean planets of the 7th house or the whole chart's promise of happiness.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Parashari texts judge marriage from the native's own 7th house, its lord and the karakas, treating Ashtakoota as a secondary check.

hindi: तो यह कुंडली इनका उत्तर यह है कि चलित भी चलेगा केपी भी चलेगी सब घुमाना पड़ेगा एक से नहीं होगा
says: Returning to the questioner's chart, he gives the answer: rashi, chalit and KP all have to be run, every chart has to be rotated and judged, and one chart alone will not do.
ambiguity: 'इनका उत्तर' refers to a questioner's chart from earlier, with Mars in chalit lagna and sign 8 missing; he is answering how to read it.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice of reading mainly the rashi chart; matches the project rule that every house in every chart is judged.

gist: Moderator remarks that two questions got mixed into that one and asks to take the next question.
Question read out: when a woman has excessive hair on her face, what is the planetary reason?

hindi: तो उसका प्रॉब्लम बुध से रिलेटेड है उसका टेस्टोस्टेरोन का लफड़ा है
says: He answers that excessive facial hair in a woman is a Mercury-related problem and a testosterone (hormone) imbalance. This is a medical statement as he made it, recorded as his tradition claim and not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: In the tradition Mercury governs skin, hair, nerves and glands, so a Mars-afflicted or Mars-sign Mercury, and the house it occupies, would be checked; face and head areas map to the 1st and 2nd houses. A clean Mercury in Virgo or Gemini would not show the pattern. Tradition-style reading only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Mars's sign Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries). Face and head carry Mars-heat on Mercury, the pattern he describes becomes plausible.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra). The 2nd is the face and Mercury sits in Mars's sign, a face-related Mercury affliction.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in own and exalted sign Virgo in the 1st house (lagna Virgo). Strong, clean Mercury; the pattern is not expected.

ambiguity: 'बुध से रिलेटेड' does not say whether Mercury is weak or afflicted; the testosterone link is his own add-on.
classical_check: Mercury as significator of skin and glands is classical; the testosterone link is a modern gloss.

hindi: और उसका जो स्वाधिष्ठान है वो डिस्टर्ब है स्वाधिष्ठान का हिसाब किताब है
says: He adds that in such a person the Swadhisthana (sacral chakra) is disturbed, and the matter has to be worked out through the Swadhisthana's own accounting in the chart. This is a chakra claim from tradition, not a medical one.
cells_derived_method: none: this sentence does not say which house or sign carries the Swadhisthana; the next sentence points to planets in it and to sign 12.
ambiguity: The chakra-to-house mapping is not given here, and 'हिसाब किताब है' is vague about what has to be computed.
classical_check: Chakras are tantric and yogic, not part of Parashari texts; his mapping of chakras to the chart is his own.

hindi: स्वाधिष्ठान में देखना पड़ेगा उसका जो कौन से ग्रह बैठे हुए वहा पर न और 12 नंबर राशियों में क्या डिस्टरबेंस है बृहस्पति और केतु में क्या डिस्टरबेंस है
says: He gives the checking procedure: look at the Swadhisthana and see which planets sit there, then see what disturbance there is in sign 12 (Pisces, whose planets in his scheme are Jupiter and Ketu), that is, what is wrong with Jupiter and Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Pisces is the Jupiter and Ketu sign, so affliction of those two is read through the house Pisces falls in, which decides the life area the disturbance reaches. The planets sitting in the Swadhisthana are checked alongside it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 1st house (lagna Pisces). Jupiter and Ketu affliction shows in body and temperament.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 6th house (lagna Libra). Disturbance reaches health, debts and daily service.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries). Disturbance shows in sleep, expenses and hidden matters.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर राशियों' is read as sign 12 (Pisces); why the Swadhisthana maps to sign 12 is not explained in this slice.
classical_check: Pisces under Jupiter is classical; Ketu as co-lord and the chakra link are modern and his own.

hindi: उसकी वजह से होगा टेस्टोस्टेरोन बढ़ने से होता य फेशियल र ज्यादा आ जाते कोई ब ल मैस्टी आ जाती नेचर में
says: He says that disturbance is what raises testosterone, and the raised testosterone is what brings more facial hair and some masculine quality into the person's nature. A health claim recorded as he said it, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'कोई ब ल मैस्टी' is garbled and is probably 'masculinity' or 'muscularity'.
classical_check: Silent: hormones are not classical; this is a modern gloss on the Mercury and chakra claims.

hindi: उसकी वजह से होता है तीसरे घर में दबंगी के ग्रह पड़े होंगे पराक्रम स्थान में
says: He adds a chart marker for such a case: the 3rd house, the house of prowess, will have domineering, aggressive planets placed in it, and that is behind the masculine pattern.
cells_derived_method: 'Dabangi' planets are the natural malefics and fiery planets such as Mars, Sun, Saturn and Rahu. In the 3rd the sign they sit in changes how it shows: fire and Mars signs give open bossiness, water signs give hidden willpower, Saturn signs give cold disciplined dominance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius). Open, forceful, physically assertive nature.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 3rd house (lagna Virgo). Hidden, intense willpower rather than loud dominance.
Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 3rd house (lagna Scorpio). Tough, disciplined courage, the strongest dabangi form.

ambiguity: The sentence starts with 'उसकी वजह से होता है', so it is unclear whether the 3rd-house planets are a cause or only a sign of the pattern.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts make the 3rd the house of courage and Mars, Saturn and Sun do well there; linking it to masculine traits in a woman is his own claim.

hindi: ये तीसरा घर है पराक्रम स्थान
says: He defines the 3rd house as the parakram sthan, the place of courage, valour and personal effort.
cells_derived_method: How courage shows depends on the sign touching the 3rd: Aries, Leo and Scorpio give bold, front-line courage; Taurus, Cancer and Pisces give cautious, protective or faith-based courage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Leo in the 3rd house (lagna Gemini). Courage with a leader's pride; leads from the front.
Derived, not said by him: Cancer in the 3rd house (lagna Taurus). Protective, emotion-driven bravery, effort made for family.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 3rd house (lagna Capricorn). Diffused effort, courage through faith, hesitant in direct action.

classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is parakrama bhava in Parashari texts.

hindi: यहां बृहस्पति क्या है बूढ़ा ग्रह है गुरु है ना दाढ़ी वाला बूढ़ा बैठा हुआ है ज्ञान बाचा र है
says: He describes the Jupiter sitting in this 3rd house with a picture: Jupiter is the old planet, the guru, a bearded old man sitting there as a preacher of knowledge.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in the 3rd gives a talker-teacher: more advice than action, since the courage and effort house receives wisdom and not drive. The sign sets the style of the preaching.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 3rd house (lagna Libra). Teaching and advising through writing and speech; effort takes the form of words.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries). Preaching through media and messages; wide but shallow knowledge.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 3rd house (lagna Scorpio). The wise-old-man image is weakened; knowledge is dry and doubted.

ambiguity: 'यहां' does not name the house; the 3rd is assumed from the previous sentences. 'ज्ञान बाचा र है' is garbled, probably 'gyan pracharak' or 'gyan bachak'.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the karaka of wisdom, guru and elders; the bearded old man image is his own.

hindi: ये महा सुस्त है महा आलसी आदमी होगा
says: He says this Jupiter, placed in the 3rd, makes the person extremely sluggish and a very lazy man; the house of courage and effort loses its drive under Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in the 3rd lowers the house's drive, and the sign decides how lazy: fire signs keep some drive from Mars, Sun or Jupiter's own energy, while earth and water signs sink into comfort.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius). Mars energy keeps some drive; the laziness is the mildest.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Taurus in the 3rd house (lagna Pisces). Comfort-loving and slow to start; the laziest form.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 3rd house (lagna Capricorn). Dreamy, spiritual inaction instead of effort.

classical_check: Partly agrees: several classical sources link Jupiter in the 3rd with low initiative and few brothers.

hindi: महान उच्च का बृहस्पति है महान इसके इसको अवार्ड दिया जा सकता है आलसी होने में
says: He jokes that this Jupiter is exalted and so is great at laziness: it deserves an award for being lazy. Exaltation here does not rescue the 3rd house's effort; it is said to deepen the sluggish, wise-talker pattern.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Jupiter in Cancer is the same planet in other houses with a different result: in kendra or trikona houses it gives protection and honour, and in the 3rd he says it amplifies laziness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: exalted Jupiter in the 9th house (lagna Scorpio). Fortune and dharma are protected; no laziness reading.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Jupiter in the 10th house (lagna Libra). Strong authority and a good name, a Hamsa-yoga style placement.

ambiguity: He says 'उच्च का बृहस्पति' without the sign; Cancer is inferred, and the 3rd house comes from the earlier sentences. The award line is partly a joke.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat exaltation as strengthening results; he says it amplifies laziness here.

hindi: ऐ ऐसा ज ग्रह चलेगा पर एक नालायक आलसी है वो है शनि अगर शनि यहां बैठा तो धीरे-धीरे खिसक रहा है
says: He contrasts the two lazy planets: Jupiter's laziness is acceptable because it is knowledgeable, but the truly useless lazy one is Saturn; if Saturn sits in this place the person just crawls along slowly.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 3rd varies by sign: debilitated in Aries it is the slow frustrated crawl he describes; exalted in Libra or own in Capricorn and Aquarius slowness turns into steady endurance, against his lazy label.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius). Frustrated, stalled effort, the closest match to his crawl.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 3rd house (lagna Leo). Methodical, patient effort; slowness is endurance.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 3rd house (lagna Scorpio). Persistent hard work, the opposite of lazy.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is taken as the 3rd house. The first clause 'ये ऐसा ज ग्रह चलेगा' is garbled and read as 'this kind of planet (Jupiter) is acceptable'.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat Saturn in the 3rd as favourable (an upachaya house where persistence gives courage), so calling it useless laziness is his own view.

hindi: ये ज्ञानी आलसी है ये सोई सोई ज्ञान की बात करेगा रजाई में से मुह निकाल के और काम हो गया
says: He sums up the Jupiter-type lazy person: a learned lazy man who will lie there and talk wisdom with his face poking out of the quilt, and yet somehow the work gets done.
cells_derived_method: In the 3rd, Jupiter shows work done by instructing, arranging and communicating instead of doing; the sign shows the style of that delegation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries). Work done by writing, calls and messages from bed.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 3rd house (lagna Libra). Lecturing and preaching replace physical work.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 3rd house (lagna Sagittarius). Work gets done by delegating through systems and groups.

ambiguity: 'और काम हो गया' may mean the work does get done anyway, or it is sarcasm that it is done only by talk.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe this image; it is his own.

gist: Audience asks: a debilitated planet sits in the fortune house and there is also a debilitated aspect on it, so will his fortune support him in his work?

hindi: बृहस्पति की कहानी तो निराली है वो नीच के स्थान को भी नष्ट करके भी नहीं आने देता उच्च के स्थान में बैठ के भी वहां का नाश पीट देता है ये चलने नहीं देता किसी की
says: Answering the fortune question, he says Jupiter's story is unique: it wrecks whatever it touches, whether the place is weak and debilitated or strong. Even sitting in an exalted place it destroys that place's matters and lets nobody's affairs there run.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's sitting in or aspecting a house reduces that house's matters. Jupiter in the 3rd aspects the 7th, 9th and 11th, so the fortune house is spoiled by the aspect irrespective of the debilitated planet in it. In its own sign it can still spoil the house it signifies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign in the 5th house (lagna Leo). By his logic children and learning matters are delayed or spoiled although the sign is strong.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Jupiter in the 3rd house (lagna Taurus) aspects the 7th Scorpio, 9th Capricorn and 11th Pisces, so marriage, fortune and gains are reduced by his claim.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus). Fortune and dharma are doubly weakened, by debilitation and by his rule.

ambiguity: Several words are garbled ('नष्ट करके भी नहीं आने देता', 'किसी की'). The link to the 9th house and Jupiter's aspect comes from the audience question and is inferred.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat Jupiter's aspect as protective; only the narrow maxim karako bhava nashaya (a karaka in its own house harms it) comes near his claim.

hindi: पर ये व्यक्ति गुरु ये पूजा स्थान है गुरु की पूजा करेगा गुरु की फोटो मंदिर रखेगा रोएगा खून के आंसू यह नहीं कर सकता विष्णु की पूजा नहीं कर सकता
says: He says that for this person with the troublesome Jupiter, the guru and worship area is closed: he cannot worship a guru, keep a guru's photo in the home temple, or do Vishnu puja, and if he tries it ends in tears of blood. A don't, recorded as his tradition claim.
cells_derived_method: Usual remedy logic is to worship the deity of an afflicted planet; he reverses it for a Jupiter that ruins its house, since strengthening it worsens it. Where Jupiter is benefic and comfortable, worship would be normal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: exalted Jupiter in the 3rd house (lagna Taurus). By his logic extra guru or Vishnu worship would deepen the sloth and spoil the aspected houses, not relieve them.

Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 9th house (lagna Cancer). Guru worship is natural here by classical logic; his warning would apply only if this Jupiter is also a house-wrecker.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 12th house (lagna Capricorn). Spiritual practice is natural, so the prohibition would clash with the placement.

ambiguity: The caption does not make clear whether it is a prohibition or a prediction that he will do it and weep, and 'ये पूजा स्थान है' does not say which place is meant.
classical_check: Differs from classical remedies, where an afflicted Jupiter is treated with Vishnu and guru worship; he claims the opposite for this person.

gist: Next question read out: in naturopathy, which planet has to be made powerful for a person to get well?

hindi: नेचर कहां है नेचर नेचुरल नेचुरल हैबिटेशन दो ही जगह है एक स्पेस में है और एक हृदय पर
says: He answers the naturopathy question by asking where nature lives: the natural habitat has only two places, one in space (sky or ether) and one at the heart.
ambiguity: 'स्पेस' and 'हृदय' are not mapped to a house or sign here; the next sentences suggest Rahu and Neptune are involved.
classical_check: Silent: naturopathy and natural habitation are not classical categories; this is his own scheme.

hindi: यहां यूनानी और यहां आयुर्वेद यह दोनों सूट करते हैं
says: Pointing at the two places, he says Unani medicine belongs at one and Ayurveda at the other, and both suit a person who wants nature-based healing.
ambiguity: 'यहां ... यहां' are gestures at two places on the board; which of Unani or Ayurveda goes with space and which with the heart cannot be recovered from the caption.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not map medical systems to places in the chart; his own mapping.

hindi: मात्र ज्ञान चर्चा और रिलाइजेशन राहु के पास ज्ञान चर्चा और रिलाइजेशन है
says: He assigns to Rahu the things of pure knowledge-talk and realization: simply discussing knowledge and coming to realize it belongs to Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Where Rahu sits shows where the urge to discuss and realize shows up: in the 9th through philosophy, in the 5th through study, in the 12th through meditation; the sign colours the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Gemini in the 9th house (lagna Libra). Strong urge to discuss philosophy, with unorthodox beliefs; realization comes through ideas.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Aquarius in the 5th house (lagna Libra). Study of unusual subjects through research and discussion groups.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries). Meditation and solitary realization, with some escapism.

classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts tie Rahu to foreign and unorthodox knowledge, while realization and moksha are Ketu's.

hindi: इतने भर से दिल बहुत बड़ा करके टेंशन फ्री करना वरुण
says: He assigns to Varuna (Neptune) the act of making the heart very large and becoming tension-free: broad-hearted relaxation is Neptune's department.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's relaxing effect depends on where it sits: calm and large-hearted in watery or spiritual placements, anxious in the sign he calls bad for it. The house decides which area gets that ease.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Neptune in Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius). Inner peace and a large-hearted home.
Derived, not said by him: Neptune in Libra in the 6th house (lagna Taurus). Relief from worry about work and health through easy-going habits.
Derived, not said by him: Neptune in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries). By his own earlier claim Neptune spoils in sign 8, so anxiety and not relaxation.

ambiguity: The sentence ends with the word 'वरुण' and the next sentence begins 'इससे आप ऑटोमेटिक ठीक हो सकते हैं', so the split is by caption order.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not in classical Jyotish; this is his own karaka.

hindi: इससे आप ऑटोमेटिक ठीक हो सकते हैं नेचुरोपैथी सारी यहां पर है तो आपको वरुण का ध्यान देना है
says: He concludes that by this you can get well automatically, since all of naturopathy sits at this place, so the planet to attend to for naturopathy is Varuna (Neptune). Recorded as his claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is a gesture at a spot on the board, so which house or sign is meant is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune and naturopathy are outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: यानी सब जगह विजन रखने वाले यानी घर के सारे कैमरे साफ रखो चश्मे का लेंस साफ रखो मोबाइल फोन की स्क्रीन साफ रखो
says: He turns Varuna into a concrete Vastu-style remedy: since Varuna is everything that gives vision, keep all the cameras at home clean, keep spectacle lenses clean, and keep the mobile phone screen clean.
classical_check: Silent: cleaning cameras and lenses is his Vastu-linked remedy and is absent from classical texts.

hindi: चंद्रमा होता है मोबाइल का स्क्रीन
says: He assigns the mobile phone's screen to the Moon, so the screen is a Moon object (a reflecting, mind-linked surface) alongside the Varuna objects.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether the Moon link is an extra object for the same remedy or a correction of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: a phone is a modern object; the Moon's link with mirrors, water and reflecting surfaces is classical-adjacent.

gist: Repeats the instruction to keep all these things clean and in good order.

hindi: और बुध हवा के स्थान सारी खिड़की जाले साफ सुथरे रखो एकदम ठीक रहोगे लाजवाब
says: He adds Mercury as the planet of air and air-passage places: keep every window and any cobwebs clean and tidy, and then you will be perfectly fine.
classical_check: Silent: Mercury's link with air is traditional, but cleaning windows and cobwebs as a remedy is his own.

gist: Next question read out: do planets also define the religion of an individual, or is it a choice?

hindi: यस प्लेनेट ऐसे होंगे ये तो अलग हो जाएगा पूरा क्लास ही होगी इसके ऊपर
says: He first answers that yes, planets will indicate religion, then says the topic would grow into a separate subject needing a whole class of its own, so he defers the details.
ambiguity: 'यस प्लेनेट ऐसे होंगे' is garbled and may mean 'yes, planets will be such (that they show it)'.
classical_check: Agrees that faith and dharma are read from the 9th house and its lord, Jupiter and the Sun; detail is deferred.

gist: Audience asks for a short answer, citing a well-known public figure's change of religion as a use case.

hindi: इसमें ये हमारा रिलीजन का स्थान है ये नौवां घर है
says: He starts the short answer by naming the place of religion: it is the 9th house.
cells_derived_method: The style of faith depends on the sign touching the 9th: Sagittarius gives orthodox, teacher-led faith, Aquarius gives reformist or scientific views, Scorpio gives intense, secretive and transformation-driven belief.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries). Orthodox, traditional faith guided by a teacher.
Derived, not said by him: Aquarius in the 9th house (lagna Gemini). Reformist, humanitarian or scientific attitude to religion.
Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 9th house (lagna Pisces). Intense, private faith with themes of transformation and the occult.

classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is dharma bhava (religion, faith, guru, fortune).

hindi: नौवां घर है नाइंथ हाउस राशि नहीं यहां पर जो राशि बैठी है उस हिसाब से काम चलेगा
says: He says religion is read from the 9th house and not from a sign by itself; whichever sign sits in the 9th decides how the matter works out. So the 9th is judged by the sign and planet actually placed there.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house changes meaning with the sign in it: Jupiter signs give orthodox faith, Saturn signs give duty-bound or doubting faith, Mars signs give a warrior-like faith. The planet in it then colours the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries). Jupiter's sign, so faith is traditional and teacher-led.
Derived, not said by him: Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus). Saturn's sign, so religion is practised as duty and discipline, with doubt and little show.

ambiguity: 'राशि नहीं' means the sign alone does not decide, house first; it does not mean signs are irrelevant.
classical_check: Agrees that the 9th is dharma bhava; reading it through the occupying sign matches ordinary practice.

hindi: अगर आपका अच्छा ग्रह बैठा है तो आप बहुत रिलीजियस है
says: He says that if a good (benefic or strong) planet sits in the 9th house, the person is very religious.
cells_derived_method: A good planet means strong by dignity or naturally benefic. Jupiter exalted or own, Sun in Leo or Aries, or Moon in Taurus or Cancer in the 9th give the clearest religious bent; the sign sets the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio). Deep, sincere devotion and respect for teachers.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius). Strongly dharmic, proud of tradition, drawn to temple and ritual leadership.

ambiguity: 'अच्छा ग्रह' is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees: benefics in the 9th are classically a sign of piety.

hindi: अगर यहां कोई नीच का ग्रह है जैसे मेरे पास ही कई बच्चे आते हैं नीच का ग्रह है या खराब ग्रह है तो मैं कहता हूं बिलीफ तो तुम्हें यहां पे है नहीं
says: He says that when the 9th holds a debilitated or bad planet the person has no real belief; he tells young people with this placement that belief is simply absent in them.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated planets are Sun in Libra, Moon in Scorpio, Mars in Cancer, Mercury in Pisces, Jupiter in Capricorn, Venus in Virgo, Saturn in Aries. The house they fall in as 9th depends on lagna; a bad planet in the 9th weakens faith.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces). Faith is shaky and emotionally unsettled.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo). Impatient with ritual, doubts religion.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is the 9th house from the opening of this chunk; 'खराब ग्रह' is undefined.
classical_check: Partly agrees: malefics and weak planets in the 9th are classically linked to weak dharma.

gist: Tells how youths brought by parents are startled when he asks why they came; they think how did he know, and say they do not believe in such things.

hindi: यदि उसके बुध बृहस्पति दो ग्रह विशेष वक्र लिए हुए या एक भी वक्री है तो वह बहस करेगा
says: He says that if Mercury and Jupiter are retrograde, or even one of them, the person will argue and debate about religion.
cells_derived_method: Retrograde Mercury or Jupiter shows a questioning, debating mind; the house it falls in decides the topic, most clearly the 9th for belief.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury retrograde in its own sign Gemini in the 9th (lagna Libra). Argues about belief and wants proof.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter retrograde in own sign Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer). Challenges teachers and doctrine, though inwardly spiritual.

ambiguity: 'विशेष वक्र लिए हुए' is garbled for 'vakri'.
classical_check: Classical texts treat retrograde planets as strong; the argumentative link is his own.

gist: Describes telling the arguer not to come, then the reverse psychology: he insists on staying and talking, and soon goes quiet.

hindi: क्योंकि अल्टीमेट बात क्या है उसके पास लॉजिक नहीं होगा क्योंकि जुपिटर उसका गड़बड़ है
says: He explains why the arguer goes quiet: he has no real logic because his Jupiter, the planet of reasoning and wisdom, is afflicted.
ambiguity: 'गड़बड़' is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter signifies reasoning and discrimination.

hindi: अगर अस्त हो गया ग्रह अस्त मीन सोया हुआ के प्रकाश की यूं जान निकली हुई है बिल्कुल अस्तो रखा है तो वो ज्यादा बहस भी नहीं कर पाएगा दो तीन बार चिल्लाएगा फिर चुप
says: He says a combust (asta) planet is like one drained of life by the Sun's light; a person with combust Jupiter cannot sustain an argument and shouts two or three times, then falls silent.
cells_derived_method: Combustion weakens the planet in whichever house it sits; the house shows the area where the person fizzles out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter combust in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries). Little staying power in faith debates.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated and combust in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries). Starts in career with noise and lacks follow-through.

ambiguity: The caption in the middle is garbled; the planet is taken as Jupiter from the sentence before.
classical_check: Agrees that combust planets are weakened.

hindi: ऐसे कुछ लोग होते हैं इनको स्टडी कर लो अपने घर के अंदर आपके बच्चे के घर के लोग जिन जिन का जो जो ग्रह अस्त है अगर
says: He tells the class to study such people inside their own home: find which family members, including the child, have a combust planet, since they behave like the fizzling arguer.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next slice.
classical_check: Silent: a study instruction.

hindi: अस्त है मींस थोड़ी देर भ करेगा फिर चुप हो जाएगा थोड़ी देर मेहनत करेगा फिर चुप हो जाएगा
says: He spells out what a combust planet means in behaviour: the person argues or works hard for a short while and then goes quiet and stops.
cells_derived_method: The area of life follows the combust planet's house: effort that fades in studies if in the 4th or 5th, in work if in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury combust in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries). Studies start with energy and tail off.
Derived, not said by him: Venus combust in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer). Career efforts stop-start; poor stamina in creative work.

ambiguity: 'भ करेगा' is garbled, probably 'bahas'.
classical_check: Agrees that combustion reduces a planet's results.

hindi: उनको साथ लेकर चलना पड़ेगा कोई साथ चाहिए हमेशा अस्त ग्रह वाला
says: He says a person with a combust planet always needs someone alongside; you have to carry them with you, since they cannot keep going alone.
classical_check: Silent: his own behavioural reading.

hindi: नहीं तो उसके भी उपाय होंगे या स्टोन तो सेट करी स्टोन उसको बैलेंसिंग करता है
says: He says remedies exist for this too, mainly a gemstone for the combust planet, which balances it.
ambiguity: 'सेट करी' is garbled and probably means to set (wear) the stone.
classical_check: Gemstones for weak planets are traditional; for combust planets some authorities advise them.

hindi: उसका कोई लेनदेन नहीं स्टोन पहन के आप जिंदगी भर के लिए फ्री हो फ्री कोई स्यापा नहीं 100 साल की छुट्टी किसी के साथ दोबारा माथा नहीं मारना
says: He claims a stone needs no ongoing give-and-take: once worn you are free for life, with no fuss and a 100 year holiday from repeating the effort. This is a bold remedy claim, recorded as his, not advice.
ambiguity: '100 साल की छुट्टी' is hyperbole.
classical_check: Differs: traditional sources expect stones to be matched to the chart and tested, and do not promise lifelong freedom.

hindi: अब यहां पर मान लेते हैं शनि बैठा है नौवा घर है शनि बैठ गया या कोई नेगेटिव एंटी प्लेनेट बैठ गया जैसे कि चंद्रमा नीच का है बुध नीच का है राहु नीचे केतु है कोई भी
says: He sets up a case: suppose Saturn, or any negative planet, sits in the 9th, such as a debilitated Moon, a debilitated Mercury, Rahu or Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Moon is Scorpio, debilitated Mercury is Pisces; the lagna they imply for the 9th differs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in the 9th (lagna Pisces).
Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer).

ambiguity: 'राहु नीचे' may mean Rahu being low or debilitated; Rahu's debilitation is not standard.
classical_check: Moon and Mercury debilitation signs agree with classical texts.

hindi: तो इस व्यक्ति को धर्म में पूजा पाठ करने से उल्टा नुकसान होगा उल्टा नुकसान होगा तो वो ना करे तो अच्छा
says: He says such a person will be harmed in reverse by doing puja and religious rituals, so it is better that he does not do them. A don't, recorded as tradition claim.
cells_derived_method: The prohibition applies when the 9th holds negative planets; benefic or strong planets there do not carry it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in the 9th (lagna Pisces). Ritual would agitate rather than calm; he advises staying away.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius). Not a negative case by dignity, so the prohibition may not apply.

classical_check: Differs: classical remedies prescribe worship for afflicted 9th houses.

hindi: शनि है केतु है राहु है यह डिसबिलीवर बनाता है यानी भगवान में तो बिलीव ही नहीं करना मुझे
says: He says Saturn, Ketu and Rahu in the 9th make a disbeliever, a person who says he does not believe in God at all.
cells_derived_method: Disbelief is strongest where the node or Saturn is weak or debilitated; own or exalted Saturn gives disciplined belief instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo). Rejects religion bluntly.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus). Dutiful and non-ritual; less clearly a disbeliever.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn and the nodes in the 9th are classically linked to doubt and unorthodoxy.

hindi: शनि का विशेष तौर पर अगर आप शनि पा नव घर में लिंकेज है और आप पूजा पाठ करोगे तो वह आपका सत्यानाश
says: He singles out Saturn: if Saturn is linked to the 9th house and you do puja and rituals, it will ruin you, because it does not suit you.
cells_derived_method: Linkage means Saturn sits in, owns or aspects the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign in the 9th (lagna Taurus). Ritual puja backfires, simple duty is better.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) aspects the 9th by 7th aspect (3+6), so linkage exists.

ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next slice; 'पा नव' is garbled for 'ya nauve'.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice that Saturn worship pacifies Saturn.

hindi: करेगा आपको पूजा पाठ सूट नहीं करता है नो
says: Finishing the Saturn warning, he says the 9th-house Saturn person will be wrecked and that puja and ritual simply do not suit him.
cells_derived_method: none: it repeats the previous rule, which carries the house logic.
ambiguity: Completes the sentence cut at the slice boundary.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice that Saturn worship pacifies Saturn.

hindi: इसलिए जिन लोगों का जैसा जो रिलीजन चला हुआ है वह फेथ ही अगर आप चेंज कर देते हो तो बहुत बढ़िया ऑटोमेटिक नेगेटिव समाप्त हो गया
says: He says that for people whose inherited religion does not suit them, changing the faith itself is excellent and the negative effect ends automatically. A remedy claim recorded as his, not advice.
cells_derived_method: The new faith should be one whose deity fits the strong planet; for a Saturn or node 9th, a faith not driven by ritual puja is the point.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo). Moving to a faith with a different practice style may relieve the ritual clash.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign in the 9th (lagna Taurus). A duty-based faith suits, and a change may not be needed.

ambiguity: Which religions suit which planets is explained in the next sentences.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies do not advise changing religion.

hindi: बृहस्पति अपने आप में गुरु है बृहस्पति गुरु ग्रह मंगल सेनापति है
says: He gives the roles: Jupiter is the guru in itself, and Mars is the commander (senapati) among the planets.
cells_derived_method: Guru and commander show differently by house: Jupiter in the 9th or 5th teaches, Mars in the 3rd or 10th leads in action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer). Commander in the career house, a leader of forces.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries). A natural guru or teacher of dharma.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is guru; Mars is the army commander in classical lists.

hindi: मंगल और बृहस्पति के कॉमिनेशन सिख धर्म के पास है जिनका यह ग्रह स्ट्रांग है सिख धर्म गुरुद्वारे जाना शुरू करो
says: He links the Mars and Jupiter combination to Sikh religion and tells people whose Mars and Jupiter are strong to start going to the gurudwara. A remedy claim, recorded as his.
cells_derived_method: Strength of Mars and Jupiter by sign and house: both in own or exalted signs, or together, are strongest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter own in the 9th (lagna Aries) with Mars aspecting from Aries; strong pairing, gurudwara fits.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Pisces with Mars in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius). Together in a family house, the pairing is workable but weaker for ritual.

ambiguity: 'कॉमिनेशन' is garbled for 'combination'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie planets to religions.

gist: Mimics the delighted reaction of someone who finds a fitting faith: jackpot, it is happening in the guru's house, we are in good luck.
Repeats that this is the guru planet and Mars is the commander.

hindi: भगवान कहां है भगवान तो सूर्य है उसका तो लेना देना नहीं है
says: He asks where God is and answers that God is the Sun; the Sun has no connection with the Mars and Jupiter pairing.
cells_derived_method: The Sun as God sits in the 9th or 1st; Leo and Aries show it strongly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun in own sign Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius). Faith directed to God as the source of light.
Derived, not said by him: Sun exalted in Aries in lagna Aries. A strong sense of the divine self.

ambiguity: 'उसका' is read as the Mars and Jupiter combination.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun is the soul and divine light.

hindi: भगवान का है चंद्रमा है उसका तो लेना देना नहीं है शिवालय में जाते हो
says: He links the Moon to the Shiva temple (shivalaya): going to a Shiva temple belongs to the Moon, which is not part of the Sikh scheme.
ambiguity: The first words are garbled.
classical_check: Agrees that Shiva is the deity of the Moon (Somanatha).

hindi: चंद्रमा है पॉजिटिव होने पर बात हो रही है याय चंद्रमा है शिव शिवालय में जाओगे सारी मनोकामना पूरी होगी
says: He says that when the Moon is positive, visiting a Shiva temple will fulfil all wishes. A remedy claim.
cells_derived_method: A positive Moon is strong by sign or house: Taurus or Cancer, or the 4th, 9th or 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon own in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio). Shiva temple visits fit well.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius). Strong, so Shiva worship brings peace and home gains.

classical_check: Agrees that Shiva worship is traditional for the Moon; the guarantee of all wishes is his.

gist: Says Hindu dharma has so much depth that, if you know it exactly, it can launch you like a rocket.
Says other religions lack this depth and still run the same war story, so look carefully.
Says others have set a yardstick on earth: I have more notes than you, you have fewer than me.

hindi: आप शनि और शनि से नीचे के कार्य करेंगे आप पर नोट ज्यादा आएगा
says: He says that if you do the work of Saturn and the planets below Saturn, more money (notes) will come to you.
cells_derived_method: Saturn-level work is labour, mining, oil and land. The money reaches the native where those planets are strong in the 2nd, 10th or 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries). Earnings through labour, land and heavy industry.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries). Steady gains through large systems and groups.

ambiguity: 'शनि से नीचे' is read as the planets beyond Saturn in his list (Rahu, Ketu, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto).
classical_check: Partly agrees that Saturn is the karaka of labour and mining; wealth beyond Saturn is his own scheme.

hindi: लक्ष्मी कहां रहती है मूलाधार में धरती के गर्भ में है सब कुछ
says: He says Lakshmi, wealth, lives at the Muladhara (root chakra), in the womb of the earth, where everything is stored.
ambiguity: No house or sign is assigned to Muladhara here.
classical_check: Silent: the chakra link to Lakshmi is tantric and his own.

hindi: अभी हम नीचे के प्लेनेट पर जाएंगे तो नीचे तो सारा मटेरियल मिनरल तेल पानी खजाना तो धरती में ही है बाहर से थोड़ी आता है
says: He says that taking the lower planets, everything below is material: minerals, oil, water and treasure, all of it inside the earth and not coming from outside.
ambiguity: 'नीचे के प्लेनेट' is not listed.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn rules minerals and oil; the full lower-planet map is his own.

hindi: तो जो यह काम करता है उसम नोट तो ज्यादा ही होगा
says: He concludes that whoever does this earth-resource work will certainly have more money.
ambiguity: Not investment advice; his claim only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पर व नोट देगा कहां वह ज्ञानियों को ही दे जाएगा बाद में गिफ्ट ही करके जाएगा या आतंकवादी को देगा तो यह घटनाए दोनों साथ चलेंगी
says: He says such a rich person ends up giving the money away, either to the wise as gifts or to terrorists, so both kinds of events run side by side.
ambiguity: Garbled start 'पर व नोट देगा कहां'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Complains that some countries invented nothing, not even a needle, and only know shooting and killing.

hindi: तो क्या बनाया उन्होंने उन्होंने मृत्यु बनाई पर वो भी एक देवता है प्लूटो जैसी
says: He says what they made is death, yet that too is a deity, Pluto-like; the sentence continues next.
ambiguity: Cut at the slice boundary.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not classical.

hindi: कंट्री है प्लूटो है जो गवर्न करेगा तो क्या करेगा मौत ही देगा यमराज उसका तो काम यही है वो गलत थोड़ी कर रहा है
says: He says Pluto governs such a country, and Pluto, Yamraj, can only give death; that is his job and he is not doing wrong.
